name: Acuity Scheduling
description: Appointments, availability and clients of an Acuity Scheduling account.

tools.name: List appointments
tools.description: Lists the scheduled appointments of the account, newest first by default, up to max per call. There is no page token: when a call returns max appointments, narrow minDate and maxDate. Canceled appointments only come with canceled or showall.

params.name: minDate
params.description: Only the appointments on this date or after, such as 2026-11-01.

params.name: maxDate
params.description: Only the appointments on this date or before, such as 2026-11-30.

params.name: calendarID
params.description: Only the appointments on this calendar: an id from List calendars.

params.name: appointmentTypeID
params.description: Only the appointments of this type: an id from List appointment types.

params.name: canceled
params.description: true for only the canceled appointments.

params.name: showall
params.description: true for the canceled and the scheduled appointments together.

params.name: firstName
params.description: Only the appointments of clients with this first name.

params.name: lastName
params.description: Only the appointments of clients with this last name.

params.name: email
params.description: Only the appointments of the client with this email address.

params.name: phone
params.description: Only the appointments of the client with this phone number.

params.name: excludeForms
params.description: true to leave the intake form answers out of the response, which makes it faster.

params.name: direction
params.description: Order by date. The default is DESC, newest first.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of appointments to return. The default is 100.

tools.name: Get appointment
tools.description: Returns one appointment, with the client's name, email and phone, datetime, endTime, type, calendar, price, paid, notes, the intake answers in forms, labels and confirmationPage. A canceled appointment also has noShow.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the appointment: the id from List appointments or Create appointment.

params.name: pastFormAnswers
params.description: true to also return the previous answers given to the intake forms of the appointment.

tools.name: Create appointment
tools.description: Books an appointment and returns it. By default it is booked as a client would book it: the time must be open and the required intake fields answered. With admin true those checks are skipped and calendarID is required. The client gets the confirmation email and SMS unless noEmail is true.

params.name: datetime
params.description: Date and time of the appointment, such as 2026-11-05T14:00:00-0300: a time from List available times. Without an offset, it is read in the time zone of the business or the calendar.

params.name: appointmentTypeID
params.description: Id of the appointment type: an id from List appointment types.

params.name: calendarID
params.description: Id of the calendar: an id from List calendars. Without it, Acuity picks an available calendar. Required when admin is true.

params.name: firstName
params.description: First name of the client.

params.name: lastName
params.description: Last name of the client.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the client. Required unless admin is true.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the client. The account settings may require it, unless admin is true.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone of the client, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: certificate
params.description: Package or coupon code to apply to the appointment.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes on the appointment. Only with admin true.

params.name: fields
params.description: Answers to the intake form fields of the appointment type.

params.name: smsOptIn
params.description: true when the client agreed to receive SMS, for appointment types that ask for this consent. Without it, those types send no SMS reminder.

params.name: admin
params.description: true to book as the business: no availability or intake checks, notes allowed, and calendarID required.

params.name: noEmail
params.description: true to skip the confirmation email and SMS to the client.

tools.name: Update appointment
tools.description: Updates the client details, intake answers or notes of an appointment and returns it. Only the fields sent change, and firstName and lastName cannot be cleared. Date, time and calendar change with Reschedule appointment.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the appointment: the id from List appointments or Create appointment.

params.name: firstName
params.description: First name of the client.

params.name: lastName
params.description: Last name of the client.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the client. It can only be cleared when admin is true.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the client.

params.name: certificate
params.description: Package or coupon code to apply to the appointment. Only with admin true.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes on the appointment. Only with admin true.

params.name: fields
params.description: New answers to intake form fields of the appointment.

params.name: smsOptIn
params.description: true when the client agreed to receive SMS, for appointment types that ask for this consent. false stops the SMS reminder.

params.name: admin
params.description: true to update as the business: notes and certificate allowed, without the client validations.

tools.name: Cancel appointment
tools.description: Cancels an appointment and returns it. A canceled appointment cannot be restored. By default the cancellation rules for clients apply; with admin true they are skipped and noShow can be set. The client gets the cancellation email and SMS unless noEmail is true.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the appointment: the id from List appointments.

params.name: cancelNote
params.description: Message sent with the cancellation notifications.

params.name: noShow
params.description: true to mark the appointment as a no-show. Only with admin true.

params.name: admin
params.description: true to cancel as the business, without the cancellation rules for clients.

params.name: noEmail
params.description: true to skip the cancellation email and SMS to the client.

tools.name: Reschedule appointment
tools.description: Moves an appointment to another date and time, another calendar or both, and returns it. The new time must be open unless admin is true. Canceled appointments and class series cannot be rescheduled. The client gets the rescheduling email and SMS unless noEmail is true.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the appointment: the id from List appointments.

params.name: datetime
params.description: New date and time, such as 2026-11-06T15:00:00-0300: a time from List available times. Without an offset, it is read in the time zone of the business.

params.name: calendarID
params.description: Id of the new calendar: an id from List calendars. Without it, the appointment stays on its calendar.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone of the client, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: admin
params.description: true to reschedule as the business, without the availability checks.

params.name: noEmail
params.description: true to skip the rescheduling email and SMS to the client.

tools.name: List appointment types
tools.description: Lists the appointment types, the services and classes that clients book, with id, name, duration in minutes, price, type (service, class or series), private and calendarIDs, the calendars that offer each one.

params.name: includeDeleted
params.description: true to also return the deleted appointment types.

tools.name: List calendars
tools.description: Lists the calendars the account can access, usually one per staff member, with id, name, email, location and timezone.

tools.name: List available dates
tools.description: Lists the dates of a month that have open times for an appointment type, the same dates the client scheduling page shows. Each item has date.

params.name: month
params.description: Month to check, such as 2026-11.

params.name: appointmentTypeID
params.description: Id of the appointment type: an id from List appointment types.

params.name: calendarID
params.description: Id of a calendar from List calendars, to check only that calendar. By default, every calendar that offers the appointment type.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone for the dates, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

tools.name: List available times
tools.description: Lists the open start times of an appointment type on a date, the same times the client scheduling page shows. Each item has time, which goes as datetime to Create appointment or Reschedule appointment.

params.name: date
params.description: Date to check, such as 2026-11-05: a date from List available dates.

params.name: appointmentTypeID
params.description: Id of the appointment type: an id from List appointment types.

params.name: calendarID
params.description: Id of a calendar from List calendars, to check only that calendar. By default, every calendar that offers the appointment type.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone for the times, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

tools.name: List clients
tools.description: Lists the clients of the account, with firstName, lastName, email, phone and notes.

params.name: search
params.description: Text to look for in the first name, last name or phone number of the clients.

tools.name: Create client
tools.description: Adds a client to the client list and returns it. A client that already exists gets 400 with the message That client already exists.

params.name: firstName
params.description: First name of the client.

params.name: lastName
params.description: Last name of the client.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the client.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the client.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes about the client.

tools.name: List forms
tools.description: Lists the intake forms, with appointmentTypeIDs, the appointment types each form is on, and fields: each field has the id that Create appointment and Update appointment take, name, type, required and options.

name: Agendor
description: People, organizations, deals and tasks of an Agendor CRM account.

tools.name: List people
tools.description: Lists and searches the people of the account, 10 per page by default, in data, with meta.totalCount and the next page in links.next. Text filters match the beginning of the value.

params.name: name
params.description: Beginning of the name.

params.name: email
params.description: Beginning of the email address.

params.name: cpf
params.description: Beginning of the CPF.

params.name: phone
params.description: Number searched in every phone field.

params.name: organization
params.description: Id of an organization, from List organizations, to return its people.

params.name: userOwner
params.description: Id of the user who owns the people, from List users.

params.name: state
params.description: State abbreviation of the address.

params.name: createdAtGt
params.description: Returns people created after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: updatedAtGt
params.description: Returns people updated after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: withCustomFields
params.description: true includes the custom fields of each person.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: People per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Create person
tools.description: Creates a person, a contact of an organization in B2B or the customer in B2C, and returns it in data. name is required.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name. Required.

params.name: cpf
params.description: CPF, the Brazilian personal document number.

params.name: organization
params.description: Id of the organization the person works for, from List organizations.

params.name: role
params.description: Job title in the organization.

params.name: description
params.description: Notes about the person.

params.name: ownerUser
params.description: Id of the user who owns the person, from List users.

params.name: contact
params.description: Email, phones and social profiles.

params.name: address
params.description: Address. Only Brazilian addresses are supported.

params.name: leadOrigin
params.description: Lead origin, by its name as configured in the Agendor settings, for example Facebook Ads, or by its id.

params.name: customFields
params.description: Custom field values keyed by the identifier of each custom field configured in Agendor.

tools.name: Update person
tools.description: Updates the fields sent and returns the person in data. Fields left out keep their values.

params.name: customFields

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists and searches the organizations of the account, the B2B customers, 10 per page by default, in data, with meta.totalCount and the next page in links.next. Text filters match the beginning of the value, except nameExact.

params.name: name
params.description: Beginning of the trade name.

params.name: nameExact
params.description: Whole trade name, matched exactly.

params.name: cnpj
params.description: Beginning of the CNPJ.

params.name: email
params.description: Beginning of the email address.

params.name: phone
params.description: Number searched in every phone field.

params.name: userOwner
params.description: Id of the user who owns the organizations, from List users.

params.name: state
params.description: State abbreviation of the address.

params.name: createdAtGt
params.description: Returns organizations created after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: updatedAtGt
params.description: Returns organizations updated after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: withCustomFields
params.description: true includes the custom fields of each organization.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Organizations per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Create organization
tools.description: Creates an organization, a B2B customer, and returns it in data. name is required.

params.name: name

params.name: legalName
params.description: Legal name (razão social).

params.name: cnpj

params.name: website
params.description: Homepage URL.

params.name: description
params.description: Notes about the organization.

params.name: ownerUser
params.description: Id of the user who owns the organization, from List users.

params.name: contact

params.name: address

params.name: leadOrigin

params.name: customFields

params.name: description

tools.name: List deals
tools.description: Lists and searches the deals of the account, 10 per page by default, in data, with meta.totalCount and the next page in links.next. Each deal brings its status, stage, funnel, owner and the organization or person it belongs to.

params.name: title
params.description: Beginning of the title.

params.name: dealStatus
params.description: Status of the deals: 1 ongoing, 2 won, 3 lost.

params.name: dealStage
params.description: Id of a stage, from the dealStages of List funnels.

params.name: organization
params.description: Id of an organization, from List organizations.

params.name: person
params.description: Id of a person, from List people.

params.name: userOwner
params.description: Id of the user who owns the deals, from List users.

params.name: createdAtGt
params.description: Returns deals created after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: updatedAtGt
params.description: Returns deals updated after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: endAtGt
params.description: Returns deals finished after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: withCustomFields
params.description: true includes the custom fields of each deal.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Deals per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Create organization deal
tools.description: Creates a deal for an organization, the B2B case, and returns it in data. title is required. Without funnel and dealStage, the deal starts in the first stage of the default funnel.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Id of the organization, from List organizations or Create organization.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the deal. Required.

params.name: description
params.description: Notes about the deal.

params.name: value
params.description: Monetary value of the deal.

params.name: ownerUser
params.description: Id of the user who owns the deal, from List users.

params.name: funnel
params.description: Id of the funnel, from List funnels. Defaults to the default funnel.

params.name: dealStage
params.description: Position of the starting stage in the funnel, starting at 1: the sequence of the stage in List funnels, not its id.

params.name: startTime
params.description: When the deal started, in ISO 8601.

params.name: customFields
params.description: Custom field values keyed by the identifier of each custom field configured in Agendor.

tools.name: Create person deal
tools.description: Creates a deal for a person, the B2C case, and returns it in data. title is required. Without funnel and dealStage, the deal starts in the first stage of the default funnel.

params.name: person_id
params.description: Id of the person, from List people or Create person.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the deal. Required.

params.name: description
params.description: Notes about the deal.

params.name: value
params.description: Monetary value of the deal.

params.name: ownerUser
params.description: Id of the user who owns the deal, from List users.

params.name: funnel
params.description: Id of the funnel, from List funnels. Defaults to the default funnel.

params.name: dealStage
params.description: Position of the starting stage in the funnel, starting at 1: the sequence of the stage in List funnels, not its id.

params.name: startTime
params.description: When the deal started, in ISO 8601.

params.name: customFields
params.description: Custom field values keyed by the identifier of each custom field configured in Agendor.

tools.name: Update deal
tools.description: Updates the fields sent and returns the deal in data. dealStage moves the deal to another stage, and dealStatusText wins, loses or reopens it.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the deal, from List deals or one of the create deal tools.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the deal.

params.name: description
params.description: Notes about the deal.

params.name: value
params.description: Monetary value of the deal.

params.name: ownerUser
params.description: Id of the user who owns the deal, from List users.

params.name: dealStage
params.description: Position of the new stage in the funnel, starting at 1: the sequence of the stage in List funnels, not its id. Send funnel too when the deal is not in the default funnel.

params.name: funnel
params.description: Id of the funnel of the new stage, from List funnels.

params.name: dealStatusText
params.description: won or lost finishes the deal, and ongoing reopens it.

params.name: lossReason
params.description: Why the deal was lost. Only with dealStatusText lost.

params.name: endTime
params.description: When the deal was finished, in ISO 8601.

params.name: customFields
params.description: Custom field values keyed by the identifier of each custom field configured in Agendor.

tools.name: List tasks
tools.description: Lists the tasks and activities the user can see, 10 per page by default, in data. Without entityType and entityId, createdByUserId or sortBy, the call needs dueDateGt, createdDateGt or updatedDateGt, at most 31 days before the matching upper bound, or before today when there is none.

params.name: entityType
params.description: Kind of record whose tasks are returned. Goes together with entityId.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Id of the record, from List deals, List people or List organizations, matching entityType.

params.name: finishedEq
params.description: true returns only finished tasks, false only open ones.

params.name: dueDateGt
params.description: Returns tasks due on or after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: dueDateLt
params.description: Returns tasks due on or before this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: createdDateGt
params.description: Returns tasks created on or after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: updatedDateGt
params.description: Returns tasks updated on or after this date and time, in ISO 8601.

params.name: createdByUserId
params.description: Id of the user who created the tasks, from List users.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Date used to sort the results.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort direction. Only with sortBy.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Tasks per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Create deal task
tools.description: Creates a task on a deal, such as a call or a meeting to schedule, and returns it in data. text is required.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Id of the deal, from List deals or one of the create deal tools.

params.name: text
params.description: What has to be done.

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of task: visit, meeting, call, email, proposal or WhatsApp. Leave it out for a generic task.

params.name: due_date
params.description: Due date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-03T15:00:00-03:00.

params.name: assigned_users
params.description: Ids of the users assigned to the task, from List users.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the users of the Agendor account in data, with id, name, contact email and teams. Their ids are the owners and assignees the other tools take.

params.name: name
params.description: Beginning of the name.

params.name: email
params.description: Beginning of the email address.

params.name: active
params.description: true returns only active users, false only inactive ones.

tools.name: List funnels
tools.description: Lists the sales funnels of the account in data, each with its id and its dealStages, which bring the id, name and sequence of every stage. The funnel id and the stage sequence are what the deal tools take.

tools.name: List loss reasons
tools.description: Lists the loss reasons configured in the account in data, with id and name, for the lossReason of Update deal.

name: Asaas
description: Customers, payments and subscriptions of an Asaas account.

tools.name: List customers
tools.description: Lists the customers (payers) of the account, optionally filtered by name, email, CPF or CNPJ, group or external reference. The response has data, totalCount and hasMore; page with offset and limit while hasMore is true.

params.name: name
params.description: Only the customers with this name.

params.name: email
params.description: Only the customers with this email address.

params.name: cpfCnpj
params.description: Only the customer with this CPF or CNPJ, digits only.

params.name: groupName

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Only the customers with this identifier of your own system, saved in externalReference.

params.name: offset
params.description: Position of the first customer of the page. The default is 0; add limit to it for the next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Customers per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Get customer

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the customer, starting with cus_, from List customers or from the customer field of a payment or subscription returned by List payments or List subscriptions.

tools.name: Create customer
tools.description: Creates a customer, the payer of payments and subscriptions. name and cpfCnpj are required. There is no city field: Asaas takes the city from postalCode.

params.name: cpfCnpj

params.name: email

params.name: mobilePhone

params.name: phone

params.name: postalCode

params.name: address

params.name: addressNumber

params.name: complement

params.name: province
params.description: Neighborhood of the address.

params.name: company

params.name: additionalEmails
params.description: More email addresses for the payment notifications, separated by commas.

params.name: groupName

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Identifier of the customer in your own system.

params.name: observations

params.name: notificationDisabled

tools.name: List payments
tools.description: Lists the payments (cobrancas), optionally filtered by customer, subscription, status, billing type, payment date or external reference. Values are in reais. The response has data, totalCount and hasMore; page with offset and limit while hasMore is true.

params.name: customer
params.description: Only the payments of this customer, the cus_ id from List customers.

params.name: subscription
params.description: Only the payments generated by this subscription, the sub_ id from List subscriptions.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the payments in this status. PENDING waits for payment, OVERDUE is past the due date, CONFIRMED is paid by card but not yet credited, and RECEIVED is paid and credited.

params.name: billingType
params.description: Only the payments of this billing type. UNDEFINED is a payment where the payer chooses the method.

params.name: paymentDate
params.description: Only the payments paid on this date, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Only the payments with this identifier of your own system, saved in externalReference.

params.name: offset
params.description: Position of the first payment of the page. The default is 0; add limit to it for the next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Payments per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Get payment
tools.description: Returns one payment, with status, value, net value, due date, payment date and the links invoiceUrl (the payment page) and bankSlipUrl (the boleto).

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the payment, starting with pay_, from List payments or Create payment.

tools.name: Create payment
tools.description: Creates a payment (cobranca) for a customer, by boleto, Pix or credit card, one-time or in installments. The response has invoiceUrl, the payment page to send to the payer, and Asaas may notify the customer according to the customer notification settings.

params.name: customer
params.description: Id of the customer who pays, starting with cus_, from List customers or Create customer.

params.name: billingType
params.description: How the customer pays. UNDEFINED lets the payer choose among the methods enabled on the account, on the payment page.

params.name: value
params.description: Amount in reais, for example 129.9. Required for a one-time payment; for installments, send installmentCount with totalValue or installmentValue instead.

params.name: dueDate
params.description: Due date, in YYYY-MM-DD. For installments, the due date of the first one.

params.name: description
params.description: Description shown to the payer.

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Identifier of the payment in your own system, usable as a filter in List payments.

params.name: installmentCount
params.description: Number of installments, for a payment in installments. Send it with totalValue or with installmentValue, never both.

params.name: totalValue
params.description: Total in reais split into installmentCount installments. Asaas computes each installment and puts any rounding difference in the last one.

params.name: installmentValue
params.description: Value in reais of each installment, instead of totalValue.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discount for paying early.

params.name: interest
params.description: Interest for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the interest set on the account, because sending it overrides that setting for this payment.

params.name: fine
params.description: Fine for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the fine set on the account, because sending it overrides that setting for this payment.

tools.name: Update payment
tools.description: Updates a payment that is still pending or overdue; the customer cannot change. Send billingType, value and dueDate even when they stay the same, with the current values from Get payment. A new value or due date may notify the customer.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the payment, starting with pay_, from List payments or Create payment.

params.name: billingType
params.description: How the customer pays. UNDEFINED lets the payer choose among the methods enabled on the account, on the payment page.

params.name: value
params.description: Amount in reais, for example 129.9.

params.name: dueDate
params.description: Due date, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: description
params.description: Description shown to the payer.

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Identifier of the payment in your own system, usable as a filter in List payments.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discount for paying early.

params.name: interest
params.description: Interest for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the interest set on the account, because sending it overrides that setting for this payment.

params.name: fine
params.description: Fine for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the fine set on the account, because sending it overrides that setting for this payment.

tools.name: Delete payment
tools.description: Removes a payment, which can no longer be paid; it can be restored in Asaas. It does not refund an amount already paid, and removing a payment of a subscription does not end the subscription.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the payment, starting with pay_, from List payments or Create payment.

tools.name: List subscriptions
tools.description: Lists the subscriptions, optionally filtered by customer, status, billing type or external reference. The payments a subscription generates come from List payments with the subscription filter. Page with offset and limit while hasMore is true.

params.name: customer
params.description: Only the subscriptions of this customer, the cus_ id from List customers.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the subscriptions in this status. INACTIVE is suspended, and EXPIRED reached its end date or maximum of payments.

params.name: billingType
params.description: Only the subscriptions of this billing type.

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Only the subscriptions with this identifier of your own system, saved in externalReference.

params.name: includeDeleted
params.description: true also returns the removed subscriptions.

params.name: offset
params.description: Position of the first subscription of the page. The default is 0; add limit to it for the next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Subscriptions per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Create subscription
tools.description: Creates a subscription for a customer, which generates one payment per cycle, the first one due on nextDueDate. The payments show up in List payments with the subscription filter.

params.name: customer
params.description: Id of the customer who pays, starting with cus_, from List customers or Create customer.

params.name: billingType
params.description: How the customer pays each payment. UNDEFINED lets the payer choose among the methods enabled on the account.

params.name: value
params.description: Amount of each payment, in reais, for example 19.9.

params.name: nextDueDate
params.description: Due date of the first payment, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: cycle
params.description: How often a payment is generated. BIWEEKLY is every two weeks and BIMONTHLY every two months.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the subscription, shown to the payer.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Last due date of the subscription, in YYYY-MM-DD. Without it and maxPayments, the subscription has no end.

params.name: maxPayments
params.description: Maximum number of payments the subscription generates.

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Identifier of the subscription in your own system, usable as a filter in List subscriptions.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discount for paying each payment early.

params.name: interest
params.description: Interest for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the interest set on the account, because sending it overrides that setting.

params.name: fine
params.description: Fine for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the fine set on the account, because sending it overrides that setting.

tools.name: Update subscription
tools.description: Updates a subscription. Changes apply to the payments not generated yet, unless updatePendingPayments is true. status INACTIVE suspends the subscription and keeps its payments, and ACTIVE reactivates it with a new nextDueDate.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the subscription, starting with sub_, from List subscriptions or Create subscription.

params.name: value
params.description: New amount of each payment, in reais. A credit card subscription only changes value with card tokenization enabled on the account.

params.name: status
params.description: INACTIVE stops generating payments and keeps the existing ones. ACTIVE reactivates the subscription and needs a new nextDueDate.

params.name: nextDueDate
params.description: Due date of the next payment not generated yet, in YYYY-MM-DD. It does not move the payments already generated.

params.name: billingType
params.description: How the customer pays each payment. UNDEFINED lets the payer choose among the methods enabled on the account.

params.name: cycle
params.description: How often a payment is generated. BIWEEKLY is every two weeks and BIMONTHLY every two months.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the subscription, shown to the payer.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Last due date of the subscription, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: updatePendingPayments
params.description: true also applies the changes to the pending payments already generated.

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Identifier of the subscription in your own system, usable as a filter in List subscriptions.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discount for paying each payment early.

params.name: interest
params.description: Interest for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

params.name: fine
params.description: Fine for paying after the due date. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

name: Asana
description: Workspaces, projects, tasks and task comments of an Asana user.

tools.name: List workspaces
tools.description: Lists the workspaces and organizations the user can see. Use the gid of an item as workspace in the other tools. Send limit to page; the next_page.offset of the response goes in offset.

params.name: opt_fields
params.description: Comma-separated extra fields, for example name,is_organization. is_organization tells whether a project there needs a team.

params.name: limit
params.description: Workspaces per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: The next_page.offset of the previous response.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Lists the teams of an organization that the user can see. A project created in an organization needs the gid of one of them as team.

params.name: workspace_gid
params.description: Gid of the organization, from List workspaces.

params.name: limit
params.description: Teams per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: The next_page.offset of the previous response.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects of a workspace. Only gid and name come back unless opt_fields lists more. Send limit to page; the next_page.offset of the response goes in offset.

params.name: workspace
params.description: Gid of the workspace, from List workspaces. Send it: without a filter the call can time out in a large organization.

params.name: archived
params.description: true for the archived projects only, false for the active ones only.

params.name: opt_fields
params.description: Comma-separated extra fields, for example name,notes,due_on,owner.name,current_status_update.title,permalink_url.

params.name: limit
params.description: Projects per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: The next_page.offset of the previous response.

tools.name: Create project
tools.description: Creates a project and returns it. The fields go inside data, which needs name and workspace, plus team when the workspace is an organization.

params.name: data
params.description: The new project.

tools.name: Update project
tools.description: Updates a project and returns it. Only the fields sent inside data change.

params.name: project_gid
params.description: Gid of the project, from List projects.

params.name: data
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: List tasks
tools.description: Lists the tasks of a project or section, or the tasks assigned to someone in a workspace. Send project, or section, or assignee together with workspace. Only gid and name come back unless opt_fields lists more. Send limit to page; the next_page.offset of the response goes in offset.

params.name: project
params.description: Gid of the project, from List projects.

params.name: section
params.description: Gid of a section of a project.

params.name: assignee
params.description: me, an email or a user gid. Requires workspace.

params.name: workspace
params.description: Gid of the workspace. Requires assignee.

params.name: completed_since
params.description: Returns the incomplete tasks plus the ones completed after this date-time.

params.name: modified_since
params.description: Only the tasks modified after this date-time.

params.name: opt_fields
params.description: Comma-separated extra fields, for example name,completed,due_on,assignee.name,permalink_url.

params.name: limit
params.description: Tasks per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: The next_page.offset of the previous response.

tools.name: Get task
tools.description: Returns the full record of one task: name, notes, assignee, dates, completion, projects and custom fields.

params.name: task_gid
params.description: Gid of the task, from List tasks.

params.name: opt_fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return instead of the full record.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Creates a task and returns it. The fields go inside data, which needs workspace, projects or parent; projects and parent already set the workspace. Use due_on for a date or due_at for a date and time, never both.

params.name: data
params.description: The new task.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates a task and returns it. Only the fields sent inside data change; completed set to true completes the task. Projects and followers do not change here.

params.name: task_gid
params.description: Gid of the task, from List tasks.

params.name: data
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Deletes a task. It goes to the trash of the user and can be restored there within 30 days.

params.name: task_gid
params.description: Gid of the task, from List tasks.

tools.name: List task stories
tools.description: Lists the stories of a task, its comments and its activity, oldest first. Set resource_subtype to comment_added for the comments only. Send limit to page; the next_page.offset of the response goes in offset.

params.name: task_gid
params.description: Gid of the task, from List tasks.

params.name: resource_subtype
params.description: comment_added returns the comments only.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Only the stories created after this date-time, truncated to the second.

params.name: sort_ascending
params.description: false returns the newest first. The default is true.

params.name: limit
params.description: Stories per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: The next_page.offset of the previous response.

tools.name: Create task comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a task, authored by the connected user, and returns it. The text goes inside data.

params.name: task_gid
params.description: Gid of the task, from List tasks.

params.name: data
params.description: The comment.

name: Attio
description: Records, lists and notes of an Attio workspace.

tools.name: List objects
tools.description: Lists the objects of the workspace: the standard ones, such as people, companies and deals, and the custom ones. Use the api_slug of an item as object in the record tools and as parent_object in the entry and note tools.

tools.name: List attributes
tools.description: Lists the attributes of an object or of a list, in the order of the app, with the api_slug, the type and whether each one is required or unique. The slugs are the keys of values and entry_values in the other tools and of their filters.

params.name: target
params.description: objects for the attributes of records, lists for the attributes of list entries.

params.name: identifier
params.description: api_slug of the object from List objects, or api_slug of the list from List lists.

params.name: limit
params.description: Attributes per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Attributes to skip, for the next page.

params.name: show_archived
params.description: Also returns archived attributes.

tools.name: List records
tools.description: Lists the records of an object, with an optional filter and sorts. Each record comes with id.record_id and its values keyed by attribute slug. Paginate with limit, 500 by default, and offset.

params.name: object
params.description: api_slug of the object from List objects, such as people, companies or deals.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter keyed by attribute slug, in shorthand like {name: Acme} or verbose with operators such as $eq, $contains, $in, $not_empty, $and and $or. A person name is matched on name.full_name and an email on email_addresses.email_address.

params.name: sorts
params.description: Sort order, first item first.

params.name: limit
params.description: Records per page. The default is 500.

params.name: offset
params.description: Records to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: Get record
tools.description: Returns one record with all its values keyed by attribute slug and its web_url.

params.name: object
params.description: api_slug of the object from List objects, such as people, companies or deals.

params.name: record_id
params.description: id.record_id of the record, from List records or Create record.

tools.name: Create record
tools.description: Creates a record of an object, such as a person, a company or a deal. Fails when a unique attribute, such as a company domain or a person email, already belongs to another record. Returns the new record with id.record_id.

params.name: object
params.description: api_slug of the object from List objects, such as people, companies or deals.

params.name: data
params.description: The record to create.

tools.name: Update record
tools.description: Updates the given attributes of a record and leaves the others unchanged. Values of a multiselect attribute are added to the ones it already has.

params.name: object
params.description: api_slug of the object from List objects, such as people, companies or deals.

params.name: record_id
params.description: id.record_id of the record, from List records or Create record.

params.name: data
params.description: The attributes to change.

tools.name: List lists
tools.description: Lists the lists of the workspace, such as sales pipelines, in the order of the sidebar. Use the api_slug of an item as list in the entry tools; its parent_object says which object its records come from.

tools.name: List entries
tools.description: Lists the entries of a list, with an optional filter and sorts on the list attributes, such as the stage of a pipeline. Each entry has id.entry_id, parent_record_id and parent_object. Paginate with limit, 500 by default, and offset.

params.name: list
params.description: api_slug of the list from List lists.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter keyed by list attribute slug, in shorthand like {stage: Won} or verbose with operators such as $eq, $contains, $in, $and and $or.

params.name: sorts
params.description: Sort order, first item first.

params.name: limit
params.description: Entries per page. The default is 500.

params.name: offset
params.description: Entries to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: Create list entry
tools.description: Adds a record to a list as a new entry, with values for the list attributes, such as the stage. The same record can be added more than once. Returns the entry with id.entry_id.

params.name: list
params.description: api_slug of the list from List lists.

params.name: data
params.description: The entry to create.

tools.name: Update list entry
tools.description: Updates the list attributes of an entry, such as moving a deal to another stage of a pipeline, and leaves the others unchanged. Values of a multiselect attribute are added to the ones it already has.

params.name: list
params.description: api_slug of the list from List lists.

params.name: entry_id
params.description: id.entry_id of the entry, from List entries or Create list entry.

params.name: data
params.description: The list attributes to change.

tools.name: List notes
tools.description: Lists notes, of the whole workspace or of one record when parent_object and parent_record_id are set together. Each note has id.note_id, title and content in plain text and Markdown. Paginate with limit, 10 by default and up to 50, and offset.

params.name: parent_object
params.description: api_slug of the object of the record, from List objects.

params.name: parent_record_id
params.description: id.record_id of the record, from List records.

params.name: limit
params.description: Notes per page, up to 50. The default is 10.

params.name: offset
params.description: Notes to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: Create note
tools.description: Creates a note on a record. With format markdown, content takes headings, lists, bold, italic and links; with plaintext, a line break is a new line.

params.name: data
params.description: The note to create.

name: AWeber
description: Lists, subscribers and broadcast emails of an AWeber account.

tools.name: List accounts
tools.description: Returns the AWeber account the connection reaches, in entries, with its id, the accountId every other tool asks for, and the company name.

tools.name: List lists
tools.description: Lists the subscriber lists of the account, in entries, with id, name and the counts of subscribed, unconfirmed and unsubscribed subscribers. Only the first 100 come back; total_size has the count.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

tools.name: List subscribers
tools.description: Lists the subscribers of a list, in entries, with id, email, name, status, tags, custom fields and subscription date. Only the first 100 come back, oldest first unless sort_order is desc; total_size has the count.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Order by the date the subscriber joined the list: asc, the default, brings the oldest, and desc the newest.

tools.name: Get subscriber
tools.description: Returns one subscriber of a list with email, name, status, tags, custom fields, location and the follow-up messages already sent.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: subscriberId
params.description: Id of the subscriber, from List subscribers.

tools.name: Create subscriber
tools.description: Adds a subscriber to a list, which starts the follow-up series of the list. An email already on the list returns 400, unless update_existing is true. Add people one at a time: bulk adding through the API breaks the AWeber terms.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the subscriber.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the subscriber.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to apply. Tags can start automations of the account.

params.name: custom_fields
params.description: Values of the custom fields of the list, keyed by the field name as it appears in the custom_fields of List subscribers. The fields must already exist in the list.

params.name: ad_tracking
params.description: Label of where the subscriber came from.

params.name: misc_notes
params.description: Free notes about the subscriber.

params.name: update_existing
params.description: true updates the subscriber when the email is already on the list, adding the tags and keeping the status. When custom_fields is sent, the fields left out are cleared.

tools.name: Update subscriber
tools.description: Changes the subscriber of a list that has the given email. Setting status to unsubscribed stops the emails to the subscriber; tags take an add and a remove list.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: subscriber_email
params.description: Current email address of the subscriber.

params.name: email
params.description: New email address.

params.name: name
params.description: New name.

params.name: status
params.description: New status. unconfirmed can't be set.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to change.

params.name: custom_fields
params.description: Values of the custom fields, keyed by the field name as it appears in the custom_fields of Get subscriber. Send every field: the ones left out are cleared.

params.name: ad_tracking
params.description: Label of where the subscriber came from.

params.name: misc_notes
params.description: Free notes about the subscriber.

tools.name: List broadcasts
tools.description: Lists the broadcast emails of a list in one status, in entries: drafts created through the API, scheduled ones by send time or sent ones by send date. Only the first 100 come back; total_size has the count.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: status
params.description: Status of the broadcasts. draft only returns drafts created through the API.

tools.name: Get broadcast
tools.description: Returns one broadcast email with subject, content, status, schedule, archive URL and, once sent, its stats.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: broadcastId
params.description: Id of the broadcast, the broadcast_id from List broadcasts or Create broadcast.

tools.name: Create broadcast
tools.description: Creates a broadcast email as a draft for the list; nothing is sent until Schedule broadcast. The response has the broadcast_id.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line, not empty.

params.name: body_html
params.description: Content of the email in HTML.

params.name: body_text
params.description: Content of the email in plain text, for readers without HTML.

params.name: include_lists
params.description: Other lists to send to, as a JSON array of the self_link of each list from List lists.

params.name: exclude_lists
params.description: Lists whose subscribers are left out, as a JSON array of the self_link of each list from List lists.

params.name: click_tracking_enabled
params.description: true, the default, tracks the clicks on the links.

params.name: is_archived
params.description: true, the default, publishes the email on an archive URL that can be shared.

params.name: notify_on_send
params.description: true, the default, emails the account when the stats of the sent email are ready.

tools.name: Update broadcast
tools.description: Changes a draft broadcast. Only drafts created through the API can be changed.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: broadcastId
params.description: Id of the draft, the broadcast_id from List broadcasts or Create broadcast.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line, not empty.

params.name: body_html
params.description: Content of the email in HTML.

params.name: body_text
params.description: Content of the email in plain text, for readers without HTML.

params.name: include_lists
params.description: Other lists to send to, as a JSON array of the self_link of each list from List lists. Replaces the current value.

params.name: exclude_lists
params.description: Lists whose subscribers are left out, as a JSON array of the self_link of each list from List lists. Replaces the current value.

params.name: click_tracking_enabled
params.description: true tracks the clicks on the links.

params.name: is_archived
params.description: true publishes the email on an archive URL that can be shared.

params.name: notify_on_send
params.description: true emails the account when the stats of the sent email are ready.

tools.name: Schedule broadcast
tools.description: Schedules a draft broadcast to be sent to the list at the given time, which must be in the future. Cancel broadcast takes it back while it is scheduled.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: broadcastId
params.description: Id of the draft, the broadcast_id from List broadcasts or Create broadcast.

params.name: scheduled_for
params.description: When to send, in ISO 8601, such as 2026-11-03T14:00:00-03:00. A time in the past returns BroadcastDatetimeExpired.

tools.name: Cancel broadcast
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled broadcast before it is sent.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Id of the account, from List accounts.

params.name: listId
params.description: Id of the list, from List lists.

params.name: broadcastId
params.description: Id of the scheduled broadcast, the broadcast_id from List broadcasts.

name: Baremetrics
description: SaaS metrics, plans, customers, subscriptions and chart annotations of a Baremetrics account.

tools.name: List sources
tools.description: Lists the sources of the account: each connected payment provider, such as Stripe, and the Baremetrics API itself. The id of a source is the source_id that plans, customers and subscriptions take.

tools.name: Get metrics summary
tools.description: Returns all the metrics of the account for each day of a date range, such as mrr, arr, arpu, ltv, active_customers, new_customers and user_churn. Money values come in cents.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Get metric
tools.description: Returns the value of one metric for each day of a date range, each with the value of compare_to days before and the percent change. Money values come in cents, so an mrr of 6024087 is 60,240.87.

params.name: metric
params.description: Name of the metric.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: compare_to
params.description: How many days back each value is compared to. The default is 30.

tools.name: List metric customers
tools.description: Lists, for each day of a date range, the customers that make up a metric, with the MRR contribution of each one in cents and the current and previous plan. For example, the upgrades metric returns the customers who upgraded in the range.

params.name: metric

params.name: source_id
params.description: Id of the source, from List sources.

params.name: search

params.name: sort

params.name: order

params.name: page

params.name: per_page
params.description: Customers per page, up to 200. The default is 30.

params.name: page

tools.name: List annotations

params.name: page

params.name: per_page
params.description: Annotations per page, up to 200. The default is 30.

params.name: annotation

params.name: user_id

name: beehiiv

params.name: order_by

params.name: direction

params.name: limit

params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: publicationId

params.name: email

params.name: tier

params.name: direction

params.name: limit

params.name: subscriptionId

params.name: email

params.name: send_welcome_email

params.description: on asks for confirmation by email, off activates right away, not_set follows the setting of the publication.

params.name: tier

params.name: premium_tiers

params.name: utm_source

params.name: utm_medium

params.name: utm_campaign

params.name: referring_site

params.name: referral_code

params.name: custom_fields

params.name: tier

params.name: premium_tiers
params.description: Names of the premium tiers to assign, as shown in beehiiv.

params.name: unsubscribe

params.name: custom_fields
params.description: Custom field values to change, by field name. delete true removes the value of that field.

tools.name: Create subscription tag
tools.description: Adds tags to a subscription. A tag that does not exist in the publication yet is created.

params.name: publicationId
params.description: Id of the publication, from List publications.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Id of the subscription, from List subscriptions.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to add, such as webinar or customer.

tools.name: List posts
tools.description: Lists the posts of a publication with id, title, subtitle, status, publish_date and web_url. expand stats adds the email and web statistics of each post. Page with page and limit, up to 100; the response has total_pages.

params.name: publicationId
params.description: Id of the publication, from List publications.

params.name: expand
params.description: One addition per call: stats, recipients, or the rendered HTML of a version. The HTML is slow to render, and the call can answer 202 with Retry-After until it is ready.

params.name: status
params.description: Only posts in this status. confirmed is scheduled or published. The default is all.

params.name: platform
params.description: Only posts published to web, to email or to both. The default is all.

params.name: audience
params.description: Only posts for this audience. The default is all.

params.name: hidden_from_feed

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. The default is created.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort direction. The default is asc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Posts per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get post
tools.description: Returns one post; expand stats adds its email and web statistics. A post created moments ago can answer 202 while beehiiv builds it, and 404 with POST_CREATION_FAILED when the creation failed.

params.name: publicationId

params.name: postId

params.name: expand
params.description: One addition per call: stats, or the rendered HTML of a version.

params.description: utm_campaign of the links.

name: Bitly

params.name: group_guid

params.description: Only links created after this moment, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.description: Only links created before this moment, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.description: Shortens a long URL into a new Bitlink and returns it, with the short link in link and its id in id. It counts toward the monthly link limit of the plan, and features the plan lacks, like a custom back-half, answer 402 UPGRADE_REQUIRED.

params.name: long_url

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the link.

params.description: When the link stops redirecting, like 2026-12-31T23:59:00+0000: at least 5 minutes from now and at most 1 year.

name: Brevo

tools.description: Lists the contacts, newest first by default, optionally narrowed by list, date or attribute. The response has contacts and count; page with limit and offset.

params.name: listIds
params.description: Only the contacts of these lists, from List contact lists.

params.name: modifiedSince
params.description: Only the contacts modified after this date-time, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00.000Z.

params.name: createdSince

params.name: limit
