params.description: Order of creation. The default is desc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Lists per page, up to 50. The default is 10.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first list of the page. The default is 0.

tools.name: Create contact list
tools.description: Creates an empty contact list in a folder and returns its id.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the list.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of the folder of the list. The folderId of an existing list, from List contact lists, works.

tools.name: List email campaigns
tools.description: Lists the email campaigns, newest first by default. The response has campaigns and count; page with limit and offset. Statistics come back only when statistics is sent.

params.name: type
params.description: Only campaigns of this type.

params.name: status
params.description: Only campaigns in this status.

params.name: statistics
params.description: Statistics to include. They cover only the last 6 months; for older campaigns use Get email campaign.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Only campaigns sent from this date-time. Requires endDate, works only without status or with status sent, and the range is up to 2 years.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Only campaigns sent up to this date-time. Requires startDate.

params.name: excludeHtmlContent
params.description: true leaves the HTML of each campaign out of the response.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of creation. The default is desc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Campaigns per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first campaign of the page. The default is 0.

tools.name: Get email campaign
tools.description: Returns one email campaign with its settings, recipients and report statistics.

params.name: campaignId
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List email campaigns.

params.name: statistics
params.description: Only this group of statistics.

params.name: excludeHtmlContent
params.description: true leaves the HTML of the campaign out of the response.

tools.name: Create email campaign
tools.description: Creates an email campaign as a draft and returns its id. Send the content in exactly one of htmlContent, htmlUrl or templateId. Setting scheduledAt schedules the sending, and then recipients are required.

params.name: name
params.description: Internal name of the campaign.

params.name: sender
params.description: Sender of the campaign: email and name, or the id of a sender of the account. Never email and id together.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: previewText
params.description: Preview text shown after the subject in the inbox.

params.name: htmlContent
params.description: Body of the email as HTML, more than 10 characters and under 1 MB.

params.name: htmlUrl
params.description: URL of the HTML body of the email.

params.name: templateId
params.description: Id of an active email template, shown next to its name in the templates list of Brevo. Its content is copied into the campaign.

params.name: recipients
params.description: Who receives the campaign: listIds from List contact lists, with optional exclusionListIds.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: Email address that receives the replies.

params.name: toField
params.description: Personalized To field, for example {FIRSTNAME} {LASTNAME}. The attributes must exist in the account.

params.name: scheduledAt
params.description: When to send, with the time zone, for example 2026-06-01T12:30:00-03:00. It schedules the sending.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag of the campaign.

params.name: utmCampaign
params.description: utm_campaign value of the links, letters, digits and spaces only. The default is the campaign name.

tools.name: Update email campaign
tools.description: Updates a draft or scheduled email campaign. Only the fields sent change. Setting scheduledAt schedules the sending.

params.name: campaignId
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List email campaigns.

params.name: name
params.description: Internal name of the campaign.

params.name: sender
params.description: Sender of the campaign: email and name, or the id of a sender of the account. Never email and id together.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: previewText
params.description: Preview text shown after the subject in the inbox.

params.name: htmlContent
params.description: Body of the email as HTML. Do not send it together with htmlUrl.

params.name: htmlUrl
params.description: URL of the HTML body of the email. Do not send it together with htmlContent.

params.name: recipients
params.description: Who receives the campaign: listIds from List contact lists, with optional exclusionListIds. Update listIds only on a campaign created with listIds.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: Email address that receives the replies.

params.name: toField
params.description: Personalized To field, for example {FIRSTNAME} {LASTNAME}.

params.name: scheduledAt
params.description: When to send, with the time zone, for example 2026-06-01T12:30:00-03:00. It schedules the sending.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag of the campaign.

params.name: utmCampaign
params.description: utm_campaign value of the links, letters, digits and spaces only.

tools.name: Send email campaign
tools.description: Sends an email campaign to its recipients right away. The campaign needs recipients and content, and the sending spends email credits: without enough credits the app answers 402.

params.name: campaignId
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List email campaigns.

tools.name: Send transactional email
tools.description: Sends a transactional email to the addresses in to, right away or at scheduledAt, and returns its messageId. Send sender, subject and htmlContent or textContent, or a templateId, whose sender and subject apply unless sent.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipients of the email.

params.name: sender
params.description: Sender: email and name, or the id of a sender of the account. Required without templateId.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email. Required without templateId.

params.name: htmlContent
params.description: Body of the email as HTML. Required without templateId.

params.name: textContent
params.description: Plain text body of the email. Ignored with templateId.

params.name: templateId
params.description: Id of a transactional template, shown next to its name in the templates list of Brevo.

params.name: params
params.description: Values for the variables of the template, as key and value.

params.name: cc
params.description: Recipients in copy.

params.name: bcc
params.description: Recipients in blind copy.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: Address that receives the replies.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to categorize the email.

params.name: scheduledAt
params.description: When to send, with the time zone. Scheduled emails may go out up to 5 minutes late.

name: Calendly
description: Event types, scheduled events and invitees of a Calendly user.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Returns the connected Calendly user: uri, the user URI that List event types, List scheduled events and Create event type ask for, and current_organization, the organization URI, with name, email, scheduling_url and timezone.

tools.name: List event types
tools.description: Lists the event types of a user or of an organization: send user or organization. Each item has uri, name, duration in minutes, scheduling_url and active. The response has collection and pagination: pass pagination.next_page_token as page_token to read the next page.

params.name: user
params.description: URI of the user whose event types to list: the uri from Get current user. Send user or organization.

params.name: organization
params.description: URI of the organization, to list all of its event types: the current_organization from Get current user. Send user or organization.

params.name: active
params.description: true for only the active event types, false for only the inactive ones. Omit it for all.

params.name: admin_managed
params.description: true for only the event types managed by an admin, false to leave them out. Omit it for all.

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated field:direction pairs. The fields are name, position, created_at and updated_at, and the direction is asc or desc. The default is name:asc.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The pagination.next_page_token of the previous response, sent with the same filters.

params.name: count
params.description: Event types per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: Get event type
tools.description: Returns one event type, with name, duration in minutes, duration_options, locations, custom_questions (the booking questions that Create event invitee answers), scheduling_url and active.

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the event type: the last segment of its uri, from List event types.

tools.name: Create event type
tools.description: Creates a one-on-one event type for a user and returns it. Only this kind (solo) can be created through the API, and it is created inactive unless active is true.

params.name: owner
params.description: URI of the user who hosts the event type: the uri from Get current user.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the event type, shown on the scheduling page.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the event type, shown on the scheduling page.

params.name: active
params.description: true to make the event type bookable right away. The default is false.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the meetings in minutes, from 1 to 720. When duration_options is sent, it must be one of the options.

params.name: duration_options
params.description: Up to 4 different lengths in minutes, each from 1 to 720, for the invitee to choose from.

params.name: locations
params.description: Each place where the meeting can happen. The invitee chooses one when there is more than one.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the scheduling page, as a hexadecimal value in lowercase such as #1a73e8.

params.name: locale
params.description: Language of the scheduling page.

tools.name: Update event type
tools.description: Updates a one-on-one event type and returns it. Only the fields sent change. Only event types of the solo kind can be updated through the API.

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the event type: the last segment of its uri, from List event types.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the event type, shown on the scheduling page.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the event type, shown on the scheduling page.

params.name: active
params.description: true to make the event type bookable, false to turn it off.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the meetings in minutes, from 1 to 720. When duration_options is sent, it must be one of the options.

params.name: duration_options
params.description: Up to 4 different lengths in minutes, each from 1 to 720, for the invitee to choose from.

params.name: locations
params.description: Each place where the meeting can happen. The invitee chooses one when there is more than one.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the scheduling page, as a hexadecimal value in lowercase such as #1a73e8.

params.name: locale
params.description: Language of the scheduling page.

tools.name: List event type available times
tools.description: Lists the open start times of an event type in a range of up to 31 days in the future. Each item has start_time in UTC, invitees_remaining and scheduling_url. There is no pagination: ask for a shorter range when needed.

params.name: event_type
params.description: URI of the event type: the uri from List event types.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start of the range, in UTC, such as 2026-11-02T00:00:00Z. It cannot be in the past.

params.name: end_time
params.description: End of the range, in UTC, in the future and at most 31 days after start_time.

tools.name: List scheduled events
tools.description: Lists the scheduled meetings of a user or of an organization: send user or organization. Each item has uri, name, status, start_time and end_time in UTC, event_type and invitees_counter. The response has collection and pagination: pass pagination.next_page_token as page_token to read the next page.

params.name: user
params.description: URI of a user: the uri from Get current user. Alone, it returns the events of the connected user. With organization, an owner or admin gets the events of that member.

params.name: organization
params.description: URI of the organization: the current_organization from Get current user. It returns the events of every member and needs an owner or admin of the organization.

params.name: invitee_email
params.description: Only the events booked by this invitee email address.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the active or only the canceled events.

params.name: min_start_time
params.description: Only the events that start after this moment, in UTC, such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: max_start_time
params.description: Only the events that start before this moment, in UTC, such as 2026-11-30T23:59:59Z.

params.name: sort
params.description: start_time:asc or start_time:desc.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The pagination.next_page_token of the previous response, sent with the same filters.

params.name: count
params.description: Events per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: Get scheduled event
tools.description: Returns one scheduled meeting, with name, status, start_time and end_time in UTC, event_type, location, invitees_counter, event_memberships (the hosts) and, when it was canceled, cancellation.

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the scheduled event: the last segment of its uri, from List scheduled events or the event of an invitee from Create event invitee.

tools.name: Cancel scheduled event
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled meeting for all of its invitees and returns the cancellation. A group event is canceled as a whole: one invitee of a group event cannot be canceled through the API.

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the scheduled event: the last segment of its uri, from List scheduled events.

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the cancellation.

tools.name: List event invitees
tools.description: Lists the invitees of a scheduled meeting, with name, email, status, questions_and_answers, tracking (the UTM parameters of the booking), no_show, cancel_url and reschedule_url. The response has collection and pagination: pass pagination.next_page_token as page_token to read the next page.

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the scheduled event: the last segment of its uri, from List scheduled events.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the active or only the canceled invitees.

params.name: email
params.description: Only the invitee with this email address.

params.name: sort
params.description: created_at:asc or created_at:desc. The default is created_at:asc.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The pagination.next_page_token of the previous response, sent with the same filters.

params.name: count
params.description: Invitees per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: Create event invitee
tools.description: Books a meeting on an open time of an event type and returns the invitee, with event (the scheduled event URI), cancel_url and reschedule_url. Calendly sends the confirmations and calendar invites as when the invitee books on the scheduling page. Only users on a paid plan can book through the API: the Free plan gets 403.

params.name: event_type
params.description: URI of the event type: the uri from List event types.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start of the meeting in UTC, such as 2026-11-05T18:30:00Z: one of the start_time values from List event type available times.

params.name: invitee
params.description: The person who books the meeting. Send name, or first_name and last_name.

params.name: location
params.description: Where the meeting happens: one of the locations of the event type, from Get event type. Required when the event type has a location, and left out when it has none or uses round robin.

params.name: questions_and_answers
params.description: Answers to the booking questions, which are the custom_questions of the event type, from Get event type. Every required question must be answered.

params.name: tracking
params.description: UTM parameters to store with the booking. They come back in the tracking of the invitee.

params.name: event_guests
params.description: Email addresses of up to 10 guests to invite to the meeting.

tools.name: Create scheduling link
tools.description: Creates a single-use scheduling link for an event type and returns its booking_url, to send to one person. The link is good for one booking, and an unused link expires after 90 days.

params.name: max_event_count
params.description: Always 1: the link books a single meeting.

params.name: owner
params.description: URI of the event type: the uri from List event types.

params.name: owner_type
params.description: Always EventType.

name: Canva
description: Designs, exports, folders and uploaded images of a Canva user.

tools.name: List designs
tools.description: Lists the designs in the projects of the user and the ones shared with them, with id, title, thumbnail, page_count and the edit and view urls. When the response has continuation, pass it as continuation to read the next page.

params.name: query
params.description: Search terms matched against the designs.

params.name: ownership
params.description: any, the default, lists both; owned only the designs of the user; shared only the ones shared with them.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Order of the designs. The default is relevance.

params.name: limit
params.description: Designs per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: Get design
tools.description: Returns a design with its title, owner, thumbnail, page_count and the edit and view urls. Those urls are temporary and open only for the connected user.

params.name: designId
params.description: Id of the design, from List designs, List folder items or Create design.

tools.name: Create design
tools.description: Creates a design and returns it with its id and the edit and view urls. Send design_type, asset_id or both. A blank design that nobody edits within 7 days is deleted for good, without going to the trash.

params.name: type
params.description: Creation mode. type_and_asset, the only one here and the one Canva assumes when it is left out, creates the design from design_type and asset_id.

params.name: design_type
params.description: Kind of design: a preset with name, or custom with width and height in pixels, each between 40 and 8000 and at most 25,000,000 pixels in total.

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Id of an image asset to place in the design, from List folder items or Get URL asset upload.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the design.

tools.name: List design export formats
tools.description: Lists the formats a design can be exported to, which depend on its type and pages. A format with page_numbers works only for those pages.

params.name: designId
params.description: Id of the design, from List designs, List folder items or Create design.

tools.name: Create design export
tools.description: Starts exporting a design as PDF, JPG, PNG, PPTX or GIF and returns the job with its id. Call Get design export until status is success: the urls of the files are valid for 24 hours. Each user can export 75 times every 5 minutes and 500 times a day.

params.name: design_id
params.description: Id of the design, from List designs, List folder items or Create design.

params.name: format
params.description: File format and its options. quality is required for jpg. size works only for pdf of a Canva doc; lossless, transparent_background and as_single_image only for png.

tools.name: Create design video export
tools.description: Starts exporting a design as an MP4 video and returns the job with its id. Call Get design export until status is success: the urls of the files are valid for 24 hours. Each user can export 75 times every 5 minutes and 500 times a day.

params.name: design_id
params.description: Id of the design, from List designs, List folder items or Create design.

params.name: format
params.description: Video format and its options.

tools.name: Get design export
tools.description: Returns an export job: status in_progress, success or failed, and, with success, the urls of the files, one per page depending on the format, valid for 24 hours. Call it again, with growing waits, while status is in_progress.

params.name: exportId
params.description: Id of the job, from Create design export or Create design video export.

tools.name: List folder items
tools.description: Lists the folders, designs and images in a folder, each with its type, the folder, design or image object and its id. Video assets are not listed. When the response has continuation, pass it as continuation to read the next page.

params.name: folderId
params.description: root for the top level of the projects, uploads for the Uploads folder, or the id of a folder listed by List folder items.

params.name: item_types
params.description: Comma-separated types to list, among design, folder and image, like design,image. All three by default.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Order of the items. The default is modified_descending.

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: Get asset
tools.description: Returns an asset with its name, tags, thumbnail, owner and dates.

params.name: assetId
params.description: Id of the asset, from List folder items or Get URL asset upload.

tools.name: Update asset
tools.description: Updates the name or the tags of an asset and returns it. The tags sent replace all the current tags.

params.name: assetId
params.description: Id of the asset, from List folder items or Get URL asset upload.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the asset, shown in Canva.

params.name: tags
params.description: New tags of the asset.

tools.name: Create URL asset upload
tools.description: Starts uploading a file from a public URL to the Uploads of the user and returns the job with its id. Call Get URL asset upload until status is success, which brings the asset and its id. Videos go up to 100 MB.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the asset in Canva.

params.name: url
params.description: Public URL of the file, reachable from the internet.

tools.name: Get URL asset upload
tools.description: Returns an upload job: status in_progress, success or failed, and, with success, the asset with its id. Call it again, with growing waits, while status is in_progress.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Id of the job, from Create URL asset upload.

name: Capsule CRM
description: People, organisations, opportunities and tasks of a Capsule CRM account.

tools.name: List parties
tools.description: Lists the people and organisations of the account, 50 per page by default. Paginate with page, starting at 1, and perPage, up to 100; a page shorter than perPage is the last one.

params.name: since
params.description: Only parties changed after this moment, in ISO 8601.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Parties per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: embed
params.description: Comma-separated extra data to include: tags, fields, organisation or missingImportantFields. Custom fields only come back with fields.

tools.name: Search parties
tools.description: Searches people and organisations with the same results as the global search of Capsule, by a name, a postcode or a phone number, for example. Paginate with page, starting at 1, and perPage, up to 100.

params.name: q
params.description: Text to search for, such as a name, a postcode or a phone number.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Parties per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: embed
params.description: Comma-separated extra data to include: tags, fields, organisation or missingImportantFields.

tools.name: Get party
tools.description: Returns one person or organisation, with its email addresses, phone numbers, addresses and websites and the id of each of them.

params.name: partyId
params.description: Id of the party, from List parties or Search parties, or the party.id of an opportunity or task.

params.name: embed
params.description: Comma-separated extra data to include: tags, fields, organisation or missingImportantFields.

tools.name: Create party
tools.description: Creates a person or an organisation. Send firstName and lastName for a person and name for an organisation. organisation links a person by id, or by name, which creates the organisation when it does not exist yet. Without owner, the party goes to the connected user.

params.name: party
params.description: The party to create.

tools.name: Update party
tools.description: Updates a person or an organisation; fields left out stay unchanged. In the arrays, an item without id is added, an item with id is changed, and an item with id and _delete set to true is removed. The ids come from Get party.

params.name: partyId
params.description: Id of the party, from List parties, Search parties or Create party.

params.name: party
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: List opportunities
tools.description: Lists the opportunities of the account, with party, milestone, value and expectedCloseOn, 50 per page by default. Paginate with page, starting at 1, and perPage, up to 100; a page shorter than perPage is the last one.

params.name: since
params.description: Only opportunities changed after this moment, in ISO 8601.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Opportunities per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: embed
params.description: Comma-separated extra data to include: tags, fields, party, milestone or missingImportantFields.

tools.name: Create opportunity
tools.description: Creates an opportunity for a party, at a milestone of a pipeline. name, party and milestone are required.

params.name: opportunity
params.description: The opportunity to create.

tools.name: Update opportunity
tools.description: Updates an opportunity; fields left out stay unchanged. Moving it to another milestone, such as Won or Lost, is a change of milestone.

params.name: opportunityId
params.description: Id of the opportunity, from List opportunities or Create opportunity.

params.name: opportunity
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: List pipelines
tools.description: Lists the sales pipelines of the account. Use the id of a pipeline in List pipeline milestones.

params.name: includeDeleted
params.description: Also returns archived pipelines.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Pipelines per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

tools.name: List pipeline milestones
tools.description: Lists the milestones of a pipeline, with the probability of each; complete is true on the ones that close the opportunity, such as Won and Lost. Use the id of a milestone as milestone in the opportunity tools.

params.name: pipelineId
params.description: Id of the pipeline, from List pipelines.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Milestones per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the users of the account, with name and username. Use the id of a user as owner in the party, opportunity and task tools.

tools.name: List tasks
tools.description: Lists the tasks of the account, only the open ones unless status says otherwise. Each task has dueOn, owner and the party or opportunity it is linked to. Paginate with page, starting at 1, and perPage, up to 100.

params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated statuses to return: open, completed or pending. The default is open.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Tasks per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: embed
params.description: Comma-separated extra data to include: party, opportunity, kase, owner or nextTask.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Creates a task due on dueOn, optionally at dueTime, linked to a party or to an opportunity, never both. description and dueOn are required.

params.name: task
params.description: The task to create.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates a task; fields left out stay unchanged. Set status to COMPLETED to complete it.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Id of the task, from List tasks or Create task.

params.name: task
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Deletes a task for good. To close a task that was done, use Update task with status COMPLETED instead.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Id of the task, from List tasks or Create task.

name: Chatwoot
description: Conversations, messages and contacts of Chatwoot Cloud accounts.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Lists conversations of an account, the open ones by default, with status, labels, inbox_id, can_reply, the contact in meta.sender, the assignee and the last message. data.meta has the counts by assignee type. Pages are numbered from 1; an empty payload means there are no more pages.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the Chatwoot account: the id of one of the accounts from Get profile, also shown in the dashboard URL after /accounts/, as in app.chatwoot.com/app/accounts/123.

params.name: status
params.description: Only conversations with this status. The default is open.

params.name: assignee_type
params.description: Only conversations assigned to the user of the connection, unassigned, assigned to anyone, or all (the default).

params.name: q
params.description: Only conversations with messages containing this text.

params.name: inbox_id
params.description: Only conversations of this inbox, from List inboxes.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Only conversations of this team, from List teams.

params.name: labels
params.description: Only conversations with this label. One label per call.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Starts a conversation with a contact in an inbox, optionally with a first message. source_id identifies the contact in that inbox: it comes from contact_inboxes of Search contacts, from Create contact or from Create contact inbox. On WhatsApp inboxes, the first message goes as an approved template in message.template_params.

params.description: Id of the Chatwoot account: the id of one of the accounts from Get profile, also shown in the dashboard URL after /accounts/, as in app.chatwoot.com/app/accounts/123.

params.description: source_id of the contact in the inbox, from contact_inboxes of Search contacts, Create contact or Create contact inbox. Each item pairs an inbox with its source_id.

params.name: inbox_id
params.description: Inbox of the conversation, the same of the source_id, from List inboxes.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from Search contacts.

params.name: status

params.name: assignee_id
params.description: Id of the agent to assign, from List agents.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Id of the team to assign, from List teams.

params.name: custom_attributes

params.name: message
params.description: First message of the conversation, sent to the contact.

tools.name: Update conversation status
tools.description: Sets the status of a conversation: open, resolved, pending or snoozed. Without snoozed_until a snoozed conversation waits for the next reply of the contact, and any reply of the contact reopens it.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the Chatwoot account: the id of one of the accounts from Get profile, also shown in the dashboard URL after /accounts/, as in app.chatwoot.com/app/accounts/123.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations.

params.name: status
params.description: New status of the conversation.

params.name: snoozed_until
params.description: With snoozed: when the conversation reopens, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

tools.name: Assign conversation
tools.description: Assigns a conversation to an agent or to a team. When assignee_id is sent, team_id is ignored.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the Chatwoot account: the id of one of the accounts from Get profile, also shown in the dashboard URL after /accounts/, as in app.chatwoot.com/app/accounts/123.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations.

params.name: labels
params.description: Full list of label names the conversation should have, such as support or billing.

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: Returns the latest messages of a conversation in ascending order, with meta holding its labels, contact and assignee. sender_type says who sent each message, and private marks internal notes. For older messages, pass before with the id of the oldest one received.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the Chatwoot account: the id of one of the accounts from Get profile, also shown in the dashboard URL after /accounts/, as in app.chatwoot.com/app/accounts/123.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations.

params.name: before
params.description: Returns up to 20 messages before the message with this id, from a previous response.

params.name: after
params.description: Returns up to 100 messages after the message with this id, from a previous response.

tools.name: Create message
tools.description: Sends a message in a conversation. An outgoing message goes to the contact through the channel of the inbox, such as WhatsApp, email or the website widget; private true makes it an internal note only agents see. On WhatsApp, template_params sends an approved template.

params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations.

params.name: content
params.description: Text of the message. With a template, the rendered text of the template.

params.description: outgoing is a message to the contact; incoming records a message as sent by the contact.

params.name: private
params.description: true makes the message an internal note, not sent to the contact.

params.name: template_params
params.description: WhatsApp template approved in WhatsApp Business Manager.

name: ClickUp
description: Spaces, Lists, tasks and task comments of the ClickUp Workspaces a user authorized.

tools.description: Lists the Workspaces (called teams in API v2) that the user authorized for the connection, each with its id and its members. The user ids of the members are the ones the assignee arguments take.

params.description: Only entries from this moment on, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z.

params.name: end
params.description: Only entries up to this moment, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z.

params.name: description
params.description: Only entries whose description contains this text.

params.name: project
params.description: Only the entries of this project, by id from List projects.

params.name: task
params.description: Only the entries of this task, by id from List tasks.

params.name: hydrated
params.description: True to bring the project, task and tags of each entry.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to fetch, starting at 1. Pages have 50 items, and a page with fewer is the last one.

tools.name: Create time entry
tools.description: Creates a time entry for the connected user. Requires start. Without end, it starts a running timer, which Stop timer ends. If the workspace has required custom fields for time entries, Clockify refuses the entry.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List workspaces or the activeWorkspace of Get current user.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the entry, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the entry, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z. Leave it out to start a running timer.

params.name: description
params.description: What was done.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Id of a task of that project, from List tasks.

params.name: billable
params.description: True when the time is billable.

tools.name: Update time entry
tools.description: Updates a time entry. Requires start. It is a full update: send also the end, description, projectId, taskId and billable to keep, because a field left out may be cleared.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List workspaces or the activeWorkspace of Get current user.

params.name: timeEntryId
params.description: Id of the time entry, from List time entries.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the entry, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the entry, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z.

params.name: description
params.description: What was done.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Id of a task of that project, from List tasks.

params.name: billable
params.description: True when the time is billable.

tools.name: Delete time entry
tools.description: Deletes a time entry.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List workspaces or the activeWorkspace of Get current user.

params.name: timeEntryId
params.description: Id of the time entry, from List time entries.

tools.name: Stop timer
tools.description: Stops the running timer of a user in a workspace, setting the end of that entry. Requires end.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List workspaces or the activeWorkspace of Get current user.

params.name: userId
params.description: Id of the user, from Get current user for the connected user or from List users for someone else.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the running entry, as UTC in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as 2026-10-26T13:00:00Z.

name: Cloudflare
description: Zones, DNS records and cache of a Cloudflare account.

tools.name: List zones
tools.description: Lists the zones (domains) the token reaches, with id, name, status, name_servers, plan and account. The id is the zone_id the other tools take. Paginate with page and per_page; result_info.total_pages tells how many pages there are.

params.name: name
params.description: Domain of the zone, such as example.com. To search part of it, prefix contains:, such as contains:shop.

params.name: status
params.description: Only zones in this status. pending means the name servers still do not point to Cloudflare.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort order.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Zones per page, from 5 to 50. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Create zone
tools.description: Adds a domain to a Cloudflare account and returns the zone in pending status, with the name_servers to set at the domain registrar. The zone becomes active once the registrar points to them.

params.name: name
params.description: The domain, such as example.com.

params.name: account
params.description: Account that receives the zone.

params.name: type
params.description: full when Cloudflare hosts the DNS (the default); partial for a CNAME setup with DNS hosted elsewhere, only on Business and Enterprise plans.

tools.name: Update zone
tools.description: Pauses or resumes Cloudflare on a zone and returns it. With paused true the zone keeps only the DNS, without the security and performance features of Cloudflare.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: The id of the zone, from List zones.

params.name: paused
params.description: true pauses Cloudflare on the zone, false resumes it.

tools.name: List DNS records
tools.description: Lists the DNS records of a zone, with id, type, name, content, proxied, ttl and comment. Filters work together unless match is any. Paginate with page and per_page; result_info.total_pages tells how many pages there are.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: The id of the zone, from List zones.

params.name: type
params.description: Only records of this type.

params.name: name
params.description: Exact full name of the record, including the zone, such as www.example.com.

params.name: content
params.description: Exact content of the record, such as an IP address.

params.name: comment
params.description: Exact comment of the record.

params.name: proxied
params.description: Only records that go, or do not go, through the Cloudflare proxy.

params.name: match
params.description: all requires every filter (the default); any accepts records that pass at least one.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field. The default is type.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort order. The default is asc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Records per page. The default is 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Create DNS record
tools.description: Creates a DNS record in a zone and returns it, with its id. A and AAAA records cannot share a name with a CNAME, and an NS record cannot share a name with any other record.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: The id of the zone, from List zones.

params.name: type
params.description: Record type.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name of the record, including the zone, such as www.example.com; the zone itself for the root.

params.name: content
params.description: Value of the record: the IPv4 or IPv6 address, the target host of a CNAME, MX or NS, or the text of a TXT. CAA and SRV records use data instead.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Time to live in seconds, from 60 to 86400, or 1 for automatic (the default).

params.name: proxied
params.description: Sends the traffic through Cloudflare. Only for A, AAAA and CNAME records. The default is false.

params.name: priority
params.description: Required for MX records. Lower values are preferred.

params.name: comment
params.description: Note about the record, with no effect on DNS answers.

params.name: data
params.description: Parts of a CAA or SRV record: flags, tag and value for CAA, such as {flags: 0, tag: issue, value: letsencrypt.org}; priority, weight, port and target for SRV.

tools.name: Update DNS record
tools.description: Changes a DNS record and returns it. Only the fields sent change. A and AAAA records cannot share a name with a CNAME, and an NS record cannot share a name with any other record.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: The id of the zone, from List zones.

params.name: dns_record_id
params.description: The id of the record, from List DNS records.

params.name: type
params.description: Record type.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name of the record, including the zone, such as www.example.com.

params.name: content
params.description: Value of the record: the IPv4 or IPv6 address, the target host of a CNAME, MX or NS, or the text of a TXT. CAA and SRV records use data instead.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Time to live in seconds, from 60 to 86400, or 1 for automatic.

params.name: proxied
params.description: Sends the traffic through Cloudflare. Only for A, AAAA and CNAME records.

params.name: priority
params.description: Priority of an MX record. Lower values are preferred.

params.name: comment
params.description: Note about the record, with no effect on DNS answers.

params.name: data
params.description: Parts of a CAA or SRV record: flags, tag and value for CAA, such as {flags: 0, tag: issue, value: letsencrypt.org}; priority, weight, port and target for SRV.

tools.name: Delete DNS record
tools.description: Deletes a DNS record of a zone and returns its id. The change reaches DNS answers right away and cannot be undone.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: The id of the zone, from List zones.

params.name: dns_record_id
params.description: The id of the record, from List DNS records.

tools.name: Purge cache
tools.description: Removes cached content of a zone from every Cloudflare data center; the next request for it goes to the origin. Send exactly one of files, tags, hosts, prefixes or purge_everything. A success means the request was accepted, not that anything was cached. How many items fit in one call depends on the plan.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: The id of the zone, from List zones.

params.name: files
params.description: Full URLs to purge, such as https://www.example.com/styles.css.

params.name: tags
params.description: Purges all content whose Cache-Tag response header has one of these tags.

params.name: hosts
params.description: Purges all content cached for these hostnames, such as www.example.com.

params.name: prefixes
params.description: Purges all content whose URL starts with one of these prefixes, without the scheme, such as www.example.com/blog/.

params.name: purge_everything
params.description: true purges all cached content of the zone.

name: Superhuman Docs
description: Docs, pages, tables and rows of Superhuman Docs, formerly Coda.

tools.name: List docs
tools.description: Lists the docs the user can access and has opened at least once, latest activity first, with id, name, owner, workspace and browserLink. Send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against the docs.

params.name: isOwner
params.description: true returns only docs the user owns.

params.name: minimumAccess
params.description: Only docs where the user has at least this access; write means editor or manager.

params.name: limit
params.description: Docs per page. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response. The other filters are implied by it.

tools.name: Create doc
tools.description: Creates a doc, empty or as a copy of another doc, in the My docs folder of the oldest workspace the user joined. Needs the Doc Maker role in the workspace.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the doc. The default is Untitled.

params.name: sourceDoc
params.description: Id of a doc to copy, from List docs.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone of the doc, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

tools.name: List pages
tools.description: Lists the pages of a doc with id, name, subtitle, parent and children. Send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: limit
params.description: Pages per page of results. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List page content
tools.description: Returns the content of a page as plain text, element by element. Send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next part.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: pageIdOrName
params.description: Id of the page, from List pages. A name also works, but names change and repeat.

params.name: limit
params.description: Elements per call, up to 500. The default is 50.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Create page
tools.description: Creates a page in a doc, or a subpage, with content in Markdown or HTML. The change is queued and shows up in a few seconds; the response has the id of the page. Needs the Doc Maker role.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the page.

params.name: subtitle
params.description: Subtitle of the page.

params.name: parentPageId
params.description: Id of the parent page, from List pages, to create a subpage.

params.name: pageContent
params.description: Content of the page.

tools.name: Update page
tools.description: Renames a page or adds content to it, at the end, at the start or replacing everything. The change is queued and shows up in a few seconds. Changing the name needs the Doc Maker role.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: pageIdOrName
params.description: Id of the page, from List pages. A name also works, but names change and repeat.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the page.

params.name: subtitle
params.description: New subtitle of the page.

params.name: isHidden
params.description: true hides the page from the page list of the doc.

params.name: contentUpdate
params.description: Content to add.

tools.name: List tables
tools.description: Lists the tables and views of a doc with id, name, type and parent page. Rows are written only to tables, not to views. Send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: tableTypes
params.description: Types to include, separated by commas: table and view. Omit it to list both.

params.name: limit
params.description: Tables per page. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List columns
tools.description: Lists the columns of a table with id, name and format. The column ids go in the cells of Create rows and Update row and in the query of List rows.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: tableIdOrName
params.description: Id of the table, from List tables. A name also works, but names change.

params.name: visibleOnly
params.description: true returns only the visible columns. Applies to tables, not views.

params.name: limit
params.description: Columns per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List rows
tools.description: Lists the rows of a table or view, oldest first unless sortBy says otherwise, with id, name and the values keyed by column id. The data can lag a few seconds behind the doc; send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: tableIdOrName
params.description: Id of the table or view, from List tables. A name also works, but names change.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter on one column: the column id from List columns, or its name in double quotes, then a colon and a JSON value, such as "Status":"Done" or c-tuVwxYz:42. Text values go in double quotes.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: createdAt, the default, brings the oldest first; updatedAt orders by the last edit; natural follows the order shown in the table and returns only visible rows.

params.name: useColumnNames
params.description: true keys the values by column name instead of id.

params.name: valueFormat
params.description: simple, the default, returns plain values, with lists as comma-separated text; simpleWithArrays returns lists as arrays; rich adds Markdown to text and structure to currency, lookup, image, person and link values.

params.name: visibleOnly
params.description: true returns only the visible rows and columns.

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows per page. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Create rows
tools.description: Inserts rows in a table, or updates the rows that match the keyColumns. Every matching row is updated. Only base tables take rows, not views; the change is queued and shows up in a few seconds.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: tableIdOrName
params.description: Id of the table, from List tables. A name also works, but names change.

params.name: rows
params.description: Rows to insert, each with the values of its cells.

params.name: keyColumns
params.description: Column ids from List columns that identify an existing row. With them, matching rows are updated instead of duplicated.

tools.name: Update row
tools.description: Changes cells of a row. The change is queued and shows up in a few seconds.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: tableIdOrName
params.description: Id of the table, from List tables. A name also works, but names change.

params.name: rowIdOrName
params.description: Id of the row, from List rows. A name also works, but with repeated names an arbitrary row is changed.

params.name: row
params.description: The new values.

tools.name: Delete row
tools.description: Deletes a row from a table or view. The deletion is queued and done in a few seconds.

params.name: docId
params.description: Id of the doc, from List docs.

params.name: tableIdOrName
params.description: Id of the table, from List tables. A name also works, but names change.

params.name: rowIdOrName
params.description: Id of the row, from List rows. A name also works, but with repeated names an arbitrary row is deleted.

name: Constant Contact
description: Contacts, contact lists and email campaigns of a Constant Contact account.

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Lists the contacts of the account, leaving deleted ones out by default, optionally filtered by email, list, status or date. The response has contacts and, when there are more, _links.next.href with the cursor of the next page.

params.name: email
params.description: Only the contact with this exact email address.

params.name: lists
params.description: Only the members of these lists, as comma-separated list_id values from List contact lists, up to 25.

params.name: status
params.description: Only contacts in these statuses, comma-separated: all, active, deleted, not_set, pending_confirmation, temp_hold or unsubscribed. all includes the deleted contacts.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Only contacts created after this date-time, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Only contacts created before this date-time.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Only contacts updated after this date-time.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Only contacts updated before this date-time.

params.name: optout_after
params.description: Only contacts that unsubscribed after this date-time.

params.name: optout_before
params.description: Only contacts that unsubscribed before this date-time.

params.name: include
params.description: Subresources to add to each contact, comma-separated: custom_fields, list_memberships, phone_numbers, street_addresses, taggings or notes. Without it, only the core fields come back.

params.name: include_count
params.description: true adds contacts_count, the total of contacts that match the filters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Contacts per page, up to 500. The default is 50.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Next page: the cursor value of _links.next.href in the previous response. The cursor keeps the filters of the first call.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a contact and returns it with its contact_id. Send create_source and at least email_address, first_name or last_name. An email address that already exists in the account answers 409.

params.name: create_source
params.description: Who adds the contact: Account when the account user adds it, Contact when the person signed up. Constant Contact requires the right value for compliance.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Email address of the contact. permission_to_send explicit or implicit is allowed only when the person agreed to receive emails; anti-spam laws and the Constant Contact terms forbid it otherwise.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the contact.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the contact.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title of the contact.

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company where the contact works.

params.name: birthday_month
params.description: Month of the birthday, 1 to 12. Send it together with birthday_day.

params.name: birthday_day
params.description: Day of the birthday, 1 to 31. Send it together with birthday_month.

params.name: anniversary
params.description: Anniversary date, such as when the contact became a customer, as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY.

params.name: phone_numbers
params.description: Up to 3 phone numbers.

params.name: street_addresses
params.description: Up to 3 street addresses, each with its kind.

params.name: list_memberships
params.description: Ids of the lists to subscribe the contact to, from List contact lists, up to 50.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Updates a contact by replacing its core fields: email_address, names, job_title, company_name, birthday and anniversary left out become empty, so send the current values too, from List contacts. Subresources left out are kept, and one that is sent replaces the current one.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts.

params.name: update_source
params.description: Who makes the change: Account when the account user changes it, Contact when the person asked for it. A deleted contact comes back only with Account.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Email address of the contact. permission_to_send explicit or implicit is allowed only when the person agreed to receive emails; unsubscribed opts the contact out, with an optional opt_out_reason.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the contact.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the contact.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title of the contact.

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company where the contact works.

params.name: birthday_month
params.description: Month of the birthday, 1 to 12. Send it together with birthday_day.

params.name: birthday_day
params.description: Day of the birthday, 1 to 31. Send it together with birthday_month.

params.name: anniversary
params.description: Anniversary date, such as when the contact became a customer, as YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY.

params.name: phone_numbers
params.description: Up to 3 phone numbers. When sent, they replace the current ones.

params.name: street_addresses
params.description: Up to 3 street addresses, each with its kind. When sent, they replace the current ones.

params.name: list_memberships
params.description: Ids of all the lists the contact should be in, from List contact lists, up to 50. When sent, the contact leaves the lists that are not in it. The current lists come from List contacts with include list_memberships.

tools.name: List contact lists
tools.description: Lists the contact lists with their list_id, name and description. An account has up to 1000 lists, and one page brings up to 1000.

params.name: name
params.description: Only the list with this full name.

params.name: status
params.description: Only lists in this status.

params.name: include_membership_count
params.description: Adds membership_count to each list: active counts only the contacts that can receive email, all counts every member.

params.name: include_count
params.description: true adds lists_count, the total of lists that match the filters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Lists per page, up to 1000.

tools.name: Create contact list
tools.description: Creates an empty contact list and returns it with its list_id. A name already used by another list answers 409.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the list.

params.name: description
params.description: Text that describes the list.

params.name: favorite
params.description: true marks the list as a favorite.

tools.name: List email campaigns
tools.description: Lists the email campaigns, most recently updated first, with campaign_id, name, type and current_status, including the deleted ones (Removed). Up to 500 per page; reach older ones with before_date and after_date. The activity ids come from Get email campaign.

params.name: after_date
params.description: Only campaigns last updated after this date-time, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z.

params.name: before_date
params.description: Only campaigns last updated before this date-time.

params.name: limit
params.description: Campaigns per page, up to 500. The default is 50.

tools.name: Get email campaign
tools.description: Returns one email campaign with its name, current_status and campaign_activities. The campaign_activity_id with role primary_email is the one the activity tools take.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List email campaigns or Create email campaign.

tools.name: Create email campaign
tools.description: Creates a draft email campaign with custom HTML content and returns it with campaign_activities, where the primary_email activity is. To send it, set the lists with Update email campaign activity and then use Schedule email campaign activity.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the campaign, unique in the account and not shown to contacts.

params.name: email_campaign_activities
params.description: Exactly one activity with the content of the email. format_type 5 is the custom code email. from_email and reply_to_email must be confirmed email addresses of the account. html_content needs [[trackingImage]] inside the body element, or opens and clicks are not reported. Without physical_address_in_footer, the address of the account is used.

tools.name: Get email campaign activity
tools.description: Returns an email campaign activity: sender, subject, preheader, contact_list_ids or segment_ids, format_type and current_status. html_content and physical_address_in_footer come back only when asked in include.

params.name: campaign_activity_id
params.description: Id of the activity, from the campaign_activities of Get email campaign or Create email campaign.

params.name: include
params.description: Extra properties, comma-separated: html_content, physical_address_in_footer, permalink_url or document_properties.

tools.name: Update email campaign activity
tools.description: Updates the primary_email activity of a campaign in DRAFT or DONE status. It replaces the properties: send the current sender, subject, preheader and lists from Get email campaign activity along with the changes, because what is left out is cleared. html_content and physical_address_in_footer are kept when not sent.

params.name: campaign_activity_id
params.description: Id of the activity with role primary_email, from Get email campaign or Create email campaign.

params.name: contact_list_ids
params.description: Ids of the lists that receive the email, from List contact lists. Required before scheduling, unless the activity uses a segment.

params.name: segment_ids
params.description: The segment that receives the email, as returned by Get email campaign activity. Send it back to keep it. Never together with contact_list_ids.

params.name: from_name
params.description: Sender name shown to contacts.

params.name: from_email
params.description: Sender address, a confirmed email address of the account.

params.name: reply_to_email
params.description: Address that receives the replies, a confirmed email address of the account.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: preheader
params.description: Short summary shown after the subject in the inbox.

params.name: html_content
params.description: New HTML body, only for format_type 5. Keep [[trackingImage]] inside the body element so opens and clicks are reported.

params.name: physical_address_in_footer
params.description: Address of the sender shown in the footer. state_code is required when country_code is US.

tools.name: Schedule email campaign activity
tools.description: Sends the primary_email activity of a campaign to its lists or segment, right away or at scheduled_date. Set the lists first with Update email campaign activity. An activity in DONE status goes only to contacts added to its lists since the last sending.

params.name: campaign_activity_id
params.description: Id of the activity with role primary_email, from Get email campaign or Create email campaign.

params.name: scheduled_date
params.description: When to send, in ISO-8601 UTC, for example 2026-11-05T13:00:00.000Z, or 0 to send right away.

tools.name: Get email campaign stats

tools.name: List receivables
tools.description: Lists the installments to receive (contas a receber) due in a period, with customer, categories, amounts paid and open and status, plus the totals of the period in totais. The response has itens and itens_totais; page with pagina, and a page shorter than tamanho_pagina is the last one.

params.name: data_vencimento_ate

params.name: tamanho_pagina

The response has itens and itens_totais; page with pagina, and a page shorter than tamanho_pagina is the last one.

params.name: data_vencimento_de

params.name: data_competencia_ate
params.description: Only the installments with accrual date until this date, in YYYY-MM-DD. Requires data_competencia_de.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the installments in these statuses, separated by commas: EM_ABERTO (open), ATRASADO (overdue), RECEBIDO (paid), RECEBIDO_PARCIAL (partly paid), RENEGOCIADO (renegotiated) and PERDIDO (written off). For example EM_ABERTO,ATRASADO.

params.name: ids_categorias

params.name: ids_contas_financeiras
params.description: Only the installments of these financial accounts: ids from List financial accounts, separated by commas.

params.name: descricao

params.name: pagina

params.name: data_competencia

tools.name: List sales
tools.description: Lists the sales issued in a period, with number, customer, total and situation, plus totais and quantidades of the approved, canceled and waiting sales. The response has itens and total_itens; page with pagina, and a page shorter than tamanho_pagina is the last one.

params.name: ids_clientes

params.name: pagina

params.name: tamanho_pagina

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Lists the financial categories, with id, name and tipo (RECEITA or DESPESA). The id goes in rateio.id_categoria of Create receivable and Create payable. Page with pagina, and a page shorter than tamanho_pagina is the last one.

params.name: busca

params.name: pagina

name: Crisp
description: Conversations, messages and contacts of the Crisp workspaces where the customer installed their own Crisp plugin.

tools.name: List websites
tools.description: Lists the Crisp workspaces, called websites in the API, where the plugin of this token is installed, with their website_id. Get website gives the name of each one. Pages start at 1, and an empty data list means there are no more pages.

params.name: page_number
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get website
tools.description: Returns the name, domain and logo of a Crisp workspace, to tell apart the ids that List websites returns.

params.name: website_id
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List websites.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Lists the conversations of a workspace, with session_id, state, unread counts, assigned operator, last message and the visitor meta (nickname, email, phone, segments). Pages start at 1, and a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: website_id
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List websites.

params.name: page_number
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Conversations per page, from 20 to 50. Defaults to 20.

params.name: search_query
params.description: Text to search in the conversations when search_type is text, or the name of a segment when search_type is segment.

params.name: search_type
params.description: How search_query is read: text for a full text search, segment for the conversations tagged with that segment.

params.name: filter_unread
params.description: 1 returns only conversations with unread messages.

params.name: filter_resolved
params.description: 1 returns only resolved conversations.

params.name: filter_not_resolved
params.description: 1 returns only conversations that are not resolved.

params.name: filter_assigned
params.description: Returns only the conversations assigned to this operator: the user_id inside details, from List operators.

params.name: filter_unassigned
params.description: 1 returns only conversations with no assigned operator.

params.name: filter_date_start
params.description: Only conversations updated from this moment on, in ISO 8601, like 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.

params.name: filter_date_end
params.description: Only conversations updated up to this moment, in ISO 8601.

params.name: order_date_created
params.description: 1 orders by creation date instead of the default order.

params.name: order_date_updated
params.description: 1 orders by last update instead of the default order.

params.name: order_date_waiting
params.description: 1 orders by the longest wait for an answer and leaves out the conversations that are not waiting.

params.name: include_empty
params.description: 1 also returns conversations without any message. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: Get conversation
tools.description: Returns a conversation with its state, assigned operator, unread counts, last message, people_id of the contact and the visitor meta. The messages come from List conversation messages.

params.name: website_id
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List websites.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with session_, from List conversations.

tools.name: List conversation messages
tools.description: Returns the latest batch of messages of a conversation, with type, sender, content and timestamp in milliseconds. To page towards older messages, send the timestamp of the oldest message of the batch as timestamp_before.

params.name: website_id
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List websites.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with session_, from List conversations.

params.name: timestamp_before
params.description: Returns the batch that ends before this timestamp in milliseconds, for older messages.

params.name: timestamp_after
params.description: Returns the batch that starts after this timestamp in milliseconds, for newer messages.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Sends a message as an operator in a conversation. type text goes to the visitor right away; type note is an internal note seen only by operators.

params.name: website_id
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List websites.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with session_, from List conversations.

params.name: type
params.description: text for a message to the visitor, note for an internal note.

params.name: from
params.description: Sender of the message. Always operator.

params.name: origin
params.description: Channel of the message: chat for the chatbox, email for conversations that came in by email.

params.name: content

params.name: user

params.name: mentions

params.name: attachments
params.description: Files already hosted at a public URL, from 1 to 10.

tools.name: Update conversation state

params.name: website_id

params.name: session_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with session_, from List conversations.

params.name: state

tools.name: Assign conversation

params.name: website_id
params.description: Id of the workspace, from List websites.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with session_, from List conversations.

params.name: assigned
params.description: Operator who takes the conversation.

params.name: silent
params.description: true assigns without notifying the operator.

tools.name: Update conversation meta

params.name: website_id

params.name: session_id

params.name: nickname

params.name: email
params.description: Visitor email.

params.name: phone
params.description: Visitor phone number.

params.name: address

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the conversation.

params.name: segments
params.description: Segments, the Crisp tags, of the conversation.

params.name: data
params.description: Custom visitor data as key and value pairs, like plan or order number.

params.name: website_id

name: Discord

params.name: limit

params.name: after
params.description: Only servers after this server id, from a previous page of List guilds.

params.name: before
params.description: Only servers before this server id, from a previous page of List guilds.

tools.name: List channels
tools.description: Lists the channels and categories of a server, without threads. type tells the kind: 0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage, 15 forum and 16 media. A forum or media channel lists its tags in available_tags.

params.name: guild_id
params.description: Id of the server, from List guilds.

tools.name: Create channel
tools.description: Creates a channel or a category in a server and returns it with its id. The bot needs the Manage Channels permission.

params.name: guild_id
params.description: Id of the server, from List guilds.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the channel, up to 100 characters.

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of channel: 0 text, the default, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage or 15 forum. Announcement needs a Community server.

params.name: topic

params.name: parent_id

params.name: position

params.name: rate_limit_per_user

Without Message Content Intent on the bot, content, embeds and attachments come back empty, except in messages that mention the bot. The bot needs View Channel and Read Message History.

params.name: channel_id

params.name: after

params.name: around
params.description: Messages around this message id, from List messages. Send only one of before, after and around.

params.name: limit
params.description: Messages per call, up to 100. The default is 50.

tools.name: Search messages
tools.description: Searches the messages of a server, up to 25 per page, newest first by default; page with offset. The response has total_results and messages, a list of one-message lists. If the server is not indexed yet, Discord answers 202 with retry_after: call again after those seconds. Needs Message Content Intent on the bot.

params.name: guild_id
params.description: Id of the server, from List guilds.

params.name: content

params.name: channel_id

params.name: author_id

params.name: mentions
params.description: Only messages that mention these people, by the author.id of messages from List messages.

params.name: has
params.description: Only messages that have these things, such as image, link or poll. A leading minus excludes the thing.

params.name: pinned

params.name: min_id
params.description: Only messages after this message id, from List messages.

params.name: max_id
params.description: Only messages before this message id, from List messages.

params.name: sort_by
