params.name: sort_order
params.description: desc, the default, or asc. Ignored when sort_by is relevance.

params.name: limit
params.description: Messages per page, up to 25, the default.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip, up to 9975.

params.name: include_nsfw
params.description: true also searches age-restricted channels.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Posts a message from the bot in a channel or thread and returns it with its id. Send at least content, embeds or poll. The bot needs Send Messages in the channel, or Send Messages in Threads in a thread.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of a channel from List channels, or of a thread from Create thread.

params.name: content
params.description: Text of the message, up to 2000 characters, with Discord markdown.

params.name: embeds
params.description: Up to 10 rich cards shown under the text, with 6000 characters in total.

params.name: message_reference
params.description: Makes the message a reply to another message of the same channel.

params.name: poll
params.description: A poll attached to the message.

params.name: flags
params.description: 4 hides link previews and 4096 sends without push notifications. Add the values to combine them.

tools.name: Update message
tools.description: Edits a message the bot sent and returns it. Fields left out keep their value, and embeds replaces all the cards of the message.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of the channel or thread of the message, from List channels or Create thread.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the message, from Send message or List messages.

params.name: content
params.description: New text of the message, up to 2000 characters, with Discord markdown.

params.name: embeds
params.description: Up to 10 rich cards shown under the text, with 6000 characters in total. An empty list removes them.

params.name: flags
params.description: 4 hides the link previews and 0 shows them again. Keep any other flag the message already has.

tools.name: Delete message
tools.description: Deletes a message and answers 204 with no body. Deleting a message of someone else needs the Manage Messages permission.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of the channel or thread of the message, from List channels or Create thread.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the message, from Send message or List messages.

tools.name: Create thread
tools.description: Creates a thread in a text or announcement channel, or a post in a forum or media channel, and returns it with its id, which the message tools take as channel_id. In a forum or media channel send message, the first post; elsewhere send type, because the default is a private thread. The bot needs Create Public Threads, or Send Messages in a forum.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of the channel, from List channels.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the thread or title of the post, up to 100 characters.

params.name: type
params.description: Outside forums: 11 public thread, 12 private thread, the default, or 10 in an announcement channel. Not used in a forum or media channel.

params.name: auto_archive_duration
params.description: Minutes without activity before the thread is hidden from the channel list.

params.name: invitable
params.description: For a private thread, true lets members who are not moderators add others.

params.name: message
params.description: First post of a forum or media channel thread. Send content or embeds.

params.name: applied_tags
params.description: Up to 5 tags of a forum or media channel post: ids from the available_tags of the channel in List channels.

tools.name: List scheduled events
tools.description: Lists the events of a server with their id, status (1 scheduled, 2 active, 3 completed, 4 canceled) and times.

params.name: guild_id
params.description: Id of the server, from List guilds.

params.name: with_user_count
params.description: true adds user_count, the number of people interested in each event.

tools.name: Create scheduled event
tools.description: Creates an event in a server and returns it with its id. An event outside Discord takes entity_type 3 with entity_metadata.location and scheduled_end_time; an event in a voice or stage channel takes entity_type 2 or 1 with channel_id. The bot needs Create Events, and a server holds up to 100 scheduled or active events.

params.name: guild_id
params.description: Id of the server, from List guilds.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the event, up to 100 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the event, up to 1000 characters.

params.name: privacy_level
params.description: Always 2: the event is visible to the members of the server.

params.name: scheduled_start_time
params.description: Start of the event, ISO 8601 with offset, for example 2026-11-05T19:00:00-03:00.

params.name: scheduled_end_time
params.description: End of the event, ISO 8601 with offset. Required when entity_type is 3.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Where it happens: 1 in a stage channel, 2 in a voice channel or 3 outside Discord.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of the voice or stage channel, from List channels. Required for entity_type 1 and 2, left out for 3.

params.name: entity_metadata
params.description: Required for entity_type 3.

tools.name: Update scheduled event
tools.description: Updates an event and returns it. Fields left out keep their value. status 2 starts the event, 3 ends an active one and 4 cancels a scheduled one; after 3 or 4 the event cannot change anymore.

params.name: guild_id
params.description: Id of the server, from List guilds.

params.name: guild_scheduled_event_id
params.description: Id of the event, from List scheduled events.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the event, up to 100 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: New description of the event, up to 1000 characters.

params.name: status
params.description: 2 starts a scheduled event, 3 ends an active one and 4 cancels a scheduled one.

params.name: scheduled_start_time
params.description: New start, ISO 8601 with offset.

params.name: scheduled_end_time
params.description: New end, ISO 8601 with offset. Required when changing entity_type to 3.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Where it happens: 1 in a stage channel, 2 in a voice channel or 3 outside Discord. Changing to 3 also needs entity_metadata.location, scheduled_end_time and channel_id sent as null.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of the voice or stage channel, from List channels. Send null when changing entity_type to 3.

params.name: entity_metadata
params.description: Location of an event outside Discord. Ignored for the other types.

params.name: privacy_level
params.description: Always 2: the event is visible to the members of the server.

name: Dropbox
description: Files, folders and shared links of a Dropbox account.

tools.name: List files and folders
tools.description: Lists the files and folders inside a folder, each with .tag (file, folder or deleted), name, path_display and id. When has_more is true, pass the cursor to List more files for the rest.

params.name: path
params.description: Folder to list, like /Clients/Acme, or an empty string for the root folder. Paths start with a slash, never end with one and ignore case. A folder id (id:...) from this tool or Search files also works. On team accounts with team space, the root is the member's own folder.

params.name: recursive
params.description: When true, also lists the contents of every subfolder. Very large folders can be slow or fail this way; list them level by level instead.

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: When true, also returns files and folders that were deleted, as entries with .tag deleted.

params.name: include_mounted_folders
params.description: When false, leaves out the contents of shared folders, team folders and app folders inside the path. Defaults to true.

params.name: include_non_downloadable_files
params.description: When false, leaves out files that cannot be downloaded, such as Google Docs. Defaults to true.

params.name: limit
params.description: Approximate maximum number of entries per page, up to 2000.

tools.name: List more files
tools.description: Returns the next page of a listing started by List files and folders, with the same options. Call it again with the new cursor while has_more is true.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor returned by List files and folders or by the previous call of this tool.

tools.name: Search files
tools.description: Searches files and folders and returns up to max_results matches, each with the item under metadata.metadata. When has_more is true, narrow the query or the folder. Changes from the last moments may not show yet.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to search for, up to 1000 characters. It can match the name and other fields of an item; set filename_only in options to match names only.

params.name: options
params.description: Filters and limits of the search.

tools.name: Get file or folder
tools.description: Returns the metadata of a file or folder: .tag (file or folder), name, path_display, id and, for files, size, rev and the modification dates. The root folder has no metadata.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file or folder, like /Clients/Acme/logo.png, or its id (id:...) from List files and folders or Search files.

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: When true, a deleted file or folder returns its metadata with .tag deleted instead of a not_found error.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a folder and returns its metadata under metadata.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the new folder, like /Clients/Acme/Briefs.

params.name: autorename
params.description: When something already exists at the path, Dropbox gives the new folder a different name instead of failing.

tools.name: Move or rename file
tools.description: Moves or renames a file or folder; a folder moves with everything inside it. Returns the new metadata under metadata. Changing only the case of a name is not supported.

params.name: from_path
params.description: Current path of the file or folder, or its id (id:...) from List files and folders or Search files.

params.name: to_path
params.description: New path, including the name, like /Clients/Acme/Approved/logo.png. Keep the folder and change the name to rename.

params.name: autorename
params.description: When something already exists at to_path, Dropbox gives the moved item a different name instead of failing.

tools.name: Copy file or folder
tools.description: Copies a file or folder; a folder is copied with everything inside it. Returns the metadata of the copy under metadata.

params.name: from_path
params.description: Path of the file or folder to copy, or its id (id:...) from List files and folders or Search files.

params.name: to_path
params.description: Path of the copy, including the name, like /Clients/Acme/Drafts/logo.png.

params.name: autorename
params.description: When something already exists at to_path, Dropbox gives the copy a different name instead of failing.

tools.name: Delete file or folder
tools.description: Deletes a file or folder; a folder is deleted with everything inside it. Returns the metadata the item had under metadata. Dropbox keeps deleted items restorable for a period that depends on the plan.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file or folder to delete, or its id (id:...) from List files and folders or Search files.

params.name: parent_rev
params.description: Deletes the file only if its current rev, from Get file or folder or List files and folders, is this one. Does not apply to folders.

tools.name: Get temporary link
tools.description: Returns a direct link to the content of a file, valid for four hours, plus the file metadata. Anyone with the link can download the file until it expires; for a lasting link, use Create shared link.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file, or its id (id:...) from List files and folders or Search files. Folders have no temporary link.

tools.name: List shared links
tools.description: Lists shared links with their url, path_lower, expires and link_permissions. Without path it lists every link of the account, and when has_more is true the next page comes with the cursor.

params.name: path
params.description: Path or id (id:...) of a file or folder, from List files and folders or Search files. Returns the links that reach it, including links to its parent folders.

params.name: direct_only
params.description: With path, when true, returns only the links to the path itself, leaving out links to its parent folders.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor of the previous page. Dropbox only returns a cursor when path is omitted.

tools.name: Create shared link
tools.description: Creates a shared link to a file or folder and returns it with its url. If the item already has a link, Dropbox answers shared_link_already_exists, sometimes with that link; List shared links finds it and Update shared link changes its settings.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file or folder to share, or its id (id:...) from List files and folders or Search files.

params.name: settings
params.description: Settings of the link. Omit it for a public link. Free Basic accounts can only create public links without expiration, and team or shared folder policies can still restrict the result.

tools.name: Update shared link
tools.description: Changes the settings of an existing shared link and returns the link with the settings that took effect. The access level of an existing link cannot change.

params.name: url
params.description: The url of the link, from List shared links or Create shared link.

params.name: settings
params.description: The settings to change, at least one. Free Basic accounts can only keep public links without expiration, and team or shared folder policies can still restrict the result.

params.name: remove_expiration
params.description: When true, removes the expiration of the link.

name: Dub
description: Short links, tags, folders and click and conversion analytics of a Dub workspace.

tools.name: List links
tools.description: Lists the short links of the workspace with destination, tags, folder, UTM parameters and the counts of clicks, leads and sales. For the next page, send the id of the last link as startingAfter; a page shorter than pageSize is the last one.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the short link slug and the destination URL.

params.name: domain
params.description: Only links of this domain, such as dub.sh or a custom domain from List domains.

params.name: tagIds
params.description: Only links with these tags: ids from List tags, separated by commas.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Only links in this folder. Id from List folders.

params.name: showArchived
params.description: true also returns archived links.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Links per page, up to 100. The default is 100.

params.name: startingAfter
params.description: Id of the last link of the previous page, from List links.

tools.name: Get link
tools.description: Returns one short link with its counts of clicks, leads and sales. Send domain and key together, such as dub.sh and abc123 for dub.sh/abc123, or send linkId.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain of the short link, such as dub.sh. Goes with key.

params.name: key
params.description: Slug of the short link, the part after the domain. Goes with domain.

params.name: linkId
params.description: Id of the link, from List links or Create link.

tools.name: Create link
tools.description: Shortens a URL and returns the short link in shortLink, with its id. Without domain it uses the primary domain of the workspace, or dub.sh when there is none, and without key Dub picks a random 7-character slug.

params.name: url
params.description: Destination URL.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain of the short link, without protocol, from List domains.

params.name: key
params.description: Slug of the short link, the part after the domain.

params.name: tagIds
params.description: Ids of the tags of the link, from List tags or Create tag.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of the folder of the link, from List folders.

params.name: comments
params.description: Internal notes about the link.

params.name: utm_source
params.description: UTM source added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_medium
params.description: UTM medium added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_campaign
params.description: UTM campaign added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_term
params.description: UTM term added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_content
params.description: UTM content added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: trackConversion
params.description: true tracks leads and sales of the link. The workspace needs conversion tracking set up.

params.name: expiresAt
params.description: When the link expires.

params.name: expiredUrl
params.description: Where the link sends visitors after it expires.

params.name: proxy
params.description: true shows the custom preview of title, description and image when the link is shared.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the custom preview. Used when proxy is true.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the custom preview. Used when proxy is true.

params.name: image
params.description: URL of the image of the custom preview. Used when proxy is true.

tools.name: Update link
tools.description: Changes a short link; only the fields sent change. A new domain or key changes the short link itself, and archived true hides the link from List links.

params.name: linkId
params.description: Id of the link, from List links, Get link or Create link.

params.name: url
params.description: New destination URL.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain of the short link, without protocol, from List domains.

params.name: key
params.description: Slug of the short link, the part after the domain.

params.name: archived
params.description: true archives the link, false restores it.

params.name: tagIds
params.description: Ids of all the tags of the link, from List tags or Create tag.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of the folder of the link, from List folders.

params.name: comments
params.description: Internal notes about the link.

params.name: utm_source
params.description: UTM source added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_medium
params.description: UTM medium added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_campaign
params.description: UTM campaign added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_term
params.description: UTM term added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: utm_content
params.description: UTM content added to the destination URL, replacing the one in it.

params.name: trackConversion
params.description: true tracks leads and sales of the link. The workspace needs conversion tracking set up.

params.name: expiresAt
params.description: When the link expires.

params.name: expiredUrl
params.description: Where the link sends visitors after it expires.

params.name: proxy
params.description: true shows the custom preview of title, description and image when the link is shared.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the custom preview. Used when proxy is true.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the custom preview. Used when proxy is true.

params.name: image
params.description: URL of the image of the custom preview. Used when proxy is true.

tools.name: Get analytics
tools.description: Returns clicks, leads or sales of the workspace, a domain, a link, a tag or a folder, as a total, a time series or a ranking chosen by groupBy. Without start and interval it covers the last 24 hours, and it needs the Pro plan or higher.

params.name: event
params.description: What to count. composite returns clicks, leads and sales together. The default is clicks.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: count returns the total, timeseries the values over time, and the others a ranking. The default is count.

params.name: interval
params.description: Period ending now: mtd, qtd and ytd start at the beginning of the month, quarter or year. Ignored when start is sent.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the period. Takes precedence over interval.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the period. Defaults to now.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone of the time series, such as America/Sao_Paulo. The default is UTC.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to filter by, such as dub.sh. With key, a single short link. Several values go separated by commas, and a minus sign before a value excludes it.

params.name: key
params.description: Slug of a short link. Goes with domain.

params.name: linkId
params.description: Id of a link, from List links. Several values go separated by commas, and a minus sign before a value excludes it.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Id of a tag, from List tags. Several values go separated by commas, and a minus sign before a value excludes it.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of a folder, from List folders. Several values go separated by commas, and a minus sign before a value excludes it.

params.name: country
params.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, such as BR. Several values go separated by commas, and a minus sign before a value excludes it.

params.name: device
params.description: Device type, such as Desktop, Mobile or Tablet.

params.name: referer
params.description: Hostname of the referrer, such as google.com.

params.name: utm_source
params.description: UTM source to filter by.

params.name: utm_medium
params.description: UTM medium to filter by.

params.name: utm_campaign
params.description: UTM campaign to filter by.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Lists click, lead or sale events one by one, with time, link and click details and, for leads and sales, the customer; it needs the Business plan or higher. Without start and interval it covers the last 24 hours, and a page shorter than limit is the last one.

params.name: event
params.description: Kind of event. The default is clicks.

params.name: interval
params.description: Period ending now: mtd, qtd and ytd start at the beginning of the month, quarter or year. Ignored when start is sent.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the period. Takes precedence over interval.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the period. Defaults to now.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Sao_Paulo. The default is UTC.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to filter by, such as dub.sh. With key, a single short link.

params.name: key
params.description: Slug of a short link. Goes with domain.

params.name: linkId
params.description: Id of a link, from List links.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Id of a tag, from List tags.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of a folder, from List folders.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: limit
params.description: Events per page, up to 1000. The default is 100.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order by time. The default is desc, newest first.

tools.name: List domains
tools.description: Lists the custom domains of the workspace, whose slug goes in the domain argument of the link tools. Pages start at 1, and a page shorter than pageSize is the last one.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the domains.

params.name: archived
params.description: true also returns archived domains.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Domains per page, up to 50.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: Lists the tags of the workspace with their ids and colors. Pages start at 1, and a page shorter than pageSize is the last one.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against tag names.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field to sort by. The default is name.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The default is asc.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Tags per page, up to 100.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Creates a tag to organize links, such as a campaign or a client. The response has the id that goes in tagIds.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the tag.

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the tag. Without it, Dub picks one at random.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Lists the link folders of the workspace with their ids. Pages start at 1, and a page shorter than pageSize is the last one.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against folder names.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Folders per page, up to 50.

name: Eventbrite
description: Events, ticket types, attendees and orders of the organizations of an Eventbrite account.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists the organizations the connected user is a member of, with id and name. Events, venues, orders and attendees belong to an organization. When pagination.has_more_items is true, pass pagination.continuation as continuation to read the next page.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The pagination.continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Lists the events of an organization, with id, name, summary, start, end, status, url, venue_id and organizer_id. When pagination.has_more_items is true, pass pagination.continuation as continuation, with the same filters, to read the next page.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Id of the organization: an id from List organizations.

params.name: name_filter
params.description: Only the events whose name matches this text.

params.name: status
params.description: One or more statuses separated by commas: draft, live, started, ended, completed, canceled, or all.

params.name: time_filter
params.description: Only the past events, or only the current and future ones. The default is all.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Order of the list.

params.name: expand
params.description: Related objects to include in each event, separated by commas, such as venue,organizer,ticket_availability.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Events per page.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The pagination.continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: Get event
tools.description: Returns one event, with name, summary, start and end (timezone, utc and local), status, url, currency, capacity, online_event, listed, venue_id and organizer_id. An event created or changed a moment ago can take a few seconds to show the change here.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events or Create event.

params.name: expand
params.description: Related objects to include, separated by commas, such as venue,organizer,ticket_availability.

tools.name: Create event
tools.description: Creates a draft event in an organization and returns it. To put it on sale, add a ticket type with Create ticket class and then use Publish event.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Id of the organization that owns the event: an id from List organizations.

params.name: event
params.description: The event. name, start, end and currency are required. An event has a venue_id or is an online_event, never both.

tools.name: Update event
tools.description: Updates an event and returns it. Only the fields sent change. On the parent of a series of dates, the name, currency, capacity, password and the show and hide options change on every date.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events.

params.name: event
params.description: The fields to change. An event has a venue_id or is an online_event, never both.

tools.name: Publish event
tools.description: Publishes a draft event, which goes on sale, and returns published true. The event needs a name, a summary or description, an organizer, at least one ticket class and, for paid tickets, valid payment options. A deleted event cannot be published.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events or Create event.

tools.name: Delete event
tools.description: Deletes an event and returns deleted true. Only an event without pending or completed orders can be deleted. Deleting the parent of a series of dates deletes every date.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events.

tools.name: List ticket classes
tools.description: Lists the ticket types of an event, with id, name, cost, fee, free, donation, capacity, quantity_sold, sales_start and sales_end. When pagination.has_more_items is true, pass pagination.continuation as continuation to read the next page.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events.

params.name: pos
params.description: Only the ticket types sold at this point of sale.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The pagination.continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: Create ticket class
tools.description: Creates a ticket type for an event and returns it: free (free true), paid (cost) or donation (donation true). A free or paid ticket type needs capacity.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events or Create event.

params.name: ticket_class
params.description: The ticket type. Send free true, a cost or donation true.

tools.name: List event attendees
tools.description: Lists the attendees of an event, one per ticket sold, with profile (name and email), ticket_class_name, order_id, status, checked_in, cancelled, refunded and the answers to the questions. When pagination.has_more_items is true, pass pagination.continuation as continuation, with the same filters, to read the next page.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events.

params.name: status
params.description: attending (attending or checked in), not_attending (not attending or deleted) or unpaid (the order is not paid).

params.name: changed_since
params.description: Only the attendees changed at or after this moment, in UTC, such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The pagination.continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: List event orders
tools.description: Lists the orders of an event, with id, name and email of the buyer, costs (gross, fees and net), status and created. When pagination.has_more_items is true, pass pagination.continuation as continuation, with the same filters, to read the next page.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event: an id from List events.

params.name: status
params.description: active (attending), inactive (not attending), both, or all_not_deleted (active and inactive, without the deleted orders).

params.name: changed_since
params.description: Only the orders changed at or after this moment, in UTC, such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: only_emails
params.description: Only the orders placed by these email addresses, separated by commas.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The pagination.continuation of the previous response.

tools.name: List venues
tools.description: Lists the venues of an organization, with id, name, address and capacity: the venue_id that Create event and Update event take. When pagination.has_more_items is true, pass pagination.continuation as continuation to read the next page.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Id of the organization: an id from List organizations.

params.name: continuation
params.description: The pagination.continuation of the previous response.

name: Everhour
description: Clients, budgets, projects, time records and invoices of an Everhour team.

tools.name: List clients
tools.description: Lists the clients of the team in a single response, with the ids of their projects and the budget with its usage in progress. Money is in cents and time in seconds.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against client names. Omit it to list every client.

tools.name: Create client
tools.description: Creates a client. Names are not deduplicated, so check List clients first. Link the projects whose time is invoiced to this client.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the client.

params.name: projects
params.description: Ids of the projects of the client, from List projects, such as as:1234567890.

params.name: businessDetails
params.description: Free text with the business details of the client, shown on invoices.

params.name: reference
params.description: Reference shown on the invoices of the client, such as a contract number.

params.name: email
params.description: Email addresses that receive the invoices of the client, up to 10.

params.name: paymentDueDays
params.description: Default payment term of the invoices, in days.

params.name: defaultDiscount
params.description: Default discount of the invoices, as a percentage.

params.name: defaultTax
params.description: Default tax of the invoices.

params.name: invoicePublicNotes
params.description: Notes printed on the invoices of the client.

params.name: billingDetails
params.description: Billing details of the client. Every field is optional.

tools.name: Update client
tools.description: Changes a client. Only the fields sent are changed. To link a new project, send the complete projects list, including the ids already linked that List clients shows.

params.name: client_id
params.description: Id of the client, from List clients.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the client.

params.name: projects
params.description: Ids of all the projects of the client, from List projects, such as as:1234567890.

params.name: status
params.description: archived hides the client, active brings it back.

params.name: businessDetails
params.description: Free text with the business details of the client, shown on invoices.

params.name: reference
params.description: Reference shown on the invoices of the client, such as a contract number.

params.name: email
params.description: Email addresses that receive the invoices of the client, up to 10.

params.name: paymentDueDays
params.description: Default payment term of the invoices, in days.

params.name: defaultDiscount
params.description: Default discount of the invoices, as a percentage.

params.name: defaultTax
params.description: Default tax of the invoices.

params.name: invoicePublicNotes
params.description: Notes printed on the invoices of the client.

params.name: billingDetails
params.description: Billing details of the client. Every field is optional.

tools.name: Update client budget
tools.description: Creates or replaces the budget of a client. Send the whole budget, because partial updates are not supported. Reaching the threshold emails the admins of the team.

params.name: client_id
params.description: Id of the client, from List clients.

params.name: type
params.description: money counts billable amounts, time counts hours, and costs counts money at the hourly cost of each member.

params.name: budget
params.description: Budget value: cents for money and costs, such as 500000 for 5,000.00, or seconds for time, such as 36000 for 10 hours.

params.name: period
params.description: general is a one-off budget; the others restart every period.

params.name: appliedFrom
params.description: Day the budget starts counting, in YYYY-MM-DD. Only for the general period.

params.name: disallowOverbudget
params.description: true stops time from being tracked over the budget.

params.name: excludeUnbillableTime
params.description: true leaves non-billable time out of the usage.

params.name: excludeExpenses
params.description: true leaves expenses out of the usage.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Usage percentage that emails the admins of the team.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects the user has access to, with the client id, billing type, rates and budget with its usage. Ids carry the integration prefix, such as as:1234567890 for Asana or ev:1234567890 for projects created in Everhour. Pages start at 1, and a page shorter than limit is the last one.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against project names.

params.name: limit
params.description: Projects per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Search tasks
tools.description: Searches tasks by name in all projects, or in one project. Returns the task ids, such as ev:3000010034, that the time record tools ask for, with the project ids, status and time totals in seconds.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against task names.

params.name: project
params.description: Id of a project, from List projects, to search only in it.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of tasks returned, from 1 to 100.

params.name: searchInClosed
params.description: true also searches closed and completed tasks.

tools.name: List time records
tools.description: Lists the time records of the whole team in a date range, both days included. Without from and to it returns only today. Each record has the time in seconds, the user id, whose name comes from List users, the date, the task with its project ids, and isInvoiced. A page shorter than limit is the last one.

params.name: from
params.description: First day, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: to
params.description: Last day, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: limit
params.description: Records per page, up to 50000.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: opts_include_billing
params.description: 1 adds the billable rate and amount, in cents, to each record. Only admins with billing access receive them.

tools.name: Create time record
tools.description: Logs time on a task for a day. A user has at most one record per task and day: sending the same user, task and date again updates the duration of that record instead of creating another one.

params.name: time
params.description: Duration in seconds, such as 5400 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

params.name: date
params.description: Day of the record, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: task
params.description: Id of the task, from Search tasks, such as ev:3000010034.

params.name: user
params.description: Id of the team member the time belongs to, from List users. Omit it to log time for the connected user; logging for someone else depends on the role of the connected user.

params.name: comment
params.description: Note about the work done.

tools.name: Update time record
tools.description: Changes a time record by its id. time is required in every call, so send the current duration to keep it.

params.name: time_id
params.description: Id of the time record, from List time records.

params.name: time
params.description: Duration in seconds, such as 5400 for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

params.name: date
params.description: Day of the record, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: task
params.description: Id of the task, from Search tasks, such as ev:3000010034.

params.name: user
params.description: Id of the team member the time belongs to, from List users.

params.name: comment
params.description: Note about the work done.

tools.name: Delete time record
tools.description: Removes a time record by setting its duration to zero. The history of the record is kept, and it no longer appears in List time records.

params.name: time_id
params.description: Id of the time record, from List time records.

tools.name: List invoices
tools.description: Lists every invoice of the team in a single response, with the client, period, status (draft, sent or paid), line items and amounts in cents.

tools.name: Create invoice
tools.description: Creates an invoice for a client from the time tracked in the period, and the expenses when asked. The time records it covers are marked as invoiced. Mark it as sent or paid with Update invoice.

params.name: client_id
params.description: Id of the client, from List clients.

params.name: limitDateFrom
params.description: First day of the time invoiced, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: limitDateTill
params.description: Last day of the time invoiced, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: includeTime
params.description: true adds the tracked time.

params.name: includeExpenses
params.description: true adds the billable expenses.

params.name: projects
params.description: Ids of the projects of the client to invoice, from List clients. Omit it to invoice all of them.

params.name: tax
params.description: Tax of the invoice.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discount as a percentage.

tools.name: Update invoice
tools.description: Changes the number, dates, notes, tax, discount or status of an invoice. Set manualStatus to sent or paid to move it forward.

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: Id of the invoice, from List invoices.

params.name: manualStatus
params.description: Status set by hand, over the one Everhour derives.

params.name: publicId
params.description: Invoice number shown to the client.

params.name: issueDate
params.description: Issue date, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: dueDate
params.description: Due date, in YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: reference
params.description: Reference shown on the invoice, such as a contract number.

params.name: publicNotes
params.description: Notes printed on the invoice.

params.name: tax
params.description: Tax of the invoice.

params.name: discount
params.description: Discount as a percentage.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the members of the team, removed ones included, with id, name, email, role and status. The id is the user of the time records and the user argument of the time record tools.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against names and email addresses.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of members returned.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Returns the connected user: id, name, email, role, team settings and the formats of date and time. The id is the user that Create time record and Update time record accept in user, and the one the time goes to when user is omitted. The apiKey field of the response comes back masked.

name: Fathom Analytics
description: Sites, events, milestones and traffic reports of a Fathom Analytics account.

tools.name: List sites
tools.description: Lists the sites of the account with id, name, sharing and timezone, oldest first. The id is the code of the tracking script that the other tools ask for. While has_more is true, send the id of the last site as starting_after.

params.name: limit
params.description: Sites per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Cursor: the id of the last site of the previous page.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Cursor that pages backwards: the id of the first site of the current page.

tools.name: Get site
tools.description: Returns one site with its name, sharing, timezone and creation date.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

tools.name: Create site
tools.description: Creates a site and returns it with the id to put in the tracking script. Needs a token with the Admin permission.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the site. It does not have to match the URL.

params.name: sharing
params.description: Who can see the dashboard by its share link: none, the default, or public. A private dashboard with a password is configured in Fathom, not here.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Reporting timezone as a TZ database name, for example America/Sao_Paulo. The default is the timezone of the account.

params.name: multi_domain
params.description: true lets the site track several domains.

params.name: multi_domain_option
params.description: With multi_domain true, required: combined reports all domains together, separate reports each one apart.

tools.name: Update site
tools.description: Changes a site. Only the fields sent change.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the site.

params.name: sharing
params.description: Who can see the dashboard by its share link: none, the default, or public. A private dashboard with a password is configured in Fathom, not here.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Reporting timezone as a TZ database name, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: multi_domain
params.description: true lets the site track several domains.

params.name: multi_domain_option
params.description: With multi_domain true, required: combined reports all domains together, separate reports each one apart.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Lists every event name the site has tracked, with its currency, sorted by name. Report on an event by its name; its id only works as a page cursor. While has_more is true, send the id of the last event as starting_after.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: limit
params.description: Events per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Cursor: the id of the last event of the previous page.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Cursor that pages backwards: the id of the first event of the current page.

tools.name: Get aggregation
tools.description: Builds a custom report on the pageviews of a site or on one event: totals, or grouped by period and by fields such as pathname, referrer_source or utm_campaign. Numbers come back as text, and there is no pagination: grouped reports return up to 500 rows unless limit says otherwise.

params.name: entity
params.description: pageview reports on the visits of a site, event on one event.

params.name: entity_id
params.description: With entity pageview, required: the id of the site, from List sites.

params.name: site_id
params.description: With entity event, required: the id of the site, from List sites.

params.name: entity_name
params.description: With entity event, required: the name of the event, from List events.

params.name: aggregates
params.description: Comma-separated aggregates. For pageview: visits, uniques, pageviews, avg_duration and bounce_rate. For event: conversions, unique_conversions and value, which comes in cents.

params.name: date_grouping
params.description: Groups the numbers by period. Omit it for totals. hour only works for ranges of up to 7 days.

params.name: field_grouping
params.description: Comma-separated fields to group by: hostname, pathname, entry_page, exit_page, referrer_hostname, referrer_pathname, referrer_source, ai_source, browser, country_code, city, state, region, device_type, operating_system, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_medium, utm_source, utm_term, keyword or ref.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: A field of aggregates or field_grouping with asc or desc, for example pageviews:desc. With date_grouping, timestamp:asc and timestamp:desc also work.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the timezone of the site, for example 2026-10-01 00:00:00. The default is the first recorded data.

params.name: date_to
params.description: End as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in the timezone of the site. The default is now.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum rows, up to 1000. With field_grouping, the default is 500.

params.name: filters
params.description: JSON array of filters, as text. Each filter has property, operator (is, is not, is like, is not like, matching or not matching) and a text value, for example [{"property":"pathname","operator":"is","value":"/pricing"}].

tools.name: Get current visitors
tools.description: Returns how many people are on the site right now. With detailed, also the top 150 pages and the top 150 referrers.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: detailed
params.description: true adds the top pages and referrers to the count.

tools.name: List milestones
tools.description: Lists the milestones of the site, the dates marked on its reports, oldest first. While has_more is true, send the id of the last milestone as starting_after.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: limit
params.description: Milestones per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Cursor: the id of the last milestone of the previous page.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Cursor that pages backwards: the id of the first milestone of the current page.

tools.name: Create milestone
tools.description: Marks a date on the reports of the site, such as a campaign launch.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the milestone, up to 30 characters.

params.name: milestone_date
params.description: Date of the milestone as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Update milestone
tools.description: Changes a milestone. Send both name and milestone_date, even the one that does not change.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: milestone_id
params.description: Id of the milestone, a UUID, from List milestones.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the milestone, up to 30 characters.

params.name: milestone_date
params.description: Date of the milestone as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Delete milestone
tools.description: Deletes a milestone for good.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites. It is the code of the tracking script, for example CDBUGS.

params.name: milestone_id
params.description: Id of the milestone, a UUID, from List milestones.

name: Figma
description: Files, comments, version history and published components and styles that a Figma user can open.

tools.name: Get file metadata
tools.description: Returns the metadata of a file without its content: name, folder, editor type (Figma Design, FigJam, Slides and others), creator, who changed it last and when, thumbnail, the role of the user and the link access. Much cheaper than Get file in the Figma rate limits, so use it first when the question is about the file and not its layers.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

tools.name: Get file
tools.description: Returns the document tree of a file: pages, frames and layers with their properties and ids, plus the components and styles the file uses. The tree of a large file is huge: pass depth 1 for the pages only, or 2 for the top-level frames of each page, then read a frame with Get file nodes. Figma puts this call in its smallest rate limit tier: files in a Starter plan, and users with a View or Collab seat, get only up to 20 calls a month.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: depth
params.description: How deep to go into the tree, counted from the document: 1 returns the pages, 2 the pages and their top-level frames. Omit it to return every layer.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated node ids, like 1:2,1:3, to return only those nodes, their children and the path to them. A node id is the node-id of a Figma link with the hyphen changed to a colon (node-id=1-2 is 1:2), or an id returned by Get file.

params.name: version
params.description: Id of a version from List file versions, to read the file as it was then. Omit it for the current version.

params.name: branch_data
params.description: Also returns the branches of the file with their keys, which the other tools accept as file_key. The default is false.

tools.name: Get file nodes
tools.description: Returns the given frames or layers of a file, each with its whole subtree, under nodes, plus the name, version and last change of the file. A node that does not exist comes back as null. It is the light way to read one frame of a large file. Figma puts this call in its smallest rate limit tier: files in a Starter plan, and users with a View or Collab seat, get only up to 20 calls a month.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated node ids, like 1:2,1:3. A node id is the node-id of a Figma link with the hyphen changed to a colon (node-id=1-2 is 1:2), or an id returned by Get file.

params.name: depth
params.description: How deep to go into each node, counted from the node: 1 returns only its direct children. Omit it to return the whole subtree.

params.name: version
params.description: Id of a version from List file versions, to read the nodes as they were then. Omit it for the current version.

tools.name: Render images
tools.description: Renders frames or layers of a file as images and returns, in images, a map from each node id to a temporary URL of the image, valid for 30 days. A null value means that node could not be rendered. Images above 32 megapixels are scaled down. Figma puts this call in its smallest rate limit tier: files in a Starter plan, and users with a View or Collab seat, get only up to 20 calls a month.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated node ids to render, like 1:2,1:3. A node id is the node-id of a Figma link with the hyphen changed to a colon (node-id=1-2 is 1:2), or an id returned by Get file.

params.name: format
params.description: Image format. The default is png.

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale factor, from 0.01 to 4. The default is 1.

params.name: version
params.description: Id of a version from List file versions, to render the nodes as they were then. Omit it for the current version.

params.name: contents_only
params.description: When true, the default, content of other layers that overlaps the node is left out of the image. False includes it and takes longer.

params.name: use_absolute_bounds
params.description: Uses the full size of the node even when it is cropped or has empty space around it, which keeps text layers from being cut. The default is false.

tools.name: List file versions
tools.description: Lists the version history of a file, newest first: id, creation date, author, and the label and description of named versions. To read older versions, pass as before the before value of the pagination.next_page link; the history ends when next_page is missing.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Versions per page, up to 50. The default is 30.

params.name: before
params.description: The before value of the pagination.next_page link of the previous response, to read the versions older than it.

tools.name: List comments
tools.description: Lists all the comments of a file, replies included. Each comment has id, message, author, created_at, resolved_at when it was resolved, its position in client_meta and the reactions. A reply carries the id of its root comment in parent_id.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: as_md
params.description: Returns the messages as Markdown when they have formatting.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description: Posts a comment on a file as the connected user and returns it, or a reply when comment_id is sent. Without client_meta the comment is not pinned to a spot of the canvas. A posted comment cannot be edited, only deleted with Delete comment.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: message
params.description: Text of the comment.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Id of the comment to reply to, from List comments. It must be a root comment, one without parent_id: replies to replies are refused.

params.name: client_meta
params.description: Where the comment goes. Send x and y for a spot of the canvas, or node_id and node_offset to attach it to a frame; add region_width and region_height to mark an area instead of a point. A reply takes no position.

tools.name: Delete comment
tools.description: Deletes a comment of a file. Figma only lets the author delete a comment, so it works on the comments made by the connected user.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the file: the part after /design/, /file/ or /board/ in the URL of the file in Figma. The key of a branch also works.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Id of the comment, from List comments.

tools.name: List file components
tools.description: Lists the components published from a library file: key, name, description, node_id, thumbnail, dates, author and the frame and page that contain each one. Components that were never published do not appear.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the library file: the part after /design/ or /file/ in the URL of the file in Figma. It must be the main file, not a branch.

tools.name: List team components
tools.description: Lists the components published in the libraries of a team, with the file_key and node_id of each one, which Get file nodes and Render images accept. The response has meta.cursor: pass its after value as after to read the next page; the list ends when after is missing.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Id of the team: the number after /team/ in the URL of the team page in Figma. The API has no call that lists teams.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Components per page, up to 1000. The default is 30.

params.name: after
params.description: The meta.cursor.after value of the previous response, to read the next page.

tools.name: List file styles
tools.description: Lists the styles published from a library file: colors, text, effects and grids, with key, name, style_type, description and node_id. The values of a style are in its node: read them with Get file nodes.

params.name: file_key
params.description: Key of the library file: the part after /design/ or /file/ in the URL of the file in Figma. It must be the main file, not a branch.

tools.name: List team styles
tools.description: Lists the styles published in the libraries of a team, with the file_key and node_id of each one; the values are in the node, read with Get file nodes. The response has meta.cursor: pass its after value as after to read the next page; the list ends when after is missing.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Id of the team: the number after /team/ in the URL of the team page in Figma. The API has no call that lists teams.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Styles per page. The default is 30.

params.name: after
params.description: The meta.cursor.after value of the previous response, to read the next page.

name: folk
description: People, companies, deals and notes of a folk CRM workspace.

tools.name: List groups
tools.description: Lists the groups of the workspace with id and name. Groups hold people, companies and deals. The next page comes from the cursor inside pagination.nextLink; the last page has no nextLink.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

params.name: cursor

params.description: Only the tickets of the requester with this external id, the id of the requester in your own system.

name: Front
description: Conversations, messages and tags of a Front company that the API token can reach.

tools.name: Search conversations
tools.description: Searches the conversations the API token can reach, most recent activity first, and returns _total with the matches. Trashed conversations are left out unless the query asks for is:trashed. The next page comes from the page_token inside _pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

params.name: query
params.description: Words and filters separated by spaces, combined with AND. Words match subject and body; quote a phrase. Filters: is:open, is:archived, is:assigned, is:unassigned, is:snoozed, is:unreplied, is:waiting, is:resolved, is:trashed; inbox:ID (List inboxes); tag:ID (List tags); assignee:ID or participant:ID (List teammates); from:, to:, cc: or recipient: with an email or handle; before:, after: or during: with a Unix time in seconds. Up to 15 filters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. Defaults to 50.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The page_token value in the _pagination.next URL of the previous response.

tools.name: Get conversation
tools.description: Returns a conversation with its subject, status, assignee, main recipient, tags, custom fields and links. The messages come from List conversation messages.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with cnv_, from Search conversations.

tools.name: List conversation messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of a conversation, newest first unless sort_order is asc, with author, recipients, subject, body and attachment details. The next page comes from the page_token inside _pagination.next, which is null on the last page.

params.description: Field used to sort the messages. Only created_at is supported.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: asc for oldest first, desc for newest first.

tools.name: Update conversation
tools.description: Updates the assignee, inbox, status, tags or custom fields of a conversation. Send only the fields to change. tag_ids replaces every tag of the conversation, so use Apply tags to add tags without removing the others.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with cnv_, from Search conversations.

params.name: assignee_id
params.description: Id of the teammate to assign the conversation to, starting with tea_, from List teammates. Send null to unassign it.

params.name: inbox_id
params.description: Id of the inbox to move the conversation to, starting with inb_, from List inboxes.

params.name: status
params.description: New status. archived closes the conversation, open reopens it, deleted moves it to the trash and spam marks it as spam.

params.name: tag_ids
params.description: Ids of all the tags the conversation should keep, from List tags. Replaces the current tags; an empty list removes them all.

params.name: custom_fields
params.description: Conversation custom fields, keyed by the field name shown in Front, with a value of the field type: text, true or false, a Unix time in seconds for dates, an integer, a teammate email, an inbox id or one of the enum values.

tools.name: Apply tags
tools.description: Adds one or more tags to a conversation and keeps the tags it already has.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with cnv_, from Search conversations.

params.name: tag_ids
params.description: Ids of the tags to add, starting with tag_, from List tags.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description: Adds an internal comment to a conversation. Comments are seen only by teammates, never by the contact. The body accepts Markdown.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with cnv_, from Search conversations.

params.name: body
params.description: Text of the comment, in Markdown.

params.name: author_id
params.description: Teammate who signs the comment: the id starting with tea_ from List teammates, or alt:email: followed by the teammate email. Omit it to post as the API token.

params.name: is_pinned
params.description: Pins the comment at the top of the conversation.

tools.name: Create draft
tools.description: Creates a draft reply to the last message of a conversation, for a teammate to review and send in Front. Nothing is sent. A private draft is visible only to its author, so set author_id to the teammate who will review it, or use mode shared.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, starting with cnv_, from Search conversations.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel the draft will be sent from: the id starting with cha_ from List channels, or alt:address: followed by the channel address, like alt:address:support@acme.com.

params.name: body
params.description: Body of the draft. Email channels accept HTML.

params.name: author_id
params.description: Teammate who owns the draft: the id starting with tea_ from List teammates, or alt:email: followed by the teammate email. Omit it to create the draft as the API token.

params.name: mode
params.description: private, the default, shows the draft only to its author; shared shows it to every teammate with access to the conversation.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient handles, like email addresses, for when the draft is sent.

params.name: cc
params.description: Handles that get a copy when the draft is sent.

params.name: bcc
params.description: Handles that get a blind copy when the draft is sent.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the draft.

tools.name: Reply to conversation
tools.description: Sends a reply in a conversation right away and answers 202 with a message_uid. Front archives the conversation when the reply goes out, unless options.archive is false. Needs the send permission on the API token. A merged conversation answers with a redirect to the conversation it was merged into.

params.name: conversation_id

params.name: body

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient handles, like email addresses.

params.name: cc
params.description: Handles that get a copy.

params.name: bcc
params.description: Handles that get a blind copy.

params.name: subject

params.name: author_id
params.description: Id of the teammate the reply is sent on behalf of, starting with tea_, from List teammates.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Id of the channel to send the reply from, starting with cha_, from List channels.

params.name: options

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Sends a new message from a channel, which starts a new conversation, and answers 202 with a message_uid. It goes out right away, and Front archives the new conversation unless options.archive is false. Needs the send permission on the API token.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient handles, like email addresses or phone numbers, depending on the channel.

params.name: body
params.description: Body of the message. Email channels accept HTML.

params.name: cc
params.description: Handles that get a copy.

params.name: bcc
params.description: Handles that get a blind copy.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject, for email messages.

params.name: author_id
params.description: Id of the teammate the message is sent on behalf of, starting with tea_, from List teammates.

params.name: options
params.description: Tags to add and whether to archive the new conversation after sending.

params.description: One subscription status: subscribed, unconfirmed (double opt-in not confirmed yet), undelivered, or removed for the unsubscribed.

params.name: sectionLogicOperator

params.description: Up to 8 groups of criteria. params.name: openTrackingConsent

params.name: newsletterId

tools.name: Create newsletter
tools.description: Creates a newsletter. With type broadcast, the default, it goes into the sending queue right away, or at sendSettings.sendOn; with type draft it is only saved, to send later with Send newsletter draft. GetResponse accepts 256 of these calls a day.

params.name: type
params.description: broadcast sends it, draft only saves it. The default is broadcast.

params.name: name
params.description: Internal name of the newsletter.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: fromField
params.description: Sender, with fromFieldId from List from fields.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: Reply-to address, with fromFieldId from List from fields.

params.name: campaign
params.description: Campaign (contact list) the newsletter belongs to, with campaignId from List campaigns.

params.name: content
params.description: Body of the email: html, and optionally a plain text version in plain.

params.name: flags
params.description: clicktrack tracks the link clicks, google_analytics adds the Google Analytics tags to the links.

params.name: trackOpens
params.description: Tracks the opens, as the text true or false. The default is true.

params.name: sendSettings
params.description: Who receives it and when. selectedCampaigns and excludedCampaigns take campaignId values from List campaigns, and selectedContacts takes contactId values from Search contacts; the criteria combine with AND. Without sendOn, it goes right away; sendOn takes date in local time, such as 2026-11-05T09:00:00, and timeZone with the timezoneId from List time zones. timeTravel true sends at that hour in the time zone of each recipient.

params.name: messageId
params.description: newsletterId of the draft, from List newsletters or Create newsletter.

params.name: sendSettings
params.description: Who receives it and when. selectedCampaigns and excludedCampaigns take campaignId values from List campaigns, and selectedContacts takes contactId values from Search contacts; the criteria combine with AND. Without sendOn, it goes right away; sendOn takes date in local time, such as 2026-11-05T09:00:00, and timeZone with the timezoneId from List time zones. timeTravel true sends at that hour in the time zone of each recipient.

tools.name: Get newsletter statistics
tools.description: Returns the statistics of one newsletter as a list of time intervals, each with sent, opens, clicks, forwarded, unsubscribed, bounced and complaints, in total and unique counts. Add the intervals up for the totals; page with page and perPage, and a page shorter than perPage is the last.

params.name: newsletterId
params.description: Id of the newsletter, from List newsletters.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, comma-separated, such as sent,uniqueOpened,uniqueClicked.

params.name: title
params.description: New title.

params.name: body
params.description: New content, in Markdown.

params.name: state
params.description: Closes or reopens the issue.

params.name: state_reason
params.description: Why the state changed. Ignored unless state changes.

params.name: duplicate_issue_id
params.description: With state_reason duplicate, the id (not the number) of the issue this one duplicates, from the id field of List issues or Get issue.

params.name: labels
params.description: Names of the labels the issue should have, replacing the current ones. An empty list removes all.

params.name: assignees
params.description: Logins of the users the issue should be assigned to, replacing the current ones. An empty list removes all.

params.name: milestone
params.description: Number of a milestone of the repository, from the milestone.number of an issue in List issues.

params.name: type
params.description: Name of an issue type of the organization, such as Bug or Task.

tools.name: List issue comments
tools.description: Lists the comments of an issue or of a pull request, oldest first. The review comments on the code of a pull request are not included. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: owner
params.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository, the owner.login of List repositories.

params.name: repo
params.description: Name of the repository, the name of List repositories.

params.name: issue_number
params.description: Number of the issue or pull request, the number of List issues, Search issues or List pull requests.

params.name: since
params.description: Only comments updated after this time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 30.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Create issue comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to an issue or to a pull request and returns it. Notifies the participants.

params.name: owner
params.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository, the owner.login of List repositories.

params.name: repo
params.description: Name of the repository, the name of List repositories.

params.name: issue_number
params.description: Number of the issue or pull request, the number of List issues, Search issues or List pull requests.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the comment, in Markdown.

tools.name: List pull requests
tools.description: Lists the pull requests of a repository, newest first. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: owner
params.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository, the owner.login of List repositories.

params.name: repo
params.description: Name of the repository, the name of List repositories.

params.name: state
params.description: Only pull requests in this state. The default is open.

params.name: head
params.description: Only pull requests from this branch, written as owner:branch, such as octocat:new-feature.

params.name: base
params.description: Only pull requests into this branch, such as main.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field. popularity is the number of comments; long-running keeps pull requests open for more than a month with recent activity. The default is created.

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort order. The default is desc for created and asc for the others.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 30.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get pull request
tools.description: Returns a pull request, with its branches, head.sha, mergeable and mergeable_state, the number of commits and changed files, and whether it was merged. mergeable may come null while GitHub computes it: call again after a few seconds.

params.name: owner
params.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository, the owner.login of List repositories.

params.name: repo
params.description: Name of the repository, the name of List repositories.

params.name: pull_number
params.description: Number of the pull request, the number of List pull requests or Search issues.

tools.name: Create pull request
tools.description: Opens a pull request from the head branch into the base branch and returns it, with its number. Send title, or issue to turn an existing issue into the pull request. Notifies the watchers of the repository.

params.name: owner
params.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository, the owner.login of List repositories.

params.name: repo
params.description: Name of the repository, the name of List repositories.

params.name: head
params.description: Branch with the changes. For a branch of a fork, write owner:branch.

params.name: base
params.description: Existing branch of this repository that receives the changes, such as main.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the pull request. Required unless issue is sent.

params.name: body
params.description: Description of the pull request, in Markdown.

params.name: draft
params.description: Opens it as a draft. In private repositories, drafts need GitHub Team or Enterprise Cloud.

params.name: maintainer_can_modify
params.description: Lets the maintainers of the base repository push to the head branch of a fork.

params.name: issue
params.description: Number of an issue of the repository, the number of List issues, to turn into this pull request. Its title, body and comments move to the pull request.

tools.name: Merge pull request
tools.description: Merges a pull request into its base branch and returns merged and the sha of the new commit. Answers 405 when the pull request cannot be merged, and 409 when sha no longer matches its head. Repositories that merge through a merge queue do not accept it.

params.name: owner
params.description: Login of the user or organization that owns the repository, the owner.login of List repositories.

params.name: repo
params.description: Name of the repository, the name of List repositories.

params.name: pull_number
params.description: Number of the pull request, the number of List pull requests or Search issues.

params.name: merge_method
params.description: How to merge. The default is merge; the repository may allow only some methods.

params.name: commit_title
params.description: Title of the merge commit.

params.name: commit_message
params.description: Extra text for the merge commit message.

params.name: sha
params.description: The head.sha of Get pull request. The merge only happens if the branch still points to it.

name: GitLab
description: Projects, issues and merge requests that a GitLab.com account can reach.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists projects, newest first. Send membership true to get only the projects of the account: without it, GitLab.com returns every public project. Each item has id and path_with_namespace, which the other tools take as the project. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: membership
params.description: Only projects the account is a member of.

params.name: owned
params.description: Only projects the account owns.

params.name: starred
params.description: Only projects the account starred.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the path, name and description of the project.

params.name: visibility
params.description: Only projects with this visibility.

params.name: archived
params.description: true for only archived projects, false for only the active ones.

params.name: simple
