params.description: Returns only the main fields of each project.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. The default is created_at.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. The default is desc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: List project members
tools.description: Lists the members of a project, including those inherited from its groups. Each item has id, username and name: the id is what assignee_ids and reviewer_ids ask for. Paginate with page and per_page.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: query
params.description: Part of the name, username or email of the member.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: List issues
tools.description: Lists issues of every project the account can see. By default only the issues the account created: send scope assigned_to_me or all for the others. Each item has project_id and iid, which the issue tools ask for. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: scope
params.description: Whose issues. The default is created_by_me.

params.name: state
params.description: Only issues in this state. The default is all.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the title and description.

params.name: labels
params.description: Comma-separated label names, such as bug,ui. Only issues with all of them. None for issues without labels, Any for issues with at least one.

params.name: milestone
params.description: Title of a milestone. None for issues without milestone, Any for issues with one.

params.name: author_username
params.description: Username of the author.

params.name: assignee_username
params.description: Username of an assignee.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Only issues created on or after this time.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Only issues updated on or after this time.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. The default is created_at.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. The default is desc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: List project issues
tools.description: Lists the issues of a project, newest first. Each item has iid, the number of the issue in the project, which the issue tools ask for. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: state
params.description: Only issues in this state. The default is all.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the title and description.

params.name: labels
params.description: Comma-separated label names, such as bug,ui. Only issues with all of them. None for issues without labels, Any for issues with at least one.

params.name: milestone
params.description: Title of a milestone. None for issues without milestone, Any for issues with one.

params.name: author_username
params.description: Username of the author.

params.name: assignee_username
params.description: Username of an assignee.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Only issues created on or after this time.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Only issues updated on or after this time.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. The default is created_at.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. The default is desc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get issue
tools.description: Returns an issue of a project, with title, description, state, labels, assignees, milestone and due date.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project. In List issues it is the project_id of the issue.

params.name: issue_iid
params.description: The iid of the issue from List project issues or List issues, not its id.

tools.name: Create issue
tools.description: Creates an issue in a project and returns it, with its iid. Notifies the participants.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the issue.

params.name: description
params.description: Content of the issue, in Markdown.

params.name: assignee_ids
params.description: Ids of the users to assign, from List project members. More than one assignee needs the Premium or Ultimate plan.

params.name: labels
params.description: Label names. A name that does not exist yet becomes a new label of the project.

params.name: milestone
params.description: Title of a milestone of the project or of its groups.

params.name: due_date
params.description: Due date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: issue_type
params.description: Type of the issue. The default is issue.

params.name: confidential
params.description: Makes the issue visible only to project members with at least the Planner role.

tools.name: Update issue
tools.description: Changes an issue and returns it. Only the fields sent change, and at least one must be sent. To close or reopen it, send state_event. labels replaces all the labels; add_labels and remove_labels change only the ones named.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project. In List issues it is the project_id of the issue.

params.name: issue_iid
params.description: The iid of the issue from List project issues or List issues, not its id.

params.name: title
params.description: New title.

params.name: description
params.description: New content, in Markdown.

params.name: state_event
params.description: Closes or reopens the issue.

params.name: assignee_ids
params.description: Ids of the users the issue should be assigned to, from List project members, replacing the current ones. Send [0] to remove all.

params.name: labels
params.description: Label names that replace all the current ones.

params.name: add_labels
params.description: Label names to add. A name that does not exist yet becomes a new label of the project.

params.name: remove_labels
params.description: Label names to remove.

params.name: milestone
params.description: Title of a milestone of the project or of its groups.

params.name: due_date
params.description: Due date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: confidential
params.description: Makes the issue confidential, or public again with false.

tools.name: List issue notes
tools.description: Lists the comments (notes) of an issue, newest first by default, including the notes GitLab writes for each change. Send activity_filter only_comments to keep just what people wrote. Paginate with page and per_page.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project. In List issues it is the project_id of the issue.

params.name: issue_iid
params.description: The iid of the issue from List project issues or List issues, not its id.

params.name: activity_filter
params.description: Which notes to return. The default is all_notes.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. The default is created_at.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. The default is desc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Create issue note
tools.description: Adds a comment (note) to an issue and returns it. Notifies the participants.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project. In List issues it is the project_id of the issue.

params.name: issue_iid
params.description: The iid of the issue from List project issues or List issues, not its id.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the comment, in Markdown.

params.name: internal
params.description: Makes it an internal note, visible only to project members with at least the Reporter role.

tools.name: List merge requests
tools.description: Lists the merge requests of a project, newest first. Each item has iid, which the merge request tools ask for. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: state
params.description: Only merge requests in this state. The default is all.

params.name: scope
params.description: Only the merge requests the account created, is assigned to, or reviews.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the title and description.

params.name: labels
params.description: Comma-separated label names, such as bug,ui. Only merge requests with all of them.

params.name: author_username
params.description: Username of the author.

params.name: assignee_username
params.description: Username of an assignee.

params.name: reviewer_username
params.description: Username of a reviewer.

params.name: source_branch
params.description: Only merge requests from this branch.

params.name: target_branch
params.description: Only merge requests into this branch.

params.name: draft
params.description: true for only drafts, false for only the ready ones.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Only merge requests updated on or after this time.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. The default is created_at.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. The default is desc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get merge request
tools.description: Returns a merge request, with its branches, sha, detailed_merge_status (mergeable is the value that allows merging), has_conflicts and head_pipeline.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: merge_request_iid
params.description: The iid of the merge request from List merge requests, not its id.

tools.name: Create merge request
tools.description: Opens a merge request from source_branch into target_branch and returns it, with its iid. A title that starts with Draft: opens it as a draft. Notifies the assignees and reviewers.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the merge request.

params.name: source_branch
params.description: Branch with the changes.

params.name: target_branch
params.description: Branch that receives the changes, such as main.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the merge request, in Markdown.

params.name: assignee_ids
params.description: Ids of the users to assign, from List project members.

params.name: reviewer_ids
params.description: Ids of the users to ask for review, from List project members.

params.name: labels
params.description: Label names. A name that does not exist yet becomes a new label of the project.

params.name: milestone
params.description: Title of a milestone of the project or of its groups.

params.name: remove_source_branch
params.description: Deletes the source branch when the merge request is merged.

params.name: squash
params.description: Squashes the commits into one on merge. Without it, the project setting decides.

params.name: allow_collaboration
params.description: Lets the members who can merge into the target branch push to the source branch of a fork.

tools.name: Merge merge request
tools.description: Merges a merge request and returns it. With auto_merge true it merges once the pipeline and checks pass. Answers 405 when it cannot be merged, 409 when sha does not match the source branch, and 422 when the merge fails.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the project from List projects, or its path_with_namespace, such as group/project.

params.name: merge_request_iid
params.description: The iid of the merge request from List merge requests, not its id.

params.name: auto_merge
params.description: Merges later, when the pipeline and the other checks pass, instead of now.

params.name: squash
params.description: Squashes the commits into one.

params.name: should_remove_source_branch
params.description: Deletes the source branch after the merge.

params.name: merge_commit_message
params.description: Message of the merge commit.

params.name: squash_commit_message
params.description: Message of the squashed commit.

params.name: sha
params.description: The sha of Get merge request. The merge only happens if the source branch still points to it. Some groups require it.

name: Gmail
description: Messages, conversations, labels and drafts of a Gmail mailbox.

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of the mailbox that match q and labelIds. Each item has only id and threadId: read the content with Get message. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query in the syntax of the Gmail search box, such as from:ana@example.com is:unread newer_than:7d or subject:invoice has:attachment.

params.name: labelIds
params.description: Only messages that have all these labels: ids from List labels, or system labels such as INBOX, UNREAD and STARRED.

params.name: includeSpamTrash
params.description: Also returns the messages in SPAM and TRASH. The default is false.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Messages per page, up to 500. The default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Get message
tools.description: Gets a message with its threadId, labelIds and snippet. With format full, the default, payload has the headers (From, To, Subject, Date, Message-ID) and the body parts, whose data is base64url encoded. Attachments come only as an attachmentId and are not downloaded.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Message id from List messages, or the message.id of a draft from List drafts.

params.name: format
params.description: full returns the parsed payload, metadata only the headers, minimal only the ids and labels, and raw the whole RFC 2822 message base64url encoded in raw. The default is full.

params.name: metadataHeaders
params.description: With format metadata, returns only these headers, such as From, Subject and Message-ID.

tools.name: Get thread
tools.description: Gets a conversation with all its messages. Each message has id, labelIds, snippet and, with format full, the default, the payload with the headers and the base64url encoded body parts.

params.name: threadId
params.description: Thread id from List messages or Get message.

params.name: format
params.description: full returns the parsed payload of each message, metadata only the headers, and minimal only the ids and labels. The default is full.

params.name: metadataHeaders
params.description: With format metadata, returns only these headers, such as From, Subject and Message-ID.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Sends an email right away to the recipients in the To, Cc and Bcc headers of raw, and returns the sent message with id, threadId and labelIds. To reply inside a conversation, pass its threadId, keep the same Subject and set the In-Reply-To and References headers to the Message-ID of the message answered, which Get message returns in payload.headers.

params.name: raw
params.description: The whole email in RFC 2822 format, base64url encoded: the header lines, such as To, Cc, Subject and Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8, a blank line and the body. A subject with accents goes encoded as =?UTF-8?B?...?=.

params.name: threadId
params.description: Thread id from List messages, Get message or Get thread, to send the email as a reply in that conversation.

tools.name: Update message labels
tools.description: Adds and removes labels on a message and returns its labelIds. Remove UNREAD to mark it as read, remove INBOX to archive it, add STARRED to star it, or add TRASH to move it to the trash.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Message id from List messages.

params.name: addLabelIds
params.description: Labels to add, up to 100: ids from List labels, or system labels such as UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, INBOX, SPAM and TRASH.

params.name: removeLabelIds
params.description: Labels to remove, up to 100: ids from List labels, or system labels such as UNREAD and INBOX.

tools.name: List labels
tools.description: Lists the labels of the mailbox: the system labels, such as INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, UNREAD, STARRED and SPAM, and the labels the user created. The id of each one is what labelIds, addLabelIds and removeLabelIds take.

tools.name: Create label
tools.description: Creates a label and returns it with its id, to apply with Update message labels. The name cannot be the name of a system label or of an existing label.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the label, as Gmail shows it.

params.name: labelListVisibility
params.description: Whether the label shows in the label list of Gmail: always, only while it has unread messages, or never.

params.name: messageListVisibility
params.description: Whether the label shows on the messages in the message list of Gmail.

tools.name: List drafts
tools.description: Lists the drafts of the mailbox. Each item has the draft id and a message with id and threadId: read the content with Get message using message.id. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query in the syntax of the Gmail search box, such as to:ana@example.com or subject:proposal.

params.name: includeSpamTrash
params.description: Also returns the drafts in SPAM and TRASH. The default is false.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Drafts per page, up to 500. The default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Create draft
tools.description: Saves an email as a draft without sending it, and returns the draft id and its message with id and threadId. Send it later with Send draft.

params.name: message
params.description: The email of the draft.

tools.name: Update draft
tools.description: Replaces the whole email of a draft. The draft id stays and message.id changes. To edit the current text, read it first with Get message, format raw, using the message.id from List drafts.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Draft id from List drafts or Create draft.

params.name: message
params.description: The new email of the draft.

tools.name: Send draft
tools.description: Sends an existing draft right away to the recipients in its To, Cc and Bcc headers. The draft is deleted, and the sent message comes back with a new id and the SENT label.

params.name: id
params.description: Draft id from List drafts or Create draft.

tools.name: Delete draft
tools.description: Deletes a draft for good, without moving it to the trash.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Draft id from List drafts or Create draft.

name: Google Calendar
description: Calendars and events of a Google account.

tools.name: List calendars
tools.description: Lists the calendars on the user's calendar list. Use the id of an item as calendarId in the event tools. The id primary is the user's main calendar.

params.name: minAccessRole
params.description: Only calendars where the user has at least this role.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Results per page.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Lists the events of a calendar. Set singleEvents to true to expand recurring events, which is required to order by startTime.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars, or primary.

params.name: timeMin
params.description: Exclusive lower bound for the event end time, RFC3339 with offset.

params.name: timeMax
params.description: Exclusive upper bound for the event start time, RFC3339 with offset.

params.name: q
params.description: Free text searched in summary, description, location and attendees.

params.name: singleEvents
params.description: Expands recurring events into single instances.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: startTime requires singleEvents set to true.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Results per page. The default is 250.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Create event
tools.description: Creates an event. Use start.dateTime and end.dateTime for a timed event, or start.date and end.date for an all-day event. sendUpdates decides who is emailed about it. A Google Meet link needs conferenceData with conferenceDataVersion 1.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars, or primary.

params.name: sendUpdates
params.description: Who receives an email about the new event.

params.name: conferenceDataVersion
params.description: Send 1 together with conferenceData. With the default, 0, the conference in the body is ignored.

params.name: summary
params.description: Title of the event.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the event.

params.name: location
params.description: Free-form location.

params.name: start
params.description: When the event starts.

params.name: end
params.description: When the event ends.

params.name: attendees
params.description: People invited to the event.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE or EXDATE lines of RFC 5545 for a recurring event, for example RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO;COUNT=10. A recurring event needs timeZone in start and end. DTSTART and DTEND lines are not accepted.

params.name: conferenceData
params.description: Video conference of the event. For a new Google Meet link send createRequest, with conferenceDataVersion 1. The link comes back in hangoutLink and in conferenceData.entryPoints.

tools.name: Get event
tools.description: Returns one event with its attendees and their responses, the Meet link in hangoutLink, and recurringEventId when it is an instance of a recurring event.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars, or primary.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Event id, from List events.

tools.name: Update event
tools.description: Changes the fields sent and keeps the others. A list, such as attendees or recurrence, replaces the whole list, so send every attendee that should stay. sendUpdates decides who is emailed about the change.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars, or primary.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Event id, from List events. The id of a recurring event changes the whole series; the id of one instance, listed with singleEvents true, changes only that one.

params.name: sendUpdates
params.description: Who receives an email about the change.

params.name: conferenceDataVersion
params.description: Send 1 together with conferenceData. With the default, 0, the conference in the body is ignored.

params.name: summary
params.description: Title of the event.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the event.

params.name: location
params.description: Free-form location.

params.name: start
params.description: When the event starts: dateTime for a timed event, or date for an all-day event.

params.name: end
params.description: When the event ends: dateTime for a timed event, or date for an all-day event.

params.name: attendees
params.description: The full list of people invited to the event.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE or EXDATE lines of RFC 5545 for a recurring event, for example RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO;COUNT=10. A recurring event needs timeZone in start and end. DTSTART and DTEND lines are not accepted.

params.name: conferenceData
params.description: Video conference of the event. For a new Google Meet link send createRequest, with conferenceDataVersion 1. The link comes back in hangoutLink and in conferenceData.entryPoints.

tools.name: Delete event
tools.description: Deletes an event. The id of a recurring event deletes the whole series; the id of one instance deletes only that one. sendUpdates decides who is emailed about the cancellation. The response is empty, status 204.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars, or primary.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Event id, from List events. Instances of a recurring event are listed with singleEvents true.

params.name: sendUpdates
params.description: Who receives an email about the cancellation.

tools.name: Get free/busy
tools.description: Returns the busy intervals of one or more calendars between timeMin and timeMax, under calendars, keyed by calendar id. A calendar the user cannot see comes back with errors instead of busy.

params.name: timeMin
params.description: Start of the interval, RFC3339 with offset.

params.name: timeMax
params.description: End of the interval, RFC3339 with offset.

params.name: timeZone
params.description: IANA time zone of the response, such as America/Sao_Paulo. The default is UTC.

params.name: items
params.description: Calendars to check. Each id is a calendar id from List calendars, primary, or the email of a person who shares their calendar with the user.

tools.name: Create calendar
tools.description: Creates a secondary calendar owned by the user, such as a content calendar for one client. The id in the response goes in calendarId of the event tools.

params.name: summary
params.description: Title of the calendar.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the calendar.

params.name: timeZone
params.description: IANA time zone of the calendar, such as America/Sao_Paulo.

name: Google Chat
description: Spaces, direct messages, messages and members of a Google Chat user.

tools.name: List spaces
tools.description: Lists the spaces, group chats and direct messages the user is a member of, with name, displayName and spaceType. The part of the name after spaces/ is the spaceId of the other tools, and group chats and direct messages only show up after their first message.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter by type, written as spaceType = "SPACE", "GROUP_CHAT" or "DIRECT_MESSAGE". Join several types with OR.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Spaces per page, up to 1000. The default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Get direct message
tools.description: Returns the direct message space between the user and another person; the part of its name after spaces/ is the spaceId for Send message. Responds 404 when the two have no direct message yet, which Create space starts.

params.name: name
params.description: The other person as users/ followed by the email address, such as users/ana@example.com.

tools.name: Create space
tools.description: Creates a space with the user in it and invites other people. SPACE needs displayName and takes up to 49 people; GROUP_CHAT takes at least two people and no name; DIRECT_MESSAGE takes exactly one person and returns the existing direct message when there is one.

params.name: space
params.description: The space to create.

params.name: memberships
params.description: People to invite, without the user, who joins automatically.

params.name: requestId
params.description: A random UUID of your own that makes the call idempotent: repeating it with the same requestId returns the space already created.

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of a space, oldest first by default, with name, sender, createTime, text and thread. Senders come as users/ followed by an id, without the display name; send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces or Get direct message.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter by creation time and thread: create_time followed by a greater-than or a less-than sign and an RFC 3339 timestamp in double quotes, such as "2026-10-01T00:00:00-03:00", and thread.name = spaces/AAAAAAAAAAA/threads/123. Join conditions with AND.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Order by creation time: ASC, the default, brings the oldest first, and DESC the latest first.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Messages per page, up to 1000. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response, with the same filter and orderBy.

params.name: showDeleted
params.description: true also returns deleted messages, without their content.

tools.name: Search messages
tools.description: Searches messages by keywords in every space and direct message of the user, latest first. Each result has the message, whose name carries the space and message ids; messages from Chat apps, private messages and muted spaces are left out.

params.name: filter
params.description: Keywords, with quotes for an exact phrase, and optional conditions joined by AND: space.name = "spaces/AAAAAAAAAAA", space.display_name:Project, sender.name = "users/ana@example.com", attachment:*, has_link(), and create_time followed by a greater-than-or-equal or a less-than sign and an RFC 3339 timestamp in double quotes. Up to 1000 characters.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Results per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response, with the same filter.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Sends a text message from the user to a space or direct message. To reply in a thread, send thread with the thread name from List messages and messageReplyOption; without messageReplyOption the message starts a new thread.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces, Get direct message or Create space.

params.name: text
params.description: Text of the message. Supports Chat formatting, such as *bold* and _italic_, and the first link gets a preview.

params.name: thread
params.description: Thread to reply in. Goes with messageReplyOption.

params.name: messageReplyOption
params.description: Needed to reply in a thread: REPLY_MESSAGE_FALLBACK_TO_NEW_THREAD starts a new thread when the reply fails, and REPLY_MESSAGE_OR_FAIL returns NOT_FOUND. Only in named spaces.

params.name: requestId
params.description: A random UUID of your own that makes the call idempotent: repeating it with the same requestId returns the message already sent.

tools.name: Update message
tools.description: Changes the text of a message, with updateMask set to text.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Id of the message: the part after messages/ in its name, from List messages, Search messages or Send message, such as BBBBBBBBBBB.BBBBBBBBBBB.

params.name: updateMask
params.description: Fields to change. Send text, the field this tool changes.

params.name: text
params.description: New text of the message.

tools.name: Delete message
tools.description: Deletes a message. A message with replies in a thread is only deleted with force set to true, which deletes the replies too.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Id of the message: the part after messages/ in its name, from List messages, Search messages or Send message.

params.name: force
params.description: true also deletes the replies of the message.

tools.name: Create reaction
tools.description: Adds an emoji reaction from the user to a message.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Id of the message: the part after messages/ in its name, from List messages or Search messages.

params.name: emoji
params.description: The emoji of the reaction.

tools.name: List members
tools.description: Lists the members of a space with role and state. Members come as users/ followed by an id, without the display name; send nextPageToken as pageToken for the next page.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter by role or type, such as role = "ROLE_MANAGER" or member.type = "HUMAN". Join the two with AND or OR.

params.name: showInvited
params.description: true also returns people invited who haven't joined.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Members per page, up to 1000. The default is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response, with the same filter.

tools.name: Create member
tools.description: Adds a person to a space, or invites them when their settings ask for acceptance. Needs a user allowed to add members to the space.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Id of the space: the part after spaces/ in the name from List spaces.

params.name: member
params.description: The person to add.

name: Google Docs
description: Google Docs documents of a Google account: create them, read their content and edit their text.

tools.name: Create document
tools.description: Creates a blank Google Doc in the root folder of My Drive and returns it with its documentId. Add the content afterwards with Update document. To start from a template or in a given folder, copy or create the file with Google Drive instead.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the document, which is also its file name in Drive.

tools.name: Get document
tools.description: Gets a document with its title, revisionId and content. The text is in body.content: each paragraph has elements whose textRun.content holds the text, with the startIndex and endIndex that Update document uses as positions, counted in UTF-16 code units.

params.name: documentId
params.description: Document id: the part of the URL of the document between /d/ and /edit, or the documentId from Create document.

params.name: includeTabsContent
params.description: true returns every tab of the document in tabs, each with its tabId and content. false, the default, returns only the first tab, in body.

params.name: suggestionsViewMode
params.description: How pending suggestions show: inline, as if accepted, or as if rejected. Edits must be based on the document read with SUGGESTIONS_INLINE.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, such as documentId,title,revisionId,body to leave out styles and lists.

tools.name: Update document
tools.description: Applies a list of edits to a document, in order and all or nothing: if one request is invalid, none is applied. Each item of requests has exactly one kind of edit. replaceAllText fills a template without positions; the other kinds use the indexes from Get document. Send edits with indexes from the highest index to the lowest, so one does not shift the next.

params.name: documentId
params.description: Document id: the part of the URL of the document between /d/ and /edit, or the documentId from Create document.

params.name: requests
params.description: The edits, applied in order. Each item has exactly one of the keys below. Other kinds of the Docs API reference, such as insertTableRow or createHeader, are accepted too.

params.name: writeControl
params.description: Guards the edits against changes made to the document after Get document. Use one of the two fields.

name: Google Drive
description: Files, folders, sharing and comments of a Google Drive account, including its shared drives.

tools.name: List files
tools.description: Searches the files and folders the account can see. Each file comes with only id, name and mimeType unless fields asks for more, such as webViewLink, modifiedTime and parents. To leave out the trash, add trashed = false to q. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query in the Drive syntax, such as name contains 'budget' and trashed = false, 'FOLDER_ID' in parents with a folder id from this tool or root for the top of My Drive, or mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, such as nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,webViewLink,parents). Keep nextPageToken in the list to page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Files per page, up to 1000. Always set it: without it a search in My Drive returns every matching file at once.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Comma-separated sort keys, each one optionally followed by desc, such as modifiedTime desc or folder,name. Keys: createdTime, folder, modifiedByMeTime, modifiedTime, name, name_natural, quotaBytesUsed, recency, sharedWithMeTime, starred and viewedByMeTime.

params.name: corpora
params.description: Where to search: user, the default, is My Drive and the files shared with the account; drive is one shared drive, given in driveId; allDrives is everything, and slower.

params.name: driveId
params.description: Id of a shared drive from List shared drives, with corpora drive, includeItemsFromAllDrives and supportsAllDrives.

params.name: includeItemsFromAllDrives
params.description: Includes files of shared drives in the results. Needs supportsAllDrives set to true.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true to reach files of shared drives.

tools.name: Get file
tools.description: Gets the metadata of a file or folder, not its content. webViewLink is the address that opens it in the browser, and parents has the id of the folder it is in.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File or folder id from List files.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, such as id,name,mimeType,parents,webViewLink,modifiedTime,owners,size, or * for all of them. Without it only basic fields, such as id, name and mimeType, come back.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file can be in a shared drive.

tools.name: Create file
tools.description: Creates a file with metadata only, without content: a folder, or an empty Google Doc, Sheet or Slides presentation, chosen by mimeType. Returns id, name and mimeType, plus whatever fields asks for, such as webViewLink.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the new file or folder. Without it Google names it Untitled.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: What to create: a folder, a Google Doc, a Google Sheet or a Google Slides presentation.

params.name: parents
params.description: The folder to create it in, as a one-item list with a folder id from List files. Without it the file goes to the top of My Drive.

params.name: description
params.description: Short description of the file.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, such as id,name,webViewLink.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the folder in parents can be in a shared drive.

tools.name: Update file
tools.description: Renames, describes, stars, moves or trashes a file or folder; only the fields sent change. To move it, pass the new folder in addParents and the current one, from the parents of Get file, in removeParents. A folder of My Drive cannot move into a shared drive.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File or folder id from List files.

params.name: name
params.description: New name.

params.name: description
params.description: New short description.

params.name: starred
params.description: Stars or unstars the file for the account.

params.name: trashed
params.description: true moves the file to the trash, where it stays for 30 days, and false restores it. Only the owner can trash a file of My Drive.

params.name: addParents
params.description: Folder id from List files to move the file into, or several ids separated by commas.

params.name: removeParents
params.description: Folder id to take the file out of, usually its current parent from Get file, or several ids separated by commas.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file can be in a shared drive.

tools.name: Copy file
tools.description: Copies a file, such as a report template, and returns the new file. Without parents the copy stays in the same folder as the original. Folders cannot be copied.

params.name: fileId
params.description: Id of the file to copy, from List files.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the copy.

params.name: parents
params.description: The folder of the copy, as a one-item list with a folder id from List files.

params.name: description
params.description: Short description of the copy.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, such as id,name,webViewLink.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file or the folder in parents can be in a shared drive.

tools.name: List shared drives
tools.description: Lists the shared drives the account is a member of, with id and name. The id goes in driveId of List files. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query for shared drives, such as name contains 'Clients'.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Shared drives per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List permissions
tools.description: Lists who has access to a file or folder. Without fields each permission has only basic fields, such as id, type and role: ask for emailAddress and displayName in fields to see who it is. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File or folder id from List files.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, such as nextPageToken,permissions(id,type,role,emailAddress,displayName,domain).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Permissions per page, up to 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file can be in a shared drive.

params.name: includePermissionsForView
params.description: Set it to published to include, besides the permissions of the file, the permissions of the published view of a Google Form, which say who can answer it.

tools.name: Create permission
tools.description: Shares a file or folder and returns the new permission with its id. Google emails the users and groups it is shared with, unless sendNotificationEmail is false. emailAddress is required for type user or group, and domain for type domain.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File or folder id from List files.

params.name: role
params.description: Access to grant. fileOrganizer and organizer only exist in shared drives.

params.name: type
params.description: Who receives it: a user or group by e-mail, everyone in a domain, or anyone with the link.

params.name: emailAddress
params.description: E-mail of the user or group, for type user or group.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain, such as example.com, for type domain.

params.name: allowFileDiscovery
params.description: For type domain or anyone, whether the file shows up in search. Without it the file is reached only by its link.

params.name: expirationTime
params.description: When the access ends, RFC 3339, in the future and at most a year away. Only for type user or group.

params.name: sendNotificationEmail
params.description: Emails users and groups about the share. The default is true; false shares silently.

params.name: emailMessage
params.description: Plain text message added to the notification e-mail.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file can be in a shared drive.

params.name: view
params.description: Set it to published to grant access to the published view of a Google Form, which decides who can answer it: with type anyone, anyone with the link; with type user, the given email. Omit it for a normal permission on the file.

tools.name: Update permission
tools.description: Changes the role or the expiration of an access that already exists, and returns the permission.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File or folder id from List files.

params.name: permissionId
params.description: Permission id from List permissions.

params.name: role
params.description: New access. fileOrganizer and organizer only exist in shared drives.

params.name: expirationTime
params.description: New end of the access, RFC 3339, in the future and at most a year away. Only for type user or group.

params.name: removeExpiration
params.description: Set to true to remove the expiration, so the access no longer ends.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file can be in a shared drive.

tools.name: Delete permission
tools.description: Removes an access from a file or folder: the user, group, domain or link loses it.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File or folder id from List files.

params.name: permissionId
params.description: Permission id from List permissions.

params.name: supportsAllDrives
params.description: Set to true when the file can be in a shared drive.

tools.name: List comments
tools.description: Lists the comments of a file, such as a Google Doc under review, with their replies and whether they are resolved. Google requires fields in this call. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File id from List files.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, required by Google, such as nextPageToken,comments(id,content,author/displayName,createdTime,resolved,quotedFileContent/value,replies(content,author/displayName)).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Comments per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

params.name: startModifiedTime
params.description: Only comments changed since this moment, RFC 3339.

params.name: includeDeleted
params.description: Also returns deleted comments, without their content.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a file. In Google Docs, Sheets and Slides it is not tied to a passage: it shows as a comment on the whole file. Google requires fields in this call.

params.name: fileId
params.description: File id from List files.

params.name: content
params.description: Plain text of the comment.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return, required by Google, such as id,content,createdTime.

name: Google Forms
description: Forms and their responses of a Google account.

tools.name: Create form
tools.description: Creates an empty form with a title and returns its formId and responderUri, the link for respondents. Add the questions with Update form. Since July 2026 a form created by the API starts unpublished and takes no responses until Update publish settings publishes it.

params.name: info
params.description: Only the titles: the description, the items and the settings are refused here and go in Update form.

tools.name: Get form
tools.description: Returns a form: info, settings, publishSettings, responderUri (the link for respondents), revisionId and the items in order, each with its itemId and, in a question, its questionId. The answers of List responses are keyed by questionId.

params.name: formId
params.description: Form id from Create form, or from the editing URL of the form, between /d/ and /edit. The link for respondents, with /d/e/, carries another id.

tools.name: Update form
tools.description: Edits a form: creates, changes, moves and deletes questions, blocks of text and sections, and changes the title, the description and the email collection. The edits apply in order and all or nothing. The replies of createItem bring the new itemId and questionId.

params.name: formId
params.description: Form id from Create form, or from the editing URL of the form, between /d/ and /edit. The link for respondents, with /d/e/, carries another id.

params.name: requests
params.description: The edits. Each item has exactly one of the keys below. Each edit sees the form as the previous ones left it, so the positions shift after a create, a delete or a move.

params.name: includeFormInResponse
params.description: Returns the whole form after the edits.

params.name: writeControl
params.description: Guards the edits against changes made to the form after Get form. Use one of the two fields.

tools.name: Update publish settings
tools.description: Publishes, closes or unpublishes a form. isPublished and isAcceptingResponses both true open it for responses, isPublished true with isAcceptingResponses false closes it, and both false unpublish it. Who can respond follows the sharing of the form in Google Drive. Legacy forms, whose Get form has no publishSettings, are not supported.

params.name: formId
params.description: Form id from Create form, or from the editing URL of the form, between /d/ and /edit. The link for respondents, with /d/e/, carries another id.

params.name: publishSettings
params.description: The new publishing state.

tools.name: List responses
tools.description: Lists the responses of a form, each with responseId, createTime, lastSubmittedTime, respondentEmail when the form collects it, and answers keyed by questionId: Get form tells which question each questionId is. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: formId
params.description: Form id from Create form, or from the editing URL of the form, between /d/ and /edit. The link for respondents, with /d/e/, carries another id.

params.name: filter
params.description: Only the responses submitted after a moment: the word timestamp, the greater-than sign and an RFC 3339 time in UTC ending in Z, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. The greater-than sign followed by an equals sign also includes that moment.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Responses per page. Always set it: without it, up to 5000 responses come at once.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response, with the same filter.

tools.name: Get response
tools.description: Returns one response of a form, with its answers keyed by questionId.

params.name: formId
params.description: Form id from Create form, or from the editing URL of the form, between /d/ and /edit. The link for respondents, with /d/e/, carries another id.

params.name: responseId
params.description: Response id from List responses.

name: Google Tag Manager
description: Containers, tags, triggers and versions of the Google Tag Manager accounts of a Google account.

tools.name: List accounts
tools.description: Lists the Tag Manager accounts the user can access, with accountId and name. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List containers
tools.description: Lists the containers of an account, with containerId, name, publicId (the GTM- code installed on the site) and usageContext, such as web. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List workspaces
tools.description: Lists the workspaces of a container, with workspaceId and name. Tags and triggers are edited in a workspace, usually Default Workspace, and reach the site only through Create version and Publish version.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: Lists the tags of a workspace, with tagId, name, type, parameter, firingTriggerId and paused. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Get tag
tools.description: Returns a tag with all its fields, including fingerprint. Update tag replaces the whole tag, so it starts from this response.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Tag id from List tags.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Creates a tag in a workspace. It reaches the site only after Create version and Publish version. Without firingTriggerId the tag never fires.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the tag in Tag Manager.

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of tag, such as html for Custom HTML. For other kinds, copy type and parameter from a tag of the same kind with Get tag.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Settings of the tag, which depend on its type. A Custom HTML tag takes a template parameter with key html and the code in value.

params.name: firingTriggerId
params.description: Ids of the triggers that fire the tag, from List triggers or Create trigger. The tag fires when any of them is true.

params.name: blockingTriggerId
params.description: Ids of the triggers that block the tag, from List triggers. While any of them is true, the tag does not fire.

params.name: paused
params.description: true keeps the tag from firing without deleting it.

params.name: tagFiringOption
params.description: How often the tag fires: unlimited, once per event or once per page load.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes about the tag.

tools.name: Update tag
tools.description: Replaces a whole tag: send every field to keep, as Get tag returns it, with the changes, because a field left out is cleared. Set paused to true to stop a tag without deleting it. The change reaches the site only after Create version and Publish version.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Tag id from List tags.

params.name: fingerprint
params.description: The fingerprint from Get tag: if the tag changed since then, Google refuses the update.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the tag in Tag Manager.

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of tag, such as html for Custom HTML. For other kinds, copy type and parameter from a tag of the same kind with Get tag.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Settings of the tag, which depend on its type. A Custom HTML tag takes a template parameter with key html and the code in value.

params.name: firingTriggerId
params.description: Ids of the triggers that fire the tag, from List triggers or Create trigger. The tag fires when any of them is true.

params.name: blockingTriggerId
params.description: Ids of the triggers that block the tag, from List triggers. While any of them is true, the tag does not fire.

params.name: paused
params.description: true keeps the tag from firing without deleting it.

params.name: tagFiringOption
params.description: How often the tag fires: unlimited, once per event or once per page load.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes about the tag.

params.name: liveOnly
params.description: true fires the tag only in the live environment, not in preview.

params.name: priority
params.description: Firing priority as an integer parameter: tags with a higher value fire first. The default is 0.

params.name: scheduleStartMs
params.description: Start of the firing schedule, in milliseconds since 1970, as text.

params.name: scheduleEndMs
params.description: End of the firing schedule, in milliseconds since 1970, as text.

params.name: parentFolderId
params.description: Folder id of the tag, from Get tag.

params.name: consentSettings
params.description: Consent the tag checks before firing.

params.name: monitoringMetadata
params.description: A map parameter with key and value pairs added to the event data for tag monitoring. Its entries are template parameters without variables.

params.name: monitoringMetadataTagNameKey
params.description: Key under which the tag name goes in monitoringMetadata. Empty leaves it out.

params.name: setupTag
params.description: Tag that fires before this one.

params.name: teardownTag
params.description: Tag that fires after this one.

tools.name: Delete tag
tools.description: Deletes a tag from a workspace. The site keeps firing it until a version without the tag is published.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Tag id from List tags.

tools.name: List triggers
tools.description: Lists the triggers of a workspace, with triggerId, name, type and conditions. A triggerId goes in firingTriggerId or blockingTriggerId of a tag. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Create trigger
tools.description: Creates a trigger in a workspace and returns its triggerId. A pageview trigger without filter fires on every page. A condition compares a variable, such as {{Page URL}}, with a value; the built-in variables of clicks and forms, such as {{Click ID}}, only work once enabled in the workspace, which this toolkit does not do.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the trigger in Tag Manager.

params.name: type
params.description: Event that fires the trigger: pageview, domReady or windowLoaded for page loads, customEvent for a dataLayer event, click for any element, linkClick for links only, formSubmission, historyChange, timer, scrollDepth, elementVisibility, youTubeVideo, jsError, init or consentInit.

params.name: filter
params.description: Conditions that must all be true for the trigger to fire.

params.name: customEventFilter
params.description: Only customEvent: conditions on the event, such as {{_event}} equals the event name pushed to the dataLayer.

params.name: autoEventFilter
params.description: Only the triggers that listen to the page, such as linkClick, formSubmission and timer: conditions that enable the listener on a page, usually on {{Page URL}}.

params.name: waitForTags
params.description: Only formSubmission and linkClick: true holds the submit or the link until the tags fire.

params.name: waitForTagsTimeout
params.description: Only formSubmission and linkClick: how long to hold, in milliseconds.

params.name: checkValidation
params.description: Only formSubmission and linkClick: true fires the tags only if the submit or the click is not canceled by the page, such as by a failed validation.

params.name: eventName
params.description: Only timer: name of the event the timer pushes.

params.name: interval
params.description: Only timer: milliseconds between events.

params.name: limit
params.description: Only timer: how many events to push at most.

params.name: parameter
params.description: Other settings of the trigger, such as the scroll percentages of a scrollDepth trigger or the element of an elementVisibility trigger.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes about the trigger.

tools.name: Create version
tools.description: Turns the changes of a workspace into a container version, which reaches the site only through Publish version. The workspace is deleted afterwards: the response brings containerVersion, with its containerVersionId, and newWorkspacePath, whose last part is the id of the workspace that replaces it. compilerError true means the workspace has errors to fix.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Workspace id from List workspaces.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the version.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes about the version, such as what changed.

tools.name: List versions
tools.description: Lists the versions of a container, with containerVersionId, name and the number of tags, triggers and variables. To go back to an earlier version, publish it with Publish version. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: includeDeleted
params.description: Also lists the deleted versions.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Publish version
tools.description: Publishes a container version: its tags go live on every site that has the container, in place of the version published before. Google asks for no confirmation.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Account id from List accounts.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id from List containers: the number in containerId, not the GTM- code of publicId.

params.name: versionId
params.description: The containerVersionId from Create version, or from List versions to go back to an earlier version.

name: Google Tasks
description: Task lists and tasks of a Google account.

tools.name: List task lists
tools.description: Lists the task lists of the account, with id and title. Use the id of an item as tasklist in the other tools. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Task lists per page, up to 1000, which is also the default.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Create task list
tools.description: Creates a task list and returns it with its id. An account can have up to 2000 task lists.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the task list.

tools.name: Update task list
tools.description: Renames a task list.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists.

params.name: title
params.description: New title of the task list.

tools.name: List tasks
tools.description: Lists the tasks of a task list, subtasks included, with id, title, notes, status, due, completed and parent, the id of the parent task of a subtask. Tasks completed in the Google apps are hidden: set showHidden to true to see them. Pass nextPageToken as pageToken to read the next page.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists.

params.name: dueMin
params.description: Only tasks due on or after this RFC 3339 timestamp, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: dueMax
params.description: Only tasks due before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: completedMin
params.description: Only tasks completed on or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: completedMax
params.description: Only tasks completed before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: updatedMin
params.description: Only tasks changed on or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: showCompleted
params.description: Includes completed tasks. The default is true, but tasks completed in the Google apps also need showHidden set to true.

params.name: showHidden
params.description: Includes hidden tasks, which are the completed tasks cleared from the list, including the ones completed in the Google apps. The default is false.

params.name: showDeleted
params.description: Includes deleted tasks. The default is false.

params.name: showAssigned
params.description: Includes the tasks assigned to the account from Google Docs or Chat spaces. The default is false.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Tasks per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response.

tools.name: Get task
tools.description: Returns a task with its title, notes, status, due date, completion time, parent and webViewLink, the link to the task in the Google Tasks web app.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists.

params.name: task
params.description: Task id from List tasks.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Creates a task in a task list, in the first position unless previous says otherwise. Pass parent to create it as a subtask. Tasks assigned from Google Docs or Chat spaces cannot be created here.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the task.

params.name: notes
params.description: Notes of the task.

params.name: due
params.description: Day the task is planned for, as an RFC 3339 timestamp such as 2026-10-30T00:00:00Z. Only the date is kept: the API cannot set a time. It places the task on the calendar and is not a deadline.

params.name: status
params.description: needsAction, the default, for an open task, or completed.

params.name: parent
params.description: Task id from List tasks under which the new task is created as a subtask. Leave it out for a top-level task. A task assigned from Docs or Chat cannot be a parent.

params.name: previous
params.description: Task id from List tasks of the sibling the new task goes after. Leave it out to create the task in the first position.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Changes the title, notes, due date or status of a task; only the fields sent change. Set status to completed to complete the task, or to needsAction to reopen it. To change its list, parent or position, use Move task.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists.

params.name: task
params.description: Task id from List tasks.

params.name: title
params.description: New title of the task.

params.name: notes
params.description: New notes of the task. Tasks assigned from Google Docs cannot have notes.

params.name: due
params.description: Day the task is planned for, as an RFC 3339 timestamp such as 2026-10-30T00:00:00Z. Only the date is kept: the API cannot set a time. It places the task on the calendar and is not a deadline.

params.name: status
params.description: completed completes the task and needsAction reopens it.

tools.name: Move task
tools.description: Moves a task to another position, under another parent task or to another task list. Without parent the task goes to the top level, and without previous it goes to the first position. Repeating tasks cannot move to another list.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Id of the current task list of the task, from List task lists.

params.name: task
params.description: Task id from List tasks.

params.name: parent
params.description: Task id from List tasks of the new parent, which makes the task a subtask. It must be in the destination list and cannot be hidden, assigned or repeating.

params.name: previous
params.description: Task id from List tasks of the sibling the task goes after. It must be in the destination list and cannot be hidden.

params.name: destinationTasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists to move the task to. Leave it out to move the task inside its current list.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Deletes a task. A task assigned from Google Docs or Chat spaces is deleted there too.

params.name: tasklist
params.description: Task list id from List task lists.

params.name: task
params.description: Task id from List tasks.

name: Grafana Cloud
description: Dashboards and folders of a Grafana Cloud stack.

tools.name: List dashboards
tools.description: Lists the dashboards of the stack. Each item has metadata.name, the uid the other tools ask for, the folder uid in the metadata annotation grafana.app/folder and the whole dashboard JSON in spec, with its title. Keep limit small; when metadata.continue comes back, pass it as continue for the next page.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of dashboards to return.

params.name: continue
params.description: The metadata.continue token of the previous response, with the same limit.

tools.name: Get dashboard
tools.description: Returns one dashboard: metadata, with the uid in name, the resourceVersion and the folder annotation, and the dashboard JSON in spec, with title, panels, variables and time range.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: name
params.description: Uid of the dashboard, the metadata.name from List dashboards. It is also the segment after /d/ in the dashboard URL.

tools.name: Create dashboard
tools.description: Creates a dashboard from its JSON in spec, at the root or in a folder. Send metadata.name with the uid you want, or metadata.generateName with a prefix for a random uid. A uid already in use answers 409.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Identity and folder of the new dashboard.

params.name: spec
params.description: The dashboard JSON model: title, panels, templating, time, refresh and the other dashboard fields.

tools.name: Update dashboard
tools.description: Replaces a dashboard with a new version of its JSON. Read it with Get dashboard first, change spec and send back the whole spec, because fields left out are removed. Send the resourceVersion you read so a newer change is not overwritten; a stale one answers 409.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: name
params.description: Uid of the dashboard, the metadata.name from List dashboards.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Identity, version and folder of the dashboard.

params.name: spec
params.description: The whole dashboard JSON model, as Get dashboard returned it, with the changes.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Lists the folders of the stack the token can see, each with metadata.name, the uid the folder fields of the other tools ask for, the parent folder in the metadata annotation grafana.app/folder and the title in spec. When metadata.continue comes back, pass it as continue for the next page.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of folders to return.

params.name: continue
params.description: The metadata.continue token of the previous response, with the same limit.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a folder at the root or inside another folder. Send metadata.name with the uid you want, or metadata.generateName with a prefix for a random uid.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Identity and parent of the new folder.

params.name: spec
params.description: Content of the folder.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Renames a folder or moves it under another one. Send the title, and the parent in the annotation grafana.app/folder when it has one, because the call replaces the folder.

params.name: namespace
params.description: stacks- followed by the instance ID shown under Details of the Grafana instance in the Grafana Cloud portal, for example stacks-123456.

params.name: name
params.description: Uid of the folder, the metadata.name from List folders.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Identity and parent of the folder.

params.name: spec
params.description: Content of the folder.

name: Gumroad
description: Products, sales, subscribers and offer codes of a Gumroad creator account.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Lists the products of the account, newest first, 10 per page, in a short form: Get product returns the whole product. When more follow, the response has next_page_key, which goes in page_key.

params.name: page_key
params.description: The next_page_key of the previous response.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Returns a product with price, description, category, tags, variants, files and, with the view_sales scope, sales_count and sales_usd_cents.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products, for example A-m3CDDC5dlrSdKZp0RFhA==.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Lists the product categories of Gumroad. The path of a category, such as design/ui-and-web/figma, goes in category in Create product and Update product.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Creates a product and publishes it right away, unless draft is true. When publishing is blocked, for example by an unconfirmed email or a missing payout method, the product stays a draft and the response has a warning: publish it later with Publish product.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the product.

params.name: price
params.description: Price in the smallest unit of the currency, for example 1000 for 10.00 USD.

params.name: price_currency_type
params.description: ISO currency code, such as usd or brl. The currency of the account by default.

params.name: native_type
params.description: Kind of product, digital by default. It cannot be changed later.

params.name: subscription_duration
params.description: Billing period, only for a membership.

params.name: description
params.description: Description shown on the product page, as HTML.

params.name: custom_summary
params.description: Short summary of what the buyer gets.

params.name: custom_permalink
params.description: Custom last part of the product URL.

params.name: category
params.description: Path of a category from List categories, such as design/ui-and-web/figma.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the product.

params.name: customizable_price
params.description: true for pay what you want, with price as the minimum.

params.name: suggested_price_cents
params.description: Suggested price for pay what you want, in the smallest unit of the currency.

params.name: max_purchase_count
params.description: Limit of copies that can be sold.

params.name: draft
params.description: true saves the product as an unpublished draft. false by default.

tools.name: Update product
tools.description: Changes a product and returns it. Only the fields sent change, but tags replaces the whole list. A warning in the response reports offer codes that stopped being valid for the product.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the product.

params.name: price
params.description: Price in the smallest unit of the currency. Not accepted for a tiered membership, whose prices are on the tiers.

params.name: price_currency_type
params.description: ISO currency code, such as usd or brl.

params.name: description
params.description: Description shown on the product page, as HTML.

params.name: custom_summary
params.description: Short summary of what the buyer gets.

params.name: custom_receipt
params.description: Text added to the receipt the buyer gets.

params.name: custom_permalink
params.description: Custom last part of the product URL.

params.name: category
params.description: Path of a category from List categories, such as design/ui-and-web/figma.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the product. The list replaces the current one.

params.name: customizable_price
params.description: true for pay what you want, with price as the minimum.

params.name: suggested_price_cents
params.description: Suggested price for pay what you want, in the smallest unit of the currency.

params.name: max_purchase_count
params.description: Limit of copies that can be sold.

tools.name: Publish product
tools.description: Publishes a draft or unpublished product, so buyers can buy it. Refused while the account has no confirmed email or no payout method, or when an offer code of the product leaves the price invalid.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.
