tools.name: Unpublish product
tools.description: Unpublishes a product, which stops new sales. Publish product puts it back on sale.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

tools.name: List sales
tools.description: Lists the successful sales of the account, newest first, 10 per page, with buyer email, product, price, refund, subscription and license data. When more follow, the response has next_page_key, which goes in page_key.

params.name: after
params.description: Only sales after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: before
params.description: Only sales before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of a product from List products: only its sales.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the buyer.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the buyer.

params.name: order_id
params.description: The numeric order number shown on the receipt of the buyer.

params.name: license_key
params.description: License key sold with the product.

params.name: page_key
params.description: The next_page_key of the previous response. Keep the same filters.

tools.name: Get sale
tools.description: Returns a sale of the account: buyer, product, variants, price, refund and shipping status, subscription and license.

params.name: sale_id
params.description: Id of the sale, from List sales.

tools.name: List subscribers
tools.description: Lists the subscribers of a membership product, with email, recurrence, status (alive, pending_cancellation, failed_payment, cancelled and others) and the ids of their sales. Without paginated, every subscriber comes in one response.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of a membership product, from List products.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of a subscriber: only that subscriber.

params.name: paginated
params.description: true returns 100 per page, with next_page_key when more follow.

params.name: page_key
params.description: The next_page_key of the previous response.

tools.name: List offer codes
tools.description: Lists the offer codes of a product, with amount_cents for a fixed discount or percent_off for a percentage, uses, limit and validity. A universal code applies to every product.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

tools.name: Create offer code
tools.description: Creates a discount code that buyers type at checkout. The discount is in cents of the product currency unless offer_type is percent. The amount and universal cannot be changed later.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

params.name: name
params.description: The code the buyer types at checkout, such as BLACKFRIDAY30.

params.name: amount_off
params.description: Discount: cents of the product currency, or a percentage when offer_type is percent.

params.name: offer_type
params.description: cents by default.

params.name: universal
params.description: true makes the code valid for every product of the account. false by default.

params.name: max_purchase_count
params.description: How many times the code can be used.

params.name: minimum_amount_cents
params.description: Minimum order total, in cents, for the code to apply.

params.name: valid_at
params.description: Start of validity, RFC 3339 with time zone, such as 2026-11-27T00:00:00-03:00.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: End of validity, in the same format. It needs valid_at and must come after it.

params.name: auto_apply
params.description: true applies the discount by itself on product pages, as a sale. Only for a universal code, and only one per account.

params.name: sale_label
params.description: Plain text label of the automatic sale, up to 32 characters. Sale when empty.

name: Instantly
description: Cold email campaigns, leads and sending accounts of an Instantly workspace.

tools.name: List campaigns
tools.description: Lists the campaigns of the workspace with id, name and status, up to limit per page. For the next page, pass next_starting_after as starting_after, until it stops coming back.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the campaign name.

params.name: status
params.description: Only campaigns in this status: 0 draft, 1 active, 2 paused, 3 completed, 4 running subsequences, -1 accounts unhealthy, -2 bounce protect, -99 account suspended.

params.name: limit
params.description: Campaigns per page, up to 100.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The next_starting_after of the previous page.

tools.name: Get campaign
tools.description: Returns a campaign with its status, schedule, sequences (the email steps and their variants), sending accounts in email_list and sending options.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List campaigns.

tools.name: Create campaign
tools.description: Creates a campaign as a draft, with its schedule, email steps and sending accounts. Add leads with Create lead and start it with Activate campaign.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the campaign.

params.name: campaign_schedule
params.description: When the campaign sends.

params.name: sequences
params.description: The email copy, as a single sequence with its steps. Instantly only reads the first item.

params.name: email_list
params.description: Sending accounts, by the email from List accounts.

params.name: daily_limit
params.description: Maximum emails the campaign sends per day.

params.name: daily_max_leads
params.description: Maximum new leads contacted per day.

params.name: email_gap
params.description: Minutes between two emails of the campaign.

params.name: stop_on_reply
params.description: When true, a lead who replies gets no more steps.

params.name: stop_on_auto_reply
params.description: When true, an automatic reply, like out of office, also stops the lead.

params.name: stop_for_company
params.description: When true, a reply stops every lead of the same company domain.

params.name: open_tracking
params.description: Whether to track opens.

params.name: link_tracking
params.description: Whether to track link clicks.

params.name: text_only
params.description: When true, every email goes as plain text.

tools.name: Update campaign
tools.description: Changes a campaign. Send only the fields to change; sequences and campaign_schedule replace the current ones whole.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List campaigns.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the campaign.

params.name: campaign_schedule
params.description: When the campaign sends.

params.name: sequences
params.description: The email copy, as a single sequence with its steps. Instantly only reads the first item.

params.name: email_list
params.description: Sending accounts, by the email from List accounts. Replaces the current list.

params.name: daily_limit
params.description: Maximum emails the campaign sends per day.

params.name: daily_max_leads
params.description: Maximum new leads contacted per day.

params.name: email_gap
params.description: Minutes between two emails of the campaign.

params.name: stop_on_reply
params.description: When true, a lead who replies gets no more steps.

params.name: stop_on_auto_reply
params.description: When true, an automatic reply, like out of office, also stops the lead.

params.name: stop_for_company
params.description: When true, a reply stops every lead of the same company domain.

params.name: open_tracking
params.description: Whether to track opens.

params.name: link_tracking
params.description: Whether to track link clicks.

params.name: text_only
params.description: When true, every email goes as plain text.

tools.name: Activate campaign
tools.description: Starts a draft campaign or resumes a paused one. Instantly then sends the steps to the campaign leads, from the accounts in email_list, inside the schedule.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List campaigns.

tools.name: Pause campaign
tools.description: Pauses a campaign, so no more emails go out until Activate campaign resumes it.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List campaigns.

tools.name: Get campaign analytics
tools.description: Returns, per campaign, the leads, contacted, emails sent, opens, replies, link clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, completed leads and opportunities, for one campaign or all of them.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the campaign, from List campaigns. Omit it for every campaign.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the period, as a date like 2026-10-01 (UTC midnight) or a full ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the period, in the same formats as start_date.

params.name: exclude_total_leads_count
params.description: When true, leaves out the total of leads, which makes the call much faster.

tools.name: List leads
tools.description: Lists leads with their email, names, company, status and interest status, up to limit per page. For the next page, pass next_starting_after as starting_after, until it stops coming back.

params.name: campaign
params.description: Only leads of this campaign, by the id from List campaigns.

params.name: list_id
params.description: Only leads of this lead list, by the id from List lead lists.

params.name: search
params.description: Whole words, or the start of a value, matched against email, names, company and job title. Leads created a few seconds ago may not show yet.

params.name: filter
params.description: Only leads in this state, like FILTER_VAL_REPLIED for leads that replied or FILTER_LEAD_INTERESTED for leads marked as interested.

params.name: contacts
params.description: Only leads with these emails.

params.name: ids
params.description: Only these leads, by the id from a previous call of List leads.

params.name: in_campaign
params.description: True for leads that are in a campaign, false for leads outside any campaign.

params.name: in_list
params.description: True for leads that are in a lead list, false for leads outside any list.

params.name: limit
params.description: Leads per page, up to 100.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The next_starting_after of the previous page.

tools.name: Create lead
tools.description: Adds a lead to a campaign or to a lead list. A lead added to an active campaign enters its sequence and gets emails on the schedule.

params.name: campaign
params.description: Campaign that gets the lead, by the id from List campaigns. Send it or list_id.

params.name: list_id
params.description: Lead list that gets the lead, by the id from List lead lists. Send it or campaign.

params.name: email
params.description: Email of the lead, where the campaign sends.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the lead.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the lead.

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company of the lead.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title of the lead.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone of the lead.

params.name: website
params.description: Website of the lead.

params.name: personalization
params.description: Personalized line the email copy can use for this lead.

params.name: custom_variables
params.description: Extra variables of the lead, as text, number or boolean values by name, like {"industry": "Retail"}. The campaign starts accepting the same variable names for its other leads.

params.name: skip_if_in_workspace
params.description: When true, skips the lead if its email is already anywhere in the workspace.

params.name: skip_if_in_campaign
params.description: When true, skips the lead if it is already in a campaign.

params.name: skip_if_in_list
params.description: When true, skips the lead if it is already in a lead list.

tools.name: Update lead
tools.description: Changes a lead: its details, custom variables or interest status, such as marking it interested or meeting booked.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the lead, from List leads or Create lead.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the lead.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the lead.

params.name: company_name
params.description: Company of the lead.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title of the lead.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone of the lead.

params.name: website
params.description: Website of the lead.

params.name: personalization
params.description: Personalized line the email copy can use for this lead.

params.name: lt_interest_status
params.description: Interest status: 1 interested, 2 meeting booked, 3 meeting completed, 4 won, 0 out of office, -1 not interested, -2 wrong person, -3 lost, -4 no show.

params.name: custom_variables
params.description: Extra variables of the lead, as text, number or boolean values by name, like {"industry": "Retail"}.

tools.name: List accounts
tools.description: Lists the sending accounts (mailboxes) of the workspace with their email, status and warmup data, up to limit per page. For the next page, pass next_starting_after as starting_after, until it stops coming back.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the account email.

params.name: status
params.description: Only accounts in this status: 1 active, 2 paused, 3 paused for maintenance, -1 connection error, -2 soft bounce error, -3 sending error.

params.name: filter
params.description: Only accounts that are paused, have errors, have no custom tracking domain (NO_CTD), or whose warmup is active, paused or failing (W_).

params.name: limit
params.description: Accounts per page, up to 100.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The next_starting_after of the previous page.

tools.name: List lead lists
tools.description: Lists the lead lists of the workspace with id and name, up to limit per page. For the next page, pass next_starting_after as starting_after, until it stops coming back.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the list name.

params.name: limit
params.description: Lists per page, up to 100.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The next_starting_after of the previous page.

name: Intercom
description: Contacts, conversations and messages of an Intercom workspace.

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Lists the contacts of the workspace, users and leads, 10 per page by default. The next page comes from pages.next.starting_after in the response; without it, this is the last page. Merged contacts do not appear.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Contacts per page, up to 150. The default is 10.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The pages.next.starting_after of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: Search contacts
tools.description: Searches contacts by their attributes, for example by email, role or a custom attribute. Timestamps are Unix seconds in UTC. Returns total_count and data, 50 per page by default, and the next page comes from pages.next.starting_after. A contact created in the last few minutes may not show up yet.

params.name: query
params.description: Filters joined by AND or OR, up to 15 in the group. One filter also goes in the value list.

params.name: pagination
params.description: Page size and cursor.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort of the results.

tools.name: Get contact
tools.description: Returns one contact with role, email, phone, name, owner_id, custom_attributes, tags, companies and location. A contact merged into another returns 410.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts or Search contacts.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a contact, a user or a lead. Send at least one of email, external_id or role. Every custom attribute sent must already exist in the workspace, or Intercom refuses the contact.

params.name: role
params.description: lead creates a lead; user, or any other value, creates a user.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Unique id of the contact in your own system.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the contact.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the contact.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the contact.

params.name: avatar
params.description: URL of an image used as the avatar of the contact.

params.name: signed_up_at
params.description: When the contact signed up, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: last_seen_at
params.description: When the contact was last seen, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: owner_id
params.description: Id of the teammate who owns the contact, from List admins.

params.name: unsubscribed_from_emails
params.description: true if the contact unsubscribed from emails.

params.name: language_override
params.description: Preferred language of the contact for the Messenger, such as pt-BR or en.

params.name: custom_attributes
params.description: Custom attribute values keyed by attribute name. Each attribute must already exist in the workspace.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Updates a contact: send only the fields to change. A user cannot become a lead. Every custom attribute sent must already exist in the workspace.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts or Search contacts.

params.name: role
params.description: user turns a lead into a user. Sending lead for a user returns 400.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Unique id of the contact in your own system.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the contact.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the contact.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the contact.

params.name: avatar
params.description: URL of an image used as the avatar of the contact.

params.name: signed_up_at
params.description: When the contact signed up, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: last_seen_at
params.description: When the contact was last seen, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: owner_id
params.description: Id of the teammate who owns the contact, from List admins.

params.name: unsubscribed_from_emails
params.description: true if the contact unsubscribed from emails.

params.name: language_override
params.description: Preferred language of the contact for the Messenger, such as pt-BR or en.

params.name: custom_attributes
params.description: Custom attribute values keyed by attribute name. Each attribute must already exist in the workspace.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Lists the conversations of the workspace, 20 per page by default. The next page comes from pages.next.starting_after in the response; without it, this is the last page. Get conversation returns all the parts of one conversation.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Conversations per page, up to 150. The default is 20.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The pages.next.starting_after of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: Search conversations
tools.description: Searches conversations by their attributes, for example the open ones assigned to a teammate or a team. Timestamps are Unix seconds. Returns total_count and conversations, 20 per page by default, and the next page comes from pages.next.starting_after.

params.name: query
params.description: Filters joined by AND or OR, up to 15 in the group. One filter also goes in the value list.

params.name: pagination
params.description: Page size and cursor.

tools.name: Get conversation
tools.description: Returns one conversation with its parts (messages, notes and actions), up to the 500 most recent ones, plus state, assignees, contacts and tags.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations or Search conversations, sent as a number.

params.name: display_as
params.description: plaintext returns bodies and subjects as plain text, with links as label (url). Omit it for HTML.

tools.name: Create conversation reply
tools.description: Replies to a conversation as a teammate. A comment goes to the contact through the channel of the conversation, such as the Messenger or email; a note stays internal, visible only to teammates. Closing, snoozing, reopening and assigning are done by Manage conversation.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations or Search conversations.

params.name: message_type
params.description: comment is a reply the contact sees; note is internal.

params.name: type
params.description: Always admin: the reply comes from a teammate.

params.name: admin_id
params.description: Id of the teammate who writes the reply, from List admins.

params.name: body
params.description: Text of the reply. Notes accept some HTML formatting.

params.name: attachment_urls
params.description: URLs of images to attach, up to 10.

params.name: skip_notifications
params.description: true sends the reply without notifications.

tools.name: Manage conversation
tools.description: Closes, snoozes, reopens or assigns a conversation. close needs type admin; snoozed needs snoozed_until; assignment needs type and assignee_id, and a conversation can have an admin and a team assigned at the same time. Assigning a closed conversation reopens it unless skip_reopen is true.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Id of the conversation, from List conversations or Search conversations.

params.name: message_type
params.description: close, snoozed (reopens at snoozed_until), open (reopens a closed or snoozed conversation) or assignment.

params.name: admin_id
params.description: Id of the teammate performing the action, from List admins.

params.name: type
params.description: admin with close. With assignment, admin or team, saying what assignee_id is.

params.name: assignee_id
params.description: With assignment: id of the teammate, from List admins, or of the team, from List teams, matching type. 0 leaves the conversation unassigned.

params.name: snoozed_until
params.description: With snoozed: when the conversation reopens, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: body
params.description: Optional message left in the conversation with close or assignment.

params.name: skip_reopen
params.description: With assignment: true keeps a closed conversation closed.

tools.name: Create message
tools.description: Sends a new message from a teammate to a contact, in the Messenger (in_app) or by email. Email needs subject and template. The conversation only exists after the contact replies, unless create_conversation_without_contact_reply is true.

params.name: message_type
params.description: in_app shows the message in the Messenger; email sends it by email.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email. Required with email.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the message, as HTML or plain text.

params.name: template
params.description: Style of the email, plain or personal. Required with email.

params.name: from
params.description: The teammate who sends the message.

params.name: to
params.description: The contact who receives the message.

params.name: create_conversation_without_contact_reply
params.description: true opens the conversation in the inbox right away, without waiting for the contact to reply. The default is false.

tools.name: List admins
tools.description: Lists the teammates (admins) of the workspace with id, name, email, away_mode_enabled and team_ids. The id is the admin_id of replies and conversation actions and the owner_id of contacts.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Lists the teams of the workspace with id, name and admin_ids. The id is the assignee_id of a conversation assigned to a team.

name: Jira
description: Issues and projects of a Jira Cloud site.

tools.name: Search issues
tools.description: Searches issues with JQL. The query must be bounded, for example project = KEY. Only the issue id comes back unless fields lists what to include. Pass the nextPageToken of the response to read the next page.

params.name: jql
params.description: JQL query, for example project = KEY AND status = Done ORDER BY created DESC.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated field names to return, for example summary,status,assignee.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Issues per page.

params.name: nextPageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: Get issue
tools.description: Returns one issue by id or key, with all navigable fields unless fields lists what to include.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated field names to return. Omit it to return all navigable fields.

tools.name: Create issue
tools.description: Creates an issue. fields needs at least project, issuetype and summary, and any other field must exist on the create screen of the project, as List create fields shows. In this API version the description field takes an Atlassian Document Format object, not plain text.

params.name: fields
params.description: Field values of the new issue. The project key comes from List projects, the issue type name from List issue types, and the other field ids and allowed values from List create fields.

tools.name: Update issue
tools.description: Edits the fields of an issue: fields sets values, and update applies operations such as adding or removing one label. A field goes in fields or in update, never both. The status does not change here: use Transition issue. The response is empty, status 204, unless returnIssue is true.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: fields
params.description: New values by field id, for example {"summary": "New title", "priority": {"name": "High"}, "assignee": {"accountId": "..."}}. The accountId comes from Search assignable users. description and multi-line text fields take an Atlassian Document Format object.

params.name: update
params.description: Operations by field id, each a list of objects with one verb (set, add, remove or edit), for example {"labels": [{"add": "urgent"}, {"remove": "later"}]}.

params.name: returnIssue
params.description: true returns the edited issue in the response.

tools.name: Delete issue
tools.description: Deletes an issue. An issue with subtasks is only deleted with deleteSubtasks set to true, which deletes them too. Needs the Delete issues permission in the project. The response is empty, status 204.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: deleteSubtasks
params.description: true also deletes the subtasks of the issue.

tools.name: List transitions
tools.description: Lists the transitions the user can make on an issue now, each with the id that Transition issue takes, its name and the status it leads to in to.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: expand
params.description: transitions.fields adds the fields of each transition screen, with required and allowed values.

tools.name: Transition issue
tools.description: Moves an issue to another status by running one of its transitions. When the transition has a screen, its required fields, such as resolution, go in fields or update. The response is empty, status 204.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: transition
params.description: The transition to run.

params.name: fields
params.description: Values for fields of the transition screen by field id, for example {"resolution": {"name": "Done"}}. List transitions with expand shows them.

params.name: update
params.description: Operations on fields of the transition screen by field id, each a list of objects with one verb (set, add, remove or edit).

tools.name: List comments
tools.description: Lists the comments of an issue, with the body in Atlassian Document Format. Page with startAt and maxResults until startAt plus the returned count reaches total.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Order by creation date; -created puts the newest first.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Index of the first comment to return. The default is 0.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Comments per page. The default is 100.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to an issue, visible to everyone who can see the issue. Jira notifies the watchers by the notification scheme of the project. Returns the new comment.

params.name: issueIdOrKey
params.description: Issue id or key, for example KEY-123, from Search issues.

params.name: body
params.description: The comment in Atlassian Document Format, for example {"type": "doc", "version": 1, "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Approved"}]}]}.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects the user can see, with the key and id that the issue tools and JQL take. Page with startAt and maxResults until isLast is true.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against the project key and name, case insensitive.

params.name: action
params.description: Only projects where the user can do this. create lists where they can create issues. The default is view.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort field; a leading minus reverses it. The default is key.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Index of the first project to return. The default is 0.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Projects per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

tools.name: List issue types
tools.description: Lists the issue types the user can create in a project, with the id and name that Create issue and List create fields take, and subtask true for subtask types.

params.name: projectIdOrKey
params.description: Project key or id, from List projects.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Index of the first issue type to return. The default is 0.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Issue types per page, up to 200. The default is 50.

tools.name: List create fields
tools.description: Lists the fields of the create screen for a project and issue type: the fieldId that Create issue takes, whether it is required, its schema and its allowed values with their ids. Page with startAt and maxResults until total.

params.name: projectIdOrKey
params.description: Project key or id, from List projects.

params.name: issueTypeId
params.description: Issue type id, from List issue types.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Index of the first field to return. The default is 0.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Fields per page, up to 200. The default is 50.

tools.name: Search assignable users
tools.description: Finds users who can be assigned to new issues of a project or to one issue, with the accountId that the assignee field takes. Send project or issueKey. Returns a list, which can be shorter than maxResults even when more users exist.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against the start of the display name or of the email address, for example john finds John Smith.

params.name: project
params.description: Project key or id, from List projects, for users assignable to its new issues.

params.name: issueKey
params.description: Issue key, from Search issues, for users assignable to that issue.

params.name: startAt
params.description: Index of the first user to return. The default is 0.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Users per page. The default is 50.

name: Jotform
description: Forms, questions, submissions and reports of a Jotform account, read only.

tools.name: List forms
tools.description: Lists the forms of the account with id, title, status, url, dates and the counts of submissions (count) and unread ones (new). Paginate with offset and limit until fewer forms than limit come back.

params.name: offset
params.description: Items to skip, 0 by default.

params.name: limit
params.description: Forms per call, 20 by default and up to 1000.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter as a JSON object in text, on id, title, status, new, created_at or updated_at. A key can end in :gt, :lt or :ne to compare, like {"created_at:gt":"2026-01-01 00:00:00"} or {"status:ne":"DELETED"}.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Field the forms are sorted by: new is the unread count and count the total of submissions.

tools.name: Get form
tools.description: Returns the basic details of a form: title, status (ENABLED, DISABLED or DELETED), url, dates, last submission, total submissions (count) and unread ones (new).

params.name: form_id
params.description: Id of the form, from List forms or from the form URL: the number at the end of https://form.jotform.com/30693660548966.

tools.name: List form questions
tools.description: Lists the questions of a form keyed by question id (qid), with type, label (text), name, order and settings such as required. Submissions key their answers by the same qid.

params.name: form_id
params.description: Id of the form, from List forms or from the form URL: the number at the end of https://form.jotform.com/30693660548966.

tools.name: List form submissions
tools.description: Lists the submissions of a form, each with id, created_at, status (ACTIVE or OVERQUOTA), new and the answers keyed by question id, each with the question label, type and answer. Paginate with offset and limit until fewer submissions than limit come back.

params.name: form_id
params.description: Id of the form, from List forms or from the form URL: the number at the end of https://form.jotform.com/30693660548966.

params.name: offset
params.description: Items to skip, 0 by default.

params.name: limit
params.description: Submissions per call, 20 by default and up to 1000.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter as a JSON object in text, on id, IP, created_at, status, new, flag, updated_at or workflowStatus. A key can end in :gt, :lt or :ne to compare, like {"created_at:gt":"2026-01-01 00:00:00"}. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Submission field the list is sorted by, like created_at or id.

tools.name: List submissions
tools.description: Lists the submissions of every form of the account, each with id, form_id, created_at, status, new and the answers keyed by question id, each with the question label, type and answer. Paginate with offset and limit until fewer submissions than limit come back.

params.name: offset
params.description: Items to skip, 0 by default.

params.name: limit
params.description: Submissions per call, 20 by default and up to 1000.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter as a JSON object in text, on id, form_id, IP, created_at, status, new, flag or updated_at; a key can end in :gt, :lt or :ne. formIDs takes a list of form ids from List forms and fullText searches the answers, like {"formIDs":["30693660548966"]} or {"fullText":"John Brown"}.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Field the submissions are sorted by.

tools.name: Get submission
tools.description: Returns one submission with form_id, created_at, status, new and the answers keyed by question id, each with the question label, type and answer.

params.name: submission_id
params.description: Id of the submission, from List form submissions or List submissions.

tools.name: List form reports
tools.description: Lists the reports of a form with id, title, type in list_type (excel, csv, grid, table, calendar, rss or visual), the fields they show and the url where the report opens.

params.name: form_id
params.description: Id of the form, from List forms or from the form URL: the number at the end of https://form.jotform.com/30693660548966.

tools.name: Get report
tools.description: Returns one report with form_id, title, list_type, the fields it shows, status, url and whether it is password protected.

params.name: report_id
params.description: Id of the report, from List form reports.

name: Keap
description: Contacts, tags, opportunities, notes and tasks of a Keap app.

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Lists the contacts of the Keap app in contacts, with next_page_token for the following page. Without fields, each contact comes with a default set of properties. Filter by email, name, ids and other fields with filter.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters joined by ;, each one field==value, for example email==ana@acme.com or given_name==Mar* for a prefix. Fields: email, given_name, family_name, ids (comma-separated, from List contacts), city, state, website, start_update_time and end_update_time (ISO 8601 with milliseconds), plus custom fields by field name.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated properties to return, for example email_addresses,phone_numbers,tag_ids,owner_id,custom_fields,create_time.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field and direction separated by a space: id, create_time, email or update_time, then asc or desc, for example create_time desc.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Contacts per page, up to 1000.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a contact and returns it. It needs at least one item in email_addresses, phone_numbers or addresses. With duplicate_option, a matching contact is updated instead of a new one being created.

params.name: given_name
params.description: First name.

params.name: family_name
params.description: Last name.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title.

params.name: email_addresses
params.description: Email addresses, one per slot.

params.name: phone_numbers
params.description: Phone numbers, one per slot.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Postal addresses, one per kind.

params.name: website
params.description: Website address.

params.name: owner_id
params.description: Id of the user who owns the contact, the id field of List users (not global_user_id).

params.name: contact_type
params.description: Type of the contact as configured in the Keap app, for example Lead or Customer.

params.name: birth_date
params.description: Birth date, for example 1990-05-17.

params.name: duplicate_option
params.description: Match used to find an existing contact to update instead of creating one: by email, by email and name, or by email, name and company. Without it, a new contact is always created.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Updates the fields sent and returns the contact. Fields left out keep their values, but each list sent (email_addresses, phone_numbers, addresses) replaces the whole list.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts or Create contact.

params.name: given_name
params.description: First name.

params.name: family_name
params.description: Last name.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title.

params.name: email_addresses
params.description: Email addresses, one per slot. Sending this list replaces all the current ones, and an empty list removes them.

params.name: phone_numbers
params.description: Phone numbers, one per slot. Sending this list replaces all the current ones, and an empty list removes them.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Postal addresses, one per kind. Sending this list replaces all the current ones, and an empty list removes them.

params.name: website
params.description: Website address.

params.name: owner_id
params.description: Id of the user who owns the contact, the id field of List users (not global_user_id).

params.name: contact_type
params.description: Type of the contact as configured in the Keap app, for example Lead or Customer.

params.name: birth_date
params.description: Birth date, for example 1990-05-17.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: Lists the tags of the Keap app in tags, with id, name, description and category, and next_page_token for the following page.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters joined by ;, each one field==value, for example name==VIP. Fields: name, description, category_id, tag_ids (comma-separated, from List tags), since_create_time, until_create_time, since_update_time and until_update_time.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field and direction separated by a space: name, create_time or update_time, then asc or desc, for example name asc.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Tags per page, up to 1000.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Creates a tag and returns it with its id. The tag is not applied to anyone until Apply tag.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the tag. Up to 255 characters are kept.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the tag.

tools.name: Apply tag
tools.description: Applies a tag to one or more contacts. Applying a tag can start the automations of the Keap app that listen to it, such as email sequences.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: Id of the tag, from List tags or Create tag.

params.name: contact_ids
params.description: Ids of the contacts, from List contacts.

tools.name: Remove tag
tools.description: Removes a tag from one or more contacts. The tag itself stays in the Keap app.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: Id of the tag, from List tags.

params.name: contact_ids
params.description: Ids of the contacts, from List contacts.

tools.name: List opportunities
tools.description: Lists the opportunities of the sales pipeline in opportunities, each with its contact, stage and user, and next_page_token for the following page.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters joined by ;, each one field==value, for example stage_id==3;user_id==5. Fields: stage_id (from List opportunity stages), user_id (from List users), contact_id (from List contacts), opportunity_title (with * for a prefix), ids (comma-separated, from List opportunities, up to 100), projected_revenue_low and projected_revenue_high (also with greater-than or less-than comparisons).

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field and direction separated by a space: next_action_time, contact_name, opportunity_title, created_time or update_time, then asc or desc, for example created_time desc.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Opportunities per page, up to 1000.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: Create opportunity
tools.description: Creates an opportunity for a contact in a pipeline stage and returns it. opportunity_title, contact_id and stage_id are required.

params.name: opportunity_title
params.description: Title of the opportunity.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts.

params.name: stage_id
params.description: Id of the pipeline stage, from List opportunity stages.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user assigned to the opportunity, the id field of List users (not global_user_id).

params.name: projected_revenue_low
params.description: Low estimate of the revenue.

params.name: projected_revenue_high
params.description: High estimate of the revenue.

params.name: estimated_close_time
params.description: Expected close date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-30T15:00:00Z.

params.name: next_action_time
params.description: Date and time of the next action in ISO 8601.

params.name: next_action_notes
params.description: What the next action is.

params.name: opportunity_notes
params.description: General notes.

params.name: include_in_forecast
params.description: Counts the opportunity in the sales forecast.

tools.name: Update opportunity
tools.description: Updates the fields sent and returns the opportunity. Fields left out keep their values. Moving the opportunity to another stage is a change of stage_id.

params.name: opportunity_id
params.description: Id of the opportunity, from List opportunities or Create opportunity.

params.name: opportunity_title
params.description: Title of the opportunity.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts.

params.name: stage_id
params.description: Id of the pipeline stage, from List opportunity stages.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user assigned to the opportunity, the id field of List users (not global_user_id).

params.name: projected_revenue_low
params.description: Low estimate of the revenue.

params.name: projected_revenue_high
params.description: High estimate of the revenue.

params.name: estimated_close_time
params.description: Expected close date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-30T15:00:00Z.

params.name: next_action_time
params.description: Date and time of the next action in ISO 8601.

params.name: next_action_notes
params.description: What the next action is.

params.name: opportunity_notes
params.description: General notes.

params.name: include_in_forecast
params.description: Counts the opportunity in the sales forecast.

tools.name: Create note
tools.description: Adds a note to a contact and returns it. user_id is required, and so is title or type.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact, from List contacts.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the user writing the note, the id field of List users (not global_user_id).

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the note. Required when type is left out.

params.name: text
params.description: Content of the note.

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of note, one of Appointment, Call, Email, Fax, Letter or Other in Keap Max and Pro, or a value configured by the admin in Keap Classic. Required when title is left out.

params.name: is_pinned
params.description: Pins the note to the top of the contact.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Creates a task assigned to a user, optionally about a contact or an opportunity, and returns it. title and assigned_to_user_id are required.

params.name: title
params.description: What has to be done.

params.name: description
params.description: Details of the task.

params.name: assigned_to_user_id
params.description: Id of the user the task is assigned to, the id field of List users (not global_user_id).

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Id of the contact the task is about, from List contacts.

params.name: opportunity_id
params.description: Id of the opportunity the task is about, from List opportunities.

params.name: due_time
params.description: Due date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-03T15:00:00Z.

params.name: priority
params.description: Priority of the task.

params.name: remind_time_mins
params.description: Minutes before the due time to show a reminder: 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 1440 or 2880.

tools.name: List opportunity stages
tools.description: Lists the stages of the sales pipeline in stages, with id, name, order and win probability. The ids are the stage_id the opportunity tools take.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter in the form field==value, for example opportunity_stage_name==Qualified*. Fields: opportunity_stage_name and opportunity_stage_id.

params.name: order_by
params.description: stage_order asc or stage_order desc.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Stages per page, up to 1000.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the users of the Keap app in users, with id, names, email addresses, admin and status, and next_page_token for the following page. Their id is the owner_id, user_id and assigned_to_user_id the other tools take.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters joined by ;, each one field==value, for example email==ana@acme.com. Fields: email, given_name, include_inactive (true or false), include_partners (true or false) and user_ids (comma-separated).

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field and direction separated by a space: create_time, email or name, then asc or desc, for example name asc.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Users per page, up to 100.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response. Omit it on the first page.

name: Kit
description: Subscribers, tags, forms, broadcasts and growth statistics of a Kit account, formerly ConvertKit.

tools.name: List subscribers
tools.description: Lists the subscribers with their id, email, first name, state and custom fields, only the active ones by default. Look one up by email_address. The response has subscribers and pagination; while has_next_page is true, pass pagination.end_cursor as after.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Only the subscriber with exactly this email address. Does not work together with an engagement sort_field.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the subscribers in this state. The default is active, and all returns every state.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Only the subscribers created after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Only the subscribers created before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Only the subscribers updated after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Only the subscribers updated before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: sort_field
params.description: Field to sort by. The default is id. The engagement fields count the last 90 days, and cancelled_at needs status cancelled.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Order of the sort.

params.name: include
params.description: Extra fields on each subscriber, separated by commas: attribution, tags, location, and canceled_at, which needs status cancelled.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Subscribers per page, up to 1000. The default is 500.

params.name: after
params.description: The pagination.end_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: Create subscriber
tools.description: Creates an active subscriber. When the email address already belongs to a subscriber, it updates the first name of that subscriber instead. It adds no tag: use Apply tag next.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Email address of the subscriber.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the subscriber.

params.name: fields
params.description: Custom field values keyed by the field key, for example last_name, not Last Name. List subscribers shows the keys in the fields of each subscriber, and a key that is not a custom field of the account is refused.

tools.name: Update subscriber
tools.description: Updates the email address, first name or custom fields of a subscriber. A custom field key that does not exist in the account makes the request fail.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the subscriber, from List subscribers.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Email address of the subscriber: the current one, or a new one to change it.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the subscriber.

params.name: fields
params.description: Custom field values to change, keyed by the field key, for example last_name, not Last Name. List subscribers shows the keys in the fields of each subscriber, and a key that is not a custom field of the account is refused.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: Lists the tags with their id, name and creation date. The response has tags and pagination; while has_next_page is true, pass pagination.end_cursor as after.

params.name: include
params.description: subscriber_count adds the number of subscribers of each tag.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Tags per page, up to 1000. The default is 500.

params.name: after
params.description: The pagination.end_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Creates a tag and returns it with its id. When a tag with the same name exists, ignoring case, it returns that tag instead of a duplicate.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the tag.

tools.name: Apply tag
tools.description: Applies a tag to an existing subscriber, found by email address. Automations of the account that start with this tag run for the subscriber. Create the subscriber first with Create subscriber.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: ID of the tag, from List tags or Create tag.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Email address of the subscriber.

tools.name: List forms
tools.description: Lists the forms and landing pages with their id, name, type and embed URL, only the active ones by default. The response has forms and pagination; while has_next_page is true, pass pagination.end_cursor as after.

params.name: type
params.description: embed returns only embedded forms and hosted only landing pages.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the forms in this status. The default is active.

params.name: include
params.description: subscriber_count adds the number of active subscribers who joined through each form.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Forms per page, up to 1000. The default is 500.

params.name: after
params.description: The pagination.end_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: List segments
tools.description: Lists the segments with their id and name. Segments are built in the Kit app, and their ids target a broadcast in subscriber_filter. The response has segments and pagination; while has_next_page is true, pass pagination.end_cursor as after.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Segments per page, up to 1000. The default is 500.

params.name: after
params.description: The pagination.end_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: List broadcasts
tools.description: Lists the broadcasts with their id, subject, content, status, send_at, targeting and email template. The response has broadcasts and pagination; while has_next_page is true, pass pagination.end_cursor as after.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the broadcasts in this status.

params.name: sent_after
params.description: Only the broadcasts sent after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: sent_before
params.description: Only the broadcasts sent before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Broadcasts per page, up to 1000. The default is 500.

params.name: after
params.description: The pagination.end_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: Create broadcast
tools.description: Creates a broadcast email as a draft, or schedules it when send_at is set. It goes to every subscriber, or only to the segments and tags in subscriber_filter. Returns the broadcast with its id.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line of the email.

params.name: content
params.description: Body of the email as HTML. On a Classic template, the template adds its design around this body.

params.name: preview_text
params.description: Preview text shown after the subject in the inbox.

params.name: description
params.description: Internal description of the broadcast, not shown to the subscribers.

params.name: send_at
params.description: When to send, in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-02T13:00:00-03:00. Without a time zone it is UTC. It schedules the sending; omit it to keep a draft.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Sending address of the account to send from. The default sending address of the account when omitted.

params.name: email_template_id
params.description: ID of the email template, as the email_template id of a broadcast in List broadcasts. The default template of the account when omitted. Starting point templates do not work.

params.name: public
params.description: true also publishes the broadcast on the web, in the newsletter feed of the Creator Profile and landing pages.

params.name: subscriber_filter
params.description: Who receives the broadcast: one object with exactly one of all, any or none. Omit it to send to every subscriber.

tools.name: Update broadcast
tools.description: Updates a draft or scheduled broadcast. Send subject and content on every update, copied from List broadcasts when they do not change. Setting send_at schedules the sending, and null takes the broadcast back to draft.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the broadcast, from List broadcasts.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line of the email.

params.name: content
params.description: Body of the email as HTML. On a Classic template, the template adds its design around this body.

params.name: preview_text
params.description: Preview text shown after the subject in the inbox.

params.name: description
params.description: Internal description of the broadcast, not shown to the subscribers.

params.name: send_at
params.description: When to send, in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-02T13:00:00-03:00. Without a time zone it is UTC. It schedules the sending; null takes the broadcast back to draft.

params.name: email_address
params.description: Sending address of the account to send from.

params.name: email_template_id
params.description: ID of the email template, as the email_template id of a broadcast in List broadcasts. Starting point templates do not work.

params.name: public
params.description: true also publishes the broadcast on the web, in the newsletter feed of the Creator Profile and landing pages.

params.name: subscriber_filter
params.description: Who receives the broadcast: one object with exactly one of all, any or none. Without it, every subscriber receives it.

tools.name: List broadcast stats
tools.description: Returns, for each broadcast with its id, subject and send_at, the recipients, opens, open rate, clicks, click rate, unsubscribes and sending status. The response has broadcasts and pagination; while has_next_page is true, pass pagination.end_cursor as after.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the broadcasts in this status.

params.name: sent_after
params.description: Only the broadcasts sent after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: sent_before
params.description: Only the broadcasts sent before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Broadcasts per page, up to 1000. The default is 500.

params.name: after
params.description: The pagination.end_cursor of the previous page.

tools.name: Get growth stats
tools.description: Returns the subscribers at the end of the period, the new subscribers, the cancellations and the net new subscribers between starting and ending, counted in the sending time zone of the account. The default period is the last 90 days.

params.name: starting
params.description: First day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is 90 days ago.

params.name: ending
params.description: Last day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today.

name: Lemon Squeezy
description: Stores, products, orders, customers, subscriptions, discounts and checkouts of a Lemon Squeezy account.

tools.name: List stores
tools.description: Lists the stores of the user by name, with domain, currency, total sales and revenue in cents. The id of a store goes in the store relationship of Create customer, Create discount and Create checkout. Only the first 10 come back.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Lists the products of every store of the user by name, with status, price range, buy_now_url and store_id. Only the first 10 come back; meta.page.total has the count. List product variants returns the variants that checkouts and discounts use.

tools.name: List product variants
tools.description: Lists the variants of a product with price in cents, subscription interval, free trial and status. The id of a variant goes in Create checkout and in the variants of Create discount. Only the first 10 come back.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

tools.name: List orders
tools.description: Lists the 10 newest orders of every store of the user, with order_number, buyer name and email, status, totals in cents, refunds and receipt URL. Older orders are only reachable by id in Get order; meta.page.total has the count.

tools.name: Get order
tools.description: Returns an order: order_number, buyer, status, currency, subtotal, discount, tax, total and refunded amount in cents, the first order item and the receipt URL.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Id of the order, from List orders or from the order_id of a subscription in List subscriptions. It is not the order_number shown to the buyer.

tools.name: List customers
tools.description: Lists the 10 newest customers of every store of the user, with name, email, marketing status (subscribed, unsubscribed, archived, requires_verification, invalid_email or bounced), MRR and total revenue in cents. meta.page.total has the count.

tools.name: Create customer
tools.description: Creates a customer in a store and returns it. The fields go inside data, as JSON:API: type, attributes with name and email, and the store in relationships.

params.name: data
params.description: The new customer.

tools.name: Update customer
tools.description: Changes a customer and returns it. The fields go inside data, as JSON:API, with the same id as customer_id. Only the attributes sent change; status archived stops the marketing emails.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Id of the customer, from List customers or from the customer_id of an order in List orders.

params.name: data
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: List subscriptions
tools.description: Lists the 10 newest subscriptions of every store of the user, with product, variant, customer email, status (on_trial, active, paused, past_due, unpaid, cancelled or expired), renews_at, ends_at and order_id. meta.page.total has the count.

tools.name: List discounts
tools.description: Lists the discount codes of every store of the user, oldest first, with code, amount, amount_type, redemption limit, dates and status. Only the first 10 come back; meta.page.total has the count.

tools.name: Create discount
tools.description: Creates a discount code for a store and returns it. The fields go inside data, as JSON:API: type, attributes and the store in relationships, plus the variants when is_limited_to_products is true.

params.name: data
params.description: The new discount.

tools.name: Create checkout
tools.description: Creates a checkout link for a variant, optionally with custom price, prefilled buyer data, discount code and expiry, and returns it with the link in data.attributes.url. The fields go inside data, as JSON:API: type, attributes, and the store and variant in relationships.

params.name: data
params.description: The new checkout.

name: Mailjet
description: Contacts, contact lists, campaign drafts and email statistics of a Mailjet account.

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Lists the contacts of the account with their email, name, exclusion status and activity dates, optionally only those of a list. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: ContactsList
params.description: Only the contacts of this list, by the ID from List contact lists.

params.name: Campaign
params.description: Only the contacts targeted by this campaign, by the CampaignID that List campaign drafts returns for a sent draft.

params.name: IsExcludedFromCampaigns
params.description: true returns only the contacts excluded from marketing emails, false leaves them out.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Contacts per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first contact of the page. The default is 0.

params.name: Sort
params.description: Property and order separated by a space, for example ID DESC for the newest first. Not every property can sort.

tools.name: Get contact
tools.description: Returns one contact, found by its ID or by its email address, with its name, exclusion status and activity dates. Use it to get the ID of a contact you only know by email.

params.name: contact_ID
params.description: ID of the contact, from List contacts, or the email address of the contact.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Changes the name of a contact or its exclusion from marketing emails. Only the fields sent change. An excluded contact still receives transactional emails.

params.name: contact_ID
params.description: ID of the contact, from List contacts or Get contact.

params.name: Name
params.description: New name of the contact.

params.name: IsExcludedFromCampaigns
params.description: true excludes the contact from all marketing emails, false allows them again.

tools.name: List contact lists
tools.description: Lists the contact lists with their ID, name, subscriber count and deletion status. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: Name
params.description: Only the list with exactly this name.

params.name: IsDeleted
params.description: true returns only the deleted lists, false only the active ones.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Lists per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first list of the page. The default is 0.

params.name: Sort
params.description: Property and order separated by a space, for example Name ASC. Not every property can sort.

tools.name: Create contact list
tools.description: Creates an empty contact list and returns it with its ID.

params.name: Name
params.description: Name of the list, unique in the account.

tools.name: Manage list contact
tools.description: Adds a contact to a list by email, creating the contact when the email is new and setting its name and properties, or unsubscribes or removes it from the list, according to Action.

params.name: list_ID
params.description: ID of the list, from List contact lists.

params.name: Email
params.description: Email address of the contact.

params.name: Action
params.description: addforce adds and subscribes the contact, even if it had unsubscribed from the list. addnoforce adds it but keeps an existing unsubscription. unsub unsubscribes it from the list and remove takes it out of the list.

params.name: Name
params.description: Name of the contact.

params.name: Properties
params.description: Values of contact properties keyed by the property name, from List contact properties, for example firstname. A name that is not a property of the account fails.

tools.name: List contact properties
tools.description: Lists the contact properties of the account with their name, data type and namespace. The names are the keys of Properties in Manage list contact. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Properties per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first property of the page. The default is 0.

tools.name: List senders
tools.description: Lists the sender addresses and domains of the account with their ID, email, name and status. Only an Active sender can send a campaign. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: Email
params.description: Only the sender with this email address.

params.name: Domain
params.description: Only the senders of this domain, for example example.com.

params.name: Status
params.description: Only the senders in this status.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Senders per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first sender of the page. The default is 0.

tools.name: List templates
tools.description: Lists the email templates with their ID, name, purposes and edit mode. The ID links a template to a campaign draft as its content. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: Name
params.description: Only the template with exactly this name.

params.name: OwnerType
params.description: apikey returns the templates of this API key only, user the templates of the primary key, which subaccounts can read, and global the gallery templates of Mailjet.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Templates per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first template of the page. The default is 0.

tools.name: List campaign drafts
tools.description: Lists the campaign drafts with their ID, title, subject, sender, list, status and, once sent, the CampaignID used by Get statistics. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: Status
params.description: Only the drafts in this status: 0 draft, 1 scheduled, 2 sent, -1 archived, -2 deleted, -3 canceled A/B test, 3 A/B test without a winner yet and 4 A/B test with the winner sent.

params.name: ContactsList
params.description: Only the drafts that target this list, by the ID from List contact lists.

params.name: IsArchived
params.description: true returns only the archived drafts, false leaves them out.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Drafts per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first draft of the page. The default is 0.

params.name: Sort
params.description: Property and order separated by a space, for example ID DESC for the newest first. Not every property can sort.

tools.name: Create campaign draft
tools.description: Creates a campaign draft and returns it with its ID. Sending needs Sender, SenderEmail and ContactsListID, plus content: link a template with TemplateID or write the content in the Mailjet editor.

params.name: Locale
params.description: Language and country of the campaign, for example en_US or pt_BR.

params.name: Subject
params.description: Subject line of the email.

params.name: Title
params.description: Internal title of the campaign, not shown to the recipients.

params.name: ContactsListID
params.description: ID of the list that receives the campaign, from List contact lists.

params.name: Sender
params.description: ID of the sender, from List senders, as text.

params.name: SenderEmail
params.description: Email address of an Active sender, from List senders.

params.name: SenderName
params.description: Sender name shown to the recipients.

params.name: ReplyEmail
params.description: Address that receives the replies.

params.name: TemplateID
params.description: ID of the template whose content the campaign uses, from List templates.

tools.name: Update campaign draft
tools.description: Updates a campaign draft that was not sent yet. Only the fields sent change. Status archives or deletes the draft, or takes it back from the archive.

params.name: draft_ID
params.description: ID of the draft, from List campaign drafts.

params.name: Locale
params.description: Language and country of the campaign, for example en_US or pt_BR.

params.name: Subject
params.description: Subject line of the email.

params.name: Title
params.description: Internal title of the campaign, not shown to the recipients.

params.name: ContactsListID
params.description: ID of the list that receives the campaign, from List contact lists.

params.name: Sender
params.description: ID of the sender, from List senders, as text.

params.name: SenderEmail
params.description: Email address of an Active sender, from List senders.

params.name: SenderName
params.description: Sender name shown to the recipients.

params.name: ReplyEmail
params.description: Address that receives the replies.

params.name: TemplateID
params.description: ID of the template whose content the campaign uses, from List templates.

params.name: Status
params.description: -1 archives and -2 deletes a draft in status 0. On an archived draft, 0 takes it back and -2 deletes it.

tools.name: Schedule campaign draft
tools.description: Schedules the sending of a campaign draft to its list. The draft needs a sender, a list and content. Mailjet sends it at Date, and the emails go out to every subscribed contact of the list.

params.name: draft_ID
params.description: ID of the draft, from List campaign drafts.

params.name: Date
params.description: When to send, as an RFC3339 date-time such as 2026-11-02T13:00:00Z or a Unix timestamp. Now sends right away.

tools.name: Send campaign draft
tools.description: Sends a campaign draft to every subscribed contact of its list right away. The draft needs a sender, a list and content, and the sending cannot be undone.

params.name: draft_ID
params.description: ID of the draft, from List campaign drafts.

tools.name: Get statistics
tools.description: Returns sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, spam and unsubscribed counts of a campaign, a list, a sender or the whole API key, over the lifetime or per 5 minutes, hour or day. The response has Data, Count and Total; page with Limit and Offset.

params.name: CounterSource
params.description: What to count. List works only with CounterTiming Message and CounterResolution Lifetime, and Sender only with CounterTiming Message. APIKey covers the whole connected key.

params.name: CounterTiming
params.description: Message counts by the sending time of the emails, Event by the time of each open, click or other event. Event does not work with CounterResolution Lifetime.

params.name: CounterResolution
params.description: Lifetime gives one total. Day, Hour and Highest, which is 5 minutes, give one row per period and need FromTS.

params.name: SourceID
params.description: Required unless CounterSource is APIKey. The CampaignID from List campaign drafts, the list ID from List contact lists or the sender ID from List senders. Several campaign or list IDs go separated by commas.

params.name: FromTS
params.description: Start of the period, as an RFC3339 date-time or a Unix timestamp. Required unless CounterResolution is Lifetime. The period spans up to 100 periods of the resolution, so up to 100 days with Day.

params.name: ToTS
params.description: End of the period, as an RFC3339 date-time or a Unix timestamp.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Rows per page, up to 1000. The default is 10.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Index of the first row of the page. The default is 0.

name: Make
description: Scenarios, executions and incomplete executions of the Make organizations of one zone.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists the organizations of the user, each with its id and name. The id is the organizationId the other tools ask for.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Lists the teams of an organization, each with its id and name. The id is the teamId of List scenarios.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Id of the organization, from List organizations.

tools.name: List scenarios
tools.description: Lists the scenarios of a team or of a whole organization: send teamId or organizationId, never both. Each item has the id and name of the scenario.

params.name: teamId
params.description: Id of the team, from List teams. Do not send it together with organizationId.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Id of the organization, from List organizations, to list the scenarios of all its teams. Do not send it together with teamId.

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive text matched against the scenario names. A number also matches the scenario with that id.

params.name: isActive
params.description: Set to true to return only active scenarios.

params.name: isinvalid
params.description: Set to true to return only scenarios whose blueprint failed validation, or false for the valid ones.

tools.name: Get scenario
tools.description: Returns the details of one scenario, such as its name, team, scheduling and whether it is active.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

tools.name: Update scenario
tools.description: Renames a scenario. The name does not need to be unique.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the scenario.

tools.name: Activate scenario
tools.description: Activates a scenario so it runs on its schedule. A scenario scheduled at regular intervals also runs right away.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

tools.name: Deactivate scenario
tools.description: Deactivates a scenario, which stops its schedule and the run in progress, if there is one.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

tools.name: Run scenario
tools.description: Runs an active scenario now, which uses operations of the organization. Returns the executionId; with responsive true it waits up to 40 seconds and also returns the status and the scenario outputs. A paused organization or team answers 429 with code IM310.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

params.name: data
params.description: Values of the scenario inputs, by input name. Required when the scenario has required inputs.

params.name: responsive
params.description: Set to true to wait for the end of the run. After 40 seconds the call times out, but the run goes on: follow it with Get scenario execution.

tools.name: List scenario logs
tools.description: Lists the execution logs of a scenario, newest first, each with the execution id, status, duration, operations and transfer.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the range, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

params.name: displayStatus
params.description: Returns only the executions with this status. WAITING is a timed, parked execution.

params.name: executionName
params.description: Returns only the executions whose name contains this text.

params.name: showCheckRuns
params.description: Set to true to include the runs whose trigger found nothing new, which are left out by default.

tools.name: Get scenario execution
tools.description: Returns the status of one execution of a scenario, with the scenario outputs, or the error and the module that caused it.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

params.name: executionId
params.description: Id of the execution, from Run scenario or from the id of an item of List scenario logs.

tools.name: List incomplete executions
tools.description: Lists the incomplete executions of a scenario, the runs that stopped on an error and were stored to be retried, each with id, reason, creation time, attempts and whether it is resolved.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: Id of the scenario, from List scenarios.

params.name: status
params.description: Returns only the incomplete executions with this status. scheduled means Make retries it on its own later.

params.name: createdFrom
params.description: Returns only those created at or after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
