params.name: createdTo
params.description: Returns only those created at or before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

tools.name: Retry incomplete execution
tools.description: Retries an incomplete execution with the blueprint the scenario had when the error happened, which uses operations of the organization.

params.name: dlqId
params.description: Id of the incomplete execution, from List incomplete executions.

name: Manychat
description: Contacts, tags, custom fields and automations of a Manychat account.

tools.name: Get subscriber
tools.description: Returns one contact with name, email, phone, WhatsApp, Instagram username, opt-ins, last interaction, custom fields and tags.

params.name: subscriber_id
params.description: ID of the contact, from Get subscriber by email or phone, Search subscribers by name or Create subscriber. The responses bring it as text; send it as a number.

tools.name: Get subscriber by email or phone
tools.description: Returns the contact with this email address or phone number, with the same fields as Get subscriber. Send email or phone, not both.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the contact.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the contact with the country code, for example +5511999998888.

tools.name: Search subscribers by name
tools.description: Returns up to 100 contacts whose full name matches, with the same fields as Get subscriber.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name of the contact.

tools.name: Create subscriber
tools.description: Creates a contact with an email, an SMS phone or a WhatsApp phone, at least one of them, and returns it with its id. Each channel sent needs its opt-in: has_opt_in_email for email, and has_opt_in_sms with consent_phrase for phone.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the contact.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the contact.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the contact. Required without phone and whatsapp_phone.

params.name: phone
params.description: SMS phone number with the country code, for example +5511999998888. Required without email and whatsapp_phone.

params.name: whatsapp_phone
params.description: WhatsApp number with the country code, for example +5511999998888. Required without email and phone.

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender of the contact.

params.name: has_opt_in_email
params.description: Whether the contact agreed to receive emails. Required with email.

params.name: has_opt_in_sms
params.description: Whether the contact agreed to receive SMS. Required with phone.

params.name: consent_phrase
params.description: Text of the consent the contact agreed to. Required when has_opt_in_sms is true.

tools.name: Update subscriber
tools.description: Updates the name, email, phone, gender or opt-ins of a contact. Changing email or phone needs its opt-in again: has_opt_in_email for email, and has_opt_in_sms with consent_phrase for phone.

params.name: subscriber_id
params.description: ID of the contact, from Get subscriber by email or phone or Search subscribers by name, sent as a number.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the contact.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the contact.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the contact.

params.name: phone
params.description: SMS phone number with the country code, for example +5511999998888.

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender of the contact.

params.name: has_opt_in_email
params.description: Whether the contact agreed to receive emails. Required with email.

params.name: has_opt_in_sms
params.description: Whether the contact agreed to receive SMS. Required with phone.

params.name: consent_phrase
params.description: Text of the consent the contact agreed to. Required when has_opt_in_sms is true.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: Lists the tags of the account with their id and name.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Creates a tag in the account and returns it with its id.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the tag.

tools.name: Apply tag
tools.description: Applies a tag to a contact. Automations of the account that start when this tag is applied run for the contact.

params.name: subscriber_id
params.description: ID of the contact, from Get subscriber by email or phone or Search subscribers by name, sent as a number.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: ID of the tag, from List tags or Create tag.

tools.name: Remove tag
tools.description: Removes a tag from one contact. The tag stays in the account and on the other contacts.

params.name: subscriber_id
params.description: ID of the contact, from Get subscriber by email or phone or Search subscribers by name, sent as a number.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: ID of the tag, from List tags.

tools.name: List custom fields
tools.description: Lists the custom user fields of the account with their id, name, type and description.

tools.name: Create custom field
tools.description: Creates a custom user field in the account and returns it with its id.

params.name: caption
params.description: Name of the field.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of the values of the field.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the field.

tools.name: Set custom fields
tools.description: Sets the values of up to 20 custom user fields of a contact, each field by field_id or by field_name. Automations that start when a field changes run for the contact.

params.name: subscriber_id
params.description: ID of the contact, from Get subscriber by email or phone or Search subscribers by name, sent as a number.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields and their values, from 1 to 20.

tools.name: List flows
tools.description: Lists the automations of the account with their ns, name and folder, plus the folders.

tools.name: Send flow
tools.description: Starts an automation for a contact, which sends its messages on the channels of the contact. Meta rules for Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp still apply, such as the 24-hour window, and a contact can receive up to 100 sends per hour.

params.name: subscriber_id
params.description: ID of the contact, from Get subscriber by email or phone or Search subscribers by name, sent as a number.

params.name: flow_ns
params.description: The ns of the automation, from List flows.

name: Melhor Envio
description: Shipping quotes, cart and shipping labels of a Melhor Envio account.

tools.name: Calculate shipping
tools.description: Quotes the shipping of products between two CEPs and returns one entry per service, with id, carrier, price, delivery time, the packages and an error when the service does not serve the route. custom_price and custom_delivery_time include the fees and discounts of the account. Only the services enabled for the integration in the Melhor Envio panel are quoted.

params.name: from
params.description: Origin of the shipment.

params.name: to
params.description: Destination of the shipment.

params.name: products
params.description: Products in the shipment, with unit dimensions, weight and value. Melhor Envio packs them and multiplies the value by the quantity.

params.name: options
params.description: Additional services, which raise the price.

tools.name: Create cart item
tools.description: Adds a shipping label to the cart of the account and returns it. Its id is the id of the label in the other tools. Nothing is paid until Purchase labels. Correios, J&T and Loggi take one volume per call: for more packages, add one item per package.

params.name: service
params.description: Id of the service chosen in Calculate shipping, such as 1 for PAC.

params.name: from
params.description: Sender. A person sends document (CPF); a company sends company_document (CNPJ) and state_register.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient. A person sends document (CPF); a company sends company_document (CNPJ) and state_register.

params.name: products
params.description: Every product in the shipment, complete: it goes into the content declaration sent to SEFAZ.

params.name: volumes
params.description: Packages of the shipment, with the dimensions and weight of the packages of the chosen service in Calculate shipping.

params.name: options
params.description: Insurance, additional services and documents of the shipment.

tools.name: List cart items
tools.description: Lists the labels in the cart that were not paid yet, with id, service, price, sender, recipient and volumes. Labels stay in the cart for 20 days. 10 per page: pass page for the next ones, up to last_page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to read. The default is 1.

tools.name: Delete cart item
tools.description: Removes a label that was not paid yet from the cart.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a label from List cart items or Create cart item.

tools.name: Purchase labels
tools.description: Pays labels in the cart with the balance of the Melhor Envio wallet and returns the purchase, with the total and the labels, now released. The wallet needs enough balance: check it with Get balance. Paid labels still need Generate labels.

params.name: orders
params.description: Ids of labels from List cart items or Create cart item.

tools.name: Generate labels
tools.description: Generates paid labels, which is required before Print labels, and returns the result for each id. A generated label must be posted within 20 days, or 7 days with Correios.

params.name: orders
params.description: Ids of paid labels from List labels or Purchase labels.

tools.name: Print labels
tools.description: Returns a link to print generated labels. A private link opens only for someone signed in to the Melhor Envio account; a public link opens for anyone who has it.

params.name: orders
params.description: Ids of generated labels from List labels.

params.name: mode
params.description: Who can open the link. The default is private.

tools.name: List labels
tools.description: Lists the labels of the account with id, protocol, status, service, price, tracking code and the dates of payment, generation, posting and delivery. 10 per page: pass page for the next ones, up to last_page.

params.name: status
params.description: Only labels in this status, such as pending, released, posted, delivered, undelivered or canceled.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to read. The default is 1.

tools.name: Get label
tools.description: Returns one label with status, service, price, sender, recipient, volumes, tracking code and the dates of payment, generation, posting and delivery.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a label from List labels or Search labels.

tools.name: Search labels
tools.description: Finds labels by one exact value: the id, the protocol, the tracking code, the authorization code, or the CPF or CNPJ of the sender or the recipient.

params.name: q
params.description: The value to look for, such as a tracking code or a CPF.

tools.name: Cancel label
tools.description: Cancels a label. A generated label can be canceled only before it is posted and before the carrier is notified of a pickup; the refund of a generated label comes 12 hours after the approval.

params.name: order
params.description: The label to cancel and the reason.

tools.name: Get balance
tools.description: Returns the balance of the Melhor Envio wallet in BRL, with the amount reserved and the debts. Purchase labels spends this balance.

name: Mention
description: Social listening alerts, collected mentions and tags of a Mention account.

tools.name: Get account
tools.description: Returns the Mention account of the connection with its id, name, email and language. The id is the account_id that the other tools take.

tools.name: Get app data
tools.description: Returns the reference lists of Mention: alert_languages, alert_countries and alert_sources, whose keys are the codes that alerts and mention filters take, plus alert_tones and mention_folders.

tools.name: List alerts
tools.description: Lists the alerts of the account with id, name, query, languages, sources and mention counts per folder. When there are more alerts, the response has _links.more with the cursor of the next page.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: limit
params.description: Alerts per page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor in _links.more.params of the previous response.

tools.name: Create alert
tools.description: Creates an alert, which starts collecting the mentions that match its query, and returns it with its id. Collected mentions count against the quota of the Mention plan.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the alert.

params.name: query
params.description: What the alert tracks. A basic query takes included_keywords, required_keywords, excluded_keywords and monitored_website, with at least one keyword in included_keywords or required_keywords. An advanced query takes query_string instead.

params.name: languages
params.description: Codes of up to 5 languages to track, such as en or pt, from the alert_languages of Get app data. In an advanced query they apply only to monitored pages and reviews pages.

params.name: countries
params.description: Codes of up to 5 countries to track, such as US or BR, from the alert_countries of Get app data. XX keeps the mentions without a country. Omit it to track every country. Ignored in an advanced query.

params.name: sources
params.description: Codes of the sources to track, such as web, news, blogs, forums, videos, twitter or facebook, from the alert_sources of Get app data.

params.name: blocked_sites
params.description: URLs whose mentions are ignored. A URL also blocks the pages under it.

params.name: noise_detection
params.description: true skips new mentions similar to the ones put in spam or trash.

params.name: reviews_pages
params.description: URLs of review pages on Tripadvisor, Yelp or Booking to monitor.

tools.name: Update alert
tools.description: Updates an alert, usually to refine its query, and returns it. Only the fields sent change. A query sent replaces the current one and needs its type.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: alert_id
params.description: Id of the alert, from List alerts.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the alert.

params.name: query
params.description: What the alert tracks. A basic query takes included_keywords, required_keywords, excluded_keywords and monitored_website, with at least one keyword in included_keywords or required_keywords. An advanced query takes query_string instead.

params.name: languages
params.description: Codes of up to 5 languages to track, such as en or pt, from the alert_languages of Get app data. Replaces the current list.

params.name: countries
params.description: Codes of up to 5 countries to track, such as US or BR, from the alert_countries of Get app data. XX keeps the mentions without a country. Replaces the current list.

params.name: sources
params.description: Codes of the sources to track, such as web, news, blogs, forums, videos, twitter or facebook, from the alert_sources of Get app data. Replaces the current list.

params.name: blocked_sites
params.description: URLs whose mentions are ignored. Replaces the current list.

params.name: noise_detection
params.description: true skips new mentions similar to the ones put in spam or trash.

params.name: reviews_pages
params.description: URLs of review pages on Tripadvisor, Yelp or Booking to monitor. Replaces the current list.

tools.name: List mentions
tools.description: Lists the mentions an alert collected, with title, text, URL, source, language, tone and folder. The response has _links.more, whose href carries the cursor of the older mentions. Some filters cannot be combined, as each one says.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: alert_id
params.description: Id of the alert, from List alerts.

params.name: limit
params.description: Mentions per page, up to 1000. The default is 20; a small limit answers faster.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor parameter of _links.more.href in the previous response, to read older mentions.

params.name: since_id
params.description: Only the mentions found after the mention with this id, from List mentions, sent as a number. Not combinable with before_date, not_before_date or cursor.

params.name: before_date
params.description: Only the mentions published before this date-time, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00.0+00:00. The mentions come ordered by publication date.

params.name: not_before_date
params.description: Ignores the mentions published before this date-time. Only together with before_date.

params.name: folder
params.description: Only the mentions of this folder.

params.name: unread
params.description: 1 returns only unread mentions. Not combinable with favorite, q or tone.

params.name: favorite
params.description: 1 returns only favorite mentions. Not combinable with folder spam or trash.

params.name: tone
params.description: Only the mentions of this tone: -1 negative, 0 neutral, 1 positive.

params.name: source
params.description: Only the mentions of this source code, from the alert_sources of Get app data. Only for plans with search access.

params.name: languages
params.description: Only the mentions in this language code, such as en, from the alert_languages of Get app data.

params.name: countries
params.description: Only the mentions from this country code, such as US, from the alert_countries of Get app data.

params.name: include_children
params.description: 1 also returns the child mentions.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order of the mentions. Only for plans with search access.

params.name: q
params.description: Keywords, and filters that the other arguments cannot combine, for example nasa source:(facebook OR twitter) tone:(neutral OR positive) published_at:[2026-01-01 TO 2026-01-31]. Only for plans with search access.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone of the dates in q, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

tools.name: Get mention
tools.description: Returns one mention with title, text, URLs, source, language, tone, folder, the read and favorite flags, its tasks and the first page of its child mentions.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: alert_id
params.description: Id of the alert, from List alerts.

params.name: mention_id
params.description: Id of the mention, from List mentions.

tools.name: Update mention
tools.description: Curates a mention: marks it read or favorite, moves it to a folder, sets its tone or tags it, and returns it. Only the fields sent change. The content of a mention never changes.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: alert_id
params.description: Id of the alert, from List alerts.

params.name: mention_id
params.description: Id of the mention, from List mentions.

params.name: read
params.description: true marks the mention as read.

params.name: favorite
params.description: true marks the mention as favorite, which also marks it as read. Needs the admin role on the alert.

params.name: trashed
params.description: true puts the mention in the trash. Needs the admin role on the alert.

params.name: folder
params.description: Folder to move the mention to.

params.name: tone
params.description: Tone of the mention: -1 negative, 0 neutral, 1 positive.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the mention, each an existing tag of the alert by its id from List tags. Send every tag the mention should have.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: Lists the tags of an alert with id, name, mention count and auto-tagging keywords. The id is what the tags of Update mention take.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: alert_id
params.description: Id of the alert, from List alerts.

tools.name: Create tag
tools.description: Creates a tag in an alert and returns it with its id. An alert holds up to 100 tags, and new mentions that contain one of the keywords are tagged automatically.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Id of the account, from Get account.

params.name: alert_id
params.description: Id of the alert, from List alerts.

params.name: name
params.description: Label of the tag, up to 20 characters.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Up to 5 keywords for auto-tagging.

name: Mercado Livre
description: Listings, orders and buyer questions of a Mercado Livre seller account.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Returns the connected seller account: id, nickname, email, site_id and seller reputation. The id is the user_id, seller and seller_id of the other tools, and site_id (MLB in Brazil) goes in Search categories.

tools.name: Search items
tools.description: Lists the ids of the listings of the seller, 50 per page by default. results has only item ids: List items returns their details. Page with offset and limit; past 1000 results use search_type scan and the scroll_id of each response.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Id of the seller, from Get current user.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the listings in this status.

params.name: seller_sku
params.description: SKU saved in the SELLER_SKU attribute of the listing.

params.name: sku
params.description: SKU saved in the seller_custom_field of the listing.

params.name: orders
params.description: Sort order, for example start_time_desc, stop_time_asc or last_updated_desc. stop_time_asc is the default.

params.name: offset
params.description: Results to skip, up to 1000 in total. Not used with search_type scan.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

params.name: search_type
params.description: scan to read past the first 1000 results, without offset.

params.name: scroll_id
params.description: The scroll_id of the previous Search items response with search_type scan. It lasts 5 minutes, and it comes back null at the end.

tools.name: List items
tools.description: Returns up to 20 listings by id in one call: title, price, available_quantity, sold_quantity, status, permalink, pictures and attributes. Each element has status_code, id and the listing in body.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated item ids, up to 20, from Search items, for example MLB1828680414,MLB1548991737.

params.name: attributes
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return, each with the prefix body., for example body.id,body.title,body.price,body.available_quantity,body.status. Omit it for every field.

tools.name: Search categories
tools.description: Predicts the category of a product from its title, with the domain and the attributes recognized in the text. The first result is the most likely. Its category_id goes in Create item and in List category attributes.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site of the account, MLB in Brazil: the site_id of Get current user.

params.name: q
params.description: Product title, written in the language of the site.

params.name: limit
params.description: Suggestions to return, 4 by default and up to 8.

tools.name: List category attributes
tools.description: Lists the attributes of a category with their id, value_type, accepted values and tags. Attributes tagged required must be sent in Create item, and new_required ones when the item is new.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Id of the category, from Search categories or from the category_id of a listing in List items.

tools.name: Create item
tools.description: Publishes a listing and returns it with its id. Under the User Products model, active for every seller, send family_name and no title: Mercado Livre builds the title. The description is added afterwards with Create item description.

params.name: family_name
params.description: Generic name of the product, shared by its variants, for example Apple iPhone 256GB. Up to the max_title_length of the category.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Id of the category, from Search categories.

params.name: price
params.description: Price in the currency of currency_id.

params.name: currency_id
params.description: Currency of the site, BRL in Brazil, as in the currency_id of the listings in List items.

params.name: available_quantity
params.description: Stock. 0 creates the listing paused, with substatus out_of_stock.

params.name: buying_mode
params.description: buy_it_now, the only mode available.

params.name: listing_type_id
params.description: Listing type, for example gold_special (Classic), gold_pro (Premium) or free, as in the listing_type_id of the listings in List items.

params.name: condition
params.description: Condition of the product. Mercado Livre is replacing it with the ITEM_CONDITION attribute, which is also the only way to say refurbished.

params.name: pictures
params.description: Pictures of the product, in order. The max_pictures_per_item of the category sets the limit.

params.name: attributes
params.description: Technical attributes of the product, such as BRAND, MODEL, GTIN or SELLER_SKU. List category attributes says which ones the category requires.

params.name: sale_terms
params.description: Sale terms, such as the warranty: WARRANTY_TYPE (for example Garantia do vendedor) and WARRANTY_TIME (for example 90 dias). A refurbished item needs them.

tools.name: Update item
tools.description: Changes a listing and returns it. Only the fields sent change. status paused hides it, active brings it back and closed ends it for good. title and family_name only change while the listing has no sales.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the listing, from Search items, for example MLB1828680414.

params.name: status
params.description: paused hides the listing, active reactivates a paused one and closed ends it, with no way back.

params.name: price
params.description: New price. Ignored when the listing has price automation turned on, and refused with 400 if it is the only field sent.

params.name: available_quantity
params.description: New stock. 0 pauses a new item with substatus out_of_stock, and stock above 0 reactivates it.

params.name: title
params.description: New title, only while the listing has no sales.

params.name: family_name
params.description: New family name, only while no listing of the family has sales. It changes every listing of the same product.

params.name: pictures
params.description: The full list of pictures, which replaces the current one. Keep a current picture by its id and add a new one by source.

params.name: attributes
params.description: Attributes to add or change. The ones not sent stay as they are.

params.name: sale_terms
params.description: Sale terms to change, such as WARRANTY_TYPE and WARRANTY_TIME.

tools.name: Get item description
tools.description: Returns the description of a listing in plain_text, with date_created and last_updated.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the listing, from Search items.

tools.name: Create item description
tools.description: Adds the description to a listing that has none, such as one just made with Create item. Fails with 400 when a description already exists: use Update item description.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the listing, from Create item or Search items.

params.name: plain_text
params.description: Description as plain text, without HTML or emoji. Line breaks as \n.

tools.name: Update item description
tools.description: Replaces the description of a listing that already has one.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the listing, from Search items.

params.name: plain_text
params.description: The new description as plain text, without HTML or emoji. Line breaks as \n.

tools.name: Search orders
tools.description: Lists the sales of the seller from the last 12 months, with buyer, items, payments and shipping id. sort date_desc brings the newest first. Page with offset and limit; paging.total has the count.

params.name: seller
params.description: Id of the seller, from Get current user.

params.name: q
params.description: Matches the order id, the item id, the item title or the nickname of the buyer. Name and email of the buyer are not searched.

params.name: item
params.description: Id of a listing from Search items: only the orders of that listing.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated order tags that must be present, for example paid or not_delivered.

params.name: sort
params.description: By the closing date of the sale. date_asc is the default.

params.name: offset
params.description: Results to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, 50 by default.

tools.name: Get order
tools.description: Returns a sale: status, items, quantities, prices, payments, buyer, tags and the shipping id.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Id of the order, from Search orders.

tools.name: Search questions
tools.description: Lists the questions buyers asked on the listings of the seller, or on one listing, with the answer when there is one. Unanswered questions older than 7 months are deleted. Page with offset and limit.

params.name: seller_id
params.description: Id of the seller, from Get current user. Send it or item.

params.name: item
params.description: Id of a listing, from Search items: only its questions.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the questions in this status. UNANSWERED is the queue to answer.

params.name: sort_fields
params.description: Comma-separated sort fields among item_id, seller_id, from_id and date_created.

params.name: sort_types
params.description: Direction of sort_fields.

params.name: api_version
params.description: Send 4: it is the response structure, with questions, answer and from, that the other fields describe.

params.name: offset
params.description: Results to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, 50 by default.

tools.name: Answer question
tools.description: Publishes the answer of the seller to a buyer question and returns the question with the answer. The answer is public on the listing.

params.name: question_id
params.description: Id of the question, from Search questions.

params.name: text
params.description: Text of the answer.

name: Mercado Pago
description: Payments, checkout links and subscriptions of a Mercado Pago seller account.

tools.name: Search payments
tools.description: Searches the payments the account received in the last 12 months; without dates, the ones created in the last 3 months. The response has results and paging with total, limit and offset: raise offset by limit to read the next page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field that orders the results.

params.name: criteria
params.description: Direction of sort: asc or desc.

params.name: range
params.description: Date field that begin_date and end_date filter. The default is date_created.

params.name: begin_date
params.description: Start of the period: an ISO 8601 date, like 2026-09-01T00:00:00.000-03:00, or a relative one, like NOW-30DAYS or NOW-1MONTH. The default is NOW-3MONTHS.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the period, in the same formats as begin_date. The default is NOW.

params.name: external_reference
params.description: Only the payments with this external_reference, the seller's own code set on the preference or the payment.

params.name: limit
params.description: Payments per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Payments to skip, for paging.

tools.name: Get payment
tools.description: Returns one payment: status and status_detail, transaction_amount, transaction_details with the net amount received, payment method and type, installments, payer and dates.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Id of the payment, from Search payments.

tools.name: Update payment
tools.description: Cancels a payment that is still pending, in_process or authorized, like an unpaid boleto or Pix, or changes the expiration date of a pending one. An approved payment is not cancelled here: it is refunded in Mercado Pago.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Id of the payment, from Search payments.

params.name: status
params.description: cancelled to cancel the payment.

params.name: date_of_expiration
params.description: New expiration date of a pending payment, like 2026-11-17T23:59:59.000-03:00.

tools.name: Search preferences
tools.description: Lists the payment preferences, the checkout links, created in the last 90 days. The response has elements, next_offset and total. The link itself, init_point, comes from Get preference.

params.name: external_reference
params.description: Only the preferences with this external_reference.

params.name: limit
params.description: Preferences per page. The default is 30.

params.name: offset
params.description: Preferences to skip, like the next_offset of the previous response. The default is 0.

tools.name: Get preference
tools.description: Returns a payment preference with its items, payer, payment settings, validity and init_point, the checkout link to send to the buyer. Works for preferences of any age.

params.name: preference_id
params.description: Id of the preference, from Search preferences or Create preference.

tools.name: Create preference
tools.description: Creates a payment preference and returns it with id and init_point, the Checkout Pro link where the buyer pays by Pix, card, boleto or Mercado Pago balance. Each item needs id, title, quantity and unit_price. Share init_point with the buyer.

params.name: items
params.description: Products or services of the payment. The total is the sum of quantity times unit_price.

params.name: payer
params.description: Buyer data that fills in the checkout.

params.name: payment_methods
params.description: Payment options of the checkout.

params.name: back_urls
params.description: Pages of the seller's site the buyer returns to after the checkout.

params.name: auto_return
params.description: approved sends the buyer to back_urls.success right after an approved card payment. Needs back_urls.success.

params.name: statement_descriptor
params.description: Text on the buyer's card statement, up to 13 characters.

params.name: external_reference
params.description: Your own code for this sale. Its payments carry it, so Search payments finds them by it.

params.name: expires
params.description: true makes the link valid only between expiration_date_from and expiration_date_to.

params.name: expiration_date_from
params.description: Start of the validity, like 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000-03:00.

params.name: expiration_date_to
params.description: End of the validity, in the same format as expiration_date_from.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Free key-value data saved with the preference.

tools.name: Update preference
tools.description: Changes the fields sent on a payment preference, like items, prices, buyer data or validity. The id and the init_point link stay the same.

params.name: preference_id
params.description: Id of the preference, from Search preferences or Create preference.

params.name: items
params.description: Products or services of the payment. The total is the sum of quantity times unit_price.

params.name: payer
params.description: Buyer data that fills in the checkout.

params.name: payment_methods
params.description: Payment options of the checkout.

params.name: back_urls
params.description: Pages of the seller's site the buyer returns to after the checkout.

params.name: auto_return
params.description: approved sends the buyer to back_urls.success right after an approved card payment. Needs back_urls.success.

params.name: external_reference
params.description: Your own code for this sale. Its payments carry it, so Search payments finds them by it.

params.name: expires
params.description: true makes the link valid only between expiration_date_from and expiration_date_to.

params.name: expiration_date_from
params.description: Start of the validity, like 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000-03:00.

params.name: expiration_date_to
params.description: End of the validity, in the same format as expiration_date_from. A past date closes the link.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Free key-value data saved with the preference.

tools.name: Search subscription plans
tools.description: Searches the subscription plans of the account. Each plan in results has id, reason, auto_recurring, status, subscribed (how many subscribers) and init_point, the link where a buyer subscribes. Page with offset and limit; paging has the total.

params.name: q
params.description: Free text to search in the plans.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the plans in this status.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field that orders the results, like date_created.

params.name: criteria
params.description: Direction of sort: asc or desc.

params.name: offset
params.description: Plans to skip, for paging.

params.name: limit
params.description: Plans per page.

tools.name: Create subscription plan
tools.description: Creates a subscription plan and returns it with id and init_point, the link where buyers subscribe with their card. Needs reason, back_url and auto_recurring with frequency, frequency_type and currency_id.

params.name: reason
params.description: Name of the plan, shown to the subscriber at checkout and in the notifications.

params.name: auto_recurring
params.description: Amount and cycle of the charges.

params.name: payment_methods_allowed
params.description: Payment types and methods the subscriber can use. Without it, all of them.

params.name: back_url
params.description: Page of the seller's site the subscriber returns to after subscribing.

tools.name: Update subscription plan
tools.description: Changes the fields sent on a subscription plan, like the name, the amount or the cycle. The id and the init_point link stay the same.

params.name: plan_id
params.description: Id of the plan, from Search subscription plans or Create subscription plan.

params.name: reason
params.description: Name of the plan, shown to the subscriber at checkout and in the notifications.

params.name: auto_recurring
params.description: Amount and cycle of the charges. frequency_type goes with any change here.

params.name: payment_methods_allowed
params.description: Payment types and methods the subscriber can use.

params.name: back_url
params.description: Page of the seller's site the subscriber returns to after subscribing.

tools.name: Search subscriptions
tools.description: Searches the subscriptions of the account's buyers. Each one in results has id, status, reason, preapproval_plan_id, payer_id and name, auto_recurring, next_payment_date and summarized, with charged and pending amounts. Page with offset and limit; paging has the total.

params.name: q
params.description: Free text to search in the subscriptions.

params.name: payer_email
params.description: Only the subscriptions of this subscriber email address.

params.name: preapproval_plan_id
params.description: Only the subscriptions of this plan: the id from Search subscription plans.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the subscriptions in this status. authorized is active and charging.

params.name: semaphore
params.description: Only the subscriptions with this collection status summary.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field and direction, as field_name:asc or field_name:desc, like date_created:desc.

params.name: offset
params.description: Subscriptions to skip, for paging.

params.name: limit
params.description: Subscriptions per page.

tools.name: Update subscription
tools.description: Pauses, reactivates or cancels a subscription, or changes its name, external_reference, back_url or amount. paused stops the charges until it is authorized again; canceled ends the subscription.

params.name: subscription_id
params.description: Id of the subscription, from Search subscriptions.

params.name: status
params.description: authorized reactivates a paused subscription, paused pauses it and canceled cancels it.

params.name: reason
params.description: Name of the subscription, shown to the subscriber in the notifications.

params.name: external_reference
params.description: Your own code for the subscription.

params.name: back_url
params.description: Page of the seller's site the subscriber returns to after the checkout.

params.name: auto_recurring
params.description: New amount of the next charges.

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Teams, channels, channel messages and chats of a Microsoft Teams work or school account.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Lists the teams the user is a direct member of, with id, displayName, description and isArchived. Use the id as team_id in the other tools.

tools.name: List channels
tools.description: Lists the channels of a team that the user can see, with id, displayName, description, membershipType and webUrl. Private and shared channels appear only to their members. Use the id as channel_id in the message tools.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

tools.name: Create channel
tools.description: Creates a standard channel, open to every member of the team, and returns it with its id. Private and shared channels need a member list and are not supported here.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

params.name: displayName
params.description: Name of the channel as members see it, up to 50 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the channel.

tools.name: List channel messages
tools.description: Lists the root messages of a channel, without their replies, 20 per page and ordered by the latest activity of each thread. Only the first page comes back: the @odata.nextLink of the response cannot be followed here. Read a thread with List channel message replies.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel id from List channels, for example 19:abc@thread.tacv2.

tools.name: Get channel message
tools.description: Returns one root message of a channel, with its body, the sender in from, createdDateTime and webUrl. Its replies are not included.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel id from List channels.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Message id from List channel messages.

tools.name: List channel message replies
tools.description: Lists the replies to a root message of a channel. The root message is not included: read it with Get channel message. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel id from List channels.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the root message, from List channel messages.

tools.name: Send channel message
tools.description: Posts a new message in a channel as the user and returns it with its id. Microsoft's terms forbid using Teams as a log, so send only messages that people will read.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel id from List channels.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the message. contentType is text, the default, or html for formatted content.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject shown above the message, in plain text.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the message. The default is normal.

tools.name: Reply to channel message
tools.description: Posts a reply in the thread of a root message of a channel, as the user, and returns it with its id. Send only messages that people will read.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Team id from List teams.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel id from List channels.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the root message, from List channel messages. A reply cannot be replied to.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the reply. contentType is text, the default, or html for formatted content.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the reply. The default is normal.

tools.name: List chats
tools.description: Lists the one-on-one, group and meeting chats of the user, with id, topic, chatType and webUrl. One-on-one chats have no topic: use List chat members to see who is in a chat. Only the first page comes back.

tools.name: List chat members
tools.description: Lists the people in a chat, with displayName, email and userId.

params.name: chat_id
params.description: Chat id from List chats.

tools.name: List chat messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of a chat, the most recently modified first, with body, the sender in from and createdDateTime. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: chat_id
params.description: Chat id from List chats.

tools.name: Send chat message
tools.description: Sends a message in an existing chat as the user and returns it with its id. A new chat cannot be started here, so the chat must come from List chats. Send only messages that people will read.

params.name: chat_id
params.description: Chat id from List chats.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the message. contentType is text, the default, or html for formatted content.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the message. The default is normal.

name: Miro
description: Boards, sticky notes, cards and other items of the Miro team where the connection was authorized.

tools.name: List boards
tools.description: Lists the boards the connected user can open, with id, name, description, viewLink, owner, team and dates. Pagination by offset: the response has total, offset and size, and the list ends when offset plus size reaches total. Boards created a few seconds ago may be missing from a text search, but not from a search by team_id.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against the name and description of the boards. Ignored when team_id is sent.

params.name: team_id
params.description: Only the boards of this team: the team.id of a board from List boards. With it, query is ignored and sort applies.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the boards. It only applies with team_id; default means last_created there.

params.name: limit
params.description: Boards per page, up to 50. The default is 20.

params.name: offset
params.description: Zero-based position of the first board to return. The default is 0.

tools.name: Get board
tools.description: Returns a board: name, description, viewLink, owner, team, sharing policy and dates.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

tools.name: Create board
tools.description: Creates a board in the team of the connection and returns it with its id and viewLink. On the free plan a team can have only 3 editable boards.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the board, up to 60 characters. The default is Untitled.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the board, up to 300 characters.

params.name: policy
params.description: Who can open the board. Omit it to keep the defaults of the team.

tools.name: Update board
tools.description: Updates the name, description or sharing of a board and returns it. Fields left out keep their value.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the board, up to 60 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: New description of the board, up to 300 characters.

params.name: policy
params.description: Who can open the board. Only the levels sent change.

tools.name: List board members
tools.description: Lists the members of a board with id, name and role. The id is the assigneeId that Create card and Update card ask for. Pagination by offset: the list ends when offset plus size reaches total.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: limit
params.description: Members per page, up to 50. The default is 20.

params.name: offset
params.description: Zero-based position of the first member to return. The default is 0.

tools.name: List items
tools.description: Lists the items of a board, such as sticky notes, cards, text, shapes and frames, with id, type, data, position, geometry and parent. An item inside a frame has the id of the frame in parent.id. The response has cursor: pass it as cursor to read the next page; the list ends when cursor is missing.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: type
params.description: Only the items of this type. Omit it for all of them.

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page, from 10 to 50. The default is 10.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor of the previous response, to read the next page.

tools.name: Get item
tools.description: Returns one item of a board, of any type, with its data, style, position, geometry and parent.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the item, from List items.

tools.name: Create sticky note
tools.description: Adds a sticky note to a board and returns it with its id. Without position it goes to the center of the board; inside a frame (parent.id), the position counts from the top-left corner of the frame.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: data
params.description: Text and shape of the sticky note.

params.name: style
params.description: Color and text alignment of the sticky note.

params.name: position
params.description: Where the center of the sticky note goes, in pixels. On the board, 0,0 is the center of the board; inside a frame, the top-left corner of the frame.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Size of the sticky note, in pixels. Send width or height, never both: the shape keeps the proportion.

params.name: parent
params.description: Frame that holds the sticky note.

tools.name: Update sticky note
tools.description: Updates the text, shape, color, position, size or frame of a sticky note and returns it. Fields left out keep their value.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the sticky note, from List items with type sticky_note.

params.name: data
params.description: Text and shape of the sticky note.

params.name: style
params.description: Color and text alignment of the sticky note.

params.name: position
params.description: Where the center of the sticky note goes, in pixels. On the board, 0,0 is the center of the board; inside a frame, the top-left corner of the frame.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Size of the sticky note, in pixels. Send width or height, never both: the shape keeps the proportion.

params.name: parent
params.description: Frame that holds the sticky note, to move it into a frame.

tools.name: Create card
tools.description: Adds a card, the task item of Miro, to a board and returns it with its id. Without position it goes to the center of the board; inside a frame (parent.id), the position counts from the top-left corner of the frame.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: data
params.description: Content of the card.

params.name: style
params.description: Look of the card.

params.name: position
params.description: Where the center of the card goes, in pixels. On the board, 0,0 is the center of the board; inside a frame, the top-left corner of the frame.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Size and rotation of the card.

params.name: parent
params.description: Frame that holds the card.

tools.name: Update card
tools.description: Updates the title, description, due date, assignee, color, position, size or frame of a card and returns it. Fields left out keep their value.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the card, from List items with type card.

params.name: data
params.description: Content of the card.

params.name: style
params.description: Look of the card.

params.name: position
params.description: Where the center of the card goes, in pixels. On the board, 0,0 is the center of the board; inside a frame, the top-left corner of the frame.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Size and rotation of the card.

params.name: parent
params.description: Frame that holds the card, to move it into a frame.

tools.name: Delete item
tools.description: Deletes an item of any type from a board, such as a sticky note, card or frame.

params.name: board_id
params.description: Id of the board, from List boards, or the part after /board/ in the URL of the board, which usually ends with an equals sign.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the item, from List items.

name: Mixpanel
description: Saved reports, event counts, retention, cohorts, user profiles and annotations of the Mixpanel projects a service account reaches, in US data residency.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Returns, under results, the service account itself and the organizations, projects and workspaces it can access, each keyed by id. The keys of results.projects are the project_id the other tools ask for, and results.workspaces has the workspace_id of projects that use data views.

tools.name: Get saved report
tools.description: Returns the data of a saved Insights or Funnels report, computed with the date range and filters saved in the report. Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

params.name: bookmark_id
params.description: Id of the saved report, from the URL of the report open in Mixpanel: the number after report-, for example 12345 in report-12345.

tools.name: List event names
tools.description: Lists the names of the most common events of the project in the last 31 days, to use as the event arguments of the other tools. Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

params.name: type
params.description: How the events are ranked: general by total events, unique by unique users, average by events per user.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of names. The default is 255.

tools.name: List event properties
tools.description: Lists the most common property names of one event, to build the on and where expressions of Get retention report. Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of one event, from List event names.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of property names. The default is 10.

tools.name: Get event counts
tools.description: Returns, period by period, the total, unique or average count of one or more events between two dates. Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

params.name: event
params.description: JSON array of event names, as text, for example ["Sign up","Purchase"]. The names come from List event names.

params.name: type
params.description: general counts every event, unique counts unique users and average gives the events per user.

params.name: unit
params.description: Size of each period. Unique counts do not work with hour.

params.name: from_date
params.description: First day, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Last day, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Get retention report
tools.description: Returns, for each cohort date, how many users entered the cohort (first) and how many came back in each interval after it (counts). Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

params.name: from_date
params.description: First day, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Last day, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: retention_type
params.description: birth, the default, follows users from the first time they did born_event. compounded counts recurring returns.

params.name: born_event
params.description: Event that puts a user in a cohort, from List event names. Required when retention_type is birth.

params.name: event
params.description: Event counted as a return, from List event names. Omit it to count any event.

params.name: born_where
params.description: Expression that filters the born events, for example properties["$os"] == "iOS".

params.name: where
params.description: Expression that filters the events of the query, for example properties["$browser"] == "Chrome".

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit of the intervals. The default is day.

params.name: interval
params.description: Units in each interval. The default is 1, and with day it can be at most 90.

params.name: interval_count
params.description: Number of intervals returned, besides the 0th interval for returns in less than one interval. The default is 1.

params.name: unbounded_retention
params.description: true counts a user as retained in an interval when they came back in it or in any later one. The default is false.

params.name: on
params.description: Property expression that segments the return event, for example properties["$browser"]. The property names come from List event properties.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of segments when on is sent.

tools.name: List cohorts
tools.description: Lists the saved cohorts of the project with id, name, number of users, description, creation date and visibility. Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

tools.name: Search profiles
tools.description: Returns the user profiles that match a where expression, a cohort or a list of distinct_ids, with their properties. A page holds up to page_size profiles: for the next one, repeat the call with the same filters, the session_id of the response and page plus one. Counts toward the Query API limit of 60 queries per hour.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Only for projects that use data views: the id of the global data view, a key of results.workspaces in List projects, sent as a number.

params.name: where
params.description: Expression that filters the profiles, for example properties["$email"] == "ana@example.com".

params.name: distinct_id
params.description: The $distinct_id of one profile, as Search profiles returns it, usually the user id of your own product.

params.name: distinct_ids
params.description: JSON array of $distinct_id values, as text, for example ["id1","id2"]. They come from Search profiles or are the user ids of your own product.

params.name: filter_by_cohort
params.description: JSON object with the id of a cohort from List cohorts, as text, for example {"id":12345}.

params.name: include_all_users
params.description: Only with filter_by_cohort. true, the default, also returns cohort members without a profile; false returns only members with a profile.

params.name: output_properties
params.description: JSON array of the property names to return, as text, for example ["$email","$name"]. Omit it to return every property.

params.name: session_id
params.description: The session_id of the previous response of Search profiles, to read the next page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to read, starting at 0. Above 0 it needs session_id.

tools.name: List annotations
tools.description: Lists the annotations of the project, the notes pinned to a date on its charts, with id, date, description, author and tags.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Only the annotations from this day on, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: toDate
params.description: Only the annotations up to this day, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Create annotation
tools.description: Creates an annotation, a note shown at a date on the charts of the project, such as a campaign launch. The service account needs the Analyst role or higher on the project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: date
params.description: Date and time of the annotation as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, for example 2026-10-01 09:00:00.

params.name: description
params.description: Text shown on the charts.

tools.name: Update annotation
tools.description: Changes the text of an annotation. The service account needs the Analyst role or higher on the project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: annotation_id
params.description: Id of the annotation, from List annotations.

params.name: description
params.description: New text shown on the charts.

tools.name: Delete annotation
tools.description: Deletes an annotation. The service account needs the Analyst role or higher on the project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, sent as a number: a key of results.projects in List projects, or the number after /project/ in the URL of Mixpanel.

params.name: annotation_id
params.description: Id of the annotation, from List annotations.

name: Netlify
description: Sites, deploys and form submissions of a Netlify account.

tools.name: List sites
tools.description: Lists the sites (projects, in the Netlify UI) the account can reach, with id, name, url, custom_domain, the published deploy and build settings. The id or the domain of a site is the site_id that the other tools take. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: name
params.description: Text matched against the site name.

params.name: filter
params.description: all, only the sites of the teams the account owns, or only those it reaches as a guest.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Update site
tools.description: Changes the name or the domains of a site and returns it. Only the fields sent change. The DNS of a new custom domain still has to point to Netlify.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The id of the site from List sites, or its domain, such as mysite.netlify.app.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the site, which also changes its netlify.app address.

params.name: custom_domain
params.description: Main custom domain, such as www.example.com.

params.name: domain_aliases
params.description: Other custom domains of the site, replacing the current list.

params.name: force_ssl
params.description: Redirects every HTTP request to HTTPS, once the certificate is active.

tools.name: List site deploys
tools.description: Lists the deploys of a site, newest first, with id, state, branch, context, error_message and the deploy URL. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The id of the site from List sites, or its domain, such as mysite.netlify.app.

params.name: production
params.description: true for only production deploys.

params.name: state
params.description: Only deploys in this state.

params.name: branch
params.description: Only deploys of this Git branch.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get deploy
tools.description: Returns a deploy, with state (ready when it is live or ready to publish, error when the build failed), error_message, branch, commit_ref, published_at and the deploy URL.

params.name: deploy_id
params.description: The id of the deploy, from List site deploys, or the deploy_id returned by Create site build.

tools.name: Create site build
tools.description: Starts a build of a site from its connected repository and returns the build, with deploy_id to follow in Get deploy. Without branch it builds production; another branch makes a branch deploy. It waits in line when the team has no free build capacity.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The id of the site from List sites, or its domain, such as mysite.netlify.app.

params.name: branch
params.description: Branch to build. Without it, or with the production branch, it is a production deploy.

params.name: commit_sha
params.description: Commit to build. Without it, the latest commit of the branch.

params.name: clear_cache
params.description: Clears the build cache before building.

params.name: draft
params.description: Builds a draft deploy, which is never published.

params.name: title
params.description: Title shown on the deploy.

tools.name: Cancel deploy
tools.description: Stops a deploy that is still queued or building, and returns it.

params.name: deploy_id
params.description: The id of the deploy, from List site deploys.

tools.name: Restore site deploy
tools.description: Publishes an earlier deploy again and makes it the live version of the site, which is how a rollback works. Returns the deploy.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The id of the site from List sites, or its domain, such as mysite.netlify.app.

params.name: deploy_id
params.description: The id of a ready deploy of the site, from List site deploys.

tools.name: List site forms
tools.description: Lists the forms Netlify detected in a site, with id, name, fields and submission_count. The submissions themselves come from List form submissions.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The id of the site from List sites, or its domain, such as mysite.netlify.app.

tools.name: List site submissions
tools.description: Lists the submissions of every form of a site, newest first, with name, email, the data of each field and created_at. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: site_id
params.description: The id of the site from List sites, or its domain, such as mysite.netlify.app.

params.name: state
params.description: Send spam for the submissions marked as spam. Without it, the verified ones.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: List form submissions
tools.description: Lists the submissions of one form, newest first, with name, email, the data of each field and created_at. Paginate with page and per_page: a page with fewer items than per_page is the last one.

params.name: form_id
params.description: The id of the form, from List site forms.

params.name: state
params.description: Send spam for the submissions marked as spam. Without it, the verified ones.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Delete submission
tools.description: Deletes a form submission for good, such as spam or a test. It cannot be undone.

params.name: submission_id
params.description: The id of the submission, from List form submissions or List site submissions.

name: Notion
description: Pages and data sources of a Notion workspace that were shared with the connection.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Searches the pages and data sources shared with the connection by title. Returns has_more and next_cursor for the following page.

params.name: query
params.description: Text matched against titles. Omit it to list everything shared with the connection.

params.name: filter
params.description: Restricts the results to pages or to data sources.

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: The next_cursor of the previous response.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

tools.name: Retrieve page
tools.description: Returns the properties of a page. The content of the page is not included: read it with Get page markdown.

params.name: page_id
params.description: Id of the page, from Search or List data source pages, or the 32-character id at the end of the page URL.

params.name: filter_properties
params.description: Names or ids of the properties to return, from Get data source. Omit it to return all of them.

tools.name: Create page
tools.description: Creates a page under a page or a data source shared with the connection. Send the content as Markdown in markdown, or as blocks in children, never both.

params.name: parent
params.description: Where the page is created: page_id of a parent page, from Search, or data_source_id of a data source, from Search or Get database. Send one of the two.

params.name: properties
params.description: Page properties. Under a page parent only title is valid. Under a data source the names must match its schema, from Get data source.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Page content as Markdown. Do not send it together with children.

params.name: children
params.description: Page content as Notion block objects, up to 100.

tools.name: Update page
tools.description: Updates the properties, icon or cover of a page, or moves it to the trash and back with in_trash. Properties left out keep their values. The content of the page changes with Update page markdown or Create blocks.

params.name: page_id
params.description: Id of the page, from Search or List data source pages, or the 32-character id at the end of the page URL.

params.name: properties
params.description: Property values to change, keyed by property name or id, in the format of each property type. Outside a data source only title is valid. Under a data source the names, types and options come from Get data source, a list value replaces the whole list, and people take user ids from List users.

params.name: in_trash
params.description: true moves the page to the trash and false restores it. The API cannot delete a page permanently.

params.name: icon
params.description: Page icon: an emoji, or an image from a public URL.

params.name: cover
params.description: Page cover, an image from a public URL.

tools.name: Get page markdown
tools.description: Returns the content of a page as Markdown in the markdown field. On a very large page, truncated is true and unknown_block_ids lists the parts left out, each readable by passing its id as page_id.

params.name: page_id
params.description: Id of the page, from Search or List data source pages, or the 32-character id at the end of the page URL. An id from unknown_block_ids of a previous response also works.

params.name: include_transcript
params.description: true includes the full transcript of each meeting note. By default a meeting note shows only its link.

tools.name: Update page markdown
tools.description: Edits the content of a page with Markdown: type update_content applies search-and-replace edits, and replace_content rewrites the whole page. Child pages and databases are never deleted unless allow_deleting_content is true. Returns the new content of the page.

params.name: page_id
params.description: Id of the page, from Search or List data source pages, or the 32-character id at the end of the page URL.

params.name: type
params.description: The edit to make. Send the object with this name, and only that one.

params.name: update_content
params.description: Search-and-replace edits, used when type is update_content.

params.name: replace_content
params.description: The new content of the whole page, used when type is replace_content.

tools.name: Create blocks
tools.description: Appends content blocks to a page, or to a block that takes children, at the end unless position says otherwise. Up to 100 blocks per call, with up to two levels of nesting. Returns the new first-level blocks with their ids.

params.name: block_id
params.description: Id of the parent: a page id, from Search or List data source pages or at the end of the page URL, or a block id returned by Create blocks.

params.name: children
params.description: Notion block objects, for example {"type": "paragraph", "paragraph": {"rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "Hello"}}]}}. Each text content holds up to 2000 characters.

params.name: position
params.description: Where the blocks go: end, the default, start, or after_block with the id of a block under this parent.

tools.name: Get database
tools.description: Returns a database with its title, parent and data_sources, the id and name of each data source in it. List data source pages, Get data source and Create page take that data source id, not the database id.

params.name: database_id
params.description: Id of the database: the 32-character id in the database URL, before the question mark, or the database_id in the parent of a data source from Search.

tools.name: Get data source
tools.description: Returns the schema of a data source: the name, id, type and options of each property. Read it before creating, updating or filtering pages in it.

params.name: data_source_id
params.description: Id of the data source, from Search with the data_source filter or from the data_sources of Get database.

tools.name: List data source pages
tools.description: Lists the pages of a data source, the rows of a database, with an optional filter and sorts. Returns has_more and next_cursor for the following page. A query stops at 10,000 results.

params.name: data_source_id
params.description: Id of the data source, from Search with the data_source filter or from the data_sources of Get database.

params.name: filter
params.description: One property filter, such as {"property": "Status", "status": {"equals": "Done"}}, or a compound filter {"and": [...]} or {"or": [...]} of them. Property names, types and options come from Get data source.

params.name: sorts
params.description: Sort criteria, the first one taking precedence. Each sorts by a property or by a timestamp.

params.name: filter_properties
params.description: Names or ids of the properties to return in each page, from Get data source. Omit it to return all of them.

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: The next_cursor of the previous response.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

tools.name: List comments
tools.description: Lists the unresolved comments of a page or block, each with its discussion_id. Returns has_more and next_cursor for the following page.

params.name: block_id
params.description: Id of the page, from Search or List data source pages or at the end of the page URL, or of a block returned by Create blocks.

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: The next_cursor of the previous response.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description: Comments on a page or block, opening a new discussion, or replies to an existing discussion. Send parent or discussion_id, not both.

params.name: parent
params.description: Where a new discussion starts: page_id of a page, from Search or List data source pages, or block_id of a block returned by Create blocks. Send one of the two.

params.name: discussion_id
params.description: Discussion to reply to, from List comments.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Text of the comment. Inline formatting only: bold, italic, strikethrough, code, links and inline equations. Headings, lists and code blocks are not accepted.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the members and bots of the workspace, without guests, with the id that people properties and mentions take. Emails come only when the connection has user information with email addresses. Not available to a personal access token. Returns has_more and next_cursor for the following page.

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: The next_cursor of the previous response.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page, up to 100.

name: Omnisend
