description: Contacts, campaigns, events, products and marketing reports of an Omnisend brand.

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Lists the contacts with their id, email, phone, status, tags, segments and custom properties, newest first by default. The response has contacts and paging; while paging.hasMore is true, pass paging.cursors.after as after and keep the filters.

params.name: email
params.description: Only the contact with this email address.

params.name: phone
params.description: Only the contact with this phone number, in E.164 format such as +5511999998888.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the contacts with this email subscription status. Does not work together with tag.

params.name: tag
params.description: Only the contacts with this tag. Does not work together with status.

params.name: segmentID
params.description: Only the contacts of this segment, by the segmentID from List segments.

params.name: updatedAtFrom
params.description: Only the contacts updated at or after this RFC 3339 date-time. Does not work together with the other filters.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by. The default is createdAt.

params.name: direction
params.description: Order of the sort, used only with sort. The default is desc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Contacts per page, up to 250. The default is 100.

params.name: after

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a contact, or updates the contact that already has the same email identifier. Setting a channel to subscribed sends the welcome message of the brand, when that automation is on, unless sendWelcomeMessage is false.

params.name: identifiers
params.description: Email and phone of the contact, each with the subscription status of its channel: email for the email identifier and sms for the phone identifier.

params.name: firstName
params.description: First name of the contact.

params.name: lastName
params.description: Last name of the contact.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the contact. Omnisend advises a source tag, such as source: website.

params.name: customProperties
params.description: Custom properties keyed by name, with Latin letters, digits and underscores only. Values are text, numbers, booleans, dates as text or lists of text; an empty value removes the property.

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender of the contact.

params.name: birthdate
params.description: Birth date of the contact, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: address
params.description: Street, number and apartment.

params.name: city
params.description: City.

params.name: state

params.name: postalCode
params.description: Postal code.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Country as the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example BR.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Updates a contact. Only the fields sent change, but tags replaces the whole list of tags: to only add tags, use Apply tags. A channel status in identifiers subscribes or unsubscribes the contact.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the contact, from List contacts.

params.name: identifiers
params.description: Email and phone of the contact, each with the subscription status of its channel: email for the email identifier and sms for the phone identifier.

params.name: firstName
params.description: First name of the contact.

params.name: lastName
params.description: Last name of the contact.

params.name: tags
params.description: The full list of tags the contact keeps. An empty list removes every tag.

params.name: customProperties
params.description: Custom properties to change, keyed by name, with Latin letters, digits and underscores only. An empty value removes the property.

params.name: gender
params.description: Gender of the contact.

params.name: birthdate
params.description: Birth date of the contact, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: address
params.description: Street, number and apartment.

params.name: city
params.description: City.

params.name: countryCode

tools.name: Apply tags
tools.description: Adds tags to contacts, keeping the tags they already have. Pick the contacts by contactIDs, emails, phones or segmentID; the selections add up. Limited to 60 calls per minute.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to add.

params.name: contactIDs
params.description: IDs of the contacts, from List contacts.

params.name: emails
params.description: Email addresses of the contacts.

params.name: phones
params.description: Phone numbers of the contacts, in E.164 format.

params.name: segmentID
params.description: Every contact of this segment, by the segmentID from List segments.

tools.name: List segments
tools.description: Lists the segments with their segmentID, name and status. The segmentID targets campaigns and filters contacts. The response has segments and paging; while paging.hasMore is true, pass paging.cursors.after as after.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by, on the first page only.

params.name: direction
params.description: Order of the sort, used only with sort.

params.name: limit
params.description: Segments per page, up to 50.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging.cursors.after of the previous page.

tools.name: List email templates
tools.description: Lists the email templates with their id and name, newest first by default. The id is the body of an email campaign. The response has templates and paging; while paging.hasMore is true, pass paging.cursors.after as after.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Only the templates whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by. The default is createdAt.

params.name: direction
params.description: Order of the sort. The default is desc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Templates per page, up to 100. The default is 50.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging.cursors.after of the previous page.

tools.name: List campaigns
tools.description: Lists the campaigns with their id, name, status, channel, content, audience and sending settings, newest first by default. The response has campaigns and paging; while paging.hasMore is true, pass paging.cursors.after as after and keep the filters.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the campaigns in any of these statuses.

params.name: channel
params.description: Only the campaigns of any of these channels.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Only the campaigns whose name contains this text.

params.name: createdAtFrom
params.description: Only the campaigns created after this date-time, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: createdAtTo
params.description: Only the campaigns created before this date-time.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by. The default is createdAt.

params.name: direction
params.description: Order of the sort, used only with sort. The default is desc.

params.name: view
params.description: summary leaves the heavy content and A/B test sections out of each campaign.

params.name: limit
params.description: Campaigns per page, up to 250. The default is 100.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging.cursors.after of the previous page.

tools.name: Create campaign
tools.description: Creates a regular email or SMS campaign as a draft and returns it with its id. An email campaign needs content.email.templateID, from List email templates, and an SMS campaign needs content.sms. Nothing is sent until Send campaign.

params.name: type
params.description: Always regular.

params.name: channel
params.description: Channel of the campaign.

params.name: name
params.description: Internal name of the campaign.

params.name: language
params.description: Language of the campaign as xx_XX, for example pt_BR. The default is en_US.

params.name: content
params.description: Content of the campaign: email for an email campaign or sms for an SMS campaign.

params.name: audience
params.description: Who receives the campaign. Without includedSegmentIDs, every subscriber of the channel receives it. Included and excluded segments must not overlap.

params.name: sendingSettings
params.description: When Send campaign sends it. The default strategy is immediate.

tools.name: Update campaign
tools.description: Updates a campaign in draft status. Only the fields sent change. The email template stays the one set at creation. To change a campaign that is no longer a draft, the app asks for a copy.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the campaign, from List campaigns.

params.name: name
params.description: Internal name of the campaign.

params.name: language
params.description: Language of the campaign as xx_XX, for example pt_BR.

params.name: content
params.description: Content to change: email for an email campaign or sms for an SMS campaign.

params.name: audience
params.description: Who receives the campaign. Without includedSegmentIDs, every subscriber of the channel receives it. Included and excluded segments must not overlap.

params.name: sendingSettings
params.description: When Send campaign sends it.

tools.name: Send campaign test email
tools.description: Emails a preview of an email campaign in draft to up to 5 addresses, with the saved subject, sender and content. The campaign itself does not change.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the campaign, from List campaigns.

params.name: recipients
params.description: Email addresses that receive the test.

tools.name: Send campaign
tools.description: Sends a campaign in draft status to its audience, right away or at the time of its sending settings, and spends sends of the plan. A sent campaign cannot be sent again.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the campaign, from List campaigns.

tools.name: Send event
tools.description: Sends a customer event, creating or updating the contact, and starts the automations of the brand that listen to the event name. Custom events take any name and properties; recommended events, such as placed order, follow the schema of their page in the Omnisend docs.

params.name: eventName
params.description: Name of the event, for example webinar registered, or the name of a recommended event such as placed order.

params.name: origin
params.description: Source of the event: api for a custom store, or the name of the app that sends it.

params.name: contact
params.description: Who the event belongs to, found by email, phone or id. The other fields update the contact.

params.name: properties
params.description: Properties of the event, keyed by name. Automations and segments can use them.

params.name: eventVersion
params.description: Only for recommended events: the version given on the page of the event in the Omnisend docs. Leave it out for custom events.

params.name: eventTime
params.description: When the event happened, as RFC 3339. The default is now.

params.name: eventID
params.description: Your own UUID for the event. With eventTime, it avoids processing the same past event twice.

tools.name: Get report
tools.description: Returns aggregated campaign and automation metrics, grouped by the send date of the messages: sends, opens, clicks, bounces, spam, unsubscribes and attributed orders and revenue, as totals or broken down by dimensions. Limited to 10 calls per minute and 55 per day for the brand.

params.name: queries
params.description: From 1 to 4 queries. The response has one report per alias, each with rows that carry a key per dimension and per metric.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Lists the products of the store catalog with their id, title, status, URL, images and variants with prices. The response has products and paging; page with offset and limit while paging.next is filled.

params.name: titleContains
params.description: Only the products whose title contains this text, ignoring case.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by.

params.name: limit
params.description: Products per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of products to skip.

name: OneDrive
description: Files and folders of the OneDrive of a personal or Microsoft 365 account, with their sharing.

tools.name: List items
tools.description: Lists the files and folders inside a folder, with id, name, size, lastModifiedDateTime, webUrl and a folder or file facet. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Folder id from List items, Search items or Get item, or root for the top folder of the drive.

tools.name: Search items
tools.description: Searches the drive by file name, metadata and content, and returns the matching files and folders with id, name, webUrl and parentReference. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: q
params.description: Text to find. Write a single quote twice, as in O''Brien.

tools.name: Get item
tools.description: Returns the metadata of a file or folder: name, size, dates, createdBy, webUrl, parentReference with the driveId and the folder id, and a folder or file facet. A file also has @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl, a download link that needs no sign-in and expires in about an hour.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items or Search items, or root for the top folder.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a folder inside another folder and returns it with its id.

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Id of the parent folder from List items, Search items or Get item, or root for the top folder.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the new folder.

params.name: folder
params.description: Send an empty object. It marks the new item as a folder.

tools.name: Update item
tools.description: Renames a file or folder, or moves it to another folder of the same drive, and returns it. Only the fields sent change.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

params.name: name
params.description: New name, with the extension for a file.

params.name: parentReference
params.description: Folder to move the item to.

tools.name: Copy item
tools.description: Copies a file or folder, with its contents, to a folder or under a new name. The copy runs in the background: the response is 202 with no body, and the new item shows up in List items once it is done. Sharing is not copied.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

params.name: parentReference
params.description: Destination folder. Omit it to copy into the same folder, with a new name.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the copy. Without it the copy keeps the original name.

tools.name: Delete item
tools.description: Moves a file or folder to the recycle bin of OneDrive, where the user can restore it.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

tools.name: Create sharing link
tools.description: Creates a sharing link for a file or folder, or returns the link of the same type that already exists, as a permission whose link.webUrl is the link to send.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

params.name: type
params.description: view is read only, edit allows changes, embed is for a web page and works only on files of personal accounts.

params.name: scope
params.description: anonymous lets in anyone with the link, if the organization allows it; organization, anyone signed in to the same work or school organization; users, only people given access. Without it, the default of the organization applies.

params.name: expirationDateTime
params.description: When the link stops working, in UTC, as 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z.

params.name: password
params.description: Password of the link. Personal accounts only.

tools.name: List permissions
tools.description: Lists who has access to a file or folder: links, people and groups, each with id, roles and inheritedFrom when it comes from a parent folder. The owner sees every permission; other people see only their own.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

tools.name: Create permission
tools.description: Shares a file or folder with people by email, with read or write access, and returns the new permissions. With sendInvitation true, OneDrive emails them a link. The top folder of a personal drive cannot be shared.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

params.name: recipients
params.description: People who get access.

params.name: roles
params.description: read or write.

params.name: sendInvitation
params.description: true emails the people a sharing link; false only grants the access.

params.name: requireSignIn
params.description: true makes the people sign in to open the item.

params.name: message
params.description: Plain text added to the invitation email.

params.name: expirationDateTime
params.description: When the access ends, in UTC. Not every account type supports it.

tools.name: Delete permission
tools.description: Removes a link or a person's access from a file or folder. Only permissions given on the item itself can be removed: one with inheritedFrom comes from a parent folder and is removed there.

params.name: item_id
params.description: File or folder id from List items, Search items or Get item.

params.name: permission_id
params.description: Permission id from List permissions.

name: Outlook Mail
description: Mail of an Outlook.com or Microsoft 365 mailbox: folders, messages, replies and drafts.

tools.name: List mail folders
tools.description: Lists the mail folders directly under the root of the mailbox, with id, displayName, unreadItemCount and totalItemCount. Child folders are not included, and only the first page comes back. The well-known names inbox, sentitems, drafts, deleteditems, archive and junkemail work as folder ids in the other tools without this call.

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of a folder, 10 per page, with subject, from, receivedDateTime, isRead and bodyPreview, the first 255 characters of the body. Only the first page comes back: to reach older messages, use Search messages, which pages with from. Read the full text of one message with Get message.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: Folder id from List mail folders, or a well-known name such as inbox, sentitems, drafts or archive.

tools.name: Search messages
tools.description: Searches the mailbox, attachments included, and returns the hits newest first, up to 25 per page. Each hit has hitId, the message id for the other tools, a summary and the main fields in resource. moreResultsAvailable says whether to ask for the next page with from. Only work or school accounts can search; personal Outlook.com accounts get an error.

params.name: requests
params.description: One search request, with entityTypes set to message.

tools.name: Get message
tools.description: Returns one message with its body as plain text, from, toRecipients, ccRecipients, receivedDateTime, conversationId, hasAttachments and webLink. Attachments are not included.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Message id from List messages, or the hitId from Search messages.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Sends a new email from the user's mailbox right away and saves a copy in Sent Items. The response is 202 with no body, so no message id comes back. To let someone review the email first, use Create draft.

params.name: message
params.description: The email to send.

params.name: saveToSentItems
params.description: false keeps no copy in Sent Items. The default is true.

tools.name: Reply to message
tools.description: Replies right away to the sender of a message, or to its replyTo addresses when it has them, with the comment above the quoted original, and saves the reply in Sent Items. The response is 202 with no body. To answer everyone, use Reply all to message.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the message to answer, from List messages or the hitId from Search messages.

params.name: comment
params.description: Text of the reply, placed above the quoted original message.

params.name: message
params.description: People to add to the reply.

tools.name: Reply all to message
tools.description: Replies right away to the sender and every recipient of a message, with the comment above the quoted original, and saves the reply in Sent Items. The response is 202 with no body.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the message to answer, from List messages or the hitId from Search messages.

params.name: comment
params.description: Text of the reply, placed above the quoted original message.

tools.name: Forward message
tools.description: Forwards a message right away to new recipients, with the comment above the original, and saves it in Sent Items. The response is 202 with no body.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of the message to forward, from List messages or the hitId from Search messages.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: Who receives the forwarded message.

params.name: comment
params.description: Text placed above the forwarded message.

tools.name: Create draft
tools.description: Saves a new email in Drafts without sending it and returns it with its id. Change it with Update message and send it with Send draft, or let the user review and send it from Outlook.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the email. contentType is text or html.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: Recipients in To.

params.name: ccRecipients
params.description: Recipients in Cc.

params.name: bccRecipients
params.description: Recipients in Bcc.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the email. The default is normal.

tools.name: Update message
tools.description: Changes a message and returns it: marks it read or unread, flags it, sets its categories or importance, or moves it between Focused and Other. On a draft it also changes subject, body and recipients. Only the fields sent change.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Message id from List messages, Create draft or the hitId from Search messages.

params.name: isRead
params.description: true marks the message as read, false as unread.

params.name: flag
params.description: Follow-up flag of the message.

params.name: categories
params.description: Category names. The list replaces the current one.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the message.

params.name: inferenceClassification
params.description: Moves the message to the Focused or the Other tab of the inbox.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject. Drafts only.

params.name: body
params.description: Content of the email. Drafts only. contentType is text or html.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: Recipients in To, replacing the current ones. Drafts only.

params.name: ccRecipients
params.description: Recipients in Cc, replacing the current ones. Drafts only.

params.name: bccRecipients
params.description: Recipients in Bcc, replacing the current ones. Drafts only.

tools.name: Send draft
tools.description: Sends a draft and saves it in Sent Items. The response is 202 with no body.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Id of a draft, from Create draft, or from List messages on the drafts folder.

tools.name: Move message
tools.description: Moves a message to another folder and returns it with a new id, because the move creates a copy in the destination and removes the original. Moving to deleteditems is how to delete a message: it stays recoverable in Deleted Items.

params.name: message_id
params.description: Message id from List messages or the hitId from Search messages.

params.name: destinationId
params.description: Folder id from List mail folders, or a well-known name such as inbox, archive, deleteditems or junkemail.

name: Outlook Calendar
description: Calendars, events and meeting invitations of an Outlook.com or Microsoft 365 account.

tools.name: List calendars
tools.description: Lists the calendars of the user, with id, name, isDefaultCalendar, canEdit and owner. Use the id as calendar_id. Only the first page comes back.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Lists the events of a calendar between two times, with recurring events expanded into occurrences that have their own id. start and end come in UTC. Only the first page comes back: when the response has @odata.nextLink, ask again with a shorter window.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars. The one with isDefaultCalendar true is the main calendar.

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 with offset, such as 2026-11-05T00:00:00-03:00. Without offset it is UTC.

params.name: endDateTime
params.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 with offset. Without offset it is UTC.

tools.name: Get event
tools.description: Returns one event with its body as plain text, start and end in UTC, location, attendees with their responses, organizer, onlineMeeting with the join link, recurrence and webLink.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event id from List events. The id of an occurrence acts on that occurrence; its seriesMasterId acts on the whole series.

tools.name: Create event
tools.description: Creates an event in a calendar and returns it with its id and webLink. With attendees, Outlook emails the invitations right away, and this cannot be turned off.

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: Calendar id from List calendars. The one with isDefaultCalendar true is the main calendar.

params.name: subject
params.description: Title of the event.

params.name: body
params.description: Description of the event. contentType is text or html.

params.name: start
params.description: When the event starts. An all-day event starts at midnight.

params.name: end
params.description: When the event ends. An all-day event ends at midnight of the next day, in the same time zone as start.

params.name: isAllDay
params.description: true for an all-day event, with start and end at midnight.

params.name: location
params.description: Where the event happens.

params.name: attendees
params.description: People, rooms or equipment invited. Outlook emails them the invitation.

params.name: isOnlineMeeting
params.description: true adds an online meeting, together with onlineMeetingProvider.

params.name: onlineMeetingProvider
params.description: teamsForBusiness adds a Microsoft Teams link. It needs a work or school account.

params.name: showAs
params.description: How the time shows in the calendar. oof is out of office.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the event.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: Privacy of the event.

params.name: isReminderOn
params.description: true sets a reminder.

params.name: reminderMinutesBeforeStart
params.description: Minutes before the start that the reminder shows.

params.name: categories
params.description: Category names of the user. The list replaces the current one.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Repetition. params.name: allowNewTimeProposals
params.description: false stops invitees from proposing another time. The default is true.

params.name: responseRequested
params.description: false asks invitees for no response. The default is true.

tools.description: Changes an event and returns it. Only the fields sent change. On a meeting the user organizes, Outlook emails the change to the attendees. Do not send a new body for an online meeting: the join details live in the body and would be lost.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event id from List events. The id of an occurrence acts on that occurrence; its seriesMasterId acts on the whole series.

params.description: Title of the event.

params.name: body
params.description: Description of the event. contentType is text or html.

params.description: When the event starts. An all-day event starts at midnight.

params.description: true for an all-day event, with start and end at midnight.

params.description: Where the event happens.

params.description: People, rooms or equipment invited. Outlook emails them the invitation.

params.description: true adds an online meeting, together with onlineMeetingProvider.
