params.description: teamsForBusiness adds a Microsoft Teams link. It needs a work or school account.

params.name: showAs
params.description: How the time shows in the calendar. oof is out of office.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the event.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: Privacy of the event.

params.name: isReminderOn
params.description: true sets a reminder.

params.name: reminderMinutesBeforeStart
params.description: Minutes before the start that the reminder shows.

params.name: categories
params.description: Category names of the user. The list replaces the current one.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Repetition. Besides type and interval, pattern needs: weekly, daysOfWeek and firstDayOfWeek; absoluteMonthly, dayOfMonth; relativeMonthly, daysOfWeek; absoluteYearly, dayOfMonth and month; relativeYearly, daysOfWeek and month. range.startDate is the date of start; range.type endDate needs endDate, and numbered needs numberOfOccurrences.

params.name: allowNewTimeProposals
params.description: false stops invitees from proposing another time. The default is true.

params.name: responseRequested
params.description: false asks invitees for no response. The default is true.

tools.name: Delete event
tools.description: Deletes an event from the calendar. When the user organizes the meeting, Outlook emails a cancellation to the attendees.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event id from List events. The id of an occurrence acts on that occurrence; its seriesMasterId acts on the whole series.

tools.name: Accept event
tools.description: Accepts a meeting invitation and, unless sendResponse is false, emails the response to the organizer. The response is 202 with no body.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event id from List events.

params.name: comment
params.description: Text sent with the response.

params.name: sendResponse
params.description: false answers without emailing the organizer. The default is true.

tools.name: Decline event
tools.description: Declines a meeting invitation, optionally proposing another time, and unless sendResponse is false emails the response to the organizer. The response is 202 with no body.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event id from List events.

params.name: comment
params.description: Text sent with the response.

params.name: sendResponse
params.description: false answers without emailing the organizer. The default is true.

params.name: proposedNewTime
params.description: Another time proposed to the organizer. It needs sendResponse true and an event that allows new time proposals.

tools.name: Tentatively accept event
tools.description: Tentatively accepts a meeting invitation, optionally proposing another time, and unless sendResponse is false emails the response to the organizer. The response is 202 with no body.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Event id from List events.

params.name: comment
params.description: Text sent with the response.

params.name: sendResponse
params.description: false answers without emailing the organizer. The default is true.

params.name: proposedNewTime
params.description: Another time proposed to the organizer. It needs sendResponse true and an event that allows new time proposals.

tools.name: Get schedule
tools.description: Returns the free and busy times of people, distribution lists or rooms between two times. In availabilityView each digit is one slot: 0 free or working elsewhere, 1 tentative, 2 busy, 3 out of office. scheduleItems lists the busy blocks and workingHours the working hours. Only work or school accounts can call it.

params.name: schedules
params.description: Email addresses of the people, distribution lists or rooms.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start of the period.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End of the period.

params.name: availabilityViewInterval
params.description: Minutes per slot of availabilityView. The default is 30.

name: PagerDuty
description: Incidents, services and on-call shifts of a PagerDuty account, with the permissions of the user who created the token.

tools.name: List incidents
tools.description: Lists the incidents of the account created in the last month, or in the range of since and until. There is no filter by status, service or assignee here, so read status, service and assignments in each item. Page with limit and offset while more is true.

params.name: since
params.description: Start of the range, in ISO 8601. The range goes up to 6 months, and without since and until it is the last month.

params.name: until
params.description: End of the range, in ISO 8601.

params.name: date_range
params.description: Set to all to ignore since and until and search every incident of the account.

params.name: incident_key
params.description: Returns the incidents with this deduplication key.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Up to two comma-separated fields, each with a colon and the direction, for example created_at:desc. Fields: incident_number, created_at, resolved_at and urgency. The direction defaults to asc.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: IANA time zone used to render the timestamps, for example America/Sao_Paulo. Defaults to UTC.

params.name: limit
params.description: Incidents per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of incidents to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

tools.name: Get incident
tools.description: Returns one incident with its status, urgency, priority, service, assignments, acknowledgements and escalation policy.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the incident, such as PT4KHLK, from List incidents.

tools.name: Create incident
tools.description: Creates an incident on a service, which notifies the escalation policy of the service, or the users in assignments. Needs type, title and service. Send assignments or escalation_policy, never both. An incident the user assigns to themselves starts acknowledged, without notifying them.

params.name: incident
params.description: The incident to create.

tools.name: Update incident
tools.description: Acknowledges, resolves, reassigns or escalates an incident, or changes its title, urgency, priority or service. Send type and only the fields to change. Reassigning or escalating notifies the new responders, and setting status on a resolved incident reopens it.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the incident, from List incidents.

params.name: incident
params.description: The fields to change.

tools.name: List incident notes
tools.description: Lists the notes of an incident, each with its content, author and creation time.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the incident, from List incidents.

tools.name: Create incident note
tools.description: Adds a note to an incident, signed by the user of the connection. An incident holds up to 2000 notes.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the incident, from List incidents.

params.name: note
params.description: The note.

tools.name: List incident log entries
tools.description: Lists the timeline of an incident: triggers, notifications, acknowledgements, assignments, escalations, notes and resolution, each with the agent and the time. Page with limit and offset while more is true.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the incident, from List incidents.

params.name: is_overview
params.description: Set to true to keep only the most important changes.

params.name: since
params.description: Start of the range, in ISO 8601.

params.name: until
params.description: End of the range, in ISO 8601.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: IANA time zone used to render the timestamps, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: limit
params.description: Entries per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of entries to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

tools.name: List services
tools.description: Lists the services of the account, each with its id, name, status and escalation policy. The id is what Create incident and Update incident ask for. Page with limit and offset while more is true.

params.name: query
params.description: Returns only the services whose name matches this text.

params.name: name
params.description: Returns only the service with exactly this name.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Order of the results. Defaults to name.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: IANA time zone used to render the timestamps, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: limit
params.description: Services per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of services to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

tools.name: List on-calls
tools.description: Lists who is on call, one entry per user, escalation policy and level, with the schedule when the shift comes from one. Without since and until it returns the on-calls of right now. Page with limit and offset while more is true.

params.name: since
params.description: Start of the range, in ISO 8601. Shifts that overlap the range are returned, up to 90 days ahead.

params.name: until
params.description: End of the range, in ISO 8601. Not before since.

params.name: earliest
params.description: Set to true to return only the next on-call of each combination of escalation policy, level and user.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: IANA time zone used to render the timestamps, for example America/Sao_Paulo. Defaults to the time zone of the account.

params.name: limit
params.description: Entries per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of entries to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the users of the account, with id, name, email and role. The id goes in the assignee of Create incident and Update incident. Page with limit and offset while more is true.

params.name: query
params.description: Returns only the users whose name or email matches this text.

params.name: limit
params.description: Users per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of users to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

tools.name: List escalation policies
tools.description: Lists the escalation policies of the account, each with its id, name and escalation rules. The id goes in the escalation_policy of Create incident and Update incident. Page with limit and offset while more is true.

params.name: query
params.description: Returns only the escalation policies whose name matches this text.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Order of the results. Defaults to name.

params.name: limit
params.description: Escalation policies per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of escalation policies to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

tools.name: List priorities
tools.description: Lists the incident priorities of the account, from the most to the least severe, such as P1 to P5. The id goes in the priority of Create incident and Update incident. An account that has not set up priorities has none.

params.name: limit
params.description: Priorities per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of priorities to skip.

params.name: total
params.description: Set to true to fill the total field of the response, which is slower.

name: PandaDoc
description: Documents, templates and e-signature sending of a PandaDoc workspace.

tools.name: List documents
tools.description: Lists the documents of the workspace with id, name, status and dates, 50 per page by default. Ask for the next page with page; a page with fewer results than count is the last one.

params.name: q
params.description: Text matched against the document name or reference number.

params.name: status
params.description: Only documents in this status: 0 draft, 1 sent, 2 completed, 3 uploaded, 4 error, 5 viewed, 6 waiting approval, 7 approved, 8 rejected, 9 waiting payment, 10 paid, 11 voided, 12 declined, 13 external review, 14 scheduled.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Only documents created from this template, with the id from List templates.

params.name: folder_uuid
params.description: Only documents in this folder, with the uuid from List document folders.

params.name: tag
params.description: Only documents with this tag.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Only documents created at or after this moment, like 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Only documents created before this moment.

params.name: modified_from
params.description: Only documents modified at or after this moment.

params.name: modified_to
params.description: Only documents modified before this moment.

params.name: completed_from
params.description: Only documents completed at or after this moment.

params.name: completed_to
params.description: Only documents completed before this moment.

params.name: deleted
params.description: When true, returns only deleted documents.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort field. A leading minus sorts in descending order, like -date_created for the newest first.

params.name: count
params.description: Documents per page, up to 100. Defaults to 50.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get document
tools.description: Returns the details of a document: status, recipients with their id, has_completed and shared_link, fields, tokens, pricing, texts, metadata and tags. Works once the document has left the document.uploaded status.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents or Create document.

tools.name: Get document status
tools.description: Returns the id, name and status of a document. After Create document the status stays document.uploaded for a few seconds; wait for document.draft before updating or sending it.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents or Create document.

tools.name: Create document
tools.description: Creates a document from a template (template_uuid) or from a public PDF (url and name). It stays document.uploaded for a few seconds and then turns document.draft. Nothing is sent: call Send document once Get document status shows document.draft.

params.name: template_uuid
params.description: Id of the template, from List templates. Send it or url, never both.

params.name: url
params.description: Public HTTPS URL of a PDF to build the document from, instead of a template. Requires name. The signers fill the fields marked in the PDF with PandaDoc field tags, or its own form fields when parse_form_fields is true.

params.name: parse_form_fields
params.description: Only with url: true when the PDF has form fields, false when it uses PandaDoc field tags.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the document. Required with url.

params.name: recipients
params.description: People who receive the document. Each one needs email or phone.

params.name: tokens
params.description: Values of the template variables, as listed by Get template.

params.name: fields
params.description: Values of the fields by field name, as listed by Get template. Each value is an object with value (text, number, boolean or an RFC 3339 date) and, optionally, the role it belongs to, like {"Company": {"value": "Acme"}}. Signature fields cannot be filled.

params.name: texts
params.description: Content for the text blocks of the template, by block name, as listed by Get template.

params.name: pricing_tables
params.description: Content for the pricing tables of the template, by table name, as listed by Get template. Send every product of a table, because the table is rebuilt from what you send.

params.name: folder_uuid
params.description: Folder for the document, with the uuid from List document folders. Omit it for the root folder.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Your own key-value data stored with the document, like the id of the deal in your system.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the document.

tools.name: Update document
tools.description: Updates a document in the document.draft status: name, recipients, variables, fields, text blocks, pricing tables, metadata and tags. For a document already sent, call Move document to draft first.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents or Create document.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the document.

params.name: recipients
params.description: Recipients to change or add. With id, the existing recipient is updated; without id, a new recipient is added as a copy (CC).

params.name: tokens
params.description: Values of the document variables, as listed by Get document.

params.name: fields
params.description: Values of the fields by field name, as listed by Get document. Each value is an object with value (text, number, boolean or an RFC 3339 date) and, optionally, the role it belongs to, like {"Company": {"value": "Acme"}}. Signature fields cannot be filled.

params.name: texts
params.description: New content for text blocks, by block name, as listed by Get document.

params.name: pricing_tables
params.description: New content for pricing tables, by table name, as listed by Get document. Send every product of a table, because the table is rebuilt from what you send.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Key-value data to store with the document. Existing keys are updated and new keys are added.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags of the document.

tools.name: Move document to draft
tools.description: Moves a sent or completed document back to document.draft so Update document can change it. Signature and initials fields are cleared, recipients are not told, and the document must be sent again.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents.

tools.name: Send document
tools.description: Sends a document in the document.draft status to its recipients, by email unless silent is true, and moves it to document.sent, which locks its structure. With a sandbox key, recipients must share the sender's email domain.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents or Create document.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject of the email.

params.name: message
params.description: Message of the email that carries the link to the document.

params.name: silent
params.description: When true, no email goes to the recipients or the sender and scheduled reminders are off. Each recipient's shared_link, from Get document, is then the way to reach them.

params.name: sender
params.description: Member of the workspace who appears as the sender.

params.name: forwarding_settings
params.description: Whether recipients may forward the document.

tools.name: Send document reminder
tools.description: Sends a reminder now to recipients who still have to complete a sent document. The result says, per recipient, whether each reminder went out; with a signing order, only the current signer can be reminded.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents.

params.name: reminders
params.description: One entry per recipient to remind.

tools.name: Delete document
tools.description: Deletes a document. With forever false it goes to the Trash Bin, where it can be restored; without forever, PandaDoc deletes it permanently.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the document, from List documents.

params.name: forever
params.description: Set false to move the document to the Trash Bin instead of deleting it for good. PandaDoc treats a missing value as true.

tools.name: List templates
tools.description: Lists the templates of the workspace with id and name, a page at a time. A page with fewer results than count is the last one.

params.name: q
params.description: Text matched against the template name.

params.name: tag
params.description: Only templates with these tags.

params.name: shared
params.description: When true, returns only the shared templates.

params.name: count
params.description: Templates per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get template
tools.description: Returns the details of a template: roles, fields, tokens (variables), pricing tables, texts, content placeholders, metadata and tags, which tell what Create document can fill.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the template, from List templates.

tools.name: List document folders
tools.description: Lists the document folders inside a folder, with uuid and name. Without parent_uuid it lists the folders at the root, which is not listed itself.

params.name: parent_uuid
params.description: Folder to look into, with the uuid from a previous call of this tool. Omit it for the root.

params.name: count
params.description: Folders per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

name: PostHog
description: Queries, insights, dashboards, persons, cohorts and annotations of the PostHog Cloud projects a personal API key reaches.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists the organizations the key reaches, each with its projects under teams. The project_id of each team is what the other tools ask for. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: limit
params.description: Organizations per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first organization of the page.

tools.name: List event definitions
tools.description: Lists the events tracked in the project with name, description, tags and last_seen_at, to use in queries and annotations. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive match on the event name. Every word has to match.

params.name: event_type
params.description: event, the default, returns all events. event_custom keeps only names without a $ prefix, and event_posthog only the PostHog events, with the $ prefix.

params.name: exclude_stale
params.description: true leaves out the events not seen in the last 30 days.

params.name: limit
params.description: Events per page. The default is 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first event of the page.

tools.name: Run query
tools.description: Runs an ad hoc analytics query and returns its results, up to 100 rows unless the SQL sets a LIMIT. It is not an export: PostHog refuses OFFSET, limits each project to 3 queries at a time and debits every query from an hourly read budget.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: query
params.description: The query. kind HogQLQuery runs the SQL of query over tables such as events, persons and sessions. The insight kinds, such as TrendsQuery, FunnelsQuery and RetentionQuery, take their own fields here instead, for example series and dateRange.

params.name: name
params.description: Short name of the query, shown in the query log of the project.

params.name: refresh
params.description: blocking, the default, calculates now unless fresh results are cached. force_blocking always calculates, and force_cache only returns cached results.

tools.name: List insights
tools.description: Lists the insights of the project with id, short_id, name, description and query. Unless basic is true, each one also carries its cached result. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the name, description and tags.

params.name: saved
params.description: true returns only saved insights.

params.name: insight
params.description: Only insights of this type.

params.name: basic
params.description: true returns only the metadata, without results, which is faster.

params.name: limit
params.description: Insights per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first insight of the page.

tools.name: Get insight
tools.description: Returns one insight with its query and result. By default the result comes from the cache, and refresh set to blocking calculates it again when it is stale.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: insight_id
params.description: Numeric id or 8-character short_id of the insight, from List insights, or the short_id after /insights/ in the URL of the insight.

params.name: refresh
params.description: force_cache, the default, never calculates. blocking calculates now unless the cached result is fresh, and force_blocking always calculates.

params.name: filters_override
params.description: JSON object, as text, that overrides the filters for this request only, for example {"date_from":"-30d"}.

tools.name: List dashboards
tools.description: Lists the dashboards of the project with id, name, description, pinned and tags. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the name, description and tags.

params.name: pinned
params.description: true returns only pinned dashboards.

params.name: limit
params.description: Dashboards per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first dashboard of the page.

tools.name: Get dashboard
tools.description: Returns one dashboard with its filters and tiles, each tile with its insight and the cached result.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: dashboard_id
params.description: Id of the dashboard, from List dashboards.

params.name: filters_override
params.description: JSON object, as text, that overrides the dashboard filters for this request only, for example {"date_from":"-30d"}.

tools.name: List persons
tools.description: Lists the persons of the project with their distinct_ids and properties. search finds them by email, name, person id or distinct id. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: search
params.description: Part of an email address, name, person id or distinct id.

params.name: email
params.description: Exact email address of the person.

params.name: distinct_id
params.description: Exact distinct id of the person, usually the user id of your own product.

params.name: limit
params.description: Persons per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first person of the page.

tools.name: List cohorts
tools.description: Lists the cohorts of the project with id, name, description, count of persons and whether they are static. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the name.

params.name: type
params.description: Only dynamic or only static cohorts.

params.name: limit
params.description: Cohorts per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first cohort of the page.

tools.name: List annotations
tools.description: Lists the annotations of the project, the notes pinned to a moment on the charts, with id, content, date_marker and scope. Page with limit and offset.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: search
params.description: Text matched against the annotations.

params.name: limit
params.description: Annotations per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first annotation of the page.

tools.name: Create annotation
tools.description: Creates an annotation, a note shown on the charts at a moment, such as a campaign launch. By default it shows on every chart of the project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: content
params.description: Text shown on the charts.

params.name: date_marker
params.description: Moment of the annotation, for example 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z.

params.name: scope
params.description: Where the annotation shows: project, every project of the organization, one dashboard (dashboard_id) or one insight (dashboard_item).

params.name: dashboard_id
params.description: With scope dashboard, the id of the dashboard, from List dashboards.

params.name: dashboard_item
params.description: With scope dashboard_item, the numeric id of the insight, from List insights.

tools.name: Update annotation
tools.description: Changes an annotation. Only the fields sent change. PostHog does not delete annotations: set deleted to true to hide one, or to false to restore it.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project: the project_id of a team in List organizations, or the number after /project/ in the URL of PostHog.

params.name: annotation_id
params.description: Id of the annotation, from List annotations.

params.name: content
params.description: New text shown on the charts.

params.name: date_marker
params.description: New moment of the annotation, for example 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z.

params.name: scope
params.description: Where the annotation shows: project, every project of the organization, one dashboard (dashboard_id) or one insight (dashboard_item).

params.name: dashboard_id
params.description: With scope dashboard, the id of the dashboard, from List dashboards.

params.name: dashboard_item
params.description: With scope dashboard_item, the numeric id of the insight, from List insights.

params.name: deleted
params.description: true hides the annotation, which is how PostHog deletes it. false restores it.

name: Printful
description: Orders, store products and the product catalog of a Printful store.

tools.name: List orders
tools.description: Lists the orders of the store with status, recipient, items, costs and shipments. Pages with offset and limit; paging.total in the response is the number of orders.

params.name: status
params.description: Only orders in this status: draft, inreview, pending, failed, canceled, inprocess, onhold, partial, fulfilled or archived.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of orders to skip, to read the next pages.

params.name: limit
params.description: Orders per page, up to 100.

tools.name: Get order
tools.description: Returns one order with its status, recipient, items, costs and the shipments with carrier and tracking number.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of an order from List orders, or the external_id of the order prefixed with @, such as @1001.

tools.name: Create order
tools.description: Creates an order as a draft and returns it with the costs Printful calculated. Nothing is charged until Confirm order. recipient and items are required, and print files are downloaded from public URLs.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Your own id for the order, unique in the store. The order tools also accept it prefixed with @ in place of the Printful id.

params.name: shipping
params.description: Shipping method: the id of a rate from Calculate shipping rates, such as STANDARD. The default is STANDARD.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Delivery address. country_code is a two-letter ISO code; state_code is required for the US, Canada and Australia, and tax_number for Brazil.

params.name: items
params.description: Items of the order. Each item names the product with one of: variant_id, a blank catalog variant from Get catalog product sent with its print files; sync_variant_id, a variant of a store product from Get store product, whose files are already set; or external_variant_id.

params.name: retail_costs
params.description: Retail amounts printed on the packing slip of international shipments. Used only when every item has retail_price.

params.name: gift
params.description: Gift message printed on the packing slip.

params.name: packing_slip
params.description: Custom packing slip for this order. Give at least one of email, phone, message or custom_order_id.

params.name: update_existing
params.description: When an order with this external_id already exists, updates it instead of failing.

tools.name: Update order
tools.description: Changes an order that was not submitted for fulfillment yet and returns it. Send only the fields that change; sending items replaces the item list. Nothing is charged until Confirm order.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of an order from List orders, or the external_id of the order prefixed with @.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Your own id for the order, unique in the store.

params.name: shipping
params.description: Shipping method: the id of a rate from Calculate shipping rates, such as STANDARD.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Delivery address. country_code is a two-letter ISO code; state_code is required for the US, Canada and Australia, and tax_number for Brazil.

params.name: items
params.description: The new item list. An item with the id of an existing line item from Get order changes it, an existing item left out is removed, and an item without id is added. Each new item names the product with variant_id, sync_variant_id or external_variant_id.

params.name: retail_costs
params.description: Retail amounts printed on the packing slip of international shipments. Used only when every item has retail_price.

params.name: gift
params.description: Gift message printed on the packing slip.

params.name: packing_slip
params.description: Custom packing slip for this order. Give at least one of email, phone, message or custom_order_id.

tools.name: Confirm order
tools.description: Submits a draft order for fulfillment and returns it. Printful charges the billing method of the store owner at this moment; a pending order can still be canceled with Cancel order.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a draft order from List orders, or the external_id of the order prefixed with @.

tools.name: Cancel order
tools.description: Cancels a draft or pending order and returns it. A charged amount goes back to the card of the store owner. Orders in review, in process or already shipped cannot be canceled.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of an order from List orders, or the external_id of the order prefixed with @.

tools.name: Calculate shipping rates
tools.description: Returns the shipping methods for a list of items and a destination, with rate, currency and delivery estimate. The id of a method goes in shipping of Create order and Update order. Call it right before ordering, because rates change.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Destination. Only country_code is required, and state_code for the US, Canada and Australia. More address details return more precise rates.

params.name: items
params.description: Items to ship. Each item names the product with variant_id or external_variant_id.

params.name: currency
params.description: 3-letter currency code of the rates. The default is the store currency.

params.name: locale
params.description: Language of the method names: en_US, the default, or es_ES.

tools.name: List catalog products
tools.description: Lists the blank products of the Printful catalog, such as t-shirts, mugs and posters, with id, title, type, brand and main_category_id. Get catalog product returns the variants of one of them.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Only products of these categories, as comma-separated ids such as 24,25. The category of a product is main_category_id in List catalog products.

tools.name: Get catalog product
tools.description: Returns a catalog product and its variants. Each variant has the id that orders and shipping rates take as variant_id, with size, color, price and stock; the product lists the print file placements (files) and options it accepts.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a product from List catalog products.

tools.name: List store products
tools.description: Lists the products of a store created in Printful for manual orders and the API, with id, external_id, name and how many variants each has. Get store product returns the variants.

params.name: status
params.description: Only products in this group.

params.name: category_id
params.description: Only products of these catalog categories, as comma-separated ids. The category of a catalog product is main_category_id in List catalog products.

tools.name: Get store product
tools.description: Returns a store product and its variants. The id of each variant is the sync_variant_id of Create order, and its variant_id is the catalog variant behind it.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a product from List store products, or the external_id of the product prefixed with @.

tools.name: Get statistics
tools.description: Returns sales, costs and profit statistics of the store for a period of up to 6 months, one entry per report type in result.store_statistics.

params.name: report_types
params.description: Comma-separated report types: sales_and_costs, sales_and_costs_summary, printful_costs, profit, total_paid_orders, costs_by_amount, costs_by_product, costs_by_variant and average_fulfillment_time.

params.name: date_from
params.description: First day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Last day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD, at most 6 months after date_from.

params.name: currency
params.description: 3-letter currency code of the amounts, or display_currency for the display currency of the account. The default is the store currency.

name: Printify
description: Shops, products, orders, catalog and uploaded images of a Printify merchant account.

tools.name: List shops
tools.description: Lists the shops of the account with id, title and sales_channel, such as shopify, etsy or disconnected. The id is the shop_id that every other tool asks for.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Lists the products of a shop with title, description, tags, variants with price in cents, mockup images, blueprint_id, print_provider_id and publishing status. 10 per page by default; current_page and last_page come in the response.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: limit
params.description: Products per page as a number, up to 50.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Returns a product: title, description, tags, options, variants with sku, price and cost in cents, print areas with the images and their position, mockups, is_locked and the links to the sales channel.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Creates a product in a shop from a catalog blueprint, a print provider, the variants to sell with their prices and the uploaded images placed on each print area. A low resolution image is refused with error 8203. The product is not published: use Publish product.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: title
params.description: Name of the product.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the product. HTML is accepted where the sales channel supports it.

params.name: blueprint_id
params.description: Id of the catalog item, from List blueprints or from the blueprint_id of a product in Get product.

params.name: print_provider_id
params.description: Id of the print provider, from List blueprint print providers.

params.name: variants
params.description: Variants of the blueprint to offer, with the selling price.

params.name: print_areas
params.description: The artwork of each group of variants.

tools.name: Update product
tools.description: Changes a product and returns it. Only the fields sent change, but variants must list every variant of the product. Refused while is_locked is true, during a publication. Changes reach the sales channel only after Publish product.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

params.name: title
params.description: Name of the product.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the product. HTML is accepted where the sales channel supports it.

params.name: variants
params.description: Every variant of the product, with price and whether it is on sale.

params.name: print_areas
params.description: The artwork of each group of variants. The list replaces the current print areas.

tools.name: Publish product
tools.description: Sends a product to the sales channel of the shop, such as Shopify or Etsy, and locks it in Printify until the channel confirms; in a shop connected by API, that store has to confirm. Each true field is pushed, false keeps what the channel has. Limited to 200 calls every 30 minutes.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Id of the product, from List products.

params.name: title
params.description: true publishes the title.

params.name: description
params.description: true publishes the description.

params.name: images
params.description: true publishes the mockup images.

params.name: variants
params.description: true publishes the variants and their prices.

params.name: tags
params.description: true publishes the tags.

params.name: keyFeatures
params.description: true publishes the key features.

params.name: shipping_template
params.description: true publishes the shipping template. Only Etsy and Amazon use it.

tools.name: List orders
tools.description: Lists the orders of a shop with status, line items, address, costs in cents and shipments with tracking. 10 per page at most; current_page and last_page come in the response.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: status
params.description: Only orders in this status, such as pending, on-hold, sending-to-production, in-production, fulfilled, partially-fulfilled, canceled, payment-not-received or has-issues.

params.name: sku
params.description: Only orders with at least one product of this SKU.

params.name: limit
params.description: Orders per page as a number, up to 10.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Get order
tools.description: Returns an order: status, line items with their production status, shipping address, costs in cents, shipments with carrier and tracking, and the dates of creation, production and fulfillment.

params.name: shop_id
params.description: Id of the shop, from List shops.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Id of the order, from List orders.

tools.name: List blueprints
tools.description: Lists the whole Printify catalog of blank products, called blueprints, with id, title, brand, model and images, in one long response. Prefer the blueprint_id of an existing product when one fits.

tools.name: List blueprint print providers
tools.description: Lists the print providers that make a blueprint, with id and title. Each one has its own variants, prices and print areas.

params.name: blueprint_id
params.description: Id of the blueprint, from List blueprints or Get product.

tools.name: List blueprint variants
tools.description: Lists the in-stock variants of a blueprint from one print provider: id, title, size and color options, and the placeholders with each print position and its size in pixels.

params.name: blueprint_id
params.description: Id of the blueprint, from List blueprints or Get product.

params.name: print_provider_id
params.description: Id of the print provider, from List blueprint print providers.

tools.name: List uploads
tools.description: Lists the images in the media library of the account with id, file name, size in pixels and preview URL. The id goes in the print areas of Create product and Update product. 10 per page by default.

params.name: limit
params.description: Images per page as a number, up to 100.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

tools.name: Create upload
tools.description: Adds an image to the media library from a public URL, which Printify downloads, and returns it with its id for the print areas of Create product and Update product.

params.name: file_name
params.description: Name of the file, with extension, such as logo.png.

params.name: url
params.description: Public URL of the image.

name: Recharge
description: Subscriptions, customers and charges of a Recharge store.

tools.name: List subscriptions
tools.description: Lists the subscriptions of the store with customer, address, product, quantity, price, frequency, status and next_charge_scheduled_at. Up to 250 per page: pass the next_cursor of the response as cursor to read the next page.

params.name: status
params.description: Only subscriptions in this status.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Only subscriptions of this customer, the id from List customers.

params.name: address_id
params.description: Only subscriptions of this address, from the addresses of Get customer.

params.name: external_variant_id
params.description: Only subscriptions of this product variant: the variant id of the store platform, the value of external_variant_id.ecommerce in List subscriptions.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated ids of subscriptions from List subscriptions.

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Only subscriptions created after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Only subscriptions created before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Only subscriptions updated after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. With status cancelled, it finds recent cancellations.

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Only subscriptions updated before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: limit
params.description: Subscriptions per page, up to 250. The default is 50.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The next_cursor or previous_cursor of the previous response.

tools.name: Get subscription
tools.description: Returns one subscription with product, quantity, price, frequency, status, cancellation reason and next_charge_scheduled_at.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a subscription from List subscriptions.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated related objects to add to the response: address, customer, metafields, charge_activities or bundle_selections.

tools.name: Create subscription
tools.description: Creates a subscription on an address of a customer and returns it. The product needs at least one plan in Recharge. The frequency fields, the first charge date, the variant, the quantity and the address are required.

params.name: address_id
params.description: Id of an address of the customer, from the addresses of Get customer with include addresses, or the address_id of a subscription in List subscriptions.

params.name: external_variant_id
params.description: Product variant in the store platform. The variant id comes from external_variant_id of a subscription in List subscriptions, or from the product page in the store admin.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Number of units in each order.

params.name: next_charge_scheduled_at
params.description: Date of the first charge, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: order_interval_unit
params.description: Unit of the order and charge frequencies.

params.name: order_interval_frequency
params.description: Number of order_interval_unit between orders, such as 1 for a monthly order.

params.name: charge_interval_frequency
params.description: Number of order_interval_unit between charges. Equal to order_interval_frequency when each order is paid on its own; a multiple of it for a prepaid subscription.

params.name: order_day_of_month
params.description: Day of the month the orders are created on, when order_interval_unit is month.

params.name: order_day_of_week
params.description: Day of the week the orders are created on, when order_interval_unit is week.

params.name: expire_after_specific_number_of_charges
params.description: Number of charges after which the subscription expires. Without it, the subscription runs until it is cancelled.

params.name: price
params.description: Price of one unit, such as 10.00.

params.name: product_title
params.description: Name of the product.

params.name: properties
params.description: Line item properties of the subscription, such as a color or an engraving text.

tools.name: Update subscription
tools.description: Changes an active subscription and returns it. Changing order_interval_unit, order_interval_frequency or charge_interval_frequency needs all three, recalculates the next charge date and removes skipped and manually changed charges. To move only the next charge, use Set subscription next charge date.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a subscription from List subscriptions.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Number of units in each order.

params.name: price
params.description: Price of one unit before discounts, taxes and shipping, such as 10.00.

params.name: external_variant_id
params.description: New product variant in the store platform, to swap the product. The variant id comes from external_variant_id of a subscription in List subscriptions, or from the product page in the store admin.

params.name: use_external_variant_defaults
params.description: With a new external_variant_id, takes the price from that variant.

params.name: product_title
params.description: Name of the product.

params.name: variant_title
params.description: Name of the product variant.

params.name: sku
params.description: SKU used for the charges and orders of this subscription in place of the SKU of the variant.

params.name: order_interval_unit
params.description: Unit of the order and charge frequencies. Send it with order_interval_frequency and charge_interval_frequency.

params.name: order_interval_frequency
params.description: Number of order_interval_unit between orders.

params.name: charge_interval_frequency
params.description: Number of order_interval_unit between charges.

params.name: order_day_of_month
params.description: Day of the month the orders are created on. Removes skipped and manually changed charges.

params.name: order_day_of_week
params.description: Day of the week the orders are created on. Removes skipped and manually changed charges.

params.name: expire_after_specific_number_of_charges
params.description: Number of charges after which the subscription expires.

params.name: properties
params.description: Line item properties of the subscription, such as a color or an engraving text. The list replaces the current one.

params.name: commit
params.description: True waits until the queued charges of the subscription are regenerated before answering. The default is false, which regenerates them a few seconds later.

params.name: force_update
params.description: True also applies the change to a cancelled subscription.

tools.name: Cancel subscription
tools.description: Cancels an active subscription and returns it. Recharge may email the customer and the store owner about it, unless send_email is false.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of an active subscription from List subscriptions.

params.name: cancellation_reason
params.description: Reason for the cancellation.

params.name: cancellation_reason_comments
params.description: Comment on the reason.

params.name: send_email
params.description: False keeps Recharge from sending the cancellation email.

tools.name: Activate subscription
tools.description: Reactivates a cancelled subscription and returns it, clearing the cancellation date and reason.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a cancelled subscription from List subscriptions.

tools.name: Set subscription next charge date
tools.description: Moves the next charge of a subscription to another date and returns the subscription. When two active subscriptions of the same address end up on the same date, their charges are merged into a new charge with a new id.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a subscription from List subscriptions.

params.name: date
params.description: New date of the next charge, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: List customers
tools.description: Lists the customers of the store with email, name, the count of active subscriptions and whether the payment method is valid or in dunning. Filter by email to find one customer. Up to 250 per page: pass the next_cursor of the response as cursor.

params.name: email
params.description: Only the customer with this email address.

params.name: external_customer_id
params.description: Only the customer with this id in the store platform, the value of external_customer_id.ecommerce shown in Get customer.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated ids of customers from List customers.

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Only customers created after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Only customers created before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Only customers updated after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Only customers updated before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: limit
params.description: Customers per page, up to 250. The default is 50.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The next_cursor or previous_cursor of the previous response.

tools.name: Get customer
tools.description: Returns one customer. With include, the response also brings the addresses, subscriptions or payment methods of the customer; the id of each address is the address_id that Create subscription takes.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a customer from List customers, or the customer_id of a subscription or charge.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated related objects to add to the response: addresses, subscriptions, payment_methods or metafields.

tools.name: List charges
tools.description: Lists the charges of the store, past and upcoming, with status, scheduled_at, processed_at, totals, customer and line items. Processed charges older than 90 days are not returned. Sorted by id ascending by default; up to 250 per page: pass the next_cursor of the response as cursor.

params.name: status
params.description: Only charges in these statuses, comma-separated: success, queued, error, refunded, partially_refunded, skipped, pending_manual_payment or pending.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Only charges of this customer, the id from List customers.

params.name: address_id
params.description: Only charges of this address, from the addresses of Get customer.

params.name: purchase_item_id
params.description: Only charges of this subscription, the id from List subscriptions.

params.name: external_order_id
params.description: Only the charge of this order of the store platform, the value of external_order_id.ecommerce shown in Get charge.

params.name: discount_code
params.description: Only charges with this discount code.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated ids of charges from List charges.

params.name: scheduled_at_min
params.description: Only charges scheduled after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: scheduled_at_max
params.description: Only charges scheduled before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: processed_at_min
params.description: Only charges processed on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 90 days.

params.name: processed_at_max
params.description: Only charges processed on or before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Order of the results. The default is id-asc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Charges per page, up to 250. The default is 50.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The next_cursor or previous_cursor of the previous response.

tools.name: Get charge
tools.description: Returns one charge with status, dates, totals, discounts, shipping and the line items, whose purchase_item_id is the subscription. A processed charge older than 90 days returns an error.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a charge from List charges.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated related objects to add to the response: customer, metafields, payment_methods or charge_activities.

tools.name: Skip charge
tools.description: Skips a queued charge for the given subscriptions and returns the charge.

params.name: id
params.description: Id of a queued charge from List charges.

params.name: purchase_item_ids
params.description: Ids of the subscriptions to skip in this charge, from purchase_item_id in the line items of Get charge.
