name: SE Ranking
description: SEO projects of an SE Ranking account: keyword rankings, competitors, site audits and backlinks.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects of the account, each a tracked website, with the id that the other tools ask for as site_id, its title, URL, keyword_count, check frequency and the guest_link to share the rankings without signing in.

tools.name: Get project summary
tools.description: Returns the summary of a project: the average position of the last two checks, how many positions went up and down, keywords in the top 5, 10 and 30, visibility, Domain Authority and pages indexed in Google.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: List project search engines
tools.description: Lists the search engines a project tracks, each with the site_engine_id that the ranking tools take, its region, language and keyword_count.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: List keywords
tools.description: Lists the keywords a project tracks, with id, name (the keyword text), target link, group and the site_engine_ids it is tracked in. The ranking tools return only the keyword id, so this is where the text comes from.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: site_engine_id
params.description: Search engine of the project, from List project search engines. With it, each keyword also brings its first_check_date.

tools.name: Get keyword positions
tools.description: Returns the positions of the keywords of a project on each check date of a period, grouped by search engine, with the change, search volume and competition of each keyword. Keywords come by id: the text is in List keywords.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: site_engine_id
params.description: Only this search engine of the project, from List project search engines. All of them by default.

params.name: date_from
params.description: First day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is one week ago.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Last day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today.

params.name: in_top
params.description: Only the keywords ranking in this top at the last check of the period, like 10.

params.name: with_landing_pages
params.description: 1 adds the page of the site that ranked for each keyword on each date.

params.name: with_serp_features
params.description: 1 adds the Google SERP features found for each keyword.

tools.name: Get ranking history
tools.description: Returns a time series of one ranking metric of a project per check date: one series per search engine and one with the average of all of them. value comes sometimes as text and sometimes as a number.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: type
params.description: Metric of the series. The default is avg_pos, the average position.

params.name: site_engine_id
params.description: Only this search engine of the project, from List project search engines, without the average series.

params.name: date_from
params.description: First day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is one week ago.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Last day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today.

tools.name: List competitors
tools.description: Lists the competitors added to a project, with the id that Get competitor positions asks for, their name, URL and Domain Trust.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: Get competitor positions
tools.description: Returns the positions of a competitor for the keywords of the project on each check date of a period, grouped by search engine, with the keyword name and search volume.

params.name: competitor_id
params.description: Id of the competitor, from List competitors.

params.name: with_serp_features
params.description: 1 adds the Google SERP features found for each keyword.

params.name: site_engine_id
params.description: Only this search engine of the project, from List project search engines. All of them by default.

params.name: date_from
params.description: First day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is one week ago.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Last day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today.

tools.name: List audits
tools.description: Lists the website audits of the account, with id, url, title, status (like processing or finished), last_update and the latest stats, and total as the number found. The last page is when offset plus limit reaches total.

params.name: search
params.description: Only the audits whose title or URL match this text.

params.name: date_start
params.description: Only audits from this day on, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: date_end
params.description: Only audits up to this day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: limit
params.description: Audits per page. The default is 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: How many audits to skip, for the next pages.

tools.name: Create audit
tools.description: Starts a website audit of a domain and returns its id; Get audit report shows is_finished when it ends. It uses the audit limits of the plan, and by default SE Ranking e-mails the report to the account owner at the end, unless settings.send_report is 0.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to audit, like example.com.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the audit report. The default is the domain.

params.name: settings
params.description: Crawl settings to override; the ones left out keep their defaults.

tools.name: Get audit report
tools.description: Returns the report of an audit: is_finished, the health score in score_percent, the pages crawled, the counts of errors, warnings and notices, the domain properties and each section of checks with the pages affected.

params.name: audit_id
params.description: Id of the audit, from List audits or Create audit.

tools.name: Get backlink stats
tools.description: Returns the totals of the backlinks monitored in a project: backlinks, unique anchors, IPs and domains, dofollow and nofollow, and how many backlinks can still be added today.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

name: Segment
description: Sources, destinations, warehouses and event volume of a Segment workspace in the US region, read through the Public API.

tools.name: List sources
tools.description: Lists the sources of the workspace with id, name, slug, enabled, metadata and labels. Returns the first 200, because the connection does not send pagination; pagination.totalEntries tells whether there are more.

tools.name: Get source
tools.description: Returns one source with its settings, write keys, metadata and labels.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: Id of the source, from List sources.

tools.name: List connected destinations
tools.description: Lists the destinations that receive data from one source, with id, name, enabled and metadata. Returns the first 200, because the connection does not send pagination.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: Id of the source, from List sources.

tools.name: List connected warehouses
tools.description: Lists the warehouses that receive data from one source. Returns the first 200, because the connection does not send pagination.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: Id of the source, from List sources.

tools.name: List destinations
tools.description: Lists the destinations of the workspace with id, name, enabled, metadata and the sourceId each one belongs to. Returns the first 200, because the connection does not send pagination; pagination.totalEntries tells whether there are more.

tools.name: Get destination
tools.description: Returns one destination with its settings, metadata and the sourceId it belongs to.

params.name: destinationId
params.description: Id of the destination, from List destinations or List connected destinations.

tools.name: Get delivery metrics
tools.description: Returns the delivery metrics of one destination for the events of one source in a period, each metric with its total and breakdown. Without dates, it covers the last hour by minute.

params.name: destinationId
params.description: Id of the destination, from List destinations or List connected destinations.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: Id of the source linked to the destination: the sourceId that Get destination returns.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start of the period, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. The default is 1 hour ago with MINUTE, 7 days with HOUR and 30 days with DAY.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End of the period. The default is now.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Size of each bucket. The default is MINUTE.

tools.name: List warehouses
tools.description: Lists the warehouses of the workspace with id, enabled, metadata and settings. Returns the first 200, because the connection does not send pagination; pagination.totalEntries tells whether there are more.

tools.name: Get warehouse
tools.description: Returns one warehouse with its settings and metadata.

params.name: warehouseId
params.description: Id of the warehouse, from List warehouses or List connected warehouses.

tools.name: List warehouse syncs
tools.description: Lists the latest syncs of one warehouse, with status and duration, to check whether the data is arriving. Returns the first 200, because the connection does not send pagination.

params.name: warehouseId
params.description: Id of the warehouse, from List warehouses or List connected warehouses.

tools.name: Get events volume
tools.description: Returns how many events the workspace received per bucket in a period, optionally grouped and filtered by source, event name and event type.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Size of each bucket.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start of the period, inclusive, as ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End of the period, exclusive, as ISO 8601. Segment recommends staying 1 minute behind the clock.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: Dimensions to group the counts by.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: Only these sources, by id, from List sources.

params.name: eventName
params.description: Only these event names.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Only these event types, such as track, identify or page.

name: Sentry
description: Projects, issues and error events of the Sentry organizations a token reaches.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists the organizations the token reaches in this data storage location, each with id, slug and name. The slug is the organization_id_or_slug the other tools ask for. Returns up to 100.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter in Sentry search syntax, such as slug:acme or name:Acme.

params.name: owner
params.description: Set to true to return only the organizations the user owns.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Organizations to return, up to 100.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects of an organization, each with id, slug, name and platform. The slug is the project_id_or_slug the project tools ask for. Returns up to 100; narrow with query.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: query
params.description: Returns only the projects whose name or slug matches this text.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Projects to return, up to 100.

tools.name: Get project
tools.description: Returns one project with its name, platform, teams, status and settings.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: project_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: List issues
tools.description: Lists the issues of an organization, by default the unresolved ones ordered by last seen. Each issue has id, shortId, title, status, level, count of events, count of users, first and last seen and project. Returns up to 100; narrow with query, project and statsPeriod.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: query
params.description: Search in Sentry syntax, such as is:unresolved level:error firstSeen:-24h. Defaults to is:unresolved; send an empty text for every issue.

params.name: project
params.description: Ids or slugs of the projects to keep, from List projects. Omit it for every project the token reaches.

params.name: environment
params.description: Names of the environments to keep, such as production.

params.name: statsPeriod
params.description: Relative period, such as 24h, 14d or 2w. It overrides start and end.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the period, in ISO 8601.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the period, in ISO 8601.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order: date is last seen, new is first seen, freq is events, user is users affected. Defaults to date.

params.name: shortIdLookup
params.description: Set to 1 to find an issue by the short id shown in Sentry, such as PROJECT-1A2, sent in query. The other filters are then ignored.

params.name: limit
params.description: Issues to return, up to 100.

tools.name: Get issue
tools.description: Returns one issue with its title, culprit, status, level, assignee, counts, first and last seen, release and top tags.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: issue_id
params.description: Id of the issue, the numeric id from List issues, not the short id.

params.name: environment
params.description: Names of the environments the counts consider.

tools.name: Update issue
tools.description: Resolves, archives, reopens, assigns or reprioritizes an issue. Only the fields sent change. To archive, send status ignored with a substatus, and the condition in statusDetails when it is archived_until_condition_met.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: issue_id
params.description: Id of the issue, the numeric id from List issues.

params.name: status
params.description: New status. ignored is shown as archived in Sentry.

params.name: substatus
params.description: With status ignored, how the issue stays archived: until it escalates, until the condition in statusDetails is met, or forever.

params.name: statusDetails
params.description: Details of the resolution or of the archive condition.

params.name: assignedTo
params.description: User to assign, by email or username, or a team as team: followed by the team id from Get project.

params.name: priority
params.description: New priority.

params.name: hasSeen
params.description: True marks the issue as seen by the user of the token.

params.name: inbox
params.description: True marks the issue as reviewed by the user of the token.

params.name: isBookmarked
params.description: True bookmarks the issue for the user of the token.

params.name: isSubscribed
params.description: True subscribes the user of the token to the issue.

tools.name: List issue events
tools.description: Lists the events of an issue, 100 per page. With full true each event brings the stack trace, and the page drops to 10.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: issue_id
params.description: Id of the issue, the numeric id from List issues.

params.name: query
params.description: Search in Sentry syntax over the events, such as browser.name:Chrome.

params.name: environment
params.description: Names of the environments to keep.

params.name: statsPeriod
params.description: Relative period, such as 24h or 14d. It overrides start and end.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the period, in ISO 8601.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the period, in ISO 8601.

params.name: full
params.description: True to include the full body of each event, with the stack trace.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Events per page, up to 100.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Page cursor as 0:offset:0, for example 0:100:0 for the second page of 100.

tools.name: Get issue event
tools.description: Returns one event of an issue with the stack trace, tags, context, breadcrumbs and request. Use latest, oldest or recommended as event_id when you have no event id.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: issue_id
params.description: Id of the issue, the numeric id from List issues.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event, from List issue events, or latest, oldest or recommended.

params.name: environment
params.description: Names of the environments to pick latest, oldest or recommended from.

params.name: llmFormat
params.description: Adds a formatted field with the event rendered in this format, made for reading by an AI agent.

tools.name: Get issue tag
tools.description: Returns the top values of one tag across the events of an issue, with the count of each, such as the browsers or releases affected.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: issue_id
params.description: Id of the issue, the numeric id from List issues.

params.name: key
params.description: Tag key, such as browser, os, release, environment or url. Get issue lists the tags of the issue.

params.name: environment
params.description: Names of the environments to count.

tools.name: List project events
tools.description: Lists the error events of a project, 100 per page. With full true each event brings the stack trace, and the page drops to 10.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: project_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: statsPeriod
params.description: Relative period, such as 24h or 14d. It overrides start and end.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the period, in ISO 8601.

params.name: end
params.description: End of the period, in ISO 8601.

params.name: full
params.description: True to include the full body of each event, with the stack trace.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Page cursor as 0:offset:0, for example 0:100:0 for the second page of 100.

tools.name: Get project event
tools.description: Returns one event of a project by its id, with the issue it belongs to, the stack trace, tags and context.

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: project_id_or_slug
params.description: Slug or id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Id of the event, the 32-character hexadecimal from List project events or from the event page in Sentry.

name: SharePoint
description: Sites, lists and list items of the SharePoint of a Microsoft 365 organization.

tools.name: Search sites
tools.description: Searches the SharePoint sites of the organization by keyword and returns id, displayName, name, webUrl and description. Use the id as site_id. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: search
params.description: Keywords matched against several properties of the sites, such as the name and the description.

tools.name: Get site
tools.description: Returns one site with id, displayName, name, description, webUrl and createdDateTime.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

tools.name: List lists
tools.description: Lists the lists and document libraries of a site, with id, name, displayName, webUrl and list.template, which is genericList for a list and documentLibrary for a library. Hidden system lists are left out. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

tools.name: List columns
tools.description: Lists the columns of a list with name, displayName, required, readOnly and the facet of its type, such as text, number, dateTime, boolean or choice with the allowed choices. The name, not the displayName, is the key of a column in fields.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

params.name: list_id
params.description: List id from List lists.

tools.name: List items
tools.description: Lists the items of a list with id, webUrl, createdBy and lastModifiedDateTime, plus the column values in fields when expand is fields. In a document library each item is a file or folder. Only the first page comes back.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

params.name: list_id
params.description: List id from List lists.

params.name: expand
params.description: Send fields to get the column values, which are left out otherwise. fields(select=Title,Status) brings only those columns, by their name from List columns.

tools.name: Get item
tools.description: Returns one item of a list with id, webUrl, createdBy and lastModifiedDateTime, plus the column values in fields when expand is fields.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

params.name: list_id
params.description: List id from List lists.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Item id from List items.

params.name: expand
params.description: Send fields to get the column values, which are left out otherwise. fields(select=Title,Status) brings only those columns, by their name from List columns.

tools.name: Create item
tools.description: Creates an item in a list and returns it with its id and the values saved. Every required column of List columns must be in fields.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

params.name: list_id
params.description: List id from List lists.

params.name: fields
params.description: Column values keyed by the column name from List columns, such as Title, a number for a number column and an ISO 8601 date for a dateTime column.

tools.name: Delete item
tools.description: Deletes an item from a list.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Site id from Search sites, in the form hostname,guid,guid, or root for the root site of the organization.

params.name: list_id
params.description: List id from List lists.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Item id from List items.

name: Slack
description: Channels, messages and members of a Slack workspace, through the bot of the app installed in it.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: Lists the channels of the workspace: all public channels and the private channels the app was added to. The id of a channel is the channel argument of the other tools, and is_member tells whether the app is in it. The response has channels and response_metadata.next_cursor: pass it as cursor to read the next page.

params.name: types
params.description: Comma-separated channel types: public_channel, private_channel, or public_channel,private_channel. The default is public_channel.

params.name: exclude_archived
params.description: true leaves out the archived channels.

params.name: limit
params.description: Channels per page, under 1000. The default is 100. Filters apply after the page is read, so a page can come back short or empty before the last one.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The response_metadata.next_cursor of the previous response.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Creates a public or private channel with the app as a member and returns it with its id. Add people to it with Invite members to conversation.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the channel: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only, up to 80 characters.

params.name: is_private
params.description: true creates a private channel. The default is a public one.

tools.name: Join conversation
tools.description: Adds the app to a public channel and returns the channel. The app must be a member to read the messages of a channel or post in it. A private channel cannot be joined this way: a member adds the app to it in Slack.

params.name: channel
params.description: Id of a public channel, from List conversations.

tools.name: Invite members to conversation
tools.description: Invites members of the workspace to a channel the app is in. If one of the ids fails, nobody is invited unless force is true.

params.name: channel
params.description: Id of the channel, from List conversations or Create conversation.

params.name: users
params.description: Comma-separated ids of the users to invite, up to 1000, from List users or Get user by email.

params.name: force
params.description: true invites the valid ids and skips the ones that fail.

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of a channel the app is a member of, newest first. Thread replies are not included: read them with List thread replies. The response has messages, has_more and response_metadata.next_cursor: pass it as cursor to read the next page. An app installed from outside the Slack Marketplace can be held to 15 messages per call and one call per minute.

params.name: channel
params.description: Id of the channel, from List conversations.

params.name: oldest
params.description: Only messages after this moment, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, like 1735700000 or the ts of a message.

params.name: latest
params.description: Only messages before this moment, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, like 1735700000 or the ts of a message. The default is now.

params.name: inclusive
params.description: true includes the messages whose ts equals oldest or latest.

params.name: limit
params.description: Messages per page, up to 999. The default is 100, and Slack recommends no more than 200.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The response_metadata.next_cursor of the previous response.

tools.name: List thread replies
tools.description: Lists a thread of a channel the app is a member of: the parent message followed by its replies. The response has messages, has_more and response_metadata.next_cursor: pass it as cursor to read the next page. An app installed from outside the Slack Marketplace can be held to 15 messages per call and one call per minute.

params.name: channel
params.description: Id of the channel, from List conversations.

params.name: ts
params.description: The ts of the parent message, from List messages. A message without replies comes back alone.

params.name: oldest
params.description: Only replies after this moment, as a Unix timestamp in seconds or the ts of a message.

params.name: latest
params.description: Only replies before this moment, as a Unix timestamp in seconds or the ts of a message.

params.name: inclusive
params.description: true includes the messages whose ts equals oldest or latest.

params.name: limit
params.description: Messages per page. The default is 1000.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The response_metadata.next_cursor of the previous response.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Posts a message as the app's bot and returns it with channel and ts, the pair Update message and Delete message ask for. Send text, markdown_text or blocks. The app must be a member of the channel: call Join conversation first for a public one.

params.name: channel
params.description: Id of a channel from List conversations, or the id of a user from List users or Get user by email to message that person directly from the app.

params.name: text
params.description: Text of the message, plain or in Slack mrkdwn, ideally under 4000 characters. With blocks it is only the notification fallback.

params.name: markdown_text
params.description: The message in standard Markdown, up to 12000 characters. Do not send it together with text or blocks.

params.name: blocks
params.description: Block Kit layout blocks of the message, each with its type, such as section or divider. Send text too, as the notification fallback.

params.name: thread_ts
params.description: The ts of a parent message, from List messages, to post this message as a reply in its thread.

params.name: reply_broadcast
params.description: With thread_ts, true also shows the reply in the channel.

params.name: unfurl_links
params.description: true shows a preview of text-based links.

params.name: unfurl_media
params.description: false hides the preview of media links.

tools.name: Schedule message
tools.description: Schedules a message from the app's bot for a moment up to 120 days ahead and returns its scheduled_message_id. Send text, markdown_text or blocks. The app must be a member of the channel, and a channel takes at most 30 scheduled messages within the same 5 minutes.

params.name: channel
params.description: Id of a channel from List conversations, or the id of a user from List users or Get user by email to message that person directly from the app.

params.name: post_at
params.description: When the message is posted, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, up to 120 days ahead.

params.name: text
params.description: Text of the message, plain or in Slack mrkdwn, ideally under 4000 characters. With blocks it is only the notification fallback.

params.name: markdown_text
params.description: The message in standard Markdown, up to 12000 characters. Do not send it together with text or blocks.

params.name: blocks
params.description: Block Kit layout blocks of the message, each with its type, such as section or divider. Send text too, as the notification fallback.

params.name: thread_ts
params.description: The ts of a parent message, from List messages, to post this message as a reply in its thread.

params.name: reply_broadcast
params.description: With thread_ts, true also shows the reply in the channel.

params.name: unfurl_links
params.description: true shows a preview of text-based links.

params.name: unfurl_media
params.description: false hides the preview of media links.

tools.name: Update message
tools.description: Edits a message the app's bot posted and returns it. Sending text without blocks replaces the blocks of the message with that text; leaving text out keeps them.

params.name: channel
params.description: The channel of the message, as Send message returned it. For a direct message it is the conversation id that starts with D, not the user id.

params.name: ts
params.description: The ts of the message, from Send message or List messages.

params.name: text
params.description: New text of the message, plain or in Slack mrkdwn. With blocks it is only the notification fallback.

params.name: markdown_text
params.description: The new message in standard Markdown, up to 12000 characters. Do not send it together with text or blocks.

params.name: blocks
params.description: New Block Kit layout blocks of the message, each with its type, such as section or divider. An empty array removes the blocks.

tools.name: Delete message
tools.description: Deletes a message the app's bot posted. Messages of people cannot be deleted with this connection.

params.name: channel
params.description: The channel of the message, as Send message returned it.

params.name: ts
params.description: The ts of the message, from Send message or List messages.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Lists the members of the workspace with id, name, real_name and profile.email, including bots (is_bot) and deactivated members (deleted). The response has members and response_metadata.next_cursor: pass it as cursor to read the next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Members per page, for example 200. Without it Slack tries to return everyone at once, which fails on large workspaces.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The response_metadata.next_cursor of the previous response.

params.name: include_locale
params.description: true adds the locale of each member.

tools.name: Get user by email
tools.description: Returns the member of the workspace who has this email address, with their id, to mention, invite or message them.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the member.

name: Stripe
description: Customers, charges, subscriptions and invoices of a Stripe account.

tools.name: Search customers
tools.description: Searches the customers with the Stripe search query language, by email, name, phone, creation date or metadata. The response has data, has_more and next_page; send next_page as page to get the next page. A customer created or updated in the last minute may not show up yet.

params.name: query
params.description: Up to 10 clauses joined by AND or by OR, never both, for example email:"ana@example.com" or name~"silva". Fields: email, name and phone (a colon matches exactly, a tilde matches part of the text, with at least 3 characters), metadata["key"]:"value", and created (Unix seconds), which also takes a greater-than or less-than sign, optionally followed by an equals sign, in place of the colon. Text values go in double quotes, and a leading - negates a clause.

params.name: limit
params.description: Customers per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description: The next_page value of the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: Get customer
tools.description: Returns one customer, with name, email, phone, address, balance in cents and invoice settings. A deleted customer comes back with only id and deleted set to true.

params.name: customer
params.description: Id of the customer, starting with cus_, from Search customers or from the customer field of a charge, subscription or invoice returned by Search charges, List subscriptions or Search invoices.

tools.name: Create customer
tools.description: Creates a customer. No field is required, but Stripe sends invoices and receipts only to customers with an email. Address, tax ids and metadata are not available here.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name or business name of the customer.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the customer, where Stripe sends invoices and receipts.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the customer, with the country code, for example +5511999999999.

params.name: description
params.description: Internal note shown next to the customer in the Dashboard.

tools.name: Update customer
tools.description: Updates the name, email, phone or description of a customer. Fields not sent stay as they are.

params.name: customer
params.description: Id of the customer, starting with cus_, from Search customers or Create customer.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name or business name of the customer.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the customer, where Stripe sends invoices and receipts.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number of the customer, with the country code, for example +5511999999999.

params.name: description
params.description: Internal note shown next to the customer in the Dashboard.

tools.name: Search charges
tools.description: Searches the charges, which are the payment attempts with their status, amount, refunds and disputes, with the Stripe search query language. Amounts are in the smallest unit of the currency, like cents. The response has data, has_more and next_page; send next_page as page to get the next page.

params.name: query
params.description: Up to 10 clauses joined by AND or by OR, never both, for example status:"succeeded" AND currency:"brl". Fields: status (succeeded, pending, failed), currency, customer (cus_ id), refunded and disputed ("true" or "false"), payment_method_details.card.last4, metadata["key"]:"value", and created (Unix seconds) and amount (cents), which also take a greater-than or less-than sign, optionally followed by an equals sign, in place of the colon. Text values go in double quotes.

params.name: limit
params.description: Charges per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description: The next_page value of the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: List subscriptions
tools.description: Lists the subscriptions, newest first, optionally of one customer, one price or one status. Without status, canceled subscriptions are left out. Each subscription has its prices in items.data. Page with starting_after while has_more is true.

params.name: customer
params.description: Only the subscriptions of this customer, the cus_ id from Search customers.

params.name: price
params.description: Only the subscriptions with this price, the price_ id in items.data.price.id of a subscription returned by List subscriptions or Search subscriptions.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the subscriptions in this status. all includes the canceled ones, and ended means canceled or incomplete_expired.

params.name: limit
params.description: Subscriptions per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Id of the last subscription of the previous page, to get the next page.

tools.name: Search subscriptions
tools.description: Searches the subscriptions by status, creation date, cancellation date or metadata with the Stripe search query language, which fits questions like new or canceled subscriptions in a period. The response has data, has_more and next_page; send next_page as page to get the next page.

params.name: query
params.description: Up to 10 clauses joined by AND or by OR, never both, for example status:"canceled". Fields: status (active, canceled, incomplete, incomplete_expired, past_due, paused, trialing, unpaid), metadata["key"]:"value", and created and canceled_at (Unix seconds), which also take a greater-than or less-than sign, optionally followed by an equals sign, in place of the colon. There is no customer field: use List subscriptions for one customer. Text values go in double quotes.

params.name: limit
params.description: Subscriptions per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description: The next_page value of the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: Update subscription
tools.description: Updates a subscription, for example to cancel it at the end of the current period with cancel_at_period_end, or to undo that. Changing the items or prices of the subscription is not available here.

params.name: subscription
params.description: Id of the subscription, starting with sub_, from List subscriptions or Search subscriptions.

params.name: cancel_at_period_end
params.description: true cancels the subscription at the end of the current period, and false undoes a cancellation scheduled this way.

params.name: cancel_at
params.description: Unix timestamp, in seconds, at which the subscription is canceled. A date before the end of the current period prorates according to proration_behavior.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the subscription, shown to the customer.

params.name: trial_end
params.description: End of the trial, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, or now to end the trial right away.

params.name: collection_method
params.description: charge_automatically charges the default payment method of the customer; send_invoice emails each invoice with payment instructions and needs days_until_due.

params.name: days_until_due
params.description: Days the customer has to pay each invoice. Only with collection_method send_invoice.

params.name: proration_behavior
params.description: How a change that affects the billing is prorated: create_prorations (the default) adds the proration to the next invoice, always_invoice invoices it right away and none skips it.

tools.name: Search invoices
tools.description: Searches the invoices by customer, subscription, status, date, total or number with the Stripe search query language. Amounts are in the smallest unit of the currency, like cents. The response has data, has_more and next_page; send next_page as page to get the next page.

params.name: query
params.description: Up to 10 clauses joined by AND or by OR, never both, for example customer:"cus_123" AND status:"open". Fields: status (draft, open, paid, uncollectible, void), customer (cus_ id), subscription (sub_ id), currency, number, receipt_number, metadata["key"]:"value", and created (Unix seconds) and total (cents), which also take a greater-than or less-than sign, optionally followed by an equals sign, in place of the colon. Text values go in double quotes.

params.name: limit
params.description: Invoices per page, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

params.name: page
params.description: The next_page value of the previous response, to get the next page.

tools.name: Create invoice
tools.description: Creates a draft invoice for a customer. Add the lines with Create invoice item, then email it with Send invoice. With collection_method send_invoice, send days_until_due or due_date.

params.name: customer
params.description: Id of the customer to bill, starting with cus_, from Search customers or Create customer.

params.name: collection_method
params.description: send_invoice emails the invoice with payment instructions; charge_automatically, the default, charges the default payment method of the customer.

params.name: days_until_due
params.description: Days from creation until the invoice is due. Only with collection_method send_invoice.

params.name: due_date
params.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp in seconds, instead of days_until_due. Only with collection_method send_invoice.

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter currency code in lowercase, for example brl. The default is the currency of the customer.

params.name: description
params.description: Memo shown on the invoice.

params.name: footer
params.description: Footer shown on the invoice.

params.name: auto_advance
params.description: true lets Stripe finalize and collect the invoice on its own, about an hour after creation. The default is false, and the invoice stays a draft until Send invoice.

params.name: pending_invoice_items_behavior
params.description: include adds to the new invoice the invoice items of the customer not yet on any invoice. The default is exclude.

tools.name: Create invoice item
tools.description: Adds a line to a draft invoice, with a description and an amount in the smallest unit of the currency, like cents. Send amount, or unit_amount_decimal with quantity. Without invoice, the line waits for the next invoice of the customer.

params.name: customer
params.description: Id of the customer billed, starting with cus_, the same as the invoice, from Search customers or Create customer.

params.name: invoice
params.description: Id of the draft invoice, starting with in_, from Create invoice or Search invoices.

params.name: description
params.description: Text of the line, shown on the invoice.

params.name: amount
params.description: Total of the line in the smallest unit of the currency, for example 15000 for BRL 150.00. A negative amount lowers the invoice total.

params.name: unit_amount_decimal
params.description: Price of one unit in the smallest unit of the currency, as a decimal string like 1500.5, multiplied by quantity. Use it instead of amount.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Number of units, with unit_amount_decimal. The default is 1.

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter currency code in lowercase, for example brl. It must match the currency of the invoice.

tools.name: Send invoice
tools.description: Finalizes a draft invoice and emails it to the customer with payment instructions. A finalized invoice can no longer change its amounts. In a sandbox no email goes out.

params.name: invoice
params.description: Id of the invoice, starting with in_, from Create invoice or Search invoices. Its collection_method must be send_invoice.

name: Supabase
description: Organizations, projects, Edge Functions and secrets of a Supabase account, through the Management API.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: Lists the organizations the token reaches, each with id, slug and name. The slug is what the organization tools ask for.

tools.name: Get organization
tools.description: Returns one organization with its name and plan: free, pro, team, enterprise or platform.

params.name: slug
params.description: Slug of the organization, from List organizations.

tools.name: List organization members
tools.description: Lists the members of an organization, each with user name, email, role and whether MFA is on.

params.name: slug
params.description: Slug of the organization, from List organizations.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects of an organization, each with its ref, name, region and status. The ref is what the project tools ask for. Page with limit and offset; pagination.count is the total.

params.name: slug
params.description: Slug of the organization, from List organizations.

params.name: search
params.description: Returns only the projects whose name matches this text.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Comma-separated statuses to keep: ACTIVE_HEALTHY, INACTIVE or both. INACTIVE is a paused project.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the results. Defaults to name_asc.

params.name: limit
params.description: Projects per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of projects to skip.

tools.name: Get project
tools.description: Returns one project with its name, organization, region, creation date, status and database host and version.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the project, from List projects. It is also the subdomain in the project URL, ref.supabase.co.

tools.name: Update project
tools.description: Renames a project. The name is the only field this call changes.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the project, from List projects.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the project.

tools.name: Pause project
tools.description: Pauses a project, which takes its database, APIs and functions offline until Restore project. Only projects of free plan organizations can be paused. Paused projects do not count toward the limit of two free projects.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: Restore project
tools.description: Brings a paused project back with its data and settings. A project can be restored for up to a year after it was paused, and on a free plan it counts again toward the limit of two active free projects.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the paused project, from List projects with statuses INACTIVE.

tools.name: Get project health
tools.description: Returns the health of the services of a project, each with healthy, status and the error when there is one.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the project, from List projects.

params.name: services
params.description: Comma-separated services to check, from auth, db, db_postgres_user, pooler, realtime, rest, storage and pg_bouncer. For example auth,db,rest,storage.

params.name: timeout_ms
params.description: How long to wait for each check, in milliseconds, up to 10000.

tools.name: List functions
tools.description: Lists the Edge Functions of a project, each with slug, name, status, version and whether it verifies the JWT of the caller.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: List secrets
tools.description: Lists the secrets that the Edge Functions of a project read as environment variables, each with name and update time. The value field is a digest, never the secret itself.

params.name: ref
params.description: Ref of the project, from List projects.

tools.name: Create form
tools.description: Creates a form from its blocks and returns its id, name, workspace and status. The form goes to the default workspace unless workspaceId is sent.

params.name: status
params.description: PUBLISHED puts the form live, DRAFT keeps the changes unpublished. Deleting is not done here.

params.name: blocks
params.description: Blocks of the form, in order. A question is a TITLE block with groupType QUESTION and the question in payload.html, followed by its input block, like INPUT_TEXT, INPUT_EMAIL or TEXTAREA, whose groupType repeats the type. The form title is a FORM_TITLE block with groupType TEXT and the title in payload.html.

params.description: Workspace of the form: an id from List workspaces.

params.description: Form settings. Other Tally settings, like the respondent email and the data retention, also go here.

tools.name: Update form
tools.description: Changes the name, status, settings or blocks of a form. Sending blocks replaces all of them, so read the form with Get form first; name, status and settings can go alone.

params.description: Id of the form, from List forms or from the form URL: wA0Bc1 in https://tally.so/r/wA0Bc1.

params.description: New name of the form.

params.name: status
params.description: PUBLISHED puts the form live, DRAFT keeps the changes unpublished. Deleting is not done here.

params.name: blocks
params.description: Every block of the form, in order: this list replaces the current blocks, so send all of them, the existing ones with the uuid and groupUuid from Get form, and a block left out is removed. A question is a TITLE block with groupType QUESTION and the question in payload.html, followed by its input block, like INPUT_TEXT, INPUT_EMAIL or TEXTAREA, whose groupType repeats the type. The form title is a FORM_TITLE block with groupType TEXT and the title in payload.html.

params.name: settings
params.description: Form settings. Other Tally settings, like the respondent email and the data retention, also go here.

name: Toggl Track
description: Time entries, projects, clients and time reports of a Toggl Track user.

params.name: include_archived

params.name: since
params.description: Only projects changed since this moment, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds, deleted ones included.

tools.name: List clients
tools.description: Lists the clients of every workspace of the user, with their id, name, notes, archived flag and the workspace id in wid. This route counts against the 30 requests per hour that Toggl gives each user for user-level routes, on any plan.

tools.name: Create client

params.name: workspace_id

params.name: name

params.name: workspace_id

params.name: name

params.name: client_id
params.description: Id of the client, from List clients.

params.name: billable

params.name: end_date

params.description: End of the project timeframe, as yyyy-MM-dd.

tools.name: List time entries
tools.description: Lists the latest time entries of the connected user, up to 1000. For a window, send start_date and end_date together; for whole periods or other people, use Get summary report. This route counts against the 30 requests per hour that Toggl gives each user for user-level routes, on any plan.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Only entries that start from this moment, as yyyy-MM-dd or a full RFC 3339 timestamp. Goes with end_date.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Only entries that start until this moment, as yyyy-MM-dd or a full RFC 3339 timestamp. A date alone means midnight, so use 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z to cover the whole day. Goes with start_date.

params.name: before
params.description: Only entries that start before this date, as yyyy-MM-dd or a full RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: since
params.description: Only entries changed since this moment, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds, deleted ones included.

params.name: meta
params.description: True to add the project, client and tag names to each entry.

tools.name: Get current time entry
tools.description: Returns the running time entry of the connected user, with its id, or null when no timer is running. This route counts against the 30 requests per hour that Toggl gives each user for user-level routes, on any plan.

tools.name: Create time entry
tools.description: Creates a time entry for the connected user. Requires workspace, workspace_id, created_with and start. For a running timer, send duration -1; for past work, send duration in seconds or stop.

params.name: workspace
params.description: Id of the workspace: the default_workspace_id from Get me, the workspace_id of a project from List projects, or the wid of a client from List clients. Send it in workspace_id too.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: The same workspace id as workspace, from Get me, List projects or List clients. Toggl asks for it in the path and in the body.

params.name: created_with
params.description: Name of the application creating the entry, such as the name of your app. Toggl requires it.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the entry, in UTC, as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

params.name: duration
params.description: Duration in seconds. A negative value, preferably -1, starts a running timer.

params.name: stop
params.description: End of the entry, in UTC, as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. With duration, it must match start plus duration.

params.name: description
params.description: What was done.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tag names. A name that does not exist yet becomes a new tag.

params.name: billable
params.description: True when the time is billable. Paid plans only.

tools.name: Update time entry
tools.description: Updates the fields sent of a time entry and keeps the others. Requires workspace and workspace_id. Changing start or stop changes the duration.

params.name: workspace
params.description: Id of the workspace: the default_workspace_id from Get me, the workspace_id of a project from List projects, or the wid of a client from List clients. Send it in workspace_id too.

params.description: The same workspace id as workspace, from Get me, List projects or List clients. Toggl asks for it in the path and in the body.

params.name: time_entry_id

params.name: start

params.name: stop
params.description: New end, in UTC, as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

params.name: duration
params.description: New duration, in seconds.

params.name: description
params.description: New description.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tag names to add or to remove, as tag_action says.

params.name: tag_action
params.description: Whether the names in tags are added to the entry or removed from it.

params.name: billable
params.description: True when the time is billable. Paid plans only.

tools.name: Stop time entry
tools.description: Stops a running time entry now.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Id of the workspace: the default_workspace_id from Get me, the workspace_id of a project from List projects, or the wid of a client from List clients.

params.name: time_entry_id
params.description: Id of the running time entry, from Get current time entry.

tools.name: Delete time entry
tools.description: Deletes a time entry.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Id of the workspace: the default_workspace_id from Get me, the workspace_id of a project from List projects, or the wid of a client from List clients.

params.name: time_entry_id
params.description: Id of the time entry, from List time entries or Get current time entry.

tools.name: Get summary report
tools.description: Returns the tracked time of a workspace in a period, in seconds, grouped by project, client or user and sub-grouped, for everyone the user can see. Requires start_date. The groups and sub-groups bring ids, whose names come from List projects and List clients.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Id of the workspace: the default_workspace_id from Get me, the workspace_id of a project from List projects, or the wid of a client from List clients.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the period, as yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last day of the period, as yyyy-MM-dd, included.

params.name: grouping
params.description: What the groups are: projects (the default), clients or users.

params.name: sub_grouping
params.description: What each group is split by: time_entries (the default), tasks, projects, clients or users, never the same as grouping.

params.name: project_ids
params.description: Only these projects, by id from List projects.

params.name: client_ids
params.description: Only these clients, by id from List clients.

params.name: description
params.description: Only entries whose description matches this text.

params.name: billable
params.description: True for billable time only, false for non-billable only. Paid plans only.

tools.name: Get me
tools.description: Returns the connected user: id, fullname, email, timezone and default_workspace_id, the workspace that Create client, Create project and the time entry tools ask for when the account has no project or client yet. Counts against the fixed quota of 30 calls per hour of the user routes. The api_token field of the response comes back masked.

name: Typeform

params.name: page

params.name: workspace_id

params.name: sort_by

params.name: order_by
params.description: Ascending or descending order of sort_by.

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results, starting at 1.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page, 10 by default and up to 200.

params.name: form_id
params.description: Id of the form, from List forms or from the form URL: u6nXL7 in https://mysite.typeform.com/to/u6nXL7.

tools.name: Create form
tools.description: Creates a form in a workspace and returns it with its id, field ids and the public link in _links.display. Images in fields and screens must already exist in the account.

params.name: title

params.name: workspace
params.description: Workspace that holds the form: the self.href of a workspace from List workspaces, like https://api.typeform.com/workspaces/Aw33bz.

params.name: page_size

params.name: since

params.name: until
