params.description: Maximum number of projects to return, as a number such as 20.

params.name: from
params.description: For the next page, the pagination.next of the previous response.

tools.name: Create project
tools.description: Creates a project and returns it, with its id. With gitRepository, every push to the repository deploys automatically; the Vercel app of the Git provider must have access to the repository. Build settings left out are detected by Vercel.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of a team from List teams, to create the project in that team. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the project, also used in its vercel.app address.

params.name: gitRepository
params.description: Git repository to connect.

params.name: framework
params.description: Framework preset, such as nextjs, vite, astro, nuxtjs, sveltekit or remix.

params.name: rootDirectory
params.description: Folder of the repository with the source of the project. The default is the root.

params.name: buildCommand
params.description: Build command.

params.name: installCommand
params.description: Install command.

params.name: outputDirectory
params.description: Folder the build writes the site to.

tools.name: Update project
tools.description: Changes the name or the build settings of a project and returns it. Only the fields sent change. The new settings apply from the next deployment.

params.name: idOrName
params.description: The id or the name of the project, from List projects.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the project. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the project.

params.name: framework
params.description: Framework preset, such as nextjs, vite, astro, nuxtjs, sveltekit or remix.

params.name: rootDirectory
params.description: Folder of the repository with the source of the project.

params.name: buildCommand
params.description: Build command.

params.name: installCommand
params.description: Install command.

params.name: outputDirectory
params.description: Folder the build writes the site to.

params.name: nodeVersion
params.description: Node.js version of the builds and functions.

tools.name: List deployments
tools.description: Lists deployments, newest first, with state, target, url and Git metadata. Each item has uid, the id of the deployment. Paginate passing pagination.next of the response as until.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of a team from List teams, to act on that team. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Only deployments of this project: its id or name, from List projects.

params.name: target
params.description: Only deployments of this environment, such as production or preview.

params.name: state
params.description: Comma-separated states: BUILDING, ERROR, INITIALIZING, QUEUED, READY, CANCELED or BLOCKED. Example: BUILDING,READY.

params.name: branch
params.description: Only deployments of this Git branch.

params.name: sha
params.description: Only deployments of this Git commit.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of deployments to return.

params.name: since
params.description: Only deployments created after this time, in milliseconds since 1970.

params.name: until
params.description: Only deployments created before this time, in milliseconds since 1970. For the next page, the pagination.next of the previous response.

tools.name: Get deployment
tools.description: Returns a deployment by its id or its url, with readyState, target, alias, projectId and, for a failed build, errorCode and errorMessage.

params.name: idOrUrl
params.description: The uid of the deployment from List deployments, or its hostname, such as my-site-abc123.vercel.app.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the deployment. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: withGitRepoInfo
params.description: Send true to add gitSource, with the commit, branch and repository.

tools.name: Create deployment
tools.description: Starts a deployment and returns it, with id, url and readyState. Send deploymentId to redeploy an existing deployment, or gitSource to deploy a branch or commit of the connected repository. Without target it is a preview; production makes it the production deployment. The build takes minutes: follow it with Get deployment.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the project. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the project, from List projects.

params.name: project
params.description: The id or name of the project, from List projects. When sent, it wins over name.

params.name: deploymentId
params.description: The uid of an existing deployment from List deployments, to build it again with the same settings.

params.name: withLatestCommit
params.description: With deploymentId, builds the latest commit of the branch instead of the original one.

params.name: gitSource
params.description: Branch or commit to deploy. For github send org and repo, for gitlab send projectId, and for bitbucket send owner and slug.

params.name: target
params.description: production, staging or the slug of a custom environment. Omit it for a preview.

params.name: forceNew
params.description: Send 1 to build even when an identical deployment already exists.

tools.name: Cancel deployment
tools.description: Stops a deployment that is still queued or building, and returns it with readyState CANCELED.

params.name: id
params.description: The uid of the deployment, from List deployments.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the deployment. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

tools.name: Promote deployment
tools.description: Points the production domains of a project to an existing deployment, without building it again, such as to roll production back to an older production deployment. To put a preview in production with a new build, use Create deployment with its deploymentId and target production. Answers 201 or 202 when accepted.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The id of the project, from List projects.

params.name: deploymentId
params.description: The uid of the deployment to put in production, from List deployments.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the project. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

tools.name: List deployment events
tools.description: Returns the build log of a deployment as a list of events, each with type (such as stdout, stderr or command), created and the text of the line. Use it to see why a build failed.

params.name: idOrUrl
params.description: The uid of the deployment from List deployments, or its hostname.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the deployment. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: direction
params.description: forward for the oldest lines first (the default), backward for the newest first.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events. -1 returns the whole log.

params.name: since
params.description: Only events after this time, in milliseconds since 1970.

params.name: until
params.description: Only events before this time, in milliseconds since 1970.

tools.name: List project domains
tools.description: Lists the domains of a project, with verified, the redirect and the Git branch of each. Paginate passing pagination.next of the response as until.

params.name: idOrName
params.description: The id or the name of the project, from List projects.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the project. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: production
params.description: Send true for only the production domains.

params.name: verified
params.description: Only verified, or only unverified, domains.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of domains, up to 100.

params.name: until
params.description: Only domains added before this time, in milliseconds since 1970. For the next page, the pagination.next of the previous response.

tools.name: Create project domain
tools.description: Adds a domain to a project and returns it with verified. Then point the DNS of the domain to Vercel, as Get domain config shows. With verified false, the domain is in use elsewhere: create the TXT record listed in verification and verify it in the Vercel dashboard. A domain already in the project answers 400.

params.name: idOrName
params.description: The id or the name of the project, from List projects.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the project. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: name
params.description: The domain, such as www.example.com.

params.name: redirect
params.description: Another domain of the project that this one redirects to.

params.name: redirectStatusCode
params.description: HTTP status of the redirect.

params.name: gitBranch
params.description: Git branch whose preview deployments the domain shows, instead of production.

tools.name: Get domain config
tools.description: Tells whether the DNS of a domain points to Vercel: misconfigured, configuredBy, and the recommendedIPv4 and recommendedCNAME values to set at the DNS provider.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain, such as www.example.com, from List project domains.

params.name: teamId
params.description: With a Full Account token, the id of the team from List teams that owns the domain. Omit it for the personal account or with a team token.

params.name: projectIdOrName
params.description: The id or name of the project from List projects, for a domain not added to a project yet.

name: Vimeo
description: Videos, play counts, folders and comments of the Vimeo account that was connected.

tools.name: List videos
tools.description: Lists the videos the connected user uploaded, with uri, name, description, link, duration, privacy, parent_folder, tags, embed code and stats.plays, the play count. The id of a video is the number at the end of its uri. Pagination by page: the list ends when paging.next is null. Send fields to get a smaller answer and twice the rate limit.

params.name: query
params.description: Text searched in the title, description, chapters and tags of the videos.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the videos. likes and plays only work with direction desc.

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the order.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Videos per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return, with dots for nested ones, like uri,name,link,duration,stats.plays,parent_folder.name. Vimeo doubles the rate limit of calls that send it.

tools.name: Get video
tools.description: Returns one video: name, description, link, duration, dimensions, privacy, status, parent_folder, tags, embed code, thumbnails and stats.plays, the play count. Send fields to get a smaller answer and twice the rate limit.

params.name: video_id
params.description: Id of the video: the number at the end of its uri in List videos, or the first number after vimeo.com/ in the URL of the video.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return, with dots for nested ones, like name,description,privacy.view,stats.plays. Vimeo doubles the rate limit of calls that send it.

tools.name: Update video
tools.description: Updates the title, description, privacy or license of a video of the connected user and returns it. Fields left out keep their value. Some privacy options, like password and team, depend on the plan of the account.

params.name: video_id
params.description: Id of the video: the number at the end of its uri in List videos, or the first number after vimeo.com/ in the URL of the video.

params.name: name
params.description: New title of the video, up to 128 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: New description of the video, up to 5000 characters.

params.name: privacy
params.description: Who can watch, embed, comment on and download the video. Only the fields sent change.

params.name: password
params.description: Password of the video, up to 32 characters. Required when privacy.view is password.

params.name: license
params.description: Creative Commons license of the video.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Lists the folders of the connected user, with uri, name, link, dates and the number of videos in metadata.connections.videos.total. The id of a folder is the number at the end of its uri. Pagination by page: the list ends when paging.next is null.

params.name: query
params.description: Text searched in the names of the folders.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the folders.

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the order.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Folders per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a folder for the connected user and returns it with its uri. Without parent_folder_uri it is a top-level folder; folders nest up to 10 levels.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the folder.

params.name: parent_folder_uri
params.description: The uri of the folder that will hold the new one, like /users/12345/projects/67890, from List folders.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Renames a folder of the connected user and returns it.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the folder: the number at the end of its uri in List folders.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the folder.

tools.name: List folder videos
tools.description: Lists the videos of a folder, with uri, name, description, link, duration, privacy, tags and stats.plays, the play count. Pagination by page: the list ends when paging.next is null. Send fields to get a smaller answer and twice the rate limit.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the folder: the number at the end of its uri in List folders.

params.name: include_subfolders
params.description: Also returns the videos of the subfolders.

params.name: query
params.description: Text searched in the title, description, chapters and tags of the videos.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the videos.

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the order.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Videos per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return, with dots for nested ones, like uri,name,link,stats.plays. Vimeo doubles the rate limit of calls that send it.

tools.name: Move video to folder
tools.description: Puts a video in a folder of the connected user, who must own the folder. Answers 204 with no body when it works.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Id of the folder: the number at the end of its uri in List folders.

params.name: video_id
params.description: Id of the video: the number at the end of its uri in List videos, or the first number after vimeo.com/ in the URL of the video.

tools.name: List video comments
tools.description: Lists the comments of a video, with uri, text, author, date and the number of replies in metadata.connections.replies.total. The id of a comment is the number at the end of its uri. Pagination by page: the list ends when paging.next is null.

params.name: video_id
params.description: Id of the video: the number at the end of its uri in List videos, or the first number after vimeo.com/ in the URL of the video.

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the order by date.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Comments per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

tools.name: Create comment reply
tools.description: Replies to a comment of a video as the connected user and returns the reply, which is public like any comment of the video.

params.name: video_id
params.description: Id of the video: the number at the end of its uri in List videos, or the first number after vimeo.com/ in the URL of the video.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Id of the comment: the number at the end of its uri in List video comments.

params.name: text
params.description: Text of the reply.

name: Webex
description: Spaces, messages, meetings and recordings of a Webex user.

tools.name: List rooms
tools.description: Lists the spaces the user is in, with id and title; in a 1:1 space the title is the other person. Webex pages with a Link header that this connection does not return, so ask for up to 1000 spaces at once with max.

params.name: type
params.description: direct for 1:1 spaces, group for group spaces.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Order of the spaces. lastactivity puts the most recently active first.

params.name: max
params.description: Spaces in the response, up to 1000.

tools.name: Create room
tools.description: Creates a group space with the user as its first member and returns it with its id. Add people with Create membership.

params.name: title
params.description: Name of the space.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the space. Required when isPublic is true.

params.name: isLocked
params.description: true makes the space moderated, with the user as moderator.

params.name: isPublic
params.description: true lets anyone in the organization find and join the space.

tools.name: Create membership
tools.description: Adds a person to a space by email, optionally as a moderator, and returns the membership. The user must be able to add people to that space.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Id of the space, from List rooms or Create room.

params.name: personEmail
params.description: Email address of the person to add.

params.name: isModerator
params.description: true makes the person a moderator of the space.

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: Lists the messages of a space, newest first. Webex pages with a Link header that this connection does not return: for older messages, call again with before set to the created of the oldest message received.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Id of the space, from List rooms.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Only the replies to this message, the id of a message from List messages.

params.name: mentionedPeople
params.description: Send me to list only the messages that mention the user.

params.name: before
params.description: Only messages sent before this moment, ISO 8601.

params.name: beforeMessage
params.description: Only messages sent before this message, the id of a message from List messages.

params.name: max
params.description: Messages in the response.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Posts a message as the user in a space, or in a 1:1 space with the person of toPersonEmail, and returns it with its id. Send roomId or toPersonEmail, and text or markdown.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Id of the space, from List rooms or Create room.

params.name: toPersonEmail
params.description: Email address of a person, to send the message in a 1:1 space instead of roomId.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Id of the message to reply to in a thread, from List messages or Send message.

params.name: text
params.description: The message in plain text, up to 7439 bytes. With markdown it is the fallback for clients without rich text.

params.name: markdown
params.description: The message in Markdown, up to 7439 bytes.

params.name: files
params.description: Public URL of one file to attach, such as a PDF or an image.

tools.name: Update message
tools.description: Edits a message the user posted and returns it. A message takes up to 10 edits, and one with a file or card cannot be edited.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Id of the message, from Send message or List messages.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Id of the space of the message, from List rooms.

params.name: text
params.description: New text of the message, up to 7439 bytes. Send text or markdown.

params.name: markdown
params.description: New text of the message in Markdown, up to 7439 bytes.

tools.name: Delete message
tools.description: Deletes a message the user posted and answers 204 with no body.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Id of the message, from Send message or List messages.

tools.name: List meetings
tools.description: Lists the meetings of the user in a date window of up to 7 days by default, with id, title, start, end, webLink and state. Without meetingType it returns meeting series. Webex pages with a Link header that this connection does not return: narrow from and to instead.

params.name: meetingType
params.description: meetingSeries, the default, for the series; scheduledMeeting for each upcoming occurrence; meeting for meetings that already happened or are happening.

params.name: state
params.description: Only meetings in this state. An ended meeting shows up about 15 minutes after it ends.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601. The default is now, or 7 days ago for meetingType meeting.

params.name: to
params.description: End of the window, exclusive, ISO 8601. The default is 7 days after from, or now for meetingType meeting.

params.name: max
params.description: Meetings in the response, up to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: Create meeting
tools.description: Schedules a meeting hosted by the user and returns it with its id and webLink. By default Webex emails the host and the invitees.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the meeting, up to 128 characters.

params.name: start
params.description: Start, ISO 8601 with offset, in the future.

params.name: end
params.description: End, ISO 8601 with offset, after start.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone of the meeting, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: agenda
params.description: Agenda of the meeting, up to 1300 characters.

params.name: password
params.description: Password of the meeting, within the rules of the Webex site. Webex creates one when it is left out.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Recurrence rule of a meeting series in RFC 2445 format, for example FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=MO;COUNT=10.

params.name: invitees
params.description: People invited to the meeting.

params.name: sendEmail
params.description: false skips the invitation emails. The default is true.

params.name: enabledAutoRecordMeeting
params.description: true records the meeting automatically.

params.name: enabledJoinBeforeHost
params.description: true lets attendees join before the host.

params.name: joinBeforeHostMinutes
params.description: With enabledJoinBeforeHost, how many minutes before the start attendees can join.

tools.name: Update meeting
tools.description: Changes a meeting series or one scheduled occurrence and returns it. Fields left out keep their value. Changing start, end or recurrence of a series cancels its modified occurrences. A meeting in progress or ended cannot change.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Id of the meeting series or of one occurrence, from List meetings.

params.name: title
params.description: New title, up to 128 characters.

params.name: start
params.description: New start, ISO 8601 with offset, in the future.

params.name: end
params.description: New end, ISO 8601 with offset, after start.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA time zone of the meeting, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: agenda
params.description: New agenda, up to 1300 characters.

params.name: password
params.description: New password, within the rules of the Webex site.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: New recurrence rule of a series in RFC 2445 format, for example FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=MO;COUNT=10.

params.name: sendEmail
params.description: false skips the update emails to host and invitees. The default is true.

params.name: enabledAutoRecordMeeting
params.description: true records the meeting automatically.

params.name: enabledJoinBeforeHost
params.description: true lets attendees join before the host.

params.name: joinBeforeHostMinutes
params.description: With enabledJoinBeforeHost, how many minutes before the start attendees can join.

tools.name: Delete meeting
tools.description: Deletes a meeting series or one scheduled occurrence, for good, and answers 204 with no body. By default Webex emails the host and the invitees. A meeting in progress or ended cannot be deleted.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Id of the meeting series or of one occurrence, from List meetings.

params.name: sendEmail
params.description: false skips the cancellation emails. The default is true.

tools.name: Search recordings
tools.description: Lists the recordings of meetings hosted by or shared with the user, newest first, with topic, playbackUrl and downloadUrl. Narrow by meetingId or by a from and to window; Webex pages with a Link header that this connection does not return.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Only the recordings of this meeting series, occurrence or past meeting, from List meetings.

params.name: from
params.description: Only recordings created from this moment, ISO 8601.

params.name: to
params.description: Only recordings created before this moment, ISO 8601.

params.name: topic
params.description: Only recordings with this topic, ignoring case.

params.name: max
params.description: Recordings in the response, up to 100.

name: Webflow
description: Sites, CMS collections and items, and form submissions of Webflow sites.

tools.name: List sites
tools.description: Lists the sites the connection reaches, with the id that the other tools ask for as site_id and the customDomains of each site with their ids. A site token reaches only its own site.

tools.name: Publish site
tools.description: Publishes the site with all its staged changes to the chosen domains. Send customDomains, publishToWebflowSubdomain or both. Webflow allows one successful publish per minute.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites.

params.name: customDomains
params.description: Ids of the custom domains to publish to, from the customDomains of the site in List sites.

params.name: publishToWebflowSubdomain
params.description: true also publishes to the Webflow subdomain of the site.

tools.name: List collections
tools.description: Lists the CMS collections of a site, with the id that the item tools ask for as collection_id.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites.

tools.name: Get collection
tools.description: Returns a collection with its fields: the slug, type and isRequired of each one. The field slugs are the keys of fieldData in Create collection item and Update collection item.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection, from List collections.

tools.name: List collection items
tools.description: Lists the items of a collection as they are before publishing, drafts included, with fieldData keyed by field slug. The response has pagination with limit, offset and total: the last page is when offset plus limit reaches total.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection, from List collections.

params.name: name
params.description: Only the items with exactly this name.

params.name: slug
params.description: Only the item with exactly this slug.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field the items are sorted by.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order of the sort.

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: How many items to skip, for the next pages.

tools.name: Get collection item
tools.description: Returns an item of a collection as it is before publishing, with its fieldData, isDraft and isArchived.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection, from List collections.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the item, from List collection items.

tools.name: Create collection item
tools.description: Creates an item in a collection and returns it. The item is a draft unless isDraft is false, which queues it for the next site publish. To put it live right away, use Publish collection items.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection, from List collections.

params.name: fieldData
params.description: Values of the item keyed by field slug, from Get collection. name and slug are required; rich text fields take HTML, and reference fields take item ids.

params.name: isDraft
params.description: true by default. false queues the item for the next site publish.

params.name: isArchived
params.description: true creates the item archived.

tools.name: Update collection item
tools.description: Updates an item of a collection and returns it. Only the fields sent in fieldData change. Changes to an item that is already live reach the site with Publish collection items or Publish site.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection, from List collections.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Id of the item, from List collection items.

params.name: fieldData
params.description: New values keyed by field slug, from Get collection. Rich text fields take HTML, and reference fields take item ids.

params.name: isDraft
params.description: true holds the changes back as a draft. It never takes a live item off the site.

params.name: isArchived
params.description: true archives the item and false brings it back.

tools.name: Publish collection items
tools.description: Publishes items of a collection to the live site without publishing the rest of the site. Returns publishedItemIds and errors.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Id of the collection, from List collections.

params.name: itemIds
params.description: Ids of the items, from List collection items or Create collection item.

tools.name: List forms
tools.description: Lists the forms of a site with their fields, and the id that List form submissions asks for as form_id. A form inside a component counts as one form per instance. The response has pagination with limit, offset and total.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Id of the site, from List sites.

params.name: limit
params.description: Forms per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: How many forms to skip, for the next pages.

tools.name: List form submissions
tools.description: Lists the submissions of a form, with the answers in formResponse and the date in dateSubmitted. The response has pagination with limit, offset and total: the last page is when offset plus limit reaches total.

params.name: form_id
params.description: Id of the form, from List forms.

params.name: limit
params.description: Submissions per page, up to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: How many submissions to skip, for the next pages.

name: WhatsApp Cloud API
description: Business phone numbers, messages, templates and analytics of WhatsApp Business accounts on the WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta.

tools.name: List business accounts
tools.description: Lists the WhatsApp Business accounts the system user can reach, with id and name. That id is the waba_id of the other tools, which Meta now also calls the Messaging account id. The response has data and paging.cursors.after: pass it as after to read the next page.

params.name: user_id
params.description: me for the system user of the connection.

params.name: limit
params.description: Accounts per page, up to 100. The default is 25.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging.cursors.after of the previous response.

tools.name: Get business account
tools.description: Returns a WhatsApp Business account with the fields asked for, which can be account data or analytics. Without fields only id and name come back.

params.name: waba_id
params.description: Id of the WhatsApp Business account, from List business accounts.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields: id, name, timezone_id, country, account_review_status, business_verification_status. A metric takes its filters joined by dots, with Unix timestamps up to 1 year back: pricing_analytics.start(1759276800).end(1761955200).granularity(DAILY) for messages delivered and their cost, or analytics.start(1759276800).end(1761955200).granularity(DAY) for messages sent and delivered.

tools.name: List phone numbers
tools.description: Lists the business phone numbers of a WhatsApp Business account with id, display_phone_number, verified_name and quality_rating. That id is the phone_number_id of the message and profile tools. The response has data and paging.cursors.after: pass it as after to read the next page.

params.name: waba_id
params.description: Id of the WhatsApp Business account, from List business accounts.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields, for example id,display_phone_number,verified_name,status,quality_rating,messaging_limit_tier.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the numbers.

params.name: limit
params.description: Numbers per page, up to 100.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging.cursors.after of the previous response.

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Sends a message from a business phone number and returns its id in messages[0].id. Free-form types (text, image, video, document, audio) only reach someone who wrote to the number in the last 24 hours; to start a conversation, send type template with an approved template from List message templates. Meta bills messages to the account according to its WhatsApp pricing.

params.name: phone_number_id
params.description: Id of the business phone number that sends, from List phone numbers.

params.name: messaging_product
params.description: Always whatsapp.

params.name: recipient_type
params.description: individual for a person, group for a WhatsApp group of the number.

params.name: to
params.description: Phone number of the person with country code, digits only, for example 5511987654321, or the id of the group.

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of message. Send the object with the same name, such as text or template.

params.name: text
params.description: For type text.

params.name: template
params.description: For type template.

params.name: image
params.description: For type image: a JPEG or PNG at a public URL.

params.name: video
params.description: For type video: an MP4 or 3GP at a public URL.

params.name: document
params.description: For type document: a file at a public URL, such as a PDF.

params.name: audio
params.description: For type audio: an audio file at a public URL.

tools.name: List message templates
tools.description: Lists the message templates of a WhatsApp Business account with id, name, language, status, category and components. The response has data and paging.cursors.after: pass it as after to read the next page.

params.name: waba_id
params.description: Id of the WhatsApp Business account, from List business accounts.

params.name: name
params.description: Only the templates with this name.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the templates in this status. APPROVED templates are the ones that can be sent.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields, for example name,language,status,category,components,quality_score,rejected_reason.

params.name: limit
params.description: Templates per page.

params.name: after
params.description: The paging.cursors.after of the previous response.

tools.name: Create message template
tools.description: Creates a message template and submits it to Meta review, returning id, status and category. It can be sent once the status is APPROVED, which can take up to 24 hours. Variables are {{1}}, {{2}} in the POSITIONAL format or {{first_name}} in the NAMED format, and each one needs an example. An image, video or document header needs a file handle from an upload, which this connection does not do.

params.name: waba_id
params.description: Id of the WhatsApp Business account, from List business accounts.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the template: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only, unique per language in the account.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code of the template, for example pt_BR or en_US.

params.name: category
params.description: MARKETING for promotions, UTILITY for updates about an order or account, AUTHENTICATION for one-time codes. Meta can change the category in review.

params.name: parameter_format
params.description: How the variables are written. The default is POSITIONAL.

params.name: components
params.description: Parts of the template. BODY is required; HEADER, FOOTER and BUTTONS are optional.

tools.name: Update message template
tools.description: Edits a template and sends it to review again. Only templates in APPROVED, REJECTED or PAUSED status can be edited, and only their category and components; components replaces all the parts. An approved template takes up to 10 edits in 30 days and 1 in 24 hours, and its category cannot change.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Id of the template, from List message templates.

params.name: category
params.description: New category, for a template that is not approved.

params.name: components
params.description: All the parts of the template. BODY is required; HEADER, FOOTER and BUTTONS are optional.

tools.name: Delete message template
tools.description: Deletes a template by name, in all its languages, or only the language version whose id is hsm_id. The name of a deleted approved template cannot be used again for 30 days.

params.name: waba_id
params.description: Id of the WhatsApp Business account, from List business accounts.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the template, from List message templates.

params.name: hsm_id
params.description: Id of one language version of the template, from List message templates. Without it, every language is deleted.

tools.name: Get business profile
tools.description: Returns the business profile people see on a phone number: about, address, description, email, websites, vertical and profile_picture_url.

params.name: phone_number_id
params.description: Id of the business phone number, from List phone numbers.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields. The default is all of them.

tools.name: Update business profile
tools.description: Updates the business profile of a phone number. Fields left out keep their value, and websites replaces the websites of the profile.

params.name: phone_number_id
params.description: Id of the business phone number, from List phone numbers.

params.name: messaging_product
params.description: Always whatsapp.

params.name: about
params.description: Short text shown under the name, up to 139 characters.

params.name: address
params.description: Address of the business, up to 256 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the business, up to 256 characters.

params.name: email
params.description: Contact email of the business.

params.name: websites
params.description: Up to 2 websites, with http or https.

params.name: vertical
params.description: Industry of the business.

name: Wise
description: Profiles, balances, transfers and account activity of a Wise account, read only.

tools.name: List profiles
tools.description: Lists the profiles of the account, personal and business. The id of each one is the profile_id the other tools ask for, and type says PERSONAL or BUSINESS.

tools.name: List balances
tools.description: Lists the currency balances of a profile, each with id, currency, amount (available), reservedAmount, cashAmount and totalWorth.

params.name: profile_id
params.description: Id of the profile, from List profiles.

params.name: types
params.description: Balance types, comma-separated: STANDARD for the currency balances and SAVINGS for the jars, like STANDARD or STANDARD,SAVINGS.

tools.name: Get total funds
tools.description: Returns the total of a profile across all its balances, converted to one currency: totalWorth, totalAvailable (overdraft included), totalCash and overdraft.

params.name: profile_id
params.description: Id of the profile, from List profiles.

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO 4217 code every value is converted to, like BRL or USD.

tools.name: List transfers
tools.description: Lists the transfers of a profile, with status, source and target amounts and currencies, rate, reference and dates. Page with limit and offset: a page shorter than limit is the last one.

params.name: profile
params.description: Id of the profile, from List profiles. Without it, the personal profile.

params.name: status
params.description: Statuses, comma-separated: incoming_payment_waiting, incoming_payment_initiated, processing, funds_converted, outgoing_payment_sent, cancelled, funds_refunded, bounced_back, charged_back or unknown.

params.name: sourceCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency sent.

params.name: targetCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency received.

params.name: createdDateStart
params.description: Transfers created on this date or later, like 2026-10-01.

params.name: createdDateEnd
params.description: Transfers created on this date or earlier, like 2026-10-31.

params.name: limit
params.description: Transfers per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Transfers to skip, for paging.

tools.name: Get transfer
tools.description: Returns one transfer: status, source and target amounts and currencies, rate, reference, the recipient account id in targetAccount and dates.

params.name: transfer_id
params.description: Id of the transfer, from List transfers, or the resource id of a TRANSFER in List activities.

tools.name: List activities
tools.description: Lists the activity of a profile: transfers, card payments, money received, conversions, fees and more, each with title, description, primaryAmount, status, dates and the resource it refers to. Ten per page by default: pass the cursor of the response as nextCursor to read the next page.

params.name: profile_id
params.description: Id of the profile, from List profiles.

params.name: monetaryResourceType
params.description: Only the activities of this kind, like TRANSFER or CARD_TRANSACTION.

params.name: status
params.description: Only the activities in this status.

params.name: since
params.description: Activities after this moment, in ISO 8601, like 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: until
params.description: Activities until this moment, in ISO 8601.

params.name: nextCursor
params.description: The cursor of the previous response, sent with the same filters.

params.name: size
params.description: Activities per page, up to 100. The default is 10.

tools.name: List exchange rates
tools.description: Returns Wise exchange rates: the current rate of every pair without arguments, of one pair with source and target, a past rate with time, or the history of a pair between from and to, grouped by group.

params.name: source
params.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency sent, like USD.

params.name: target
params.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency received, like BRL.

params.name: time
params.description: Moment of a past rate, as date and time, like 2026-10-13T14:53:01 or 2026-10-13T14:53:01-0300.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the history, as a date or a date and time, like 2026-09-01.

params.name: to
params.description: End of the history, in the same formats as from.

params.name: group
params.description: Interval of each point of the history.

name: Wistia
description: Media, folders and viewing analytics of a Wistia account.

tools.name: List medias
tools.description: Lists the media of the account (videos, audio, images and documents) with hashed_id, name, type, status, duration in seconds, folder, subfolder, thumbnail and dates. The hashed_id is the id the other tools ask for. Pagination by page: the list ends when a page brings fewer items than per_page.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: Only the media of this folder: its hashed_id, from List folders.

params.name: name
params.description: Only the media whose name is exactly this text.

params.name: type
params.description: Only the media of this type.

params.name: archived
params.description: true returns only archived media, false only active media. Omit it for both.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort by.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: 1 is ascending, the default, and 0 descending.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Media per page, up to 100, which is also the default.

tools.name: Get media
tools.description: Returns one media: name, type, status, duration in seconds, description, folder, subfolder, tags, thumbnail, the files in assets and dates.

params.name: media_hashed_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the media, from List medias, like 4d23503f70.

tools.name: Update media
tools.description: Updates the name, description or tags of a media and returns it. Fields left out keep their value, but tags replaces the whole list of tags of the media.

params.name: media_hashed_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the media, from List medias, like 4d23503f70.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the media.

params.name: description
params.description: New description of the media, in plain text or Markdown.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tag names of the media. They replace all the current tags, so send the ones to keep too.

tools.name: Move medias
tools.description: Moves up to 100 media to a folder, or to a subfolder of that folder. Wistia runs the move in the background and answers with a background job status. This call is limited to 10 per 5 minutes, apart from the general limit.

params.name: hashed_ids
params.description: The hashed_id of each media to move, from List medias, up to 100.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the destination folder, from List folders.

params.name: subfolder_id
params.description: The hashed_id of a subfolder of that folder, from List subfolders. Without it the media go to the default subfolder of the folder.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Lists the shared folders of the account with hashed_id, name, description, media_count, public flag and dates. The My Library folders of each user are not included. Pagination by page: the list ends when a page brings fewer items than per_page.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort by.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: 1 is ascending, the default, and 0 descending.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Folders per page, up to 100, which is also the default.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a shared folder in the account, owned by the Account Owner, and returns it with its hashed_id.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the folder.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the folder.

params.name: public
params.description: Whether the folder has a public page that anyone with the link can open.

params.name: anonymousCanUpload
params.description: Whether people without a Wistia login can upload media to the folder.

params.name: anonymousCanDownload
params.description: Whether people without a Wistia login can download media of the folder.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Updates the name, description or access of a folder and returns it. Fields left out keep their value.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the folder, from List folders.

params.name: name
params.description: New name of the folder.

params.name: description
params.description: New description of the folder.

params.name: public
params.description: Whether the folder has a public page that anyone with the link can open.

params.name: anonymousCanUpload
params.description: Whether people without a Wistia login can upload media to the folder.

params.name: anonymousCanDownload
params.description: Whether people without a Wistia login can download media of the folder.

tools.name: List subfolders
tools.description: Lists the subfolders of a folder with hashed_id, name, description, position and dates. Pagination by page: the list ends when a page brings fewer items than per_page.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the folder, from List folders.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort by. The default is position, the order shown in Wistia.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: 1 is ascending, the default, and 0 descending.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Subfolders per page, up to 100, which is also the default.

tools.name: Get account analytics
tools.description: Returns the totals of the whole account in a date range: plays, unique plays, unique loads, play_rate and engagement_rate (from 0 to 1), played_time in seconds, unique visitors and form conversions. The range goes up to 2 years.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, included.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Day after the last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD: it is excluded, so October is 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01.

tools.name: List top content
tools.description: Ranks the media, channels or folders of the account by a metric in a date range, with plays, play_rate, engagement_rate, played_time in seconds and unique visitors of each one, like the most played videos of last month. The range goes up to 2 years.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, included.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Day after the last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD: it is excluded, so October is 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01.

params.name: group_by
params.description: What to rank: media, the default, channels or folders (project).

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Metric of the ranking. The default is plays.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Direction of the ranking. The default is desc.

params.name: per_page
params.description: How many items to return, up to 1000. The default is 10.

tools.name: Get media analytics
tools.description: Returns the totals of one video in a date range: plays, unique plays, unique loads, play_rate and engagement_rate (from 0 to 1), played_time in seconds, unique visitors, call to action impressions and conversions, and form conversions. The range goes up to 2 years.

params.name: media_hashed_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the video, from List medias, like 4d23503f70.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, included.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Day after the last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD: it is excluded, so October is 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01.

tools.name: Get media analytics timeseries
tools.description: Returns the metrics of one video bucket by bucket in a date range, by day, week or month: a list with timestamp, plays, unique plays and loads, play_rate, engagement_rate, played_time in seconds, unique visitors and conversions. The range goes up to 2 years.

params.name: media_hashed_id
params.description: The hashed_id of the video, from List medias, like 4d23503f70.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, included.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Day after the last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD: it is excluded, so October is 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Size of each bucket.

name: WordPress.com
description: Posts, pages, comments and stats of a WordPress.com site, or of a self-hosted site connected with Jetpack.

tools.name: List sites
tools.description: Lists the sites of the account, with the ID that the other tools ask for as site, the name and the URL. The connection reaches only the site the client chose when authorizing it.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return for each site, like ID,name,URL, to keep the answer short. Omit it to return every field.

tools.name: List posts
tools.description: Lists the posts or pages of a site, newest first, with found as the total. Only published ones by default; status lists the others. To read the next page, pass the meta.next_page of the response as page_handle.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: type
params.description: post by default, page for pages, or any for both.

params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated statuses to list, among publish, private, draft, pending, future and trash, or any. The default is publish.

params.name: search
params.description: Text to search for in the posts.

params.name: category
params.description: Only the posts of this category, by name or slug, from List categories.

params.name: tag
params.description: Only the posts with this tag, by name or slug.

params.name: after
params.description: Only posts dated after this moment.

params.name: before
params.description: Only posts dated before this moment.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field the posts are sorted by. The default is date.

params.name: order
params.description: DESC, the default, is newest first; ASC is oldest first.

params.name: number
params.description: Posts per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page_handle
params.description: The meta.next_page of the previous response, sent with the same filters.

tools.name: Get post
tools.description: Returns a post or page with its title, content, excerpt, status, URL, categories and tags.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post or page, from List posts or Create post.

params.name: context
params.description: display, the default, returns the content as shown on the site; edit returns it as it is edited, with the shortcodes unparsed.

tools.name: Create post
tools.description: Creates a post or page and returns it. The default status is publish, which puts it live right away: send draft to save it unpublished. Once published, it is also shared on the social accounts connected to the site, unless publicize is false.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: type
params.description: post, the default, or page.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the post.

params.name: content
params.description: Content of the post, in HTML.

params.name: excerpt
params.description: Short summary of the post.

params.name: status
params.description: publish, the default, puts the post live; draft saves it unpublished; pending waits for review; private publishes it only for the site members; future schedules it for date.

params.name: date
params.description: Date of the post. With status future, the moment it goes live.

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma-separated category names or IDs, from List categories.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated tag names.

params.name: slug
params.description: Part of the URL of the post.

params.name: publicize
params.description: false keeps the post from being shared on the social accounts connected to the site. The default is true.

params.name: publicize_message
params.description: Custom message for the social share.

tools.name: Update post
tools.description: Updates a post or page and returns it. Only the fields sent change. When editing a draft, also send status draft, so the change never publishes it. status trash sends the post to the trash.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post or page, from List posts or Create post.

params.name: title
params.description: New title of the post.

params.name: content
params.description: New content of the post, in HTML.

params.name: excerpt
params.description: New short summary of the post.

params.name: status
params.description: publish puts the post live; draft keeps it unpublished; pending waits for review; private publishes it only for the site members; future schedules it for date; trash sends it to the trash.

params.name: date
params.description: Date of the post. With status future, the moment it goes live.

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma-separated category names or IDs, from List categories.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated tag names.

params.name: slug
params.description: New part of the URL of the post.

params.name: publicize
params.description: false keeps the post from being shared on the social accounts connected to the site when it is published. The default is true.

params.name: publicize_message
params.description: Custom message for the social share.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Lists the categories of a site with their ID, name, slug and post_count, sorted by name. Create post and Update post take the category names or IDs.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: search
params.description: Only the categories whose name or slug match this text.

params.name: number
params.description: Categories to return, up to 1000. The default is 100.

tools.name: List comments
tools.description: Lists the comments of a site, newest first, with found as the total and the post of each comment in post. Only approved ones by default; status unapproved lists the moderation queue. The last page is when page times number reaches found.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: status
params.description: approved, the default, lists the public comments; unapproved the moderation queue; spam and trash those folders; all every comment.

params.name: after
params.description: Only comments made on or after this moment.

params.name: before
params.description: Only comments made on or before this moment.

params.name: order
params.description: DESC, the default, is newest first; ASC is oldest first.

params.name: number
params.description: Comments per page, up to 100. The default is 20.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to return, starting at 1.

tools.name: Update comment
tools.description: Moderates or edits a comment and returns it. status approved publishes it, unapproved sends it back to the moderation queue, spam marks it as spam and trash sends it to the trash.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: ID of the comment, from List comments.

params.name: status
params.description: New moderation status. unspam and untrash bring the comment back from spam and from the trash.

params.name: content
params.description: New text of the comment, in HTML.

tools.name: Create comment reply
tools.description: Replies to a comment as the connected user and returns the reply, which is public on the site.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: ID of the comment to reply to, from List comments.

params.name: content
params.description: Text of the reply, in HTML.

tools.name: Get stats summary
tools.description: Returns the views, visitors, likes and comments of a site over the last num periods up to date, and the total of followers.

params.name: site
params.description: ID of the site, from List sites, or its domain, like example.wordpress.com.

params.name: period
params.description: Unit of the window. The default is day.

params.name: num
params.description: How many periods the window has, ending at date. The default is 1.

params.name: date

name: Wrike
description: Folders, projects, tasks and task comments of a Wrike account.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Lists the spaces, folders and projects of the account. Without filters it returns the whole folder tree, with the id, title, childIds and scope of each item, the root folder of the account included (scope WsRoot). Any filter returns a flat list with the full fields, including the status and dates of projects, up to 1000 per page.

params.name: project
params.description: True to return only projects, false to return only folders.

params.name: title
params.description: Only folders whose title contains this text.

params.name: permalink
params.description: Permalink of a folder or project, as Wrike shows it, to find that one.

params.name: owners
params.description: Only projects owned by any of these users: JSON array of user ids from List contacts, such as ["KUAJ25LC"].

params.name: customStatuses
params.description: Only projects in these custom statuses: JSON array of custom status ids from List workflows.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Project start date filter: JSON object with an exact date in equal, or a range in start and end, as yyyy-MM-dd with an optional THH:mm:ss, such as {"start":"2026-11-01","end":"2026-11-30"}.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Project end date filter: JSON object with an exact date in equal, or a range in start and end, as yyyy-MM-dd with an optional THH:mm:ss, such as {"start":"2026-11-01","end":"2026-11-30"}.

params.name: completedDate
params.description: Project completion date filter: JSON object with an exact date in equal, or a range in start and end, as yyyy-MM-dd with an optional THH:mm:ss, such as {"start":"2026-11-01","end":"2026-11-30"}.

params.name: updatedDate
params.description: Updated date filter: JSON object with start and end in UTC, as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, such as {"start":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"}.

params.name: deleted
params.description: True to list the folders in the Recycle Bin instead.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Folders per page, up to 1000. Works only with a filter.

params.name: nextPageToken
params.description: The nextPageToken of the previous response, to fetch the next page. Send the same filters again.

params.name: fields
params.description: JSON array of optional fields to add to each folder, such as ["description","customFields"].

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a folder inside a space, folder or project, or a project when project is sent. Requires title. Lists and objects go as JSON text.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of the space, folder or project that will hold it, from List folders. The root folder of the account (scope WsRoot) creates it at the top level.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the folder or project.

params.name: description
params.description: Description, in plain text or in the limited HTML that Wrike accepts.

params.name: shareds
params.description: Users to share it with, besides the author: JSON array of user ids from List contacts, such as ["KUAJ25LC"].

params.name: project
params.description: JSON object that makes the new folder a project: ownerIds (user ids from List contacts), status (Green, Yellow, Red, Completed, OnHold or Cancelled), customStatusId (a project custom status id from List workflows, instead of status), startDate and endDate as yyyy-MM-dd, budget and contractType (Billable or NonBillable). Example: {"ownerIds":["KUAJ25LC"],"status":"Green","startDate":"2026-11-03","endDate":"2026-11-28"}.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Updates the fields sent of a folder or project and keeps the others, such as the title, the project status, dates and owners, or the folders that hold it. Lists and objects go as JSON text.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Id of the folder or project, from List folders.

params.name: title
params.description: New title.

params.name: description
params.description: New description, in plain text or in the limited HTML that Wrike accepts.

params.name: addParents
params.description: Folders to also put it in: JSON array of folder ids from List folders, such as ["IEAAAAAAI4AAAAAA"].

params.name: removeParents
params.description: Folders to take it out of: JSON array of folder ids from List folders.

params.name: addShareds
params.description: Users to share it with: JSON array of user ids from List contacts, such as ["KUAJ25LC"].

params.name: removeShareds
params.description: Users to stop sharing it with: JSON array of user ids from List contacts, such as ["KUAJ25LC"].

params.name: project
params.description: JSON object with the project fields to change: ownersAdd and ownersRemove (user ids from List contacts), status (Green, Yellow, Red, Completed, OnHold or Cancelled), customStatusId (a project custom status id from List workflows), startDate and endDate as yyyy-MM-dd, budget and contractType (Billable or NonBillable). Sent on a folder, it turns the folder into a project. Example: {"status":"Completed"}.

params.name: restore
params.description: True to bring it back from the Recycle Bin.

params.name: withInvitations
params.description: Whether the owner and shared lists of the response include invited users. The API asks for it on every folder update: send false when in doubt.

params.name: descendants

params.name: title

params.name: status

params.name: updatedDate

params.description: Agenda of the meeting.

params.name: password
params.description: Passcode of the meeting. When the account requires one and none is sent, Zoom generates it.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Repetition of a type 8 meeting. type is 1 daily, 2 weekly or 3 monthly. weekly_days is a comma-separated list where 1 is Sunday and 7 is Saturday. Use end_times or end_date_time, not both.

params.name: settings
params.description: Meeting settings. approval_type 0 or 1 turns registration on, with automatic or manual approval, and 2 turns it off. Other settings of the Zoom reference also work.

tools.name: Update meeting
tools.description: Updates a meeting; only the fields sent change. With occurrence_id it changes one occurrence of a recurring meeting. Zoom accepts up to 100 updates a day per meeting.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID, from List meetings.

params.name: occurrence_id
params.description: One occurrence of a recurring meeting, from the occurrences in Get meeting. It accepts changes to agenda, start_time, duration and some settings.

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic of the meeting.

params.name: type
params.description: 2 scheduled; 1 instant; 3 recurring with no fixed time; 8 recurring with a fixed time.

params.name: start_time
params.description: New start in UTC, as 2026-03-31T12:00:00Z, or in local time together with timezone. It must be in the future.

params.name: duration
params.description: Duration in minutes.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone ID of start_time, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

params.name: agenda
params.description: Agenda of the meeting.

params.name: password
params.description: Passcode of the meeting.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Repetition of the whole series of a type 8 meeting. type is 1 daily, 2 weekly or 3 monthly. weekly_days is a comma-separated list where 1 is Sunday and 7 is Saturday. Use end_times or end_date_time, not both.

params.name: settings
params.description: Meeting settings to change. approval_type 0 or 1 turns registration on, with automatic or manual approval, and 2 turns it off. Other settings of the Zoom reference also work.

tools.name: Delete meeting
tools.description: Deletes a meeting. Without occurrence_id a recurring meeting is deleted with all of its occurrences.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID, from List meetings.

params.name: occurrence_id
params.description: Deletes only this occurrence of a recurring meeting, from the occurrences in Get meeting.

params.name: cancel_meeting_reminder
params.description: true emails the registrants about the cancellation. The default is false.

params.name: schedule_for_reminder
params.description: true emails the host and the alternative hosts about the cancellation.

tools.name: Get meeting invitation
tools.description: Returns the invitation text of a meeting, with the link and the dial-in details, ready to send to the invitees.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID, from List meetings.

tools.name: List meeting registrants
tools.description: Lists the registrants of a meeting with registration turned on. Only approved registrants come back unless status says otherwise. Needs a Pro plan or higher. Pass next_page_token to read the next page.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID, from List meetings.

params.name: status
params.description: Registration status. The default is approved.

params.name: occurrence_id
params.description: One occurrence of a recurring meeting, from the occurrences in Get meeting.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Registrants per page, up to 300. The default is 30.

params.name: next_page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response.

tools.name: Create meeting registrant
tools.description: Registers a person in a meeting with registration turned on and returns the registrant_id and the personal join_url. Zoom may email the registrant, depending on the meeting settings.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID, from List meetings.

params.name: occurrence_ids
params.description: Comma-separated occurrence IDs of a recurring meeting to register for, from the occurrences in Get meeting.

params.name: email
params.description: Email of the registrant.

params.name: first_name

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the registrant.

params.name: phone

params.name: org
params.description: Organization of the registrant.

params.name: job_title
params.description: Job title of the registrant.

params.name: comments
params.description: Questions and comments of the registrant.

params.name: custom_questions

params.name: auto_approve

tools.name: Get past meeting
tools.description: Returns the details of a meeting that already ended: start and end time, duration and participants count. Only meetings of the last year.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID from List meetings with type previous_meetings, for its latest instance, or the UUID of one instance from List recordings. A UUID that starts with / or contains // must be URL-encoded once before it is sent here.

tools.name: List past meeting participants
tools.description: Lists who joined a meeting that already ended, with join time, leave time and duration. Needs a Pro plan or higher and covers the last 15 months; meetings with a single participant are left out by default. Pass next_page_token to read the next page.

params.name: meetingId
params.description: Meeting ID from List meetings with type previous_meetings, for its latest instance, or the UUID of one instance from List recordings. A UUID that starts with / or contains // must be URL-encoded once before it is sent here.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Participants per page, up to 300. The default is 30.

params.name: next_page_token
params.description: The next_page_token of the previous response.

tools.name: List recordings
tools.description: Lists the cloud recordings of a user in a date range of up to one month, each with its files and play and download links. Without from and to it covers the current day only. Needs a Pro plan with cloud recording on. Pass next_page_token to read the next page.

params.name: userId

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, up to one month after from.

params.name: meeting_id
params.description: Only the recordings of this meeting ID, from List meetings.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Meetings per page, up to 300. The default is 30.
